verses.sa:
अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान्निर्जगन्वान्तमसो ज्योतिषागात् ।
अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्ग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः॥
verses.tr: agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvāntamaso jyotiṣāgāt agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ
verses.en: High hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

verses.sa:
स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु ।
चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः॥
verses.tr: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ
verses.en: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni! The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.

verses.sa:
विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वाञ्जातो बृहन्नभि पाति तृतीयम् ।
आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत स्वं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चन्त्यत्र॥
verses.tr: viṣṇuritthā paramamasya vidvāñjāto bṛhannabhi pāti tṛtīyam āsā yadasya payo akrata svaṃ sacetaso abhyarcantyatra
verses.en: Here, being manifested, lofty Visnu, full wise, protects his own supremest station. When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.

verses.sa:
अत उ त्वा पितुभृतो जनित्रीरन्नावृधं प्रति चरन्त्यन्नैः ।
ता ईं प्रत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि त्वं विक्षु मानुषीषु होता॥
verses.tr: ata u tvā pitubhṛto janitrīrannāvṛdhaṃ prati carantyannaiḥ tā īṃ pratyeṣi punaranyarūpā asi tvaṃ vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā
verses.en: Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase. These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.

verses.sa:
होतारं चित्ररथमध्वरस्य यज्ञस्ययज्ञस्य केतुं रुशन्तम् ।
प्रत्यर्धिं देवस्यदेवस्य मह्ना श्रिया त्व१ग्निमतिथिं जनानाम्॥
verses.tr: hotāraṃ citrarathamadhvarasya yajñasyayajñasya ketuṃ ruśantam pratyardhiṃ devasyadevasya mahnā śriyā tva1gnimatithiṃ janānām
verses.en: Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship, Sharing every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.

verses.sa:
स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभा पृथिव्याः ।
अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान्॥
verses.tr: sa tu vastrāṇyadha peśanāni vasāno agnirnābhā pṛthivyāḥ aruṣo jātaḥ pada iḻāyāḥ purohito rājanyakṣīha devān
verses.en: So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments. Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.

verses.sa:
आ हि द्यावापृथिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातरा ततन्थ ।
प्र याह्यच्छोशतो यविष्ठाऽथा वह सहस्येह देवान्॥
verses.tr: ā hi dyāvāpṛthivī agna ubhe sadā putro na mātarā tatantha pra yāhyacchośato yaviṣṭhā'thā vaha sahasyeha devān
verses.en: Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents. Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.

verses.sa:
पिप्रीहि देवाँ उशतो यविष्ठ विद्वाँ ऋतूँॠतुपते यजेह ।
ये दैव्या ऋत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने त्वं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: piprīhi devāṃ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvāṃ ṛtūṃṝtupate yajeha ye daivyā ṛtvijastebhiragne tvaṃ hotṝṇāmasyāyajiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Gladden the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons, With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.

verses.sa:
वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मन्धातासि द्रविणोदा ऋतावा ।
स्वाहा वयं कृणवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन्॥
verses.tr: veṣi hotramuta potraṃ janānāṃ mandhātāsi draviṇodā ṛtāvā svāhā vayaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi devo devānyajatvagnirarhan
verses.en: Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order. Let us with Svaha offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनु प्रवोळ्हुम् ।
अग्निर्विद्वान्त्स यजात्सेदु होता सो अध्वरान्त्स ऋतून्कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: ā devānāmapi panthāmaganma yacchaknavāma tadanu pravoḻhum agnirvidvāntsa yajātsedu hotā so adhvarāntsa ṛtūnkalpayāti
verses.en: To the Gods' pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish. Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.

verses.sa:
यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वमा पृणाति विद्वान्येभिर्देवाँ ऋतुभिः कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: yadvo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ agniṣṭadviśvamā pṛṇāti vidvānyebhirdevāṃ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti
verses.en: When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge, Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.

verses.sa:
यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः ।
अग्निष्टद्धोता क्रतुविद्विजानन्यजिष्ठो देवाँ ऋतुशो यजाति॥
verses.tr: yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ agniṣṭaddhotā kratuvidvijānanyajiṣṭho devāṃ ṛtuśo yajāti
verses.en: When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing, Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषां ह्यध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनिता त्वा जजान ।
स आ यजस्व नृवतीरनु क्षाः स्पार्हा इषः क्षुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāṃ hyadhvarāṇāmanīkaṃ citraṃ ketuṃ janitā tvā jajāna sa ā yajasva nṛvatīranu kṣāḥ spārhā iṣaḥ kṣumatīrviśvajanyāḥ
verses.en: Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner: So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा द्यावापृथिवी यं त्वापस्त्वष्टा यं त्वा सुजनिमा जजान ।
पन्थामनु प्रविद्वान्पितृयाणं द्युमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī yaṃ tvāpastvaṣṭā yaṃ tvā sujanimā jajāna panthāmanu pravidvānpitṛyāṇaṃ dyumadagne samidhāno vi bhāhi
verses.en: Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvastar, maker of fair things, created, Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.

verses.sa:
इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि ।
चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहताऽसिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन्॥
verses.tr: ino rājannaratiḥ samiddho raudro dakṣāya suṣumāṃ adarśi cikidvi bhāti bhāsā bṛhatā'siknīmeti ruśatīmapājan
verses.en: O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, all-knowing, with his lofty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.

verses.sa:
कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇāṃ yadenīmabhi varpasā bhūjjanayanyoṣāṃ bṛhataḥ piturjām ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ sūryasya stabhāyandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhāti
verses.en: Having o'ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter, Holding aloft the radiant light of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.

verses.sa:
भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् ।
सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात्॥
verses.tr: bhadro bhadrayā sacamāna āgātsvasāraṃ jāro abhyeti paścāt supraketairdyubhiragnirvitiṣṭhanruśadbhirvarṇairabhi rāmamasthāt
verses.en: Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitely shining garments.

verses.sa:
अस्य यामासो बृहतो न वग्नूनिन्धाना अग्नेः सख्युः शिवस्य ।
ईड्यस्य वृष्णो बृहतः स्वासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे॥
verses.tr: asya yāmāso bṛhato na vagnūnindhānā agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya īḍyasya vṛṣṇo bṛhataḥ svāso bhāmāso yāmannaktavaścikitre
verses.en: His goings-forth kindle as 'twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni. The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.

verses.sa:
स्वना न यस्य भामासः पवन्ते रोचमानस्य बृहतः सुदिवः ।
ज्येष्ठेभिर्यस्तेजिष्ठैः क्रीळुमद्भिर्वर्षिष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्नक्षति द्याम्॥
verses.tr: svanā na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya bṛhataḥ sudivaḥ jyeṣṭhebhiryastejiṣṭhaiḥ krīḻumadbhirvarṣiṣṭhebhirbhānubhirnakṣati dyām
verses.en: Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent, Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.

verses.sa:
अस्य शुष्मासो ददृशानपवेर्जेहमानस्य स्वनयन्नियुद्भिः ।
प्रत्नेभिर्यो रुशद्भिर्देवतमो वि रेभद्भिररतिर्भाति विभ्वा॥
verses.tr: asya śuṣmāso dadṛśānapaverjehamānasya svanayanniyudbhiḥ pratnebhiryo ruśadbhirdevatamo vi rebhadbhiraratirbhāti vibhvā
verses.en: His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted. He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.

verses.sa:
स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः ।
अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भी रभस्वाँ एह गम्याः॥
verses.tr: sa ā vakṣi mahi na ā ca satsi divaspṛthivyoraratiryuvatyoḥ agniḥ sutukaḥ sutukebhiraśvai rabhasvadbhī rabhasvāṃ eha gamyāḥ
verses.en: So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven. Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.

verses.sa:
प्र ते यक्षि प्र त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वन्द्यो नो हवेषु ।
धन्वन्निव प्रपा असि त्वमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवे प्रत्न राजन्॥
verses.tr: pra te yakṣi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yathā vandyo no haveṣu dhanvanniva prapā asi tvamagna iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan
verses.en: To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee. A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,

verses.sa:
यं त्वा जनासो अभि संचरन्ति गाव उष्णमिव व्रजं यविष्ठ ।
दूतो देवानामसि मर्त्यानामन्तर्महाँश्चरसि रोचनेन॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā janāso abhi saṃcaranti gāva uṣṇamiva vrajaṃ yaviṣṭha dūto devānāmasi martyānāmantarmahāṃścarasi rocanena
verses.en: Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful. Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.

verses.sa:
शिशुं न त्वा जेन्यं वर्धयन्ती माता बिभर्ति सचनस्यमाना ।
धनोरधि प्रवता यासि हर्यञ्जिगीषसे पशुरिवावसृष्टः॥
verses.tr: śiśuṃ na tvā jenyaṃ vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā dhanoradhi pravatā yāsi haryañjigīṣase paśurivāvasṛṣṭaḥ
verses.en: Making thee grow as 'twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection. Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.

verses.sa:
मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने त्वमङ्ग वित्से ।
शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन्रेरिह्यते युवतिं विश्पतिः सन्॥
verses.tr: mūrā amūra na vayaṃ cikitvo mahitvamagne tvamaṅga vitse śaye vavriścarati jihvayādanrerihyate yuvatiṃ viśpatiḥ san
verses.en: Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur. There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.

verses.sa:
कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः ।
अस्नातापो वृषभो न प्र वेति सचेतसो यं प्रणयन्त मर्ताः॥
verses.tr: kūcijjāyate sanayāsu navyo vane tasthau palito dhūmaketuḥ asnātāpo vṛṣabho na pra veti sacetaso yaṃ praṇayanta martāḥ
verses.en: He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling. No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.

verses.sa:
तनूत्यजेव तस्करा वनर्गू रशनाभिर्दशभिरभ्यधीताम् ।
इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथं न शुचयद्भिरङ्गैः॥
verses.tr: tanūtyajeva taskarā vanargū raśanābhirdaśabhirabhyadhītām iyaṃ te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣvā rathaṃ na śucayadbhiraṅgaiḥ
verses.en: Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him. This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत् ।
रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो३ अप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: brahma ca te jātavedo namaśceyaṃ ca gīḥ sadamidvardhanī bhūt rakṣā ṇo agne tanayāni tokā rakṣota nastanvo3 aprayucchan
verses.en: Homage and prayer are thine, O Jatavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee. Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watchful care our bodies.

verses.sa:
एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद्धृदो भूरिजन्मा वि चष्टे ।
सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्ये निहितं पदं वेः॥
verses.tr: ekaḥ samudro dharuṇo rayīṇāmasmaddhṛdo bhūrijanmā vi caṣṭe siṣaktyūdharniṇyorupastha utsasya madhye nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ
verses.en: He only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us. He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.

verses.sa:
समानं नीळं वृषणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषा अर्वतीभिः ।
ऋतस्य पदं कवयो नि पान्ति गुहा नामानि दधिरे पराणि॥
verses.tr: samānaṃ nīḻaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasānāḥ saṃ jagmire mahiṣā arvatībhiḥ ṛtasya padaṃ kavayo ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi
verses.en: Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together. The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.

verses.sa:
ऋतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयन्ती ।
विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो ध्रुवस्य कवेश्चित्तन्तुं मनसा वियन्तः॥
verses.tr: ṛtāyinī māyinī saṃ dadhāte mitvā śiśuṃ jajñaturvardhayantī viśvasya nābhiṃ carato dhruvasya kaveścittantuṃ manasā viyantaḥ
verses.en: The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him. The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय प्रदिवः सचन्ते ।
अधीवासं रोदसी वावसाने घृतैरन्नैर्वावृधाते मधूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya hi vartanayaḥ sujātamiṣo vājāya pradivaḥ sacante adhīvāsaṃ rodasī vāvasāne ghṛtairannairvāvṛdhāte madhūnām
verses.en: For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant. Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.

verses.sa:
सप्त स्वसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान्मध्व उज्जभारा दृशे कम् ।
अन्तर्येमे अन्तरिक्षे पुराजा इच्छन्वव्रिमविदत्पूषणस्य॥
verses.tr: sapta svasṝraruṣīrvāvaśāno vidvānmadhva ujjabhārā dṛśe kam antaryeme antarikṣe purājā icchanvavrimavidatpūṣaṇasya
verses.en: He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on. He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pusan.

verses.sa:
सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामेकामिदभ्यंहुरो गात् ।
आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीळे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: sapta maryādāḥ kavayastatakṣustāsāmekāmidabhyaṃhuro gāt āyorha skambha upamasya nīḻe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau
verses.en: Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal. He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.

verses.sa:
असच्च सच्च परमे व्योमन्दक्षस्य जन्मन्नदितेरुपस्थे ।
अग्निर्ह नः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वृषभश्च धेनुः॥
verses.tr: asacca sacca parame vyomandakṣasya janmannaditerupasthe agnirha naḥ prathamajā ṛtasya pūrva āyuni vṛṣabhaśca dhenuḥ
verses.en: Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Daksa's birthplace, Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.

verses.sa:
अयं स यस्य शर्मन्नवोभिरग्नेरेधते जरिताभिष्टौ ।
ज्येष्ठेभिर्यो भानुभिॠषूणां पर्येति परिवीतो विभावा॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa yasya śarmannavobhiragneredhate jaritābhiṣṭau jyeṣṭhebhiryo bhānubhiṝṣūṇāṃ paryeti parivīto vibhāvā
verses.en: This is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful; Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.

verses.sa:
यो भानुभिर्विभावा विभात्यग्निर्देवेभिॠतावाजस्रः ।
आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्योऽपरिह्वृतो अत्यो न सप्तिः॥
verses.tr: yo bhānubhirvibhāvā vibhātyagnirdevebhiṝtāvājasraḥ ā yo vivāya sakhyā sakhibhyo'parihvṛto atyo na saptiḥ
verses.en: Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours; He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.

verses.sa: ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसो व्युष्टौ । आ यस्मिन्मना हवींष्यग्नावरिष्टरथः स्कभ्नाति शूषैः॥
verses.tr: īśe yo viśvasyā devavīterīśe viśvāyuruṣaso vyuṣṭau ā yasminmanā havīṃṣyagnāvariṣṭarathaḥ skabhnāti śūṣaiḥ
verses.en: He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning, Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless.

verses.sa:
शूषेभिर्वृधो जुषाणो अर्कैर्देवाँ अच्छा रघुपत्वा जिगाति ।
मन्द्रो होता स जुह्वा३ यजिष्ठः सम्मिश्लो अग्निरा जिघर्ति देवान्॥
verses.tr: śūṣebhirvṛdho juṣāṇo arkairdevāṃ acchā raghupatvā jigāti mandro hotā sa juhvā3 yajiṣṭhaḥ sammiślo agnirā jigharti devān
verses.en: Increasing by his strength. while lauds content him, with easy flight unto the Gods he travels. Agni the cheerful Priest, best Sacrificer, balms with his tongue the Gods with whom he mingles.

verses.sa:
तमुस्रामिन्द्रं न रेजमानमग्निं गीर्भिर्नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् ।
आ यं विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्ति जातवेदसं जुह्वं सहानाम्॥
verses.tr: tamusrāmindraṃ na rejamānamagniṃ gīrbhirnamobhirā kṛṇudhvam ā yaṃ viprāso matibhirgṛṇanti jātavedasaṃ juhvaṃ sahānām
verses.en: With songs and adorations bring ye hither Agni who stirs himself at dawn like Indra, Whom sages laud with hymns as Jatavedas of those who wield the sacrificial ladle.

verses.sa:
सं यस्मिन्विश्वा वसूनि जग्मुर्वाजे नाश्वाः सप्तीवन्त एवैः ।
अस्मे ऊतीरिन्द्रवाततमा अर्वाचीना अग्न आ कृणुष्व॥
verses.tr: saṃ yasminviśvā vasūni jagmurvāje nāśvāḥ saptīvanta evaiḥ asme ūtīrindravātatamā arvācīnā agna ā kṛṇuṣva
verses.en: In whom all goodly treasures meet together, even as steeds and riders for the booty. Inclining hither bring us help, O Agni, even assistance most desired by Indra.

verses.sa:
अधा ह्यग्ने मह्ना निषद्या सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूथ ।
तं ते देवासो अनु केतमायन्नधावर्धन्त प्रथमास ऊमाः॥
verses.tr: adhā hyagne mahnā niṣadyā sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūtha taṃ te devāso anu ketamāyannadhāvardhanta prathamāsa ūmāḥ
verses.en: Yea, at thy birth, when thou hadst sat in glory, thou, Agni, wast the aim of invocations. The Gods came near, obedient to thy summons, and thus attained their rank as chief Protectors.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नो दिवो अग्ने पृथिव्या विश्वायुर्धेहि यजथाय देव ।
सचेमहि तव दस्म प्रकेतैरुरुष्या ण उरुभिर्देव शंसैः॥
verses.tr: svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyurdhehi yajathāya deva sacemahi tava dasma praketairuruṣyā ṇa urubhirdeva śaṃsaiḥ
verses.en: O AGNI, shared by all men living bring us good luck for sacrifice from earth and heaven. With us be thine intelligence, Wonder Worker! Protect us, God, with thy far-reaching blessings.

verses.sa:
इमा अग्ने मतयस्तुभ्यं जाता गोभिरश्वैरभि गृणन्ति राधः ।
यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानड्वसो दधानो मतिभिः सुजात॥
verses.tr: imā agne matayastubhyaṃ jātā gobhiraśvairabhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍvaso dadhāno matibhiḥ sujāta
verses.en: These hymns brought forth for thee, O Agni, laud thee for bounteous gifts, with cattle and with horses. Good Lord, when man from thee hath gained enjoyment, by hymns, O nobly born, hath he obtained it.

verses.sa:
अग्निं मन्ये पितरमग्निमापिमग्निं भ्रातरं सदमित्सखायम् ।
अग्नेरनीकं बृहतः सपर्यं दिवि शुक्रं यजतं सूर्यस्य॥
verses.tr: agniṃ manye pitaramagnimāpimagniṃ bhrātaraṃ sadamitsakhāyam agneranīkaṃ bṛhataḥ saparyaṃ divi śukraṃ yajataṃ sūryasya
verses.en: Agni I deem my Kinsman and my Father, count him my Brother and my Friend for ever. I honour as the face of lofty Agni in heaven the bright and holy light of Surya.

verses.sa:
सिध्रा अग्ने धियो अस्मे सनुत्रीर्यं त्रायसे दम आ नित्यहोता ।
ऋतावा स रोहिदश्वः पुरुक्षुर्द्युभिरस्मा अहभिर्वाममस्तु॥
verses.tr: sidhrā agne dhiyo asme sanutrīryaṃ trāyase dama ā nityahotā ṛtāvā sa rohidaśvaḥ purukṣurdyubhirasmā ahabhirvāmamastu
verses.en: Effectual, Agni, are our prayers for profit. He whom, at home thou, Priest for ever, guardest Is rich in food, drawn by red steeds, and holy: by day and night to him shall all be pleasant.

verses.sa:
द्युभिर्हितं मित्रमिव प्रयोगं प्रत्नमृत्विजमध्वरस्य जारम् ।
बाहुभ्यामग्निमायवोऽजनन्त विक्षु होतारं न्यसादयन्त॥
verses.tr: dyubhirhitaṃ mitramiva prayogaṃ pratnamṛtvijamadhvarasya jāram bāhubhyāmagnimāyavo'jananta vikṣu hotāraṃ nyasādayanta
verses.en: Men with their arms have generated Agni, helpful as some kind friend, adorned with splendours, And stablished as Invoker mid the people the ancient Priest the sacrifice's lover.

verses.sa:
स्वयं यजस्व दिवि देव देवान्किं ते पाकः कृणवदप्रचेताः ।
यथायज ऋतुभिर्देव देवानेवा यजस्व तन्वं सुजात॥
verses.tr: svayaṃ yajasva divi deva devānkiṃ te pākaḥ kṛṇavadapracetāḥ yathāyaja ṛtubhirdeva devānevā yajasva tanvaṃ sujāta
verses.en: Worship, thyself, O God, the Gods in heaven: what, void of knowledge, shall the fool avail thee? As thou, O God, hast worshipped Gods by seasons, so, nobly-born! to thine own self pay worship.

verses.sa:
भवा नो अग्नेऽवितोत गोपा भवा वयस्कृदुत नो वयोधाः ।
रास्वा च नः सुमहो हव्यदातिं त्रास्वोत नस्तन्वो३ अप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: bhavā no agne'vitota gopā bhavā vayaskṛduta no vayodhāḥ rāsvā ca naḥ sumaho havyadātiṃ trāsvota nastanvo3 aprayucchan
verses.en: Agni, be thou our Guardian and Protector bestow upon us life and vital vigour. Accept, O Mighty One, the gifts we offer, and with unceasing care protect our bodies.

verses.sa:
प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
दिवश्चिदन्ताँ उपमाँ उदानळपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध॥
verses.tr: pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti divaścidantāṃ upamāṃ udānaḻapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha
verses.en: Agni advances with his lofty banner: the Bull is bellowing to the earth and heavens. He hath attained the sky's supremest limits. the Steer hath waxen in the lap of waters.

verses.sa:
मुमोद गर्भो वृषभः ककुद्मानस्रेमा वत्सः शिमीवाँ अरावीत् ।
स देवतात्युद्यतानि कृण्वन्त्स्वेषु क्षयेषु प्रथमो जिगाति॥
verses.tr: mumoda garbho vṛṣabhaḥ kakudmānasremā vatsaḥ śimīvāṃ arāvīt sa devatātyudyatāni kṛṇvantsveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamo jigāti
verses.en: The Bull, the youngling with the hump, hath frolicked, the strong and never-ceasing Calf hath bellowed. Bringing our offerings to the God's assembly, he moves as Chief in his own dwelling-places.

verses.sa:
आ यो मूर्धानं पित्रोररब्ध न्यध्वरे दधिरे सूरो अर्णः ।
अस्य पत्मन्नरुषीरश्वबुध्ना ऋतस्य योनौ तन्वो जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: ā yo mūrdhānaṃ pitrorarabdha nyadhvare dadhire sūro arṇaḥ asya patmannaruṣīraśvabudhnā ṛtasya yonau tanvo juṣanta
verses.en: Him who hath grasped his Parents' head, they stablished at sacrifice a wave of heavenly lustre. In his swift flight the red Dawns borne by horses refresh their bodies in the home of Order.

verses.sa:
उषउषो हि वसो अग्रमेषि त्वं यमयोरभवो विभावा ।
ऋताय सप्त दधिषे पदानि जनयन्मित्रं तन्वे३ स्वायै॥
verses.tr: uṣauṣo hi vaso agrameṣi tvaṃ yamayorabhavo vibhāvā ṛtāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayanmitraṃ tanve3 svāyai
verses.en: For, Vasu thou precedest every Morning, and still hast been the Twins' illuminator. For sacrifice, seven places thou retainest while for thine own self thou engenderest Mitra.

verses.sa:
भुवश्चक्षुर्मह ऋतस्य गोपा भुवो वरुणो यदृताय वेषि ।
भुवो अपां नपाज्जातवेदो भुवो दूतो यस्य हव्यं जुजोषः॥
verses.tr: bhuvaścakṣurmaha ṛtasya gopā bhuvo varuṇo yadṛtāya veṣi bhuvo apāṃ napājjātavedo bhuvo dūto yasya havyaṃ jujoṣaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the Eye and Guard of mighty Order, and Varuna when to sacrifice thou comest. Thou art the Waters' Child O Jatavedas, envoy of him whose offering thou acceptest.

verses.sa:
भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः ।
दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम्॥
verses.tr: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham
verses.en: Thou art the Leader of the rite and region, to which with thine auspicious teams thou leadest, Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblationbearer, Agni.

verses.sa:
अस्य त्रितः क्रतुना वव्रे अन्तरिच्छन्धीतिं पितुरेवैः परस्य ।
सचस्यमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे जामि ब्रुवाण आयुधानि वेति॥
verses.tr: asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antaricchandhītiṃ piturevaiḥ parasya sacasyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe jāmi bruvāṇa āyudhāni veti
verses.en: Through his wise insight Trita in the cavern, seeking as ever the Chief Sire's intention, Carefully tended in his Parents' bosom, calling the weapons kin, goes forth to combat.

verses.sa:
स पित्र्याण्यायुधानि विद्वानिन्द्रेषित आप्त्यो अभ्ययुध्यत् ।
त्रिशीर्षाणं सप्तरश्मिं जघन्वान्त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिन्निः ससृजे त्रितो गाः॥
verses.tr: sa pitryāṇyāyudhāni vidvānindreṣita āptyo abhyayudhyat triśīrṣāṇaṃ saptaraśmiṃ jaghanvāntvāṣṭrasya cinniḥ sasṛje trito gāḥ
verses.en: Well-skilled to use the weapons of his Father, Aptya, urged on by Indra, fought the battle. Then Trita slew the foe seven-rayed, three-headed, and freed the cattle of the Son of Tvastar.

verses.sa:
भूरीदिन्द्र उदिनक्षन्तमोजोऽवाभिनत्सत्पतिर्मन्यमानम् ।
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिद्विश्वरूपस्य गोनामाचक्राणस्त्रीणि शीर्षा परा वर्क्॥
verses.tr: bhūrīdindra udinakṣantamojo'vābhinatsatpatirmanyamānam tvāṣṭrasya cidviśvarūpasya gonāmācakrāṇastrīṇi śīrṣā parā vark
verses.en: Lord of the brave, Indra cleft him in pieces who sought to gain much strength and deemed him mighty. He smote his three heads from his body, seizing the cattle of the omniform Son of Tvastar.

verses.sa: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन । महे रणाय चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
verses.en: Ye, Waters, are beneficent: so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.

verses.sa: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः । उशतीरिव मातरः॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ uśatīriva mātaraḥ
verses.en: Give us a portion of the sap, the most auspicious that ye have, Like mothers in their longing love.

verses.sa: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ । आपो जनयथा च नः॥
verses.tr: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpo janayathā ca naḥ
verses.en: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye send us on; And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sa: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ
verses.en: The Waters. be to us for drink, Goddesses for our aid and bliss: Let them stream to us health and strength.

verses.sa: ईशाना वार्याणां क्षयन्तीश्चर्षणीनाम् । अपो याचामि भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: īśānā vāryāṇāṃ kṣayantīścarṣaṇīnām apo yācāmi bheṣajam
verses.en: 1 beg the Floods to give us balm, these Queens who rule o'er precious things, And have supreme control of men.

verses.sa: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा । अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवम्॥
verses.tr: apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvam
verses.en: Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all.

verses.sa: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे३ मम । ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve3 mama jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.

verses.sa: इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि । यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम्॥
verses.tr: idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi yadvāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam
verses.en: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought, If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

verses.sa: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि । पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
verses.en: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come: O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

verses.sa:
ओ चित्सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवं जगन्वान् ।
पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः॥
verses.tr: o citsakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cidarṇavaṃ jaganvān piturnapātamā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ
verses.en: Fain would I win my friend to kindly friendship. So may the Sage, come through the air's wide ocean, Remembering the earth and days to follow, obtain a son, the issue of his father.

verses.sa:
न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत्सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन्॥
verses.tr: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭyetatsalakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti mahasputrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan
verses.en: Thy friend loves not the friendship which considers her who is near in kindred as stranger. Sons of the mighty Asura, the Heroes, supporters of the heavens, see far around them.

verses.sa:
उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित्त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य ।
नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्व१मा विविश्याः॥
verses.tr: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etadekasya cittyajasaṃ martyasya ni te mano manasi dhāyyasme janyuḥ patistanva1mā viviśyāḥ
verses.en: Yea, this the Immortals seek of thee with longing, progeny of the sole existing mortal. Then let thy soul and mine be knit together, and as a loving husband take thy consort.

verses.sa:
न यत्पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृता वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम ।
गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नो नाभिः परमं जामि तन्नौ॥
verses.tr: na yatpurā cakṛmā kaddha nūnamṛtā vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema gandharvo apsvapyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tannau
verses.en: Shall we do now what we ne'er did aforetime? we who spake righteously now talk impurely? Gandharva in the floods, the Dame of Waters-such is our bond, such our most lofty kinship.

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः ।
नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kardevastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ nakirasya pra minanti vratāni veda nāvasya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Even in the womb God Tvastar, Vivifier, shaping all forms, Creator, made us consorts. None violates his holy ordinances: that we are his the heavens and earth acknowledge.

verses.sa:
को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत् ।
बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन्॥
verses.tr: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kadu brava āhano vīcyā nṝn
verses.en: Who knows that earliest day whereof thou speakest? Who hath beheld it? Who can here declare it? Great is the Law of Varuna and Mitra. What, wanton! wilt thou say to men to tempt them?

verses.sa:
यमस्य मा यम्यं१ काम आगन्त्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय ।
जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद्वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा॥
verses.tr: yamasya mā yamyaṃ1 kāma āgantsamāne yonau sahaśeyyāya jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cidvṛheva rathyeva cakrā
verses.en: I, Yami, am possessed by love of Yama, that I may rest on the same couch beside him. I as a wife would yield me to my husband. Like car-wheels let us speed to meet each other.

verses.sa:
न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति ।
अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा॥
verses.tr: na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣantyete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti anyena madāhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā
verses.en: They stand not still, they never close their eyelids, those sentinels of Gods who wander round us. Not me-go quickly, wanton, with another, and hasten like a chariot wheel to meet him.

verses.sa:
रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत्सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात् ।
दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य बिभृयादजामि॥
verses.tr: rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyetsūryasya cakṣurmuhurunmimīyāt divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīryamasya bibhṛyādajāmi
verses.en: May Surya's eye with days and nights endow him, and ever may his light spread out before him. In heaven and earth the kindred Pair commingle. On Yam! be the unbrotherly act of Yama.

verses.sa:
आ घा ता गच्छानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्नजामि ।
उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत्॥
verses.tr: ā ghā tā gacchānuttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavannajāmi upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhumanyamicchasva subhage patiṃ mat
verses.en: Sure there will come succeeding times when brothers and sisters will do acts unmeet for kinsfolk. Not me, O fair one,-seek another husband, and make thine arm a pillow for thy consort.

verses.sa:
किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन्निॠतिर्निगच्छात् ।
काममूता बह्वे३तद्रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं१ सं पिपृग्धि॥
verses.tr: kiṃ bhrātāsadyadanāthaṃ bhavāti kimu svasā yanniṝtirnigacchāt kāmamūtā bahve3tadrapāmi tanvā me tanvaṃ1 saṃ pipṛgdhi
verses.en: Is he a brother when no lord is left her? Is she a sister when Destruction cometh? Forced by my love these many words I utter. Come near, and hold me in thy close embraces.

verses.sa:
न वा उ ते तन्वा तन्वं१ सं पपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात् ।
अन्येन मत्प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत्॥
verses.tr: na vā u te tanvā tanvaṃ1 saṃ papṛcyāṃ pāpamāhuryaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt anyena matpramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭyetat
verses.en: I will not fold mine arms about thy body: they call it sin when one comes near his sister. Not me,-prepare thy pleasures with another: thy brother seeks not this from thee, O fair one.

verses.sa:
बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदाम ।
अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम्॥
verses.tr: bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāma anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣyeva yuktaṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam
verses.en: Alas! thou art indeed a weakling, Yama we find in thee no trace of heart or spirit. As round the tree the woodbine clings, another will cling about thee girt as with a girdle.

verses.sa:
अन्यमू षु त्वं यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ।
तस्य वा त्वं मन इच्छा स वा तवाऽधा कृणुष्व संविदं सुभद्राम्॥
verses.tr: anyamū ṣu tvaṃ yamyanya u tvāṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam tasya vā tvaṃ mana icchā sa vā tavā'dhā kṛṇuṣva saṃvidaṃ subhadrām
verses.en: Embrace another, Yami; let another, even as the woodbine rings the tree, enfold thee. Win thou his heart and let him win thy fancy, and he shall form with thee a blest alliance.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः ।
विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजतु यज्ञियाँ ऋतून्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditeradābhyaḥ viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajatu yajñiyāṃ ṛtūn
verses.en: The Bull hath yielded for the Bull the milk of heaven: the Son of Aditi can never be deceived. According to his wisdom Varuna knoweth all: may he, the Holy, hallow times for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
रपद्गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु मे मनः ।
इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति॥
verses.tr: rapadgandharvīrapyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ iṣṭasya madhye aditirni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati
verses.en: Gandharvi spake: may she, the Lady of the flood, amid the river's roaring leave my heart untouched. May Aditi accomplish all that we desire, and may our eldest Brother tell us this as Chief.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु भद्रा क्षुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वर्वती ।
यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु क्रतुमग्निं होतारं विदथाय जीजनन्॥
verses.tr: so cinnu bhadrā kṣumatī yaśasvatyuṣā uvāsa manave svarvatī yadīmuśantamuśatāmanu kratumagniṃ hotāraṃ vidathāya jījanan
verses.en: Yea, even this blessed Morning, rich in store of food, splendid, with heavenly lustre, hath shone out for man, Since they, as was the wish of yearning Gods, brought forth that yearning Agni for the assembly as the Priest.

verses.sa:
अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषितः श्येनो अध्वरे ।
यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत॥
verses.tr: adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ virābharadiṣitaḥ śyeno adhvare yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmamāryā agniṃ hotāramadha dhīrajāyata
verses.en: And the fleet Falcon brought for sacrifice from afar this flowing Drop most excellent and keen of sight, Then when the Aryan tribes chose as Invoking Priest Agni the Wonder-Worker, and the hymn rose up.

verses.sa:
सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः ।
विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यं१ वाजं ससवाँ उपयासि भूरिभिः॥
verses.tr: sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhiragne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyaṃ1 vājaṃ sasavāṃ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ
verses.en: Still art thou kind to him who feeds thee as with grass, and, skilled in sacrifice, offers thee holy gifts. When thou, having received the sage's strengthening food with lauds, after long toil, comest with many more.

verses.sa:
उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति ।
विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती॥
verses.tr: udīraya pitarā jāra ā bhagamiyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhastaviṣyate asuro vepate matī
verses.en: Urge thou thy Parents, as a lover ' to delight: the Lovely One desires and craves it from his heart. The priest calls out, the sacrificer shows his skill, the Asura tries his strength, and with the hymn is stirred.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अक्षत्सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे ।
इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमाँ अमवान्भूषति द्यून्॥
verses.tr: yaste agne sumatiṃ marto akṣatsahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvairā sa dyumāṃ amavānbhūṣati dyūn
verses.en: Far-famed is he, the mortal man, O Agni, thou Son of Strength, who hath obtained thy favour. He, gathering power, borne onward by his horses, makes his days lovely in his might and splendour.

verses.sa:
यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र ।
रत्ना च यद्विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात्॥
verses.tr: yadagna eṣā samitirbhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra ratnā ca yadvibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt
verses.en: When, Holy Agni, the divine assembly, the sacred synod mid the Gods, is gathered, And when thou, Godlike One, dealest forth treasures, vouchsafe us, too, our portion of the riches.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः॥
verses.tr: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ
verses.en: Hear us, O Agni, in your common dwelling: harness thy rapid car of Amrta. Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

verses.sa:
द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाऽभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा ।
देवो यन्मर्तान्यजथाय कृण्वन्त्सीदद्धोता प्रत्यङ्स्वमसुं यन्॥
verses.tr: dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenā'bhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā devo yanmartānyajathāya kṛṇvantsīdaddhotā pratyaṅsvamasuṃ yan
verses.en: Heaven and Earth, first by everlasting Order, speakers of truth, are near enough to hear us, When the God, urging men to worship. sitteth as Priest, assuming all his vital vigour.

verses.sa:
देवो देवान्परिभूॠतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान् ।
धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: devo devānparibhūṝtena vahā no havyaṃ prathamaścikitvān dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān
verses.en: As God comprising Gods by Law Eternal, bear, as the Chief who knoweth, our oblation, Smoke-bannered with the fuel, radiant, joyous, better to praise and worship, Priest for ever.

verses.sa:
स्वावृग्देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तत्ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः॥
verses.tr: svāvṛgdevasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gorato jātāso dhārayanta urvī viśve devā anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadenī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ
verses.en: When the cow's nectar wins the God completely, men here below are heaven's sustainers. All the Gods came to this thy heavenly Yajus which from the motley Pair milked oil and water.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे ।
अहा यद्द्यावोऽसुनीतिमयन्मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम्॥
verses.tr: arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me ahā yaddyāvo'sunītimayanmadhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām
verses.en: 1 praise your work that ye may make me prosper: hear, Heaven and Earth, Twain Worlds that drop with fatness. While days and nights go to the world of spirits, here let the Parents with sweet meath refresh us

verses.sa:
किं स्विन्नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याऽति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद ।
मित्रश्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवाञ्छ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svinno rājā jagṛhe kadasyā'ti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda mitraściddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāñchloko na yātāmapi vājo asti
verses.en: Hath the King siezed us? How have we offended against his holy ordinance? Who knoweth? For even Mitra mid the Gods is angry there are both song and strength for those who come not.

verses.sa:
दुर्मन्त्वत्रामृतस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: durmantvatrāmṛtasya nāma salakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamṛṣva pāhyaprayucchan
verses.en: 'Tis hard to understand the Immortal's nature, where she who is akin becomes a stranger. Guard ceaselessly, great Agni, him who ponders Yama's name, easy to be comprehended.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते ।
सूर्ये ज्योतिरदधुर्मास्य१क्तून्परि द्योतनिं चरतो अजस्रा॥
verses.tr: yasmindevā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante sūrye jyotiradadhurmāsya1ktūnpari dyotaniṃ carato ajasrā
verses.en: They in the synod where the Gods rejoice them, where they are seated in Vivasvan's dwelling, Have given the Moon his beams, the Sun his splendour-the Two unweariedly maintain their brightness.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये३ न वयमस्य विद्म ।
मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्त्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत्॥
verses.tr: yasmindevā manmani saṃcarantyapīcye3 na vayamasya vidma mitro no atrāditiranāgāntsavitā devo varuṇāya vocat
verses.en: The counsel which the Gods meet to consider, their secret plan,-of that we have no knowledge. There let God Savitar, Aditi, and Mitra proclaim to Varuna that we are sinless.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः॥
verses.tr: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ
verses.en: Hear us, O Agni, in your comninn dwelling: harness thy rapid car, the car of Amrta. Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

sections.label: To the carts of the oblation
sections.name: Hymn 13

verses.sa:
युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः ।
शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: I YOKE with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of Immortality shall hear it, all the possessors of celestial natures.

verses.sa:
यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं प्र वां भरन्मानुषा देवयन्तः ।
आ सीदतं स्वमु लोकं विदाने स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नः॥
verses.tr: yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanmānuṣā devayantaḥ ā sīdataṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatamindave naḥ
verses.en: When speeding ye came nigh us like twin sisters, religious-hearted votaries brought you forward. Take your place, ye who know your proper station: be near, be very near unto our Soma.

verses.sa:
पञ्च पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहं चतुष्पदीमन्वेमि व्रतेन ।
अक्षरेण प्रति मिम एतामृतस्य नाभावधि सं पुनामि॥
verses.tr: pañca padāni rupo anvarohaṃ catuṣpadīmanvemi vratena akṣareṇa prati mima etāmṛtasya nābhāvadhi saṃ punāmi
verses.en: Five paces have I risen from Earth. I follow her who hath four feet with devout observance. This by the Sacred Syllable have I measured: I purify in the central place of Order,

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै कममृतं नावृणीत ।
बृहस्पतिं यज्ञमकृण्वत ऋषिं प्रियां यमस्तन्वं१ प्रारिरेचीत्॥
verses.tr: devebhyaḥ kamavṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kamamṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta bṛhaspatiṃ yajñamakṛṇvata ṛṣiṃ priyāṃ yamastanvaṃ1 prārirecīt
verses.en: He, for God's sake, chose death to be his portion. He chose not, for men's good, a life eternal They sacrificed Brhaspati the Rsi. Yama delivered up his own dear body.

verses.sa:
सप्त क्षरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवतन्नृतम् ।
उभे इदस्योभयस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभयस्य पुष्यतः॥
verses.tr: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvatannṛtam ubhe idasyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ
verses.en: The Seven flow to the Youth on whom the Maruts wait: the Sons unto the Father brought the sacrifice. Both these are his, as his they are the Lords of both: both toil; belonging unto both they prosper well.

verses.sa:
परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम् ।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा दुवस्य॥
verses.tr: pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya
verses.en: Honour the King with thine oblations, Yama, Vivasvan's Son, who gathers men together, Who travelled to the lofty heights above us, who searches out and shows the path to many.

verses.sa:
यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ ।
यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुरेना जज्ञानाः पथ्या३ अनु स्वाः॥
verses.tr: yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirapabhartavā u yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyurenā jajñānāḥ pathyā3 anu svāḥ
verses.en: Yama first found for us a place to dwell in: this pasture never can be taken from Us. Men born on earth tread their own paths that lead them whither our ancient Fathers have departed.

verses.sa:
मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिॠक्वभिर्वावृधानः ।
याँश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवान्त्स्वाहान्ये स्वधयान्ये मदन्ति॥
verses.tr: mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirbṛhaspatiṝkvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ yāṃśca devā vāvṛdhurye ca devāntsvāhānye svadhayānye madanti
verses.en: Mitali prospers there with Kavyas, Yama with Angiras' sons, Brhaspati with Rkvans: Exalters of the Gods, by Gods exalted, some joy in praise and some in our oblation.

verses.sa:
इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि सीदाऽङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन्हविषा मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdā'ṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājanhaviṣā mādayasva
verses.en: Come, seat thee on this bed of grass, O Yama, in company with Angirases and Fathers. Let texts recited by the sages bring thee O King, let this oblation make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरोभिरा गहि यज्ञियेभिर्यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व ।
विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्य॥
verses.tr: aṅgirobhirā gahi yajñiyebhiryama vairūpairiha mādayasva vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'sminyajñe barhiṣyā niṣadya
verses.en: Come, Yama, with the Angirases the Holy, rejoice thee here with children of Virupa. To sit on sacred grass at this our worship, I call Vivasvan, too, thy Father hither.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrgus who deserve the Soma. May these, the Holy, look on us with favour, may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्व्येभिर्यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुः ।
उभा राजाना स्वधया मदन्ता यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम्॥
verses.tr: prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvyebhiryatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuḥ ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam
verses.en: Go forth, go forth upon the ancient pathways whereon our sires of old have gone before us. 'Mere shalt thou look on both the Kings enjoying their sacred food, God Varuna and Yama.

verses.sa:
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन् ।
हित्वायावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छस्व तन्वा सुवर्चाः॥
verses.tr: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman hitvāyāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ
verses.en: Meet Yama, meet the Fathers, meet the merit of free or ordered acts, in highest heaven. Leave sin and evil, seek anew thy dwelling, and bright with glory wear another body.

verses.sa:
अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन् ।
अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै॥
verses.tr: apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitaro lokamakran ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātyavasānamasmai
verses.en: Go hence, depart ye, fly in all directions: this place for him the Fathers have provided. Yama bestows on him a place to rest in adorned with days and beams of light and waters.

verses.sa:
अति द्रव सारमेयौ श्वानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा ।
अथा पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ उपेहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति॥
verses.tr: ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā athā pitṝntsuvidatrāṃ upehi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti
verses.en: Run and outspeed the two dogs, Sarama's offspring, brindled, four-eyed, upon thy happy pathway. Draw nigh then to the gracious-minded Fathers where they rejoice in company with Yama.

verses.sa:
यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षी नृचक्षसौ ।
ताभ्यामेनं परि देहि राजन्त्स्वस्ति चास्मा अनमीवं च धेहि॥
verses.tr: yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau tābhyāmenaṃ pari dehi rājantsvasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi
verses.en: And those two dogs of thine, Yama, the watchers, four-eyed, who look on men and guard the pathway,- Entrust this man, O King, to their protection, and with prosperity and health endow him.

verses.sa:
उरूणसावसुतृपा उदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनाँ अनु ।
तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: urūṇasāvasutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janāṃ anu tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardātāmasumadyeha bhadram
verses.en: Dark-hued, insatiate, with distended nostrils, Yama's two envoys roam among the People; May they restore to us a fair existence here and to-day, that we may see the sunlight.

verses.sa: यमाय सोमं सुनुत यमाय जुहुता हविः । यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः॥
verses.tr: yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ
verses.en: To Yama pour the Soma, bring to Yama consecrated gifts: To Yama sacrifice prepared and heralded by Agni goes.

verses.sa: यमाय घृतवद्धविर्जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत । स नो देवेष्वा यमद्दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata sa no deveṣvā yamaddīrghamāyuḥ pra jīvase
verses.en: Offer to Yama holy gifts enriched with butter, and draw near: So may he grant that we may live long days of life among the Gods.

verses.sa: यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन । इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ
verses.en: Offer to Yama, to the King, oblation very rich in meath: Bow down before the Rsis of the ancient times, who made this path in days of old.

verses.sa: त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षळुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत् । त्रिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता॥
verses.tr: trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḻurvīrekamidbṛhat triṣṭubgāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā
verses.en: Into the six Expanses flies the Great One in Trkadrukas. The Gayatri, the Trstup, all metres in Yama are contained.

verses.sa:
उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः ।
असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु॥
verses.tr: udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu
verses.en: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma- May they who have attained the life of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः ।
ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु विक्षु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu
verses.en: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region, and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.

verses.sa:
आहं पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः ।
बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: āhaṃ pitṝntsuvidatrāṃ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: 1 have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, I have gained son and progeny from Visnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sa:
बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्य१र्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम् ।
त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाऽथा नः शं योररपो दधात॥
verses.tr: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtya1rvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam ta ā gatāvasā śaṃtamenā'thā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta
verses.en: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come, help us: these offerings have we made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

verses.sa:
उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु ।
त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.en: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations. Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sa:
आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गृणीत विश्वे ।
मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम॥
verses.tr: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma
verses.en: Bowing your bended knees and seated southward, accept this sacrifice of ours with favour. Punish us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

verses.sa:
आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात॥
verses.tr: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings, give riches to the man who brings oblations. Grant to your sons a portion of that treasure, and, present, give them energy, ye Fathers.

verses.sa:
ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः ।
तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ tebhiryamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu
verses.en: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet,- With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sa:
ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविदः स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः ।
आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ्सत्यैः कव्यैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvidaḥ stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ āgne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅsatyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ
verses.en: Come to us, Agni, with the gracious Fathers who dwell in glowing light, the very Kavyas, Who thirsted mid the Gods, who hasten hither, oblation winners, theme of singers' praises.

verses.sa:
ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं दधानाः ।
आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः परैः पूर्वैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ
verses.en: Come, Agni, come with countless ancient Fathers, dwellers in light, primeval, God-adorers, Eaters and drinkers of oblations, truthful, who travel with the Deities and Indra.

verses.sa:
अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अत्ता हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन॥
verses.tr: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana
verses.en: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न ईळितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी ।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि॥
verses.tr: tvamagna īḻito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi
verses.en: Thou, Agni Jatavedas, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And give them to the Fathers who did cat them with Svadha. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sa:
ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ उ च न प्रविद्म ।
त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञं सुकृतं जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yāṃśca vidma yāṃ u ca na pravidma tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva
verses.en: Thou, Jatavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not: accept the sacrifice well prepared with portions.

verses.sa:
ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते ।
तेभिः स्वराळसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयस्व॥
verses.tr: ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante tebhiḥ svarāḻasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva
verses.en: They who, consumed by fire or not cremated, joy in their offering in the midst of heaven,- Grant them, O Sovran Lord, the world of spirits and their own body, as thy pleasure wills it.

verses.sa:
मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शोचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् ।
यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात्पितृभ्यः॥
verses.tr: mainamagne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'themenaṃ pra hiṇutātpitṛbhyaḥ
verses.en: Burn him not up, nor quite consume him, Agni: let not his body or his skin be scattered. O Jatavedas, when thou hast matured him, then send him on his way unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं परि दत्तात्पितृभ्यः ।
यदा गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानां वशनीर्भवाति॥
verses.tr: śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ pari dattātpitṛbhyaḥ yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti
verses.en: When thou hast made him ready, Jatavedas, then do thou give him over to the Fathers. When he attains unto the life that waits him, he shall become the Deities' controller.

verses.sa:
सूर्यं चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा ।
अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः॥
verses.tr: sūryaṃ cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ
verses.en: The Sun receive thine eye, the Wind thy spirit; go, as thy merit is, to earth or heaven. Go, if it be thy lot, unto the waters; go, make thine home in plants with all thy members.

verses.sa:
अजो भागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः ।
यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ yāste śivāstanvo jātavedastābhirvahainaṃ sukṛtāmu lokam
verses.en: Thy portion is the goat: with heat consume him: let thy fierce flame, thy glowing splendour, burn him With thine auspicious forms, o Jatavedas, bear this man to the region of the pious.

verses.sa:
अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधाभिः ।
आयुर्वसान उप वेतु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: ava sṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhābhiḥ āyurvasāna upa vetu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā jātavedaḥ
verses.en: Again, O Agni, to the Fathers send him who, offered in thee, goes with our oblations. Wearing new life let him increase his offspring: let him rejoin a body, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणाँ आविवेश॥
verses.tr: yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ agniṣṭadviśvādagadaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇāṃ āviveśa
verses.en: What wound soe'er the dark bird hath inflicted, the emmet, or the serpent, or the jackal, May Agni who devoureth all things heal it and Soma who hath passed into the Brahmans.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व पीवसा मेदसा च ।
नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग्विधक्ष्यन्पर्यङ्खयाते॥
verses.tr: agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca nettvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛgvidhakṣyanparyaṅkhayāte
verses.en: Shield thee with flesh against the flames of Agni, encompass thee about with fat and marrow, So will the Bold One, eager to attack thee with fierce glow fail to girdle and consume thee.

verses.sa:
इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् ।
एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन्देवा अमृता मादयन्ते॥
verses.tr: imamagne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmindevā amṛtā mādayante
verses.en: Forbear, O Agni, to upset this ladle: the Gods and they who merit Soma love it. This ladle, this which serves the Gods to drink from, in this the Immortal Deities rejoice them.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः ।
इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
verses.en: 1 send afar flesh eating Agni, bearing off stains may he depart to Yama's subjects. But let this other Jatavedas carry oblation to the Gods, for he is skillful.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः क्रव्यात्प्रविवेश वो गृहमिमं पश्यन्नितरं जातवेदसम् ।
तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय देवं स घर्ममिन्वात्परमे सधस्थे॥
verses.tr: yo agniḥ kravyātpraviveśa vo gṛhamimaṃ paśyannitaraṃ jātavedasam taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya devaṃ sa gharmaminvātparame sadhasthe
verses.en: I choose as God for Father-worship Agni, flesh-eater, who hath past within your dwelling, While looking on this other Jatavedas. Let him light flames in the supreme assembly.

verses.sa: यो अग्निः क्रव्यवाहनः पितॄन्यक्षदृतावृधः । प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ॥
verses.tr: yo agniḥ kravyavāhanaḥ pitṝnyakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā
verses.en: With offerings meet let Agni bring the Fathers who support the Law. Let him announce oblations paid to Fathers and to Deities.

verses.sa: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि । उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन्हविषे अत्तवे॥
verses.tr: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝnhaviṣe attave
verses.en: Right gladly would we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to cat the food of sacrifice.

verses.sa: यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः । कियाम्ब्वत्र रोहतु पाकदूर्वा व्यल्कशा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvamagne samadahastamu nirvāpayā punaḥ kiyāmbvatra rohatu pākadūrvā vyalkaśā
verses.en: Cool, Agni, and again refresh the spot which thou hast scorched and burnt. Here let the water-lily grow, and tender grass and leafy herb.

verses.sa: शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति । मण्डूक्या३ सु सं गम इमं स्व१ग्निं हर्षय॥
verses.tr: śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati maṇḍūkyā3 su saṃ gama imaṃ sva1gniṃ harṣaya
verses.en: O full of coolness, thou cool Plant, full of fresh moisture, freshening Herb, Come hither with the female frog: fill with delight this Agni here.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोतीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति ।
यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇotītīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa
verses.en: Tvastar prepares the bridal of his Daughter: all the world hears the tidings and assembles. But Yama's Mother, Spouse of great Vivasvan, vanished as she was carried to her dwelling.

verses.sa:
अपागूहन्नमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वी सवर्णामददुर्विवस्वते ।
उताश्विनावभरद्यत्तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः॥
verses.tr: apāgūhannamṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvī savarṇāmadadurvivasvate utāśvināvabharadyattadāsīdajahādu dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ
verses.en: From mortal men they hid the Immortal Lady, made one like her and gave her to Vivasvan. Saranyu brought to him the Asvin brothers, and then deserted both twinned pairs of children.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत्पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pra vidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadatpitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ
verses.en: Guard of the world, whose cattle ne'er are injured, may Pusan bear thee hence, for he hath knowledge. May he consign thee to these Fathers' keeping, and to the gracious Gods let Agni give thee.

verses.sa:
आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पासति त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् ।
यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु॥
verses.tr: āyurviśvāyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
verses.en: May Ayu, giver of all life, protect thee, and bear thee forward on the distant pathway. Thither let Savitar the God transport thee, where dwell the pious who have passed-before thee.

verses.sa:
पूषेमा आशा अनु वेद सर्वाः सो अस्माँ अभयतमेन नेषत् ।
स्वस्तिदा आघृणिः सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन्पुर एतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmāṃ abhayatamena neṣat svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchanpura etu prajānan
verses.en: Pusan knows all these realms: may he conduct us by ways that are most free from fear and danger. Giver of blessings, glowing, all-heroic, may he, the wise and watchful, go before us.

verses.sa:
प्रपथे पथामजनिष्ट पूषा प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः ।
उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan
verses.en: Pusan was born to move on distant pathways, on the road far from earth and far from heaven. To both most wonted places of assembly he travels and returns with perfect knowledge.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो अह्वयन्त सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात्॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne sarasvatīṃ sukṛto ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt
verses.en: The pious call Sarasvati, they worship Sarasvati while sacrifice proceedeth. The pious called Sarasvati aforetime. Sarasvati send bliss to him who giveth.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथ स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयस्वाऽनमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे॥
verses.tr: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayasvā'namīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme
verses.en: Sarasvati, who camest with the Fathers, with them rejoicing thee in our oblations, Seated upon this sacred grass be joyful, and give us strengthening food that brings no sickness.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं यां पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
सहस्रार्घमिळो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धेहि॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ yāṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ sahasrārghamiḻo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhehi
verses.en: Thou, called on as Sarasvati by Fathers who come right forward to our solemn service, Give food and wealth to present sacrificers, a portion, worth a thousand, of refreshment.

verses.sa:
आपो अस्मान्मातरः शुन्धयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु ।
विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि॥
verses.tr: āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi
verses.en: The Mother Floods shall make us bright and shining, cleansers of holy oil, with oil shall cleanse us: For, Goddesses, they bear off all defilement: I, rise up from them purified and brightened.

verses.sa:
द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द प्रथमाँ अनु द्यूनिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः ।
समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः॥
verses.tr: drapsaścaskanda prathamāṃ anu dyūnimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ
verses.en: Through days of earliest date the Drop descended on this place and on that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop which still to one same place is moving.

verses.sa:
यस्ते द्रप्सः स्कन्दति यस्ते अंशुर्बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् ।
अध्वर्योर्वा परि वा यः पवित्रात्तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: yaste drapsaḥ skandati yaste aṃśurbāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam
verses.en: The Drop that falls, thy stalk which arms have shaken, which from the bosom of the press hath fallen, Or from the Adhvaryu's purifying filter, I offer thee with heart and cry of Vasat!

verses.sa: यस्ते द्रप्सः स्कन्नो यस्ते अंशुरवश्च यः परः स्रुचा । अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु राधसे॥
verses.tr: yaste drapsaḥ skanno yaste aṃśuravaśca yaḥ paraḥ srucā ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase
verses.en: That fallen Drop of thine, the stalk which from the ladle fell away, This present God Brhaspati shall pour it forth to make us rich.

verses.sa: पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं वचः । अपां पयस्वदित्पयस्तेन मा सह शुन्धत॥
verses.tr: payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ vacaḥ apāṃ payasvaditpayastena mā saha śundhata
verses.en: The plants of earth are rich in milk, and rich in milk is this my speech; And rich in milk the essence of the Waters: make me pure therewith.

verses.sa:
परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् ।
चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान्॥
verses.tr: paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān
verses.en: Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel. To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our offspring, injure not our heroes.

verses.sa:
मृत्योः पदं योपयन्तो यदैत द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ।
आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेन शुद्धाः पूता भवत यज्ञियासः॥
verses.tr: mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yadaita drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavata yajñiyāsaḥ
verses.en: As ye have come effacing Mrtyu's footstep, to further times prolonging your existence, May ye be rich in children and possessions. cleansed, purified, and meet for sacrificing.

verses.sa:
इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववृत्रन्नभूद्भद्रा देवहूतिर्नो अद्य ।
प्राञ्चो अगाम नृतये हसाय द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: ime jīvā vi mṛtairāvavṛtrannabhūdbhadrā devahūtirno adya prāñco agāma nṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: Divided from the dead are these, the living: now be our calling on the Gods successful. We have gone forth for dancing and for laughter, to further times prolonging our existence.

verses.sa:
इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम् ।
शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीरन्तर्मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन॥
verses.tr: imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīrantarmṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena
verses.en: Here I erect this rampart for the living; let none of these, none other, reach this limit. May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain.

verses.sa:
यथाहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथ ऋतव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति साधु ।
यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम्॥
verses.tr: yathāhānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yatha ṛtava ṛtubhiryanti sādhu yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām
verses.en: As the days follow days in close succession, as with the seasons duly come the seasons, As each successor fails not his foregoer, so form the lives of these, O great Ordainer.

verses.sa:
आ रोहतायुर्जरसं वृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यति ष्ठ ।
इह त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सजोषा दीर्घमायुः करति जीवसे वः॥
verses.tr: ā rohatāyurjarasaṃ vṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yati ṣṭha iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā sajoṣā dīrghamāyuḥ karati jīvase vaḥ
verses.en: Live your full lives up! find old age delightful, all of you striving one behind the other. May Tvastar, maker of fair things, be gracious and lengthen out the days of your existence.

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं विशन्तु ।
अनश्रवोऽनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे॥
verses.tr: imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ viśantu anaśravo'namīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonimagre
verses.en: Let these unwidowed dames with noble husbands adorn themselves with fragrant balm and unguent. Decked with fair jewels, tearless, free from sorrow, first let the dames go up to where he lieth.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकं गतासुमेतमुप शेष एहि ।
हस्तग्राभस्य दिधिषोस्तवेदं पत्युर्जनित्वमभि सं बभूथ॥
verses.tr: udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsumetamupa śeṣa ehi hastagrābhasya didhiṣostavedaṃ patyurjanitvamabhi saṃ babhūtha
verses.en: Rise, come unto the world of life, O woman: come, he is lifeless by whose side thou liest. Wifehood with this thy husband was thy portion, who took thy hand and wooed thee as a lover.

verses.sa:
धनुर्हस्तादाददानो मृतस्याऽस्मे क्षत्राय वर्चसे बलाय ।
अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुवीरा विश्वाः स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम॥
verses.tr: dhanurhastādādadāno mṛtasyā'sme kṣatrāya varcase balāya atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvāḥ spṛdho abhimātīrjayema
verses.en: From his dead hand I take the bow be carried, that it may be our power and might and glory. There art thou, there; and here with noble heroes may we o'ercome all hosts that fight against us.

verses.sa:
उप सर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम् ।
ऊर्णम्रदा युवतिर्दक्षिणावत एषा त्वा पातु निॠतेरुपस्थात्॥
verses.tr: upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām ūrṇamradā yuvatirdakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu niṝterupasthāt
verses.en: Betake thee to the lap of Earth the Mother, of Earth far-spreading, very kind and gracious. Young Dame, wool-soft unto the guerdon giver, may she preserve thee from Destruction's bosom.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा नि बाधथाः सूपायनास्मै भव सूपवञ्चना ।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाऽभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि॥
verses.tr: ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā mātā putraṃ yathā sicā'bhyenaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
verses.en: Heave thyself, Earth, nor press thee downward heavily: afford him easy access, gently tending him. Cover him, as a mother wraps her skirt about her child, O Earth.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चमाना पृथिवी सु तिष्ठतु सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम् ।
ते गृहासो घृतश्चुतो भवन्तु विश्वाहास्मै शरणाः सन्त्वत्र॥
verses.tr: ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām te gṛhāso ghṛtaścuto bhavantu viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santvatra
verses.en: Now let the heaving earth be free from motion: yea,- let a thousand clods remain above him. Be they to him a home distilling fatness, here let them ever be his place of refuge.

verses.sa:
उत्ते स्तभ्नामि पृथिवीं त्वत्परीमं लोगं निदधन्मो अहं रिषम् ।
एतां स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्तु तेऽत्रा यमः सादना ते मिनोतु॥
verses.tr: utte stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvatparīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhanmo ahaṃ riṣam etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantu te'trā yamaḥ sādanā te minotu
verses.en: I stay the earth from thee, while over thee I place this piece of earth. May I be free from injury. Here let the Fathers keep this pillar firm for thee, and there let Yama make thee an abiding-place.

verses.sa: प्रतीचीने मामहनीष्वाः पर्णमिवा दधुः । प्रतीचीं जग्रभा वाचमश्वं रशनया यथा॥
verses.tr: pratīcīne māmahanīṣvāḥ parṇamivā dadhuḥ pratīcīṃ jagrabhā vācamaśvaṃ raśanayā yathā
verses.en: Even as an arrow's feathers, they have set me on a fitting day. The fit word have I caught and held as 'twere a courser with the rein.

verses.sa: नि वर्तध्वं मानु गाताऽस्मान्त्सिषक्त रेवतीः । अग्नीषोमा पुनर्वसू अस्मे धारयतं रयिम्॥
verses.tr: ni vartadhvaṃ mānu gātā'smāntsiṣakta revatīḥ agnīṣomā punarvasū asme dhārayataṃ rayim
verses.en: Turn, go not farther on your way: visit us, O ye Wealthy Ones. Agni and Soma, ye who bring riches again, secure us wealth.

verses.sa: पुनरेना नि वर्तय पुनरेना न्या कुरु । इन्द्र एणा नि यच्छत्वग्निरेना उपाजतु॥
verses.tr: punarenā ni vartaya punarenā nyā kuru indra eṇā ni yacchatvagnirenā upājatu
verses.en: Make these return to us again, bring them beside us once again. May. Indra give them back to us, and Agni drive them hither-ward.

verses.sa: पुनरेता नि वर्तन्तामस्मिन्पुष्यन्तु गोपतौ । इहैवाग्ने नि धारयेह तिष्ठतु या रयिः॥
verses.tr: punaretā ni vartantāmasminpuṣyantu gopatau ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ
verses.en: Let them return to us again: under this herdsman let them feed. Do thou, O Agni, keep them here, and let the wealth we have remain.

verses.sa: यन्नियानं न्ययनं संज्ञानं यत्परायणम् । आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे॥
verses.tr: yanniyānaṃ nyayanaṃ saṃjñānaṃ yatparāyaṇam āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve
verses.en: 1 call upon their herdsman, him who knoweth well their coming nigh, Their parting and their home-return, and watcheth their approach and rest.

verses.sa: य उदानड्व्ययनं य उदानट् परायणम् । आवर्तनं निवर्तनमपि गोपा नि वर्तताम्॥
verses.tr: ya udānaḍvyayanaṃ ya udānaṭ parāyaṇam āvartanaṃ nivartanamapi gopā ni vartatām
verses.en: Yea, let the herdsman, too, return, who marketh well their driving-forth; Marketh their wandering away, their turning back and coming home.

verses.sa: आ निवर्त नि वर्तय पुनर्न इन्द्र गा देहि । जीवाभिर्भुनजामहै॥
verses.tr: ā nivarta ni vartaya punarna indra gā dehi jīvābhirbhunajāmahai
verses.en: Home-leader, lead them home to us; Indra, restore to us our kine: We will rejoice in them alive.

verses.sa: परि वो विश्वतो दध ऊर्जा घृतेन पयसा । ये देवाः के च यज्ञियास्ते रय्या सं सृजन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyāste rayyā saṃ sṛjantu naḥ
verses.en: 1 offer you on every side butter and milk and strengthening food. May all the Holy Deities pour down on us a flood of wealth.

verses.sa: आ निवर्तन वर्तय नि निवर्तन वर्तय । भूम्याश्चतस्रः प्रदिशस्ताभ्य एना नि वर्तय॥
verses.tr: ā nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya bhūmyāścatasraḥ pradiśastābhya enā ni vartaya
verses.en: O thou Home-leader, lead them home, restore them thou who bringest home. Four are the quarters of the earth; from these bring back to us our kine,

verses.sa: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनः॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ no api vātaya manaḥ
verses.en: Send unto us a good and happy mind.

verses.sa: अग्निमीळे भुजां यविष्ठं शासा मित्रं दुर्धरीतुम् । यस्य धर्मन्त्स्व१रेनीः सपर्यन्ति मातुरूधः॥
verses.tr: agnimīḻe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum yasya dharmantsva1renīḥ saparyanti māturūdhaḥ
verses.en: I worship Agni, Youthfullest of Gods, resistless, Friend of laws; Under whose guard and heavenly light the Spotted seek the Mother's breast:

verses.sa: यमासा कृपनीळं भासाकेतुं वर्धयन्ति । भ्राजते श्रेणिदन्॥
verses.tr: yamāsā kṛpanīḻaṃ bhāsāketuṃ vardhayanti bhrājate śreṇidan
verses.en: Whom with their mouth they magnify, bannered with flame and homed in light. He glitters with his row of teeth.

verses.sa: अर्यो विशां गातुरेति प्र यदानड्दिवो अन्तान् । कविरभ्रं दीद्यानः॥
verses.tr: aryo viśāṃ gātureti pra yadānaḍdivo antān kavirabhraṃ dīdyānaḥ
verses.en: Kind, Furtherer of men, he comes, when he hath reached the ends of heaven, Sage, giving splendour to the clouds.

verses.sa: जुषद्धव्या मानुषस्योर्ध्वस्तस्थावृभ्वा यज्ञे । मिन्वन्त्सद्म पुर एति॥
verses.tr: juṣaddhavyā mānuṣasyordhvastasthāvṛbhvā yajñe minvantsadma pura eti
verses.en: To taste man's offerings, he, the Strong, hath risen erect at sacrifice: Fixing his dwelling he proceeds.

verses.sa: स हि क्षेमो हविर्यज्ञः श्रुष्टीदस्य गातुरेति । अग्निं देवा वाशीमन्तम्॥
verses.tr: sa hi kṣemo haviryajñaḥ śruṣṭīdasya gātureti agniṃ devā vāśīmantam
verses.en: Here are oblation, worship, rest: rapidly comes his furtherance. To sword-armed Agni come the Gods.

verses.sa: यज्ञासाहं दुव इषेऽग्निं पूर्वस्य शेवस्य । अद्रेः सूनुमायुमाहुः॥
verses.tr: yajñāsāhaṃ duva iṣe'gniṃ pūrvasya śevasya adreḥ sūnumāyumāhuḥ
verses.en: With service for chief bliss I seek the Lord of Sacrifice, Agni, whom They call the Living, Son of Cloud.

verses.sa: नरो ये के चास्मदा विश्वेत्ते वाम आ स्युः । अग्निं हविषा वर्धन्तः॥
verses.tr: naro ye ke cāsmadā viśvette vāma ā syuḥ agniṃ haviṣā vardhantaḥ
verses.en: Blest evermore be all the men who come from us, who magnify Agni with sacrificial gifts.
