verses.sa: कृष्णः श्वेतोऽरुषो यामो अस्य ब्रध्न ऋज्र उत शोणो यशस्वान् । हिरण्यरूपं जनिता जजान॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaḥ śveto'ruṣo yāmo asya bradhna ṛjra uta śoṇo yaśasvān hiraṇyarūpaṃ janitā jajāna
verses.en: The path he treads is black and white and red, and striped, and brown, crimson, and glorious. His sire begat him bright with hues of gold.

verses.sa:
एवा ते अग्ने विमदो मनीषामूर्जो नपादमृतेभिः सजोषाः ।
गिर आ वक्षत्सुमतीरियान इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः॥
verses.tr: evā te agne vimado manīṣāmūrjo napādamṛtebhiḥ sajoṣāḥ gira ā vakṣatsumatīriyāna iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ
verses.en: Thus with his thoughts, O Son of Strength, O Agni, hath Vimada, accordant with the Immortals, Offered thee hymns, soliciting thy favour. Thou hast brought all food, strength, a prosperous dwelling.

verses.sa:
आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
यज्ञाय स्तीर्णबर्हिषे वि वो मदे शीरं पावकशोचिषं विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: āgniṃ na svavṛktibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase
verses.en: With offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as Invoking Priest, For sacrifice with trimmed grass,-at your glad carouse-piercing and brightly shining. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वामु ते स्वाभुवः शुम्भन्त्यश्वराधसः ।
वेति त्वामुपसेचनी वि वो मद ऋजीतिरग्न आहुतिर्विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvāmu te svābhuvaḥ śumbhantyaśvarādhasaḥ veti tvāmupasecanī vi vo mada ṛjītiragna āhutirvivakṣase
verses.en: The wealthy ones adorn thee, they who bring us horses as their gift: The sprinkling ladle, Agni,-at your glad carouse -and glowing offering taste thee. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वे धर्माण आसते जुहूभिः सिञ्चतीरिव ।
कृष्णा रूपाण्यर्जुना वि वो मदे विश्वा अधि श्रियो धिषे विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tve dharmāṇa āsate juhūbhiḥ siñcatīriva kṛṣṇā rūpāṇyarjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhiṣe vivakṣase
verses.en: The holy statutes rest by thee, as 'twere with ladles that o'erflow. Black and white-gleaming colours,-at your glad carouse-all glories thou assumest. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
यमग्ने मन्यसे रयिं सहसावन्नमर्त्य ।
तमा नो वाजसातये वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु चित्रमा भरा विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: yamagne manyase rayiṃ sahasāvannamartya tamā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citramā bharā vivakṣase
verses.en: O Agni, what thou deemest wealth, Victorious and Immortal One! Bring thou to give us vigour,-at your glad carouse -splendid at sacrifices. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जातो अथर्वणा विदद्विश्वानि काव्या ।
भुवद्दूतो विवस्वतो वि वो मदे प्रियो यमस्य काम्यो विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: agnirjāto atharvaṇā vidadviśvāni kāvyā bhuvaddūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase
verses.en: Skilled in all lore is Agni, he whom erst Atharvan brought to life. He was Vivasvan's envoy, at your glad carouse-the well-loved friend of Yama, Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेष्वीळतेऽग्ने प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
त्वं वसूनि काम्या वि वो मदे विश्वा दधासि दाशुषे विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ yajñeṣvīḻate'gne prayatyadhvare tvaṃ vasūni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase
verses.en: At sacrifices they adore thee, Agni, when the rite proceeds. All fair and lovely treasures-at your glad carouse-thou givest him who offers. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजं चारुमग्ने नि षेदिरे ।
घृतप्रतीकं मनुषो वि वो मदे शुक्रं चेतिष्ठमक्षभिर्विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ yajñeṣvṛtvijaṃ cārumagne ni ṣedire ghṛtapratīkaṃ manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭhamakṣabhirvivakṣase
verses.en: Men, Agni, have established thee as welcome Priest at holy rites, Thee whose face shines with butter,-at your glad carouse-bright, with eyes most observant. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषोरु प्रथयसे बृहत् ।
अभिक्रन्दन्वृषायसे वि वो मदे गर्भं दधासि जामिषु विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: agne śukreṇa śociṣoru prathayase bṛhat abhikrandanvṛṣāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase
verses.en: Wide and aloft thou spreadest thee, O Agni, with thy brilliant flame. A Bull art thou when bellowing,-at your glad carouse-thou dost impregn the Sisters. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: कुह श्रुत इन्द्रः कस्मिन्नद्य जने मित्रो न श्रूयते । ऋषीणां वा यः क्षये गुहा वा चर्कृषे गिरा॥
verses.tr: kuha śruta indraḥ kasminnadya jane mitro na śrūyate ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā
verses.en: Where is famed Indra heard of? With what folk is he renowned to-day as Mitra is,- Who in the home of Rsis and in secret is extolled with song?

verses.sa: इह श्रुत इन्द्रो अस्मे अद्य स्तवे वज्र्यृचीषमः । मित्रो न यो जनेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या॥
verses.tr: iha śruta indro asme adya stave vajryṛcīṣamaḥ mitro na yo janeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā
verses.en: Even here is Indra famed, and among us this day the glorious Thunderer is praised, He who like Mitra mid the folk hath won complete and full renown.

verses.sa: महो यस्पतिः शवसो असाम्या महो नृम्णस्य तूतुजिः । भर्ता वज्रस्य धृष्णोः पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: maho yaspatiḥ śavaso asāmyā maho nṛmṇasya tūtujiḥ bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putramiva priyam
verses.en: He who is Sovran Lord of great and perfect strength, exerter of heroic might, Who bears the fearless thunder as a father bears his darling son.

verses.sa: युजानो अश्वा वातस्य धुनी देवो देवस्य वज्रिवः । स्यन्ता पथा विरुक्मता सृजानः स्तोष्यध्वनः॥
verses.tr: yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunī devo devasya vajrivaḥ syantā pathā virukmatā sṛjānaḥ stoṣyadhvanaḥ
verses.en: Harnessing to thy car, as God, two blustering Steeds Of the Wind-God, O Thunderer, That speed along the shining path, thou making ways art glorified.

verses.sa: त्वं त्या चिद्वातस्याश्वागा ऋज्रा त्मना वहध्यै । ययोर्देवो न मर्त्यो यन्ता नकिर्विदाय्यः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyā cidvātasyāśvāgā ṛjrā tmanā vahadhyai yayordevo na martyo yantā nakirvidāyyaḥ
verses.en: Even to these dark Steeds of Wind thou of thyself hast come to ride, Of which no driver may be found, none, be he God or mortal man.

verses.sa: अध ग्मन्तोशना पृच्छते वां कदर्था न आ गृहम् । आ जग्मथुः पराकाद्दिवश्च ग्मश्च मर्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: adha gmantośanā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā na ā gṛham ā jagmathuḥ parākāddivaśca gmaśca martyam
verses.en: When ye approach, men ask you, thee and Usana: Why come ye to our dwelling-place? Why are ye come to mortal man from distant realms of earth and heaven?

verses.sa: आ न इन्द्र पृक्षसेऽस्माकं ब्रह्मोद्यतम् । तत्त्वा याचामहेऽवः शुष्णं यद्धन्नमानुषम्॥
verses.tr: ā na indra pṛkṣase'smākaṃ brahmodyatam tattvā yācāmahe'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhannamānuṣam
verses.en: O Indra, thou shalt speak us fair: our holy prayer is offered up. We pray to thee for help as thou didst strike the monster Susna dead.

verses.sa: अकर्मा दस्युरभि नो अमन्तुरन्यव्रतो अमानुषः । त्वं तस्यामित्रहन्वधर्दासस्य दम्भय॥
verses.tr: akarmā dasyurabhi no amanturanyavrato amānuṣaḥ tvaṃ tasyāmitrahanvadhardāsasya dambhaya
verses.en: Around us is the Dasyu, riteless, void of sense, inhuman, keeping alien laws. Baffle, thou Slayer of the foe, the weapon which this Dasa wields.

verses.sa: त्वं न इन्द्र शूर शूरैरुत त्वोतासो बर्हणा । पुरुत्रा ते वि पूर्तयो नवन्त क्षोणयो यथा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrairuta tvotāso barhaṇā purutrā te vi pūrtayo navanta kṣoṇayo yathā
verses.en: Hero with Heroes, thou art ours: yea, strong are they whom thou dost help. In many a place are thy full gifts, and men, like vassals, sing thy praise.

verses.sa: त्वं तान्वृत्रहत्ये चोदयो नॄन्कार्पाणे शूर वज्रिवः । गुहा यदी कवीनां विशां नक्षत्रशवसाम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tānvṛtrahatye codayo nṝnkārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ guhā yadī kavīnāṃ viśāṃ nakṣatraśavasām
verses.en: Urge thou these heroes on to slay the enemy, brave Thunderer! in the fight with swords. Even when hid among the tribes of Sages numerous as stars.

verses.sa: मक्षू ता त इन्द्र दानाप्नस आक्षाणे शूर वज्रिवः । यद्ध शुष्णस्य दम्भयो जातं विश्वं सयावभिः॥
verses.tr: makṣū tā ta indra dānāpnasa ākṣāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ yaddha śuṣṇasya dambhayo jātaṃ viśvaṃ sayāvabhiḥ
verses.en: Swift come those gifts of thine whose hand is prompt to rend and burn, O Hero Thunder-armed: As thou with thy Companions didst destroy the whole of Susna's brood.

verses.sa: माकुध्र्यगिन्द्र शूर वस्वीरस्मे भूवन्नभिष्टयः । वयंवयं त आसां सुम्ने स्याम वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: mākudhryagindra śūra vasvīrasme bhūvannabhiṣṭayaḥ vayaṃvayaṃ ta āsāṃ sumne syāma vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Let not thine excellent assistance come to us, O Hero Indra, profitless. May we, may we enjoy the bliss of these thy favours, Thunderer!

verses.sa: अस्मे ता त इन्द्र सन्तु सत्याऽहिंसन्तीरुपस्पृशः । विद्याम यासां भुजो धेनूनां न वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: asme tā ta indra santu satyā'hiṃsantīrupaspṛśaḥ vidyāma yāsāṃ bhujo dhenūnāṃ na vajrivaḥ
verses.en: May those soft impulses of thine, O Indra, be fruitful and innocent to us. May we know these whose treasures are like those of milch-kine, Thunderer!

verses.sa: अहस्ता यदपदी वर्धत क्षाः शचीभिर्वेद्यानाम् । शुष्णं परि प्रदक्षिणिद्विश्वायवे नि शिश्नथः॥
verses.tr: ahastā yadapadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhirvedyānām śuṣṇaṃ pari pradakṣiṇidviśvāyave ni śiśnathaḥ
verses.en: That Earth, through power of knowing things that may be known, handless and footless yet might thrive, Thou slewest, turning to the right, Susna for every living man.

verses.sa:
पिबापिबेदिन्द्र शूर सोमं मा रिषण्यो वसवान वसुः सन् ।
उत त्रायस्व गृणतो मघोनो महश्च रायो रेवतस्कृधी नः॥
verses.tr: pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mā riṣaṇyo vasavāna vasuḥ san uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaśca rāyo revataskṛdhī naḥ
verses.en: Drink, drink the Soma, Hero Indra; be not withheld as thou art good, O Treasure-giver. Preserve the singers and our liberal princes, and make us wealthy with abundant riches.

verses.sa:
यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणं हरीणां रथ्यं१ विव्रतानाम् ।
प्र श्मश्रु दोधुवदूर्ध्वथा भूद्वि सेनाभिर्दयमानो वि राधसा॥
verses.tr: yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ harīṇāṃ rathyaṃ1 vivratānām pra śmaśru dodhuvadūrdhvathā bhūdvi senābhirdayamāno vi rādhasā
verses.en: Indra, whose right hand wields the bolt, we worship, driver of Bay Steeds seeking sundered courses. Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, casting his weapons forth and dealing bounties.

verses.sa:
हरी न्वस्य या वने विदे वस्विन्द्रो मघैर्मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ।
ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षाः पत्यते शवोऽव क्ष्णौमि दासस्य नाम चित्॥
verses.tr: harī nvasya yā vane vide vasvindro maghairmaghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣāḥ patyate śavo'va kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma cit
verses.en: The treasure which his Bay Steeds found at sacrifice,-this wealth made opulent Indra slayer of the foe. Rbhu, Rbhuksan, Vaja-he is Lord of Might. The Dasa's very name I utterly destroy.

verses.sa:
यदा वज्रं हिरण्यमिदथा रथं हरी यमस्य वहतो वि सूरिभिः ।
आ तिष्ठति मघवा सनश्रुत इन्द्रो वाजस्य दीर्घश्रवसस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidathā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ
verses.en: When, with the Princes, Maghavari, famed of old, comes nigh the thunderbolt of gold, and the Controller's car Which his two Tawny Coursers draw, then Indra is the Sovran Lord of power whose glory spreads afar.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु वृष्टिर्यूथ्या३ स्वा सचाँ इन्द्रः श्मश्रूणि हरिताभि प्रुष्णुते ।
अव वेति सुक्षयं सुते मधूदिद्धूनोति वातो यथा वनम्॥
verses.tr: so cinnu vṛṣṭiryūthyā3 svā sacāṃ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūdiddhūnoti vāto yathā vanam
verses.en: With him too is this rain of his that comes like herds: Indra throws drops of moisture on his yellow beard. When the sweet juice is shed he seeks the pleasant place, and stirs the worshipper as wind disturbs the wood.

verses.sa:
यो वाचा विवाचो मृध्रवाचः पुरू सहस्राशिवा जघान ।
तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसि पितेव यस्तविषीं वावृधे शवः॥
verses.tr: yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yastaviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ
verses.en: We laud and praise his several deeds of valour who, father like, with power hath made us stronger; Who with his voice slew many thousand wicked ones who spake in varied manners with contemptuous cries.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं त इन्द्र विमदा अजीजनन्नपूर्व्यं पुरुतमं सुदानवे ।
विद्मा ह्यस्य भोजनमिनस्य यदा पशुं न गोपाः करामहे॥
verses.tr: stomaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanannapūrvyaṃ purutamaṃ sudānave vidmā hyasya bhojanaminasya yadā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karāmahe
verses.en: Indra, the Vimadas have formed for thee a laud, copious, unparalleled, for thee Most Bountiful. We know the good we gain from him the Mighty One when we attract him as a herdsman calls the kine.

verses.sa:
माकिर्न एना सख्या वि यौषुस्तव चेन्द्र विमदस्य च ऋषेः ।
विद्मा हि ते प्रमतिं देव जामिवदस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि॥
verses.tr: mākirna enā sakhyā vi yauṣustava cendra vimadasya ca ṛṣeḥ vidmā hi te pramatiṃ deva jāmivadasme te santu sakhyā śivāni
verses.en: Ne'er may this bond of friendship be dissevered, the Rsi Vimada's and thine, O Indra. We know thou carest for us as a brother with us, O God, be thine auspicious friendship.

verses.sa: इन्द्र सोममिमं पिब मधुमन्तं चमू सुतम् । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय वि वो मदे सहस्रिणं पुरूवसो विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: indra somamimaṃ piba madhumantaṃ camū sutam asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya vi vo made sahasriṇaṃ purūvaso vivakṣase
verses.en: O INDRA, drink this Soma, pressed out in the mortar, full of sweets. Send down to us great riches,-at your glad carouse-in thousands, O Most healthy. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: त्वां यज्ञेभिरुक्थैरुप हव्येभिरीमहे । शचीपते शचीनां वि वो मदे श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यं विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ yajñebhirukthairupa havyebhirīmahe śacīpate śacīnāṃ vi vo made śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryaṃ vivakṣase
verses.en: To thee with sacrifices, with oblations, and with lauds we come. Lord of all strength and power, grant-at your glad carouse-the best choice worthy treasure. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: यस्पतिर्वार्याणामसि रध्रस्य चोदिता । इन्द्र स्तोतॄणामविता वि वो मदे द्विषो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: yaspatirvāryāṇāmasi radhrasya coditā indra stotṝṇāmavitā vi vo made dviṣo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase
verses.en: Thou who art Lord of precious boons, inciter even of the churl. Guardian of singers, Indra,-at your glad carouse-save us from woe and hatred. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: युवं शक्रा मायाविना समीची निरमन्थतम् । विमदेन यदीळिता नासत्या निरमन्थतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śakrā māyāvinā samīcī niramanthatam vimadena yadīḻitā nāsatyā niramanthatam
verses.en: Strong, Lords of Magic power, ye Twain churned the united worlds apart, When ye, implored by Vimada, Nasatyas, forced apart the pair.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवा अकृपन्त समीच्योर्निष्पतन्त्योः । नासत्यावब्रुवन्देवाः पुनरा वहतादिति॥
verses.tr: viśve devā akṛpanta samīcyorniṣpatantyoḥ nāsatyāvabruvandevāḥ punarā vahatāditi
verses.en: When the united pair were rent asunder all the Gods complained. The Gods to the Nasatyas cried, Bring these together once again.

verses.sa: मधुमन्मे परायणं मधुमत्पुनरायनम् । ता नो देवा देवतया युवं मधुमतस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: madhumanme parāyaṇaṃ madhumatpunarāyanam tā no devā devatayā yuvaṃ madhumataskṛtam
verses.en: Sweet be my going forth, and rich in sweets be my approach to home. So, through your Deity, both Gods, enrich us with all pleasantness.

verses.sa:
भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् ।
अधा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणन्गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum adhā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇangāvo na yavase vivakṣase
verses.en: Send us a good and happy mind, send energy and mental power. Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, Sweet juice! as kine in pasture. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
हृदिस्पृशस्त आसते विश्वेषु सोम धामसु ।
अधा कामा इमे मम वि वो मदे वि तिष्ठन्ते वसूयवो विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: hṛdispṛśasta āsate viśveṣu soma dhāmasu adhā kāmā ime mama vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasūyavo vivakṣase
verses.en: rn all thy forms, O Soma, rest thy powers that influence the heart. So also these my longings-at your glad carouse-spread themselves seeking riches. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
उत व्रतानि सोम ते प्राहं मिनामि पाक्या ।
अधा पितेव सूनवे वि वो मदे मृळा नो अभि चिद्वधाद्विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: uta vratāni soma te prāhaṃ mināmi pākyā adhā piteva sūnave vi vo made mṛḻā no abhi cidvadhādvivakṣase
verses.en: Even if, O Soma, I neglect thy laws through my simplicity, Be gracious-at your glad carouse-as sire to son. Preserve us even from slaughter. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
समु प्र यन्ति धीतयः सर्गासोऽवताँ इव ।
क्रतुं नः सोम जीवसे वि वो मदे धारया चमसाँ इव विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: samu pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāso'vatāṃ iva kratuṃ naḥ soma jīvase vi vo made dhārayā camasāṃ iva vivakṣase
verses.en: Our songs in concert go to thee as streams of water to the wells. Soma, that we may live, grant-at your glad carouse-full powers of mind, like beakers. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये सोम शक्तिभिर्निकामासो व्यृण्विरे ।
गृत्सस्य धीरास्तवसो वि वो मदे व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनं विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tava tye soma śaktibhirnikāmāso vyṛṇvire gṛtsasya dhīrāstavaso vi vo made vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinaṃ vivakṣase
verses.en: O Soma, through thy might who art skillful and strong, these longing men, These sages, have thrown open-at your glad carouse-the stall of kine and horses. Thou art waxing great

verses.sa:
पशुं नः सोम रक्षसि पुरुत्रा विष्ठितं जगत् ।
समाकृणोषि जीवसे वि वो मदे विश्वा सम्पश्यन्भुवना विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: paśuṃ naḥ soma rakṣasi purutrā viṣṭhitaṃ jagat samākṛṇoṣi jīvase vi vo made viśvā sampaśyanbhuvanā vivakṣase
verses.en: Our herds thou guardest, Soma, and the moving world spread far and wide. Thou fittest them for living,-at your glad carouse-looking upon all beings. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो गोपा अदाभ्यो भव । सेध राजन्नप स्रिधो वि वो मदे मा नो दुःशंस ईशता विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato gopā adābhyo bhava sedha rājannapa sridho vi vo made mā no duḥśaṃsa īśatā vivakṣase
verses.en: On all sides, Soma, be to us a Guardian ne'er to be deceived. King, drive away our foemen-at your glad carouse:-let not the wicked rule us. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: त्वं नः सोम सुक्रतुर्वयोधेयाय जागृहि । क्षेत्रवित्तरो मनुषो वि वो मदे द्रुहो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ soma sukraturvayodheyāya jāgṛhi kṣetravittaro manuṣo vi vo made druho naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase
verses.en: Be watchful, Soma, passing wise, to give us store of vital strength. More skilled than man to guide us,-at your glad carouse-save us from harm and sorrow. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: त्वं नो वृत्रहन्तमेन्द्रस्येन्दो शिवः सखा । यत्सीं हवन्ते समिथे वि वो मदे युध्यमानास्तोकसातौ विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no vṛtrahantamendrasyendo śivaḥ sakhā yatsīṃ havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamānāstokasātau vivakṣase
verses.en: Chief slayer of our foemen, thou, Indu, art Indra's gracious Friend, When warriors invoke him-at your glad carouse -in fight, to win them offspring. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: अयं घ स तुरो मद इन्द्रस्य वर्धत प्रियः । अयं कक्षीवतो महो वि वो मदे मतिं विप्रस्य वर्धयद्विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyaḥ ayaṃ kakṣīvato maho vi vo made matiṃ viprasya vardhayadvivakṣase
verses.en: Victorious is this gladdening drink: to Indra dear it grows in strength. This-at your glad carouse -enhanced the mighty hymn of the great sage Kaksivan. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: अयं विप्राय दाशुषे वाजाँ इयर्ति गोमतः । अयं सप्तभ्य आ वरं वि वो मदे प्रान्धं श्रोणं च तारिषद्विवक्षसे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe vājāṃ iyarti gomataḥ ayaṃ saptabhya ā varaṃ vi vo made prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca tāriṣadvivakṣase
verses.en: This to the sage who offers gifts brings power that comes from wealth in kine. This, better than the seven, hath-at your glad carouse-furthered the blind, the cripple. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa: प्र ह्यच्छा मनीषा स्पार्हा यन्ति नियुतः । प्र दस्रा नियुद्रथः पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः॥
verses.tr: pra hyacchā manīṣā spārhā yanti niyutaḥ pra dasrā niyudrathaḥ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ
verses.en: Forward upon their way proceed the ready teams, the lovely songs. Further them glorious Pusan with yoked chariot, and the Mighty Twain!

verses.sa: यस्य त्यन्महित्वं वाताप्यमयं जनः । विप्र आ वंसद्धीतिभिश्चिकेत सुष्टुतीनाम्॥
verses.tr: yasya tyanmahitvaṃ vātāpyamayaṃ janaḥ vipra ā vaṃsaddhītibhiściketa suṣṭutīnām
verses.en: With sacred hymns let this man here, this singer, win the God to whom Belong this majesty and might. He hath observed our eulogies.

verses.sa: स वेद सुष्टुतीनामिन्दुर्न पूषा वृषा । अभि प्सुरः प्रुषायति व्रजं न आ प्रुषायति॥
verses.tr: sa veda suṣṭutīnāmindurna pūṣā vṛṣā abhi psuraḥ pruṣāyati vrajaṃ na ā pruṣāyati
verses.en: Pusan the Strong hath knowledge of sweet praises even as Indu hath. He dews our corn with moisture, he bedews the pasture of our kine.

verses.sa: मंसीमहि त्वा वयमस्माकं देव पूषन् । मतीनां च साधनं विप्राणां चाधवम्॥
verses.tr: maṃsīmahi tvā vayamasmākaṃ deva pūṣan matīnāṃ ca sādhanaṃ viprāṇāṃ cādhavam
verses.en: We will bethink ourselves of thee, O Pusan, O thou God, as One. Who brings fulfilment of our hymns, and stirs the singer and the sage.

verses.sa: प्रत्यर्धिर्यज्ञानामश्वहयो रथानाम् । ऋषिः स यो मनुर्हितो विप्रस्य यावयत्सखः॥
verses.tr: pratyardhiryajñānāmaśvahayo rathānām ṛṣiḥ sa yo manurhito viprasya yāvayatsakhaḥ
verses.en: joint-sharer of each sacrifice, the driver of the chariot steeds; The Rsi who is good to man, the singer's Friend and faithful Guard.

verses.sa: आधीषमाणायाः पतिः शुचायाश्च शुचस्य च । वासोवायोऽवीनामा वासांसि मर्मृजत्॥
verses.tr: ādhīṣamāṇāyāḥ patiḥ śucāyāśca śucasya ca vāsovāyo'vīnāmā vāsāṃsi marmṛjat
verses.en: One who is Lord of Suca, Lord of Suca caring for herself: Weaving the raiment of the sheep and making raiment beautiful.

verses.sa: इनो वाजानां पतिरिनः पुष्टीनां सखा । प्र श्मश्रु हर्यतो दूधोद्वि वृथा यो अदाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: ino vājānāṃ patirinaḥ puṣṭīnāṃ sakhā pra śmaśru haryato dūdhodvi vṛthā yo adābhyaḥ
verses.en: The mighty Lord of spoil and wealth, Strong Friend of all prosperity; He with light movement shakes his beard, lovely and ne'er to be deceived.

verses.sa: आ ते रथस्य पूषन्नजा धुरं ववृत्युः । विश्वस्यार्थिनः सखा सनोजा अनपच्युतः॥
verses.tr: ā te rathasya pūṣannajā dhuraṃ vavṛtyuḥ viśvasyārthinaḥ sakhā sanojā anapacyutaḥ
verses.en: O Pusan, may those goats of thine turn hitherward thy chariot-pole. Friend of all suppliants; art thou, born in old time, and arm and sure.

verses.sa: अस्माकमूर्जा रथं पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः । भुवद्वाजानां वृध इमं नः शृणवद्धवम्॥
verses.tr: asmākamūrjā rathaṃ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ bhuvadvājānāṃ vṛdha imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam
verses.en: May the majestic Pusan speed our chariot with his power and might. May he increase our store of wealth and listen to this call of ours.

verses.sa:
असत्सु मे जरितः साभिवेगो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षम् ।
अनाशीर्दामहमस्मि प्रहन्ता सत्यध्वृतं वृजिनायन्तमाभुम्॥
verses.tr: asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivego yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣam anāśīrdāmahamasmi prahantā satyadhvṛtaṃ vṛjināyantamābhum
verses.en: This, singer, is my firm determination, to aid the worshipper who pours the Soma. I slay the man who brings no milk oblation, unrighteous, powerful, the truth's perverter.

verses.sa:
यदीदहं युधये संनयान्यदेवयून्तन्वा३ शूशुजानान् ।
अमा ते तुम्रं वृषभं पचानि तीव्रं सुतं पञ्चदशं नि षिञ्चम्॥
verses.tr: yadīdahaṃ yudhaye saṃnayānyadevayūntanvā3 śūśujānān amā te tumraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pacāni tīvraṃ sutaṃ pañcadaśaṃ ni ṣiñcam
verses.en: Then Will I, when I lead my friends to battle against the radiant persons of the godless, Prepare for thee at home a vigorous bullock, and pour for thee the fifteen-fold strong juices.

verses.sa:
नाहं तं वेद य इति ब्रवीत्यदेवयून्त्समरणे जघन्वान् ।
यदावाख्यत्समरणमृघावदादिद्ध मे वृषभा प्र ब्रुवन्ति॥
verses.tr: nāhaṃ taṃ veda ya iti bravītyadevayūntsamaraṇe jaghanvān yadāvākhyatsamaraṇamṛghāvadādiddha me vṛṣabhā pra bruvanti
verses.en: I know not him who sayeth and declareth that he hath slain the godless in the battle. Soon as they see the furious combat raging, men speak forth praises of my vigorous horses.

verses.sa:
यदज्ञातेषु वृजनेष्वासं विश्वे सतो मघवानो म आसन् ।
जिनामि वेत्क्षेम आ सन्तमाभुं प्र तं क्षिणां पर्वते पादगृह्य॥
verses.tr: yadajñāteṣu vṛjaneṣvāsaṃ viśve sato maghavāno ma āsan jināmi vetkṣema ā santamābhuṃ pra taṃ kṣiṇāṃ parvate pādagṛhya
verses.en: While yet my deeds of might were unrecorded, all passed for Maghavans though I existed. The potent one who dwelt in peace I conquered, grasped by the foot and slew him on the mountain.

verses.sa:
न वा उ मां वृजने वारयन्ते न पर्वतासो यदहं मनस्ये ।
मम स्वनात्कृधुकर्णो भयात एवेदनु द्यून्किरणः समेजात्॥
verses.tr: na vā u māṃ vṛjane vārayante na parvatāso yadahaṃ manasye mama svanātkṛdhukarṇo bhayāta evedanu dyūnkiraṇaḥ samejāt
verses.en: None hinder me in mine heroic exploits, no, not the mountains when I will and purpose. Even the deaf will tremble at my roaring, and every day will dust be agitated.

verses.sa:
दर्शन्न्वत्र शृतपाँ अनिन्द्रान्बाहुक्षदः शरवे पत्यमानान् ।
घृषुं वा ये निनिदुः सखायमध्यू न्वेषु पवयो ववृत्युः॥
verses.tr: darśannvatra śṛtapāṃ anindrānbāhukṣadaḥ śarave patyamānān ghṛṣuṃ vā ye niniduḥ sakhāyamadhyū nveṣu pavayo vavṛtyuḥ
verses.en: To see the Indraless oblation-drinkers, mean offerers, o'ertaken by destruction! Then shall the fellies of my car pass over those who have blamed my joyous Friend and scorned him.

verses.sa:
अभूर्वौक्षीर्व्यु१ आयुरानड्दर्षन्नु पूर्वो अपरो नु दर्षत् ।
द्वे पवस्ते परि तं न भूतो यो अस्य पारे रजसो विवेष॥
verses.tr: abhūrvaukṣīrvyu1 āyurānaḍdarṣannu pūrvo aparo nu darṣat dve pavaste pari taṃ na bhūto yo asya pāre rajaso viveṣa
verses.en: Thou wast, thou grewest to full vital vigour: an earlier saw, a later one shall see thee. Two canopies, as 'twere, are round about him who reacheth to the limit of this region.

verses.sa:
गावो यवं प्रयुता अर्यो अक्षन्ता अपश्यं सहगोपाश्चरन्तीः ।
हवा इदर्यो अभितः समायन्कियदासु स्वपतिश्छन्दयाते॥
verses.tr: gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣantā apaśyaṃ sahagopāścarantīḥ havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyankiyadāsu svapatiśchandayāte
verses.en: The freed kine eat the barley of the pious. 1 saw them as they wandered with the herdsman. The calling of the pious rang around them. What portion will these kine afford their owner?

verses.sa:
सं यद्वयं यवसादो जनानामहं यवाद उर्वज्रे अन्तः ।
अत्रा युक्तोऽवसातारमिच्छादथो अयुक्तं युनजद्ववन्वान्॥
verses.tr: saṃ yadvayaṃ yavasādo janānāmahaṃ yavāda urvajre antaḥ atrā yukto'vasātāramicchādatho ayuktaṃ yunajadvavanvān
verses.en: When we who cat the grass of men are gathered I am with barley-eaters in the corn-land. There shall the captor yoke the yokeless bullock, and he who hath been yoked seek one to loose him.

verses.sa:
अत्रेदु मे मंससे सत्यमुक्तं द्विपाच्च यच्चतुष्पात्संसृजानि ।
स्त्रीभिर्यो अत्र वृषणं पृतन्यादयुद्धो अस्य वि भजानि वेदः॥
verses.tr: atredu me maṃsase satyamuktaṃ dvipācca yaccatuṣpātsaṃsṛjāni strībhiryo atra vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtanyādayuddho asya vi bhajāni vedaḥ
verses.en: There wilt thou hold as true my spoken purpose, to bring together quadrupeds. and bipeds. I will divide, without a fight, his riches who warreth here, against the Bull, with women.

verses.sa:
यस्यानक्षा दुहिता जात्वास कस्तां विद्वाँ अभि मन्याते अन्धाम् ।
कतरो मेनिं प्रति तं मुचाते य ईं वहाते य ईं वा वरेयात्॥
verses.tr: yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kastāṃ vidvāṃ abhi manyāte andhām kataro meniṃ prati taṃ mucāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt
verses.en: When a man's daughter hath been ever eyeless, who, knowing, will be wroth with her for blindness? Which of the two will loose on him his anger-the man who leads her home or he who woos her?

verses.sa:
कियती योषा मर्यतो वधूयोः परिप्रीता पन्यसा वार्येण ।
भद्रा वधूर्भवति यत्सुपेशाः स्वयं सा मित्रं वनुते जने चित्॥
verses.tr: kiyatī yoṣā maryato vadhūyoḥ pariprītā panyasā vāryeṇa bhadrā vadhūrbhavati yatsupeśāḥ svayaṃ sā mitraṃ vanute jane cit
verses.en: How many a maid is pleasing to the suitor who fain would marry for her splendid riches? If the girl be both good and fair of feature, she finds, herself, a friend among the people.

verses.sa:
पत्तो जगार प्रत्यञ्चमत्ति शीर्ष्णा शिरः प्रति दधौ वरूथम् ।
आसीन ऊर्ध्वामुपसि क्षिणाति न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेति भूमिम्॥
verses.tr: patto jagāra pratyañcamatti śīrṣṇā śiraḥ prati dadhau varūtham āsīna ūrdhvāmupasi kṣiṇāti nyaṅṅuttānāmanveti bhūmim
verses.en: His feet have grasped: he eats the man who meets him. Around his head he sets the head for shelter. Sitting anear and right above he smites us, and follows earth that lies spread out beneath him.

verses.sa:
बृहन्नच्छायो अपलाशो अर्वा तस्थौ माता विषितो अत्ति गर्भः ।
अन्यस्या वत्सं रिहती मिमाय कया भुवा नि दधे धेनुरूधः॥
verses.tr: bṛhannacchāyo apalāśo arvā tasthau mātā viṣito atti garbhaḥ anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurūdhaḥ
verses.en: High, leafless, shadowless, and swift is Heaven: the Mother stands, the Youngling, loosed, is feeding. Loud hath she lowed, licking Another's offspring. In what world hath the Cow laid down her udder?

verses.sa:
सप्त वीरासो अधरादुदायन्नष्टोत्तरात्तात्समजग्मिरन्ते ।
नव पश्चातात्स्थिविमन्त आयन्दश प्राक्सानु वि तिरन्त्यश्नः॥
verses.tr: sapta vīrāso adharādudāyannaṣṭottarāttātsamajagmirante nava paścātātsthivimanta āyandaśa prāksānu vi tirantyaśnaḥ
verses.en: Seven heroes from the nether part ascended, and from the upper part came eight together. Nine from behind came armed with winnowing-baskets: ten from the front pressed o'er the rock's high ridges.

verses.sa:
दशानामेकं कपिलं समानं तं हिन्वन्ति क्रतवे पार्याय ।
गर्भं माता सुधितं वक्षणास्ववेनन्तं तुषयन्ती बिभर्ति॥
verses.tr: daśānāmekaṃ kapilaṃ samānaṃ taṃ hinvanti kratave pāryāya garbhaṃ mātā sudhitaṃ vakṣaṇāsvavenantaṃ tuṣayantī bibharti
verses.en: One of the ten, the tawny, shared in common, they send to execute their final purpose. The Mother carries on her breast the Infant of noble form and soothes it while it knows not.

verses.sa:
पीवानं मेषमपचन्त वीरा न्युप्ता अक्षा अनु दीव आसन् ।
द्वा धनुं बृहतीमप्स्व१न्तः पवित्रवन्ता चरतः पुनन्ता॥
verses.tr: pīvānaṃ meṣamapacanta vīrā nyuptā akṣā anu dīva āsan dvā dhanuṃ bṛhatīmapsva1ntaḥ pavitravantā carataḥ punantā
verses.en: The Heroes dressed with fire the fatted weather: the dice were thrown by way of sport and gaming. Two reach the plain amid the heavenly waters, hallowing and with means of purifying.

verses.sa:
वि क्रोशनासो विष्वञ्च आयन्पचाति नेमो नहि पक्षदर्धः ।
अयं मे देवः सविता तदाह द्र्वन्न इद्वनवत्सर्पिरन्नः॥
verses.tr: vi krośanāso viṣvañca āyanpacāti nemo nahi pakṣadardhaḥ ayaṃ me devaḥ savitā tadāha drvanna idvanavatsarpirannaḥ
verses.en: Crying aloud they ran in all directions: One half of them will cook, and not the other. To me hath Savitar, this God, declared it: He will perform, whose food is wood and butter.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं ग्रामं वहमानमारादचक्रया स्वधया वर्तमानम् ।
सिषक्त्यर्यः प्र युगा जनानां सद्यः शिश्ना प्रमिनानो नवीयान्॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ grāmaṃ vahamānamārādacakrayā svadhayā vartamānam siṣaktyaryaḥ pra yugā janānāṃ sadyaḥ śiśnā pramināno navīyān
verses.en: I saw a troop advancing from the distance moved, not by wheels but their own God-like nature. The Friendly One seeks human generations, destroying, still new bands of evil beings.

verses.sa:
एतौ मे गावौ प्रमरस्य युक्तौ मो षु प्र सेधीर्मुहुरिन्ममन्धि ।
आपश्चिदस्य वि नशन्त्यर्थं सूरश्च मर्क उपरो बभूवान्॥
verses.tr: etau me gāvau pramarasya yuktau mo ṣu pra sedhīrmuhurinmamandhi āpaścidasya vi naśantyarthaṃ sūraśca marka uparo babhūvān
verses.en: These my two Bulls, even Pramara's, are harnessed: drive them not far; here let them often linger. The waters even shall aid him to his object, and the all-cleansing Sun who is above us.

verses.sa:
अयं यो वज्रः पुरुधा विवृत्तोऽवः सूर्यस्य बृहतः पुरीषात् ।
श्रव इदेना परो अन्यदस्ति तदव्यथी जरिमाणस्तरन्ति॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo vajraḥ purudhā vivṛtto'vaḥ sūryasya bṛhataḥ purīṣāt śrava idenā paro anyadasti tadavyathī jarimāṇastaranti
verses.en: This is the thunderbolt which often whirleth down from the lofty misty realm of Surya. Beyond this realm there is another glory so through old age they pass and feel no sorrow.

verses.sa:
वृक्षेवृक्षे नियता मीमयद्गौस्ततो वयः प्र पतान्पूरुषादः ।
अथेदं विश्वं भुवनं भयात इन्द्राय सुन्वदृषये च शिक्षत्॥
verses.tr: vṛkṣevṛkṣe niyatā mīmayadgaustato vayaḥ pra patānpūruṣādaḥ athedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhayāta indrāya sunvadṛṣaye ca śikṣat
verses.en: Bound fast to,every tree the cow is lowing, and thence the man-consuming birds are flying, Then all this world, though pressing juice for Indra and strengthening the Rsi, is affrighted.

verses.sa:
देवानां माने प्रथमा अतिष्ठन्कृन्तत्रादेषामुपरा उदायन् ।
त्रयस्तपन्ति पृथिवीमनूपा द्वा बृबूकं वहतः पुरीषम्॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ māne prathamā atiṣṭhankṛntatrādeṣāmuparā udāyan trayastapanti pṛthivīmanūpā dvā bṛbūkaṃ vahataḥ purīṣam
verses.en: In the Gods' mansion stood the first-created, and from their separation came the later. Three warm the Earth while holding stores of water, and Two of these convey the murmuring moisture.

verses.sa:
सा ते जीवातुरुत तस्य विद्धि मा स्मैतादृगप गूहः समर्ये ।
आविः स्वः कृणुते गूहते बुसं स पादुरस्य निर्णिजो न मुच्यते॥
verses.tr: sā te jīvāturuta tasya viddhi mā smaitādṛgapa gūhaḥ samarye āviḥ svaḥ kṛṇute gūhate busaṃ sa pādurasya nirṇijo na mucyate
verses.en: This is thy life: and do thou mark and know it. As such, hide not thyself in time of battle. He manifests the light and hides the vapour: his foot is never free from robes that veil it.

verses.sa:
विश्वो ह्य१न्यो अरिराजगाम ममेदह श्वशुरो ना जगाम ।
जक्षीयाद्धाना उत सोमं पपीयात्स्वाशितः पुनरस्तं जगायात्॥
verses.tr: viśvo hya1nyo arirājagāma mamedaha śvaśuro nā jagāma jakṣīyāddhānā uta somaṃ papīyātsvāśitaḥ punarastaṃ jagāyāt
verses.en: Now all my other friends are here assembled: my Sire-in-law alone hath not come hither. So might he eat the grain and drink the Soma, and, satisfied, return unto; his dwelling.

verses.sa:
स रोरुवद्वृषभस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वर्ष्मन्तस्थौ वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः ।
विश्वेष्वेनं वृजनेषु पामि यो मे कुक्षी सुतसोमः पृणाति॥
verses.tr: sa roruvadvṛṣabhastigmaśṛṅgo varṣmantasthau varimannā pṛthivyāḥ viśveṣvenaṃ vṛjaneṣu pāmi yo me kukṣī sutasomaḥ pṛṇāti
verses.en: Loud belloweth the Bull whose horns are sharpened: upon the height above earth's breadth he standeth. That man I guard and save in all his troubles who fills my flanks when he hath shed the Soma.

verses.sa:
अद्रिणा ते मन्दिन इन्द्र तूयान्त्सुन्वन्ति सोमान्पिबसि त्वमेषाम् ।
पचन्ति ते वृषभाँ अत्सि तेषां पृक्षेण यन्मघवन्हूयमानः॥
verses.tr: adriṇā te mandina indra tūyāntsunvanti somānpibasi tvameṣām pacanti te vṛṣabhāṃ atsi teṣāṃ pṛkṣeṇa yanmaghavanhūyamānaḥ
verses.en: Men with the stone press out for thee, O Indra, strong, gladdening Soma, and thereof thou drinkest. Bulls they dress for thee, and of these thou eatest when, Maghavan, with food thou art invited.

verses.sa:
इदं सु मे जरितरा चिकिद्धि प्रतीपं शापं नद्यो वहन्ति ।
लोपाशः सिंहं प्रत्यञ्चमत्साः क्रोष्टा वराहं निरतक्त कक्षात्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ su me jaritarā cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ nadyo vahanti lopāśaḥ siṃhaṃ pratyañcamatsāḥ kroṣṭā varāhaṃ niratakta kakṣāt
verses.en: Resolve for me, O singer, this my riddle: The rivers send their swelling water backward: The fox steals up to the approaching lion: the jackal drives the wild-boar from the brushwood.

verses.sa:
कथा त एतदहमा चिकेतं गृत्सस्य पाकस्तवसो मनीषाम् ।
त्वं नो विद्वाँ ऋतुथा वि वोचो यमर्धं ते मघवन्क्षेम्या धूः॥
verses.tr: kathā ta etadahamā ciketaṃ gṛtsasya pākastavaso manīṣām tvaṃ no vidvāṃ ṛtuthā vi voco yamardhaṃ te maghavankṣemyā dhūḥ
verses.en: How shall I solve this riddle, I, the simple, declare the thought of thee the Wise and Mighty? Tell us, well knowing, as befits the season: Whitherward is thy prosperous car advancing?

verses.sa:
एवा हि मां तवसं वर्धयन्ति दिवश्चिन्मे बृहत उत्तरा धूः ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि साकमशत्रुं हि मा जनिता जजान॥
verses.tr: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ vardhayanti divaścinme bṛhata uttarā dhūḥ purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi sākamaśatruṃ hi mā janitā jajāna
verses.en: Thus do they magnify me, me the mighty higher than even high heaven is my car-pole. I all at once demolish many thousands: my Sire begot me with no foe to match me.

verses.sa:
एवा हि मां तवसं जज्ञुरुग्रं कर्मन्कर्मन्वृषणमिन्द्र देवाः ।
वधीं वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानोऽप व्रजं महिना दाशुषे वम्॥
verses.tr: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ jajñurugraṃ karmankarmanvṛṣaṇamindra devāḥ vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasāno'pa vrajaṃ mahinā dāśuṣe vam
verses.en: Yea, and the Gods have known me also, Indra, as mighty, fierce and strong in every exploit. Exulting with the bolt I slaughtered Vrtra, and for the offerer open with might the cow-stall.

verses.sa:
देवास आयन्परशूँरबिभ्रन्वना वृश्चन्तो अभि विड्भिरायन् ।
नि सुद्र्वं१ दधतो वक्षणासु यत्रा कृपीटमनु तद्दहन्ति॥
verses.tr: devāsa āyanparaśūṃrabibhranvanā vṛścanto abhi viḍbhirāyan ni sudrvaṃ1 dadhato vakṣaṇāsu yatrā kṛpīṭamanu taddahanti
verses.en: The Deities approached, they carried axes; splitting the wood they came with their attendants. They laid good timber in the fire-receivers, and burnt the grass up where they found it growing.

verses.sa:
शशः क्षुरं प्रत्यञ्चं जगाराऽद्रिं लोगेन व्यभेदमारात् ।
बृहन्तं चिदृहते रन्धयानि वयद्वत्सो वृषभं शूशुवानः॥
verses.tr: śaśaḥ kṣuraṃ pratyañcaṃ jagārā'driṃ logena vyabhedamārāt bṛhantaṃ cidṛhate randhayāni vayadvatso vṛṣabhaṃ śūśuvānaḥ
verses.en: The hare hath swallowed up the opposing razor: I sundered with a clod the distant mountain. The great will I make subject to the little: the calf shall wax in strength and cat the bullock.

verses.sa:
सुपर्ण इत्था नखमा सिषायावरुद्धः परिपदं न सिंहः ।
निरुद्धश्चिन्महिषस्तर्ष्यावान्गोधा तस्मा अयथं कर्षदेतत्॥
verses.tr: suparṇa itthā nakhamā siṣāyāvaruddhaḥ paripadaṃ na siṃhaḥ niruddhaścinmahiṣastarṣyāvāngodhā tasmā ayathaṃ karṣadetat
verses.en: There hath the strong-winged eagle left his talon, as a snared lion leaves the trap that caught him. Even the wild steer in his thirst is captured: the leather strap still holds his foot entangled.

verses.sa:
तेभ्यो गोधा अयथं कर्षदेतद्ये ब्रह्मणः प्रतिपीयन्त्यन्नैः ।
सिम उक्ष्णोऽवसृष्टाँ अदन्ति स्वयं बलानि तन्वः शृणानाः॥
verses.tr: tebhyo godhā ayathaṃ karṣadetadye brahmaṇaḥ pratipīyantyannaiḥ sima ukṣṇo'vasṛṣṭāṃ adanti svayaṃ balāni tanvaḥ śṛṇānāḥ
verses.en: So may the leather strap their foot entangle who fatten on the viands of the Brahman. They all devour the bulls set free to wander, while they themselves destroy their bodies' vigour.

verses.sa:
एते शमीभिः सुशमी अभूवन्ये हिन्विरे तन्व१ः सोम उक्थैः ।
नृवद्वदन्नुप नो माहि वाजान्दिवि श्रवो दधिषे नाम वीरः॥
verses.tr: ete śamībhiḥ suśamī abhūvanye hinvire tanva1ḥ soma ukthaiḥ nṛvadvadannupa no māhi vājāndivi śravo dadhiṣe nāma vīraḥ
verses.en: They were well occupied with holy duties who sped in person with their lauds to Soma. Speaking like man, mete to us wealth and booty: in heaven thou hast the name and fame of Hero.

verses.sa:
वने न वा यो न्यधायि चाकञ्छुचिर्वां स्तोमो भुरणावजीगः ।
यस्येदिन्द्रः पुरुदिनेषु होता नृणां नर्यो नृतमः क्षपावान्॥
verses.tr: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākañchucirvāṃ stomo bhuraṇāvajīgaḥ yasyedindraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān
verses.en: As sits the young bird on the tree rejoicing, ye, swift Pair, have been roused by clear laudation, Whose Herald-Priest through many days is Indra, earth's Guardian, Friend of men, the best of Heroes.

verses.sa:
प्र ते अस्या उषसः प्रापरस्या नृतौ स्याम नृतमस्य नृणाम् ।
अनु त्रिशोकः शतमावहन्नॄन्कुत्सेन रथो यो असत्ससवान्॥
verses.tr: pra te asyā uṣasaḥ prāparasyā nṛtau syāma nṛtamasya nṛṇām anu triśokaḥ śatamāvahannṝnkutsena ratho yo asatsasavān
verses.en: May we, when this Dawn and the next dance hither, be thy best servants, most heroic Hero! Let the victorious car with triple splendour bring hitherward the hundred chiefs with Kutsa.

verses.sa:
कस्ते मद इन्द्र रन्त्यो भूद्दुरो गिरो अभ्यु१ग्रो वि धाव ।
कद्वाहो अर्वागुप मा मनीषा आ त्वा शक्यामुपमं राधो अन्नैः॥
verses.tr: kaste mada indra rantyo bhūdduro giro abhyu1gro vi dhāva kadvāho arvāgupa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyāmupamaṃ rādho annaiḥ
verses.en: What was the gladdening draught that pleased thee, Indra? Speed through our doors to songs, for thou art mighty. Why comest thou to me, what gift attracts thee? Fain would I bring thee food most meet to offer.

verses.sa:
कदु द्युम्नमिन्द्र त्वावतो नॄन्कया धिया करसय कन्न आगन् ।
मित्रो न सत्य उरुगाय भृत्या अन्ने समस्य यदसन्मनीषाः॥
verses.tr: kadu dyumnamindra tvāvato nṝnkayā dhiyā karasaya kanna āgan mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yadasanmanīṣāḥ
verses.en: Indra, what fame hath one like thee mid heroes? With what plan wilt thou act? Why hast thou sought us? As a true Friend, Wide-Strider! to sustain us, since food absorbs the thought of each among us.

verses.sa:
प्रेरय सूरो अर्थं न पारं ये अस्य कामं जनिधा इव ग्मन् ।
गिरश्च ये ते तुविजात पूर्वीर्नर इन्द्र प्रतिशिक्षन्त्यन्नैः॥
verses.tr: preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman giraśca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīrnara indra pratiśikṣantyannaiḥ
verses.en: Speed happily those, as Surya ends his journey, who meet his wish as bridegrooms meet their spouses; Men who present, O Indra strong by nature, with food the many songs that tell thy praises.

verses.sa:
मात्रे नु ते सुमिते इन्द्र पूर्वी द्यौर्मज्मना पृथिवी काव्येन ।
वराय ते घृतवन्तः सुतासः स्वाद्मन्भवन्तु पीतये मधूनि॥
verses.tr: mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaurmajmanā pṛthivī kāvyena varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādmanbhavantu pītaye madhūni
verses.en: Thine are two measures, Indra, wide-well meted, heaven for thy majesty, earth for thy wisdom. Here for thy choice are Somas mixed with butter: may the sweet meath be pleasant for thy drinking.

verses.sa:
आ मध्वो अस्मा असिचन्नमत्रमिन्द्राय पूर्णं स हि सत्यराधाः ।
स वावृधे वरिमन्ना पृथिव्या अभि क्रत्वा नर्यः पौंस्यैश्च॥
verses.tr: ā madhvo asmā asicannamatramindrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ sa vāvṛdhe varimannā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiśca
verses.en: They have poured out a bowl to him, to Indra, full of sweet juice, for faithful is his bounty. O'er earth's expanse hath he grown great by wisdom, the Friend of man, and by heroic exploits.

verses.sa:
व्यानळिन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा आस्मै यतन्ते सख्याय पूर्वीः ।
आ स्मा रथं न पृतनासु तिष्ठ यं भद्रया सुमत्या चोदयासे॥
verses.tr: vyānaḻindraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yaṃ bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse
verses.en: Indra hath conquered in his wars, the Mighty: men strive in multitudes to win his friendship. Ascend thy chariot as it were in battle, which thou shalt drive to us with gracious favour.

verses.sa:
प्र देवत्रा ब्रह्मणे गातुरेत्वपो अच्छा मनसो न प्रयुक्ति ।
महीं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिं पृथुज्रयसे रीरधा सुवृक्तिम्॥
verses.tr: pra devatrā brahmaṇe gāturetvapo acchā manaso na prayukti mahīṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsiṃ pṛthujrayase rīradhā suvṛktim
verses.en: As 'twere with swift exertion of the spirit, let the priest speed to the celestial Waters, The glorious food of Varuna and Mitra. To him who spreadeth far this laud I offer.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो हविष्मन्तो हि भूताऽच्छाप इतोशतीरुशन्तः ।
अव याश्चष्टे अरुणः सुपर्णस्तमास्यध्वमूर्मिमद्या सुहस्ताः॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo haviṣmanto hi bhūtā'cchāpa itośatīruśantaḥ ava yāścaṣṭe aruṇaḥ suparṇastamāsyadhvamūrmimadyā suhastāḥ
verses.en: Adhvaryus, he ye ready with oblations,, and come with longing to the longing Waters, Down on which looks the. purple-tinted Eagle. Pour ye that flowing wave this day, deft-handed.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवोऽप इता समुद्रमपां नपातं हविषा यजध्वम् ।
स वो दददूर्मिमद्या सुपूतं तस्मै सोमं मधुमन्तं सुनोत॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo'pa itā samudramapāṃ napātaṃ haviṣā yajadhvam sa vo dadadūrmimadyā supūtaṃ tasmai somaṃ madhumantaṃ sunota
verses.en: Go to the reservoir, O ye Adhvaryus worship the Waters' Child with your oblations. A consecrated wave he now will give you, so press for him the Soma rich in sweetness.

verses.sa:
यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्व१न्तर्यं विप्रास ईळते अध्वरेषु ।
अपां नपान्मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्याय॥
verses.tr: yo anidhmo dīdayadapsva1ntaryaṃ viprāsa īḻate adhvareṣu apāṃ napānmadhumatīrapo dā yābhirindro vāvṛdhe vīryāya
verses.en: He who shines bright in floods, unfed with fuel, whom sages worship at their sacrifices: Give waters rich in sweets, Child of the Waters, even those which gave heroic might to Indra:

verses.sa:
याभिः सोमो मोदते हर्षते च कल्याणीभिर्युवतिभिर्न मर्यः ।
ता अध्वर्यो अपो अच्छा परेहि यदासिञ्चा ओषधीभिः पुनीतात्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ somo modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhiryuvatibhirna maryaḥ tā adhvaryo apo acchā parehi yadāsiñcā oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt
verses.en: Those in which Soma joys and is delighted, as a young man with fair and pleasant damsels. Go thou unto those Waters, O Adhvaryu, and purify with herbs what thou infusest.

verses.sa:
एवेद्यूने युवतयो नमन्त यदीमुशन्नुशतीरेत्यच्छ ।
सं जानते मनसा सं चिकित्रेऽध्वर्यवो धिषणापश्च देवीः॥
verses.tr: evedyūne yuvatayo namanta yadīmuśannuśatīretyaccha saṃ jānate manasā saṃ cikitre'dhvaryavo dhiṣaṇāpaśca devīḥ
verses.en: So maidens bow before the youthful gallant who comes with love to them who yearn to meet him. In heart accordant and in wish one-minded are the Adhvaryus and the heavenly Waters.

verses.sa:
यो वो वृताभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकं यो वो मह्या अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चत् ।
तस्मा इन्द्राय मधुमन्तमूर्मिं देवमादनं प्र हिणोतनापः॥
verses.tr: yo vo vṛtābhyo akṛṇodu lokaṃ yo vo mahyā abhiśasteramuñcat tasmā indrāya madhumantamūrmiṃ devamādanaṃ pra hiṇotanāpaḥ
verses.en: He who made room for you when fast imprisoned, who freed you from the mighty imprecation,- Even to that Indra send the meath-rich current, the wave that gratifies the Gods, O Waters.

verses.sa:
प्रास्मै हिनोत मधुमन्तमूर्मिं गर्भो यो वः सिन्धवो मध्व उत्सः ।
घृतपृष्ठमीड्यमध्वरेष्वाऽऽपो रेवतीः शृणुता हवं मे॥
verses.tr: prāsmai hinota madhumantamūrmiṃ garbho yo vaḥ sindhavo madhva utsaḥ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamīḍyamadhvareṣvā''po revatīḥ śṛṇutā havaṃ me
verses.en: Send forth to him the meath-rich wave, O Rivers, which is your offspring and a well of sweetness, Oil-balmed, to be implored at sacrifices. Ye wealthy Waters, hear mine invocation.

verses.sa:
तं सिन्धवो मत्सरमिन्द्रपानमूर्मिं प्र हेत य उभे इयर्ति ।
मदच्युतमौशानं नभोजां परि त्रितन्तुं विचरन्तमुत्सम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ sindhavo matsaramindrapānamūrmiṃ pra heta ya ubhe iyarti madacyutamauśānaṃ nabhojāṃ pari tritantuṃ vicarantamutsam
verses.en: Send forth the rapture-giving wave, O Rivers, which Indra drinks, which sets the Twain in motion; The well that springeth from the clouds, desirous, that wandereth triple-formed, distilling transport.

verses.sa:
आवर्वृततीरध नु द्विधारा गोषुयुधो न नियवं चरन्तीः ।
ऋषे जनित्रीर्भुवनस्य पत्नीरपो वन्दस्व सवृधः सयोनीः॥
verses.tr: āvarvṛtatīradha nu dvidhārā goṣuyudho na niyavaṃ carantīḥ ṛṣe janitrīrbhuvanasya patnīrapo vandasva savṛdhaḥ sayonīḥ
verses.en: These winding Streams which with their double current, like cattle-raiders, seek the lower pastures,- Waters which dwell together, thrive together, Queens, Mothers of the world, these, Rsi, honour.

verses.sa:
हिनोता नो अध्वरं देवयज्या हिनोत ब्रह्म सनये धनानाम् ।
ऋतस्य योगे वि ष्यध्वमूधः श्रुष्टीवरीर्भूतनास्मभ्यमापः॥
verses.tr: hinotā no adhvaraṃ devayajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām ṛtasya yoge vi ṣyadhvamūdhaḥ śruṣṭīvarīrbhūtanāsmabhyamāpaḥ
verses.en: Send forth our sacrifice with holy worship send forth the hymn and prayer for gain of riches. For need of sacrifice disclose the udder. Give gracious hearing to our call, O Waters.

verses.sa:
आपो रेवतीः क्षयथा हि वस्वः क्रतुं च भद्रं बिभृथामृतं च ।
रायश्च स्थ स्वपत्यस्य पत्नीः सरस्वती तद्गृणते वयो धात्॥
verses.tr: āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasvaḥ kratuṃ ca bhadraṃ bibhṛthāmṛtaṃ ca rāyaśca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tadgṛṇate vayo dhāt
verses.en: For, wealthy Waters, ye control all treasures: ye bring auspicious intellect and Amrta. Ye are the Queens of independent riches Sarasvati give full life to the singer!

verses.sa:
प्रति यदापो अदृश्रमायतीर्घृतं पयांसि बिभ्रतीर्मधूनि ।
अध्वर्युभिर्मनसा संविदाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तीः॥
verses.tr: prati yadāpo adṛśramāyatīrghṛtaṃ payāṃsi bibhratīrmadhūni adhvaryubhirmanasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantīḥ
verses.en: When I behold the Waters coming hither, carrying with them milk and meath and butter, Bearing the well-pressed Soma juice to Indra, they harmonize in spirit with Adhvaryus.

verses.sa:
एमा अग्मन्रेवतीर्जीवधन्या अध्वर्यवः सादयता सखायः ।
नि बर्हिषि धत्तन सोम्यासोऽपां नप्त्रा संविदानास एनाः॥
verses.tr: emā agmanrevatīrjīvadhanyā adhvaryavaḥ sādayatā sakhāyaḥ ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāso'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enāḥ
verses.en: Rich, they are come with wealth for living beings, O friends, Adhvaryus, seat them in their places. Seat them on holy grass, ye Soma-bringers in harmony with the Offspring of the Waters.

verses.sa:
आग्मन्नाप उशतीर्बर्हिरेदं न्यध्वरे असदन्देवयन्तीः ।
अध्वर्यवः सुनुतेन्द्राय सोममभूदु वः सुशका देवयज्या॥
verses.tr: āgmannāpa uśatīrbarhiredaṃ nyadhvare asadandevayantīḥ adhvaryavaḥ sunutendrāya somamabhūdu vaḥ suśakā devayajyā
verses.en: Now to this grass are come the longing Waters: the Pious Ones are seated at our worship. Adhvaryus, press the Soma juice for Indra so will the service of the Gods be easy.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवानामुप वेतु शंसो विश्वेभिस्तुरैरवसे यजत्रः ।
तेभिर्वयं सुषखायो भवेम तरन्तो विश्वा दुरिता स्याम॥
verses.tr: ā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃso viśvebhisturairavase yajatraḥ tebhirvayaṃ suṣakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma
verses.en: May benediction of the Gods approach us, holy, to aid us with all rapid succours. Therewith may we be happily befriended, and pass triumphant over all our troubles.

verses.sa:
परि चिन्मर्तो द्रविणं ममन्यादृतस्य पथा नमसा विवासेत् ।
उत स्वेन क्रतुना सं वदेत श्रेयांसं दक्षं मनसा जगृभ्यात्॥
verses.tr: pari cinmarto draviṇaṃ mamanyādṛtasya pathā namasā vivāset uta svena kratunā saṃ vadeta śreyāṃsaṃ dakṣaṃ manasā jagṛbhyāt
verses.en: A man should think on wealth and strive to win it by adoration on the path of Order, Counsel himself with his own mental insight, and grasp still nobler vigour with his spirit.

verses.sa:
अधायि धीतिरससृग्रमंशास्तीर्थे न दस्ममुप यन्त्यूमाः ।
अभ्यानश्म सुवितस्य शूषं नवेदसो अमृतानामभूम॥
verses.tr: adhāyi dhītirasasṛgramaṃśāstīrthe na dasmamupa yantyūmāḥ abhyānaśma suvitasya śūṣaṃ navedaso amṛtānāmabhūma
verses.en: The hymn is formed, poured are the allotted portions: as to a ford friends come unto the Wondrous. We have obtained the power of case and comfort, we have become acquainted, with Immortals.

verses.sa:
नित्यश्चाकन्यात्स्वपतिर्दमूना यस्मा उ देवः सविता जजान ।
भगो वा गोभिरर्यमेमनज्यात्सो अस्मै चारुश्छदयदुत स्यात्॥
verses.tr: nityaścākanyātsvapatirdamūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jajāna bhago vā gobhiraryamemanajyātso asmai cāruśchadayaduta syāt
verses.en: Pleased be the Eternal Lord who loves the household with this man whom God Savitar created. May Bhaga Aryaman grace him with cattle: may he appear to him, and be, delightful.

verses.sa:
इयं सा भूया उषसामिव क्षा यद्ध क्षुमन्तः शवसा समायन् ।
अस्य स्तुतिं जरितुर्भिक्षमाणा आ नः शग्मास उप यन्तु वाजाः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ sā bhūyā uṣasāmiva kṣā yaddha kṣumantaḥ śavasā samāyan asya stutiṃ jariturbhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śagmāsa upa yantu vājāḥ
verses.en: Like the Dawns' dwelling-place be this assembly, where in their might men rich in food have gathered. Striving to share the praises of this singer. To us come strengthening and effectual riches!

verses.sa:
अस्येदेषा सुमतिः पप्रथानाऽभवत्पूर्व्या भूमना गौः ।
अस्य सनीळा असुरस्य योनौ समान आ भरणे बिभ्रमाणाः॥
verses.tr: asyedeṣā sumatiḥ paprathānā'bhavatpūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ asya sanīḻā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ
verses.en: This Bull's most gracious far-extended favour existed first of all in full abundance. By his support they are maintained in common who in the Asura's mansion dwell together.

verses.sa:
किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
संतस्थाने अजरे इतऊती अहानि पूर्वीरुषसो जरन्त॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīruṣaso jaranta
verses.en: What was the tree, what wood, in sooth, produced it, from which they fashioned forth the Earth and Heaven? These Twain stand fast and wax not old for ever: these have sung praise to many a day and morning.

verses.sa:
नैतावदेना परो अन्यदस्त्युक्षा स द्यावापृथिवी बिभर्ति ।
त्वचं पवित्रं कृणुत स्वधावान्यदीं सूर्यं न हरितो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: naitāvadenā paro anyadastyukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti tvacaṃ pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvānyadīṃ sūryaṃ na harito vahanti
verses.en: Not only here is this: more is beyond us. He is the Bull, the Heaven's and Earth's supporter. With power divine he makes his skin a filter, when the Bay Coursers bear him on as Surya.

verses.sa:
स्तेगो न क्षामत्येति पृथ्वीं मिहं न वातो वि ह वाति भूम ।
मित्रो यत्र वरुणो अज्यमानोऽग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम्॥
verses.tr: stego na kṣāmatyeti pṛthvīṃ mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno'gnirvane na vyasṛṣṭa śokam
verses.en: He passes o'er the broad earth like a Stega: he penetrates the world as Wind the mist-cloud. He, balmed with oil, near Varuna and Mitra, like Agni in the wood, hath shot forth splendour.

verses.sa:
स्तरीर्यत्सूत सद्यो अज्यमाना व्यथिरव्यथीः कृणुत स्वगोपा ।
पुत्रो यत्पूर्वः पित्रोर्जनिष्ट शम्यां गौर्जगार यद्ध पृच्छान्॥
verses.tr: starīryatsūta sadyo ajyamānā vyathiravyathīḥ kṛṇuta svagopā putro yatpūrvaḥ pitrorjaniṣṭa śamyāṃ gaurjagāra yaddha pṛcchān
verses.en: When suddenly called the cow that erst was barren, she, self-protected, ended all her troubles. Earth, when the first son sprang from sire and mother, cast up the game, that which men were seeking.

verses.sa:
उत कण्वं नृषदः पुत्रमाहुरुत श्यावो धनमादत्त वाजी ।
प्र कृष्णाय रुशदपिन्वतोधॠतमत्र नकिरस्मा अपीपेत्॥
verses.tr: uta kaṇvaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putramāhuruta śyāvo dhanamādatta vājī pra kṛṣṇāya ruśadapinvatodhaṝtamatra nakirasmā apīpet
verses.en: To Nrsad's son they gave the name of Kainva, and he the brown-hued courser won the treasure. For him dark-coloured streamed the shining udder: none made it swell for him. Thus Order willed it.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ग्मन्ता धियसानस्य सक्षणि वरेभिर्वराँ अभि षु प्रसीदतः ।
अस्माकमिन्द्र उभयं जुजोषति यत्सोम्यस्यान्धसो बुबोधति॥
verses.tr: pra su gmantā dhiyasānasya sakṣaṇi varebhirvarāṃ abhi ṣu prasīdataḥ asmākamindra ubhayaṃ jujoṣati yatsomyasyāndhaso bubodhati
verses.en: Forth speed the Pair to bring the meditating God, benevolent with boons sent in return for boons. May Indra graciously accept both gifts from us, when he hath knowledge of the flowing Soma juice.

verses.sa:
वीन्द्र यासि दिव्यानि रोचना वि पार्थिवानि रजसा पुरुष्टुत ।
ये त्वा वहन्ति मुहुरध्वराँ उप ते सु वन्वन्तु वग्वनाँ अराधसः॥
verses.tr: vīndra yāsi divyāni rocanā vi pārthivāni rajasā puruṣṭuta ye tvā vahanti muhuradhvarāṃ upa te su vanvantu vagvanāṃ arādhasaḥ
verses.en: Thou wanderest far, O Indra, through the spheres of light and realms of earth, the region, thou whom many praise! Let those who often bring their solemn rites conquer the noisy babblers who present no gifts.

verses.sa:
तदिन्मे छन्त्सद्वपुषो वपुष्टरं पुत्रो यज्जानं पित्रोरधीयति ।
जाया पतिं वहति वग्नुना सुमत्पुंस इद्भद्रो वहतुः परिष्कृतः॥
verses.tr: tadinme chantsadvapuṣo vapuṣṭaraṃ putro yajjānaṃ pitroradhīyati jāyā patiṃ vahati vagnunā sumatpuṃsa idbhadro vahatuḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ
verses.en: More beautiful than beauty must this seem to me, when the son duly careth for his parents' line. The wife attracts the husband: with a shout of joy the man's auspicious marriage is performed aright.

verses.sa:
तदित्सधस्थमभि चारु दीधय गावो यच्छासन्वहतुं न धेनवः ।
माता यन्मन्तुर्यूथस्य पूर्व्याऽभि वाणस्य सप्तधातुरिज्जनः॥
verses.tr: taditsadhasthamabhi cāru dīdhaya gāvo yacchāsanvahatuṃ na dhenavaḥ mātā yanmanturyūthasya pūrvyā'bhi vāṇasya saptadhāturijjanaḥ
verses.en: This beauteous place of meeting have I looked upon, where, like milch-cows, the kine order the marriage train; Where the Herd's Mother counts as first and best of all, and round her are the seven-toned people of the choir.

verses.sa:
प्र वोऽच्छा रिरिचे देवयुष्पदमेको रुद्रेभिर्याति तुर्वणिः ।
जरा वा येष्वमृतेषु दावने परि व ऊमेभ्यः सिञ्चता मधु॥
verses.tr: pra vo'cchā ririce devayuṣpadameko rudrebhiryāti turvaṇiḥ jarā vā yeṣvamṛteṣu dāvane pari va ūmebhyaḥ siñcatā madhu
verses.en: The Pious One hath reached your place before the rest: One only moves victorious with the Rudras' band. To these your helpers pour our meath, Immortal Gods, with whom your song of praise hath power to win their gifts.

verses.sa:
निधीयमानमपगूळ्हमप्सु प्र मे देवानां व्रतपा उवाच ।
इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अनु हि त्वा चचक्ष तेनाहमग्ने अनुशिष्ट आगाम्॥
verses.tr: nidhīyamānamapagūḻhamapsu pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca indro vidvāṃ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāhamagne anuśiṣṭa āgām
verses.en: He who maintains the Laws of God informed me that thou wast lying hidden in the waters. Indra, who knoweth well, beheld and showed thee. By him instructed am I come, O Agni.

verses.sa:
अक्षेत्रवित्क्षेत्रविदं ह्यप्राट् स प्रैति क्षेत्रविदानुशिष्टः ।
एतद्वै भद्रमनुशासनस्योत स्रुतिं विन्दत्यञ्जसीनाम्॥
verses.tr: akṣetravitkṣetravidaṃ hyaprāṭ sa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ etadvai bhadramanuśāsanasyota srutiṃ vindatyañjasīnām
verses.en: The stranger asks the way of him who knows it: taught by the skillful guide he travels onward. This is, in truth, the blessing of instruction: he finds the path that leads directly forward.

verses.sa:
अद्येदु प्राणीदममन्निमाहाऽपीवृतो अधयन्मातुरूधः ।
एमेनमाप जरिमा युवानमहेळन्वसुः सुमना बभूव॥
verses.tr: adyedu prāṇīdamamannimāhā'pīvṛto adhayanmāturūdhaḥ emenamāpa jarimā yuvānamaheḻanvasuḥ sumanā babhūva
verses.en: Even now he breathed: these days hath he remembered. Concealed, he sucked the bosom of his Mother. Yet in his youth old age hath come upon him: he hath grown gracious, good, and free from anger.

verses.sa:
एतानि भद्रा कलश क्रियाम कुरुश्रवण ददतो मघानि ।
दान इद्वो मघवानः सो अस्त्वयं च सोमो हृदि यं बिभर्मि॥
verses.tr: etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyāma kuruśravaṇa dadato maghāni dāna idvo maghavānaḥ so astvayaṃ ca somo hṛdi yaṃ bibharmi
verses.en: O Kalasa, all these blessings will we bring them, O Kurusravana, who give rich presents. May he, O wealthy princes, and this Soma which I am bearing in my heart, reward you.

verses.sa:
प्र मा युयुज्रे प्रयुजो जनानां वहामि स्म पूषणमन्तरेण ।
विश्वे देवासो अध मामरक्षन्दुःशासुरागादिति घोष आसीत्॥
verses.tr: pra mā yuyujre prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇamantareṇa viśve devāso adha māmarakṣanduḥśāsurāgāditi ghoṣa āsīt
verses.en: The urgings of the people have impelled me, and by the nearest way I bring you Pusan. The Universal Gods have brought me safely. The cry was heard, Behold, Dubsasu cometh!

verses.sa: सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः । नि बाधते अमतिर्नग्नता जसुर्वेर्न वेवीयते मतिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ ni bādhate amatirnagnatā jasurverna vevīyate matiḥ
verses.en: The ribs that compass me give pain and trouble me like rival wives. Indigence, nakedness, exhaustion press me sore: my mind is fluttering like a bird's.

verses.sa: मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्य स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो । सकृत्सु नो मघवन्निन्द्र मृळयाऽधा पितेव नो भव॥
verses.tr: mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato sakṛtsu no maghavannindra mṛḻayā'dhā piteva no bhava
verses.en: As rats eat weavers' threads, cares are consuming me, thy singer, Gatakratu, me. Have mercy on us once, O Indra, Bounteous Lord: be thou a Father unto us.

verses.sa: कुरुश्रवणमावृणि राजानं त्रासदस्यवम् । मंहिष्ठं वाघतामृषिः॥
verses.tr: kuruśravaṇamāvṛṇi rājānaṃ trāsadasyavam maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vāghatāmṛṣiḥ
verses.en: I the priests' Rsi chose as prince most liberal Kurusravana, The son of Trasadasyu's son,

verses.sa: यस्य मा हरितो रथे तिस्रो वहन्ति साधुया । स्तवै सहस्रदक्षिणे॥
verses.tr: yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā stavai sahasradakṣiṇe
verses.en: Whose three bays harnessed to the car bear me straight onward: I will laud The giver of a thousand meeds,

verses.sa: यस्य प्रस्वादसो गिर उपमश्रवसः पितुः । क्षेत्रं न रण्वमूचुषे॥
verses.tr: yasya prasvādaso gira upamaśravasaḥ pituḥ kṣetraṃ na raṇvamūcuṣe
verses.en: The sire of Upamasravas, even him whose words were passing sweet, As a fair field is to its lord.

verses.sa: अधि पुत्रोपमश्रवो नपान्मित्रातिथेरिहि । पितुष्टे अस्मि वन्दिता॥
verses.tr: adhi putropamaśravo napānmitrātitherihi pituṣṭe asmi vanditā
verses.en: Mark, Upamasravas, his son, mark, grandson of Mitratithi: I am thy father's eulogist.

verses.sa: यदीशीयामृतानामुत वा मर्त्यानाम् । जीवेदिन्मघवा मम॥
verses.tr: yadīśīyāmṛtānāmuta vā martyānām jīvedinmaghavā mama
verses.en: If I controlled Immortal Gods, yea, even were I Lord of men, My liberal prince were living still.

verses.sa: न देवानामति व्रतं शतात्मा चन जीवति । तथा युजा वि वावृते॥
verses.tr: na devānāmati vrataṃ śatātmā cana jīvati tathā yujā vi vāvṛte
verses.en: None lives, even had he hundred lives, beyond the statute of the Gods So am I parted from my friend.

verses.sa:
प्रावेपा मा बृहतो मादयन्ति प्रवातेजा इरिणे वर्वृतानाः ।
सोमस्येव मौजवतस्य भक्षो विभीदको जागृविर्मह्यमच्छान्॥
verses.tr: prāvepā mā bṛhato mādayanti pravātejā iriṇe varvṛtānāḥ somasyeva maujavatasya bhakṣo vibhīdako jāgṛvirmahyamacchān
verses.en: Sprung from tall trees on windy heights, these rollers transport me as they turn upon the table. The enlivening Vibhīdaka has pleased me like the draught of Soma from Mūjavant.

verses.sa:
न मा मिमेथ न जिहीळ एषा शिवा सखिभ्य उत मह्यमासीत् ।
अक्षस्याहमेकपरस्य हेतोरनुव्रतामप जायामरोधम्॥
verses.tr: na mā mimetha na jihīḻa eṣā śivā sakhibhya uta mahyamāsīt akṣasyāhamekaparasya hetoranuvratāmapa jāyāmarodham
verses.en: She never vexed me nor was angry with me, but was ever gracious to my friends and me. For a dice which scored one too much, I drive away my own devoted wife.

verses.sa:
द्वेष्टि श्वश्रूरप जाया रुणद्धि न नाथितो विन्दते मर्डितारम् ।
अश्वस्येव जरतो वस्न्यस्य नाहं विन्दामि कितवस्य भोगम्॥
verses.tr: dveṣṭi śvaśrūrapa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthito vindate marḍitāram aśvasyeva jarato vasnyasya nāhaṃ vindāmi kitavasya bhogam
verses.en: My wife drives me away, her mother hates me: the wretched man finds none to give him comfort. [They say:] "I find no more use in a gambler than in an aged horse which is for sale."

verses.sa:
अन्ये जायां परि मृशन्त्यस्य यस्यागृधद्वेदने वाज्य१क्षः ।
पिता माता भ्रातर एनमाहुर्न जानीमो नयता बद्धमेतम्॥
verses.tr: anye jāyāṃ pari mṛśantyasya yasyāgṛdhadvedane vājya1kṣaḥ pitā mātā bhrātara enamāhurna jānīmo nayatā baddhametam
verses.en: Others embrace the wife of him whose riches the victorious dice have coveted: Father and mother and brothers say about him [to the landlord's men]: "We know him not: tie him up and take him away."

verses.sa:
यदादीध्ये न दविषाण्येभिः परायद्भ्योऽव हीये सखिभ्यः ।
न्युप्ताश्च बभ्रवो वाचमक्रतँ एमीदेषां निष्कृतं जारिणीव॥
verses.tr: yadādīdhye na daviṣāṇyebhiḥ parāyadbhyo'va hīye sakhibhyaḥ nyuptāśca babhravo vācamakrataṃ emīdeṣāṃ niṣkṛtaṃ jāriṇīva
verses.en: When I resolve "I will not play with them, I will remain behind when my friends [= fellow-gamblers] depart [to play]", and the brown dice, thrown on the board, have rattled, like a fond girl I seek the place of meeting.

verses.sa:
सभामेति कितवः पृच्छमानो जेष्यामीति तन्वा३ शूशुजानः ।
अक्षासो अस्य वि तिरन्ति कामं प्रतिदीव्ने दधत आ कृतानि॥
verses.tr: sabhāmeti kitavaḥ pṛcchamāno jeṣyāmīti tanvā3 śūśujānaḥ akṣāso asya vi tiranti kāmaṃ pratidīvne dadhata ā kṛtāni
verses.en: The gamester seeks the gambling-house, and wonders, his body all afire, "Will I be lucky?" The dice run against his desire, giving the best throws to his adversary.

verses.sa:
अक्षास इदङ्कुशिनो नितोदिनो निकृत्वानस्तपनास्तापयिष्णवः ।
कुमारदेष्णा जयतः पुनर्हणो मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः कितवस्य बर्हणा॥
verses.tr: akṣāsa idaṅkuśino nitodino nikṛtvānastapanāstāpayiṣṇavaḥ kumāradeṣṇā jayataḥ punarhaṇo madhvā sampṛktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā
verses.en: Dice, verily, are armed with goads and driving-hooks, deceiving and tormenting, causing grievous woe. They give gifts like boys [do], and then snatch them back from the winner, [they are] sweetened [as] with honey with magic power over the gambler.

verses.sa:
त्रिपञ्चाशः क्रीळति व्रात एषां देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मा ।
उग्रस्य चिन्मन्यवे ना नमन्ते राजा चिदेभ्यो नम इत्कृणोति॥
verses.tr: tripañcāśaḥ krīḻati vrāta eṣāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā ugrasya cinmanyave nā namante rājā cidebhyo nama itkṛṇoti
verses.en: Their troop of three-times-fifty plays [as undefeatably] as Savitr the god whose ways are faithful. They bend not even to the anger of the mighty: the King himself pays homage and reveres them.

verses.sa:
नीचा वर्तन्त उपरि स्फुरन्त्यहस्तासो हस्तवन्तं सहन्ते ।
दिव्या अङ्गारा इरिणे न्युप्ताः शीताः सन्तो हृदयं निर्दहन्ति॥
verses.tr: nīcā vartanta upari sphurantyahastāso hastavantaṃ sahante divyā aṅgārā iriṇe nyuptāḥ śītāḥ santo hṛdayaṃ nirdahanti
verses.en: Downward they roll, and then spring quickly upward, and, handless, force the man with hands to serve them. Cast on the board, like lumps of magic charcoal, though cold themselves they burn the heart to ashes.

verses.sa:
जाया तप्यते कितवस्य हीना माता पुत्रस्य चरतः क्व स्वित् ।
ऋणावा बिभ्यद्धनमिच्छमानोऽन्येषामस्तमुप नक्तमेति॥
verses.tr: jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kva svit ṛṇāvā bibhyaddhanamicchamāno'nyeṣāmastamupa naktameti
verses.en: The gambler's wife is left forlorn and wretched: the mother mourns the son who wanders homeless. In constant fear, in debt, and seeking money, he goes by night to the home of others [probably to steal].

verses.sa:
स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वाय कितवं ततापाऽन्येषां जायां सुकृतं च योनिम् ।
पूर्वाह्णे अश्वान्युयुजे हि बभ्रून्त्सो अग्नेरन्ते वृषलः पपाद॥
verses.tr: striyaṃ dṛṣṭvāya kitavaṃ tatāpā'nyeṣāṃ jāyāṃ sukṛtaṃ ca yonim pūrvāhṇe aśvānyuyuje hi babhrūntso agnerante vṛṣalaḥ papāda
verses.en: Sad is the gambler when he sees a woman, another man's wife, and his well-ordered dwelling. He yokes the brown horses [= the dice] in the early morning, and in the evening he sinks down beside [his] fire, a beggar.

verses.sa:
यो वः सेनानीर्महतो गणस्य राजा व्रातस्य प्रथमो बभूव ।
तस्मै कृणोमि न धना रुणध्मि दशाहं प्राचीस्तदृतं वदामि॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ senānīrmahato gaṇasya rājā vrātasya prathamo babhūva tasmai kṛṇomi na dhanā ruṇadhmi daśāhaṃ prācīstadṛtaṃ vadāmi
verses.en: To the great captain of your mighty army [of dice], who has become the host's imperial leader, To him I show [my] ten [extended fingers]: "I speak the truth: No wealth am I withholding."

verses.sa:
अक्षैर्मा दीव्यः कृषिमित्कृषस्व वित्ते रमस्व बहु मन्यमानः ।
तत्र गावः कितव तत्र जाया तन्मे वि चष्टे सवितायमर्यः॥
verses.tr: akṣairmā dīvyaḥ kṛṣimitkṛṣasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamānaḥ tatra gāvaḥ kitava tatra jāyā tanme vi caṣṭe savitāyamaryaḥ
verses.en: "Play not with dice, [but] cultivate your corn-land. Enjoy the gain, and deem that wealth sufficient. There are your cattle, there your wife, O gambler": So this good Savitr himself has told me.

verses.sa:
मित्रं कृणुध्वं खलु मृळता नो मा नो घोरेण चरताभि धृष्णु ।
नि वो नु मन्युर्विशतामरातिरन्यो बभ्रूणां प्रसितौ न्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ khalu mṛḻatā no mā no ghoreṇa caratābhi dhṛṣṇu ni vo nu manyurviśatāmarātiranyo babhrūṇāṃ prasitau nvastu
verses.en: Make me your friend: show us some little mercy. Do not forcibly bewitch us with magic power. Let your wrath [and] emnity now come to rest. Let the brown [dice] now snare some other captive. Translation revised 25 April 2006 by Anthony Appleyard following Arthur Anthony Macdonnell's book "A Vedic Reader", publ Motilal Banarsidass, ISBN 81-208-1017-1 (cloth bound), ISBN 81-208-1018-X (paperback). See Talk:The Rig Veda/Book 10/Hymn 34 for notes.

verses.sa:
अबुध्रमु त्य इन्द्रवन्तो अग्नयो ज्योतिर्भरन्त उषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
मही द्यावापृथिवी चेततामपोऽद्या देवानामव आ वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: abudhramu tya indravanto agnayo jyotirbharanta uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu mahī dyāvāpṛthivī cetatāmapo'dyā devānāmava ā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: These fires associate with Indra are awake, bringing their light when first the Dawn begins to shine. May Heaven and Earth, great Pair, observe our holy work. We claim for us this day the favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्योरव आ वृणीमहे मातॄन्त्सिन्धून्पर्वताञ्छर्यणावतः ।
अनागास्त्वं सूर्यमुषासमीमहे भद्रं सोमः सुवानो अद्या कृणोतु नः॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyorava ā vṛṇīmahe mātṝntsindhūnparvatāñcharyaṇāvataḥ anāgāstvaṃ sūryamuṣāsamīmahe bhadraṃ somaḥ suvāno adyā kṛṇotu naḥ
verses.en: Yea, for ourselves we claim the grace of Heaven and Earth, of Saryanavan, of the Hills and Mother Streams. For innocence we pray to Surya and to Dawn. So may the flowing Soma bring us bliss to-day.

verses.sa:
द्यावा नो अद्य पृथिवी अनागसो मही त्रायेतां सुविताय मातरा ।
उषा उच्छन्त्यप बाधतामघं स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī trāyetāṃ suvitāya mātarā uṣā ucchantyapa bādhatāmaghaṃ svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: May the great Twain, the Mothers, Heaven and Earth, this day preserve us free from sin for peace and happiness. May Morning sending forth her light drive sin afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
इयं न उस्रा प्रथमा सुदेव्यं रेवत्सनिभ्यो रेवती व्युच्छतु ।
आरे मन्युं दुर्विदत्रस्य धीमहि स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ na usrā prathamā sudevyaṃ revatsanibhyo revatī vyucchatu āre manyuṃ durvidatrasya dhīmahi svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: May this first Dawn bring us the host of gracious Gods: rich, may it richly shine for us who strive for wealth. The wrath of the malignant may we keep afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
प्र याः सिस्रते सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिर्भरन्तीरुषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
भद्रा नो अद्य श्रवसे व्युच्छत स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmibhirjyotirbharantīruṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu bhadrā no adya śravase vyucchata svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Dawns, who come forward with the bright beams of the Sun, and at your earliest flushing bring to us the light, Shine ye on us to-day auspicious, for renown. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
अनमीवा उषस आ चरन्तु न उदग्नयो जिहतां ज्योतिषा बृहत् ।
आयुक्षातामश्विना तूतुजिं रथं स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na udagnayo jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat āyukṣātāmaśvinā tūtujiṃ rathaṃ svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Free from all sickness may the Mornings come to us, and let our fires mount upward with a lofty blaze. The Asvin Pair have harnessed their swift-moving car. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं नो अद्य सवितर्वरेण्यं भागमा सुव स हि रत्नधा असि ।
रायो जनित्रीं धिषणामुप ब्रुवे स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitarvareṇyaṃ bhāgamā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi rāyo janitrīṃ dhiṣaṇāmupa bruve svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Send us to-day a portion choice and excellent, O Savitar, for thou art he who dealeth wealth. I cry to Dhisana, Mother of opulence. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
पिपर्तु मा तदृतस्य प्रवाचनं देवानां यन्मनुष्या३ अमन्महि ।
विश्वा इदुस्राः स्पळुदेति सूर्यः स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: pipartu mā tadṛtasya pravācanaṃ devānāṃ yanmanuṣyā3 amanmahi viśvā idusrāḥ spaḻudeti sūryaḥ svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Further me this declaring of Eternal Law, the Law of Gods, as we mortals acknowledge it! The Sun goes up beholding all the rays of morn. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
अद्वेषो अद्य बर्हिषः स्तरीमणि ग्राव्णां योगे मन्मनः साध ईमहे ।
आदित्यानां शर्मणि स्था भुरण्यसि स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: adveṣo adya barhiṣaḥ starīmaṇi grāvṇāṃ yoge manmanaḥ sādha īmahe ādityānāṃ śarmaṇi sthā bhuraṇyasi svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: This day we pray with innocence in strewing grass, adjusting pressing-stones, and perfecting the hymn. Thou in the Adityas' keeping movest restlessly. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
आ नो बर्हिः सधमादे बृहद्दिवि देवाँ ईळे सादया सप्त होतॄन् ।
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: ā no barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhaddivi devāṃ īḻe sādayā sapta hotṝn indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: To our great holy grass I bid the Gods at morn to banquet, and will seat them as the seven priests,- Varuna, Indra, Mitra, Bhaga for our gain. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये वृधे नो यज्ञमवता सजोषसः ।
बृहस्पतिं पूषणमश्विना भगं स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe no yajñamavatā sajoṣasaḥ bṛhaspatiṃ pūṣaṇamaśvinā bhagaṃ svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Come hither, O Adityas, for our perfect weal: accordant help our sacrifice that we may thrive. Pusan, Brhaspati, Bhaga, both Asvins, and enkindled Agni we implore for happiness.

verses.sa:
तन्नो देवा यच्छत सुप्रवाचनं छर्दिरादित्याः सुभरं नृपाय्यम् ।
पश्वे तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे स्वस्त्य१ग्निं समिधानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: tanno devā yacchata supravācanaṃ chardirādityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svastya1gniṃ samidhānamīmahe
verses.en: Adityas, Gods, vouchsafe that this our home may be praise-worthy, prosperous, our heroes' sure defence, For cattle, for our sons, for progeny, for life. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः ।
विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे॥
verses.tr: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme
verses.en: This day may all the Maruts, all he near us with aid: may all our fires be well enkindled. May all Gods come to us with gracious favour. May spoil and wealth he ours, and all possessions.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं त्रायध्वे यं पिपृथात्यंहः ।
यो वो गोपीथे न भयस्य वेद ते स्याम देववीतये तुरासः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yaṃ pipṛthātyaṃhaḥ yo vo gopīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma devavītaye turāsaḥ
verses.en: He whom ye aid, O Deities, in battle, whom ye protect and rescue from affliction, Who fears no danger at your milk-libation, -such may we be to feast the Gods, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
उषासानक्ता बृहती सुपेशसा द्यावाक्षामा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
इन्द्रं हुवे मरुतः पर्वताँ अप आदित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः॥
verses.tr: uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇo mitro aryamā indraṃ huve marutaḥ parvatāṃ apa ādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: There are the Dawn and Night, the grand and beauteous Pair, Earth, Heaven, and Varuna, Mitra, and Aryaman. Indra I call, the Maruts, Mountains, and the Floods, Adityas, Heaven and Earth, the Waters, and the Sky.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च नः पृथिवी च प्रचेतस ऋतावरी रक्षतामंहसो रिषः ।
मा दुर्विदत्रा निॠतिर्न ईशत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: dyauśca naḥ pṛthivī ca pracetasa ṛtāvarī rakṣatāmaṃhaso riṣaḥ mā durvidatrā niṝtirna īśata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: May Dyaus and Prthivi, wise, true to Holy Law, keep us in safety from distress and injury. Let not malignant Nirrti rule over us. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मान्नो अदितिः पात्वंहसो माता मित्रस्य वरुणस्य रेवतः ।
स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरवृकं नशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: viśvasmānno aditiḥ pātvaṃhaso mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ svarvajjyotiravṛkaṃ naśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Mother of Mitra and of opulent Varuna, may Aditi preserve us safe from all distress. May we obtain the light of heaven without a foe. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ग्रावा वदन्नप रक्षांसि सेधतु दुष्ष्वप्न्यं निॠतिं विश्वमत्रिणम् ।
आदित्यं शर्म मरुतामशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: grāvā vadannapa rakṣāṃsi sedhatu duṣṣvapnyaṃ niṝtiṃ viśvamatriṇam ādityaṃ śarma marutāmaśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: May ringing press-stones keep the Raksasas afar, ill dream, and Nirrti, and each voracious fiend. May the Adityas and the Maruts shelter us. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रो बर्हिः सीदतु पिन्वतामिळा बृहस्पतिः सामभिॠक्वो अर्चतु ।
सुप्रकेतं जीवसे मन्म धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: endro barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatāmiḻā bṛhaspatiḥ sāmabhiṝkvo arcatu supraketaṃ jīvase manma dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Full flow libations; on our grass let Indra sit; Brhaspati the singer laud with Sama hymns! Wise be our hearts' imaginings that we may live. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
दिविस्पृशं यज्ञमस्माकमश्विना जीराध्वरं कृणुतं सुम्नमिष्टये ।
प्राचीनरश्मिमाहुतं घृतेन तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: divispṛśaṃ yajñamasmākamaśvinā jīrādhvaraṃ kṛṇutaṃ sumnamiṣṭaye prācīnaraśmimāhutaṃ ghṛtena taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Ye Asvins, make our sacrifice ascend to heaven, and animate the rite that it may send us bliss, Offered with holy oil, with forward-speeding rein. We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुहवं मारुतं गणं पावकमृष्वं सख्याय शम्भुवम् ।
रायस्पोषं सौश्रवसाय धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: upa hvaye suhavaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ pāvakamṛṣvaṃ sakhyāya śambhuvam rāyaspoṣaṃ sauśravasāya dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Hither I call the band of Maruts, swift to hear, great, purifying, bringing bliss, to he our Friends. May we increase our wealth to glorify our name. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
अपां पेरुं जीवधन्यं भरामहे देवाव्यं सुहवमध्वरश्रियम् ।
सुरश्मिं सोममिन्द्रियं यमीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: apāṃ peruṃ jīvadhanyaṃ bharāmahe devāvyaṃ suhavamadhvaraśriyam suraśmiṃ somamindriyaṃ yamīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: We bring the Stay of Life, who makes the waters swell, swift-hearing, Friend of Gods, who waits on sacrifice. May we control that Power, Soma whose rays are bright. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
सनेम तत्सुसनिता सनित्वभिर्वयं जीवा जीवपुत्रा अनागसः ।
ब्रह्मद्विषो विष्वगेनो भरेरत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: sanema tatsusanitā sanitvabhirvayaṃ jīvā jīvaputrā anāgasaḥ brahmadviṣo viṣvageno bharerata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Alive ourselves, with living sons, devoid of guilt, may we win this with winners by fair means to win. Let the prayer-haters bear our sin to every side. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ये स्था मनोर्यज्ञियास्ते शृणोतन यद्वो देवा ईमहे तद्ददातन ।
जैत्रं क्रतुं रयिमद्वीरवद्यशस्तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: ye sthā manoryajñiyāste śṛṇotana yadvo devā īmahe taddadātana jaitraṃ kratuṃ rayimadvīravadyaśastaddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Hear us, O ye who claim the worship of mankind, and give us, O ye Gods, the gift for which we pray, Victorious wisdom, fame with heroes and with wealth. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
महदद्य महतामा वृणीमहेऽवो देवानां बृहतामनर्वणाम् ।
यथा वसु वीरजातं नशामहै तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: mahadadya mahatāmā vṛṇīmahe'vo devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarvaṇām yathā vasu vīrajātaṃ naśāmahai taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day, great favour of great Gods, sublime and free from foes, That we may gain rich treasure sprung from hero sons. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
महो अग्नेः समिधानस्य शर्मण्यनागा मित्रे वरुणे स्वस्तये ।
श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: In great enkindled Agni's keeping, and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna. May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ये सवितुः सत्यसवस्य विश्वे मित्रस्य व्रते वरुणस्य देवाः ।
ते सौभगं वीरवद्गोमदप्नो दधातन द्रविणं चित्रमस्मे॥
verses.tr: ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ te saubhagaṃ vīravadgomadapno dadhātana draviṇaṃ citramasme
verses.en: All ye, the Gods whom Savitar the Father of truth, and Varuna and Mitra govern, Give us prosperity with hero children, and opulence in kine and various treasure.

verses.sa:
सविता पश्चातात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात् ।
सविता नः सुवतु सर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: savitā paścātātsavitā purastātsavitottarāttātsavitādharāttāt savitā naḥ suvatu sarvatātiṃ savitā no rāsatāṃ dīrghamāyuḥ
