verses.en: Savitar, Savitar from east and westward, Savitar, Savitar from north and southward, Savitar send us perfect health and comfort, Savitar let our days of life be lengthened!

verses.sa:
नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षसे महो देवाय तदृतं सपर्यत ।
दूरेदृशे देवजाताय केतवे दिवस्पुत्राय सूर्याय शंसत॥
verses.tr: namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tadṛtaṃ saparyata dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divasputrāya sūryāya śaṃsata
verses.en: Do homage unto Varuna's and Mitra's Eye: offer this solemn worship to the Mighty God, Who seeth far away, the Ensign, born of Gods. Sing praises unto Surya, to the Son of Dyaus.

verses.sa:
सा मा सत्योक्तिः परि पातु विश्वतो द्यावा च यत्र ततनन्नहानि च ।
विश्वमन्यन्नि विशते यदेजति विश्वाहापो विश्वाहोदेति सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: sā mā satyoktiḥ pari pātu viśvato dyāvā ca yatra tatanannahāni ca viśvamanyanni viśate yadejati viśvāhāpo viśvāhodeti sūryaḥ
verses.en: May this my truthful speech guard me on every side wherever heaven and earth and days are spread abroad. All else that is in motion finds a place of rest: the waters ever flow and ever mounts the Sun.

verses.sa:
न ते अदेवः प्रदिवो नि वासते यदेतशेभिः पतरै रथर्यसि ।
प्राचीनमन्यदनु वर्तते रज उदन्येन ज्योतिषा यासि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yadetaśebhiḥ patarai ratharyasi prācīnamanyadanu vartate raja udanyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya
verses.en: No godless man from time remotest draws thee down when thou art driving forth with winged dappled Steeds. One lustre waits upon thee moving to the cast, and, Surya, thou arisest with a different light.

verses.sa:
येन सूर्य ज्योतिषा बाधसे तमो जगच्च विश्वमुदियर्षि भानुना ।
तेनास्मद्विश्वामनिरामनाहुतिमपामीवामप दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सुव॥
verses.tr: yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagacca viśvamudiyarṣi bhānunā tenāsmadviśvāmanirāmanāhutimapāmīvāmapa duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva
verses.en: O Surya, with the light whereby thou scatterest gloom, and with thy ray impellest every moving thing, Keep far from us all feeble, worthless sacrifice, and drive away disease and every evil dream.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि प्रेषितो रक्षसि व्रतमहेळयन्नुच्चरसि स्वधा अनु ।
यदद्य त्वा सूर्योपब्रवामहै तं नो देवा अनु मंसीरत क्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: viśvasya hi preṣito rakṣasi vratamaheḻayannuccarasi svadhā anu yadadya tvā sūryopabravāmahai taṃ no devā anu maṃsīrata kratum
verses.en: Sent forth thou guardest well the Universe's law, and in thy wonted way arisest free from wrath. When Surya, we address our prayers to thee to-day, may the Gods favour this our purpose and desire.

verses.sa:
तं नो द्यावापृथिवी तन्न आप इन्द्रः शृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवं वचः ।
मा शूने भूम सूर्यस्य संदृशि भद्रं जीवन्तो जरणामशीमहि॥
verses.tr: taṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī tanna āpa indraḥ śṛṇvantu maruto havaṃ vacaḥ mā śūne bhūma sūryasya saṃdṛśi bhadraṃ jīvanto jaraṇāmaśīmahi
verses.en: This invocation, these our words may Heaven and Earth, and Indra and the Waters and the Maruts hear. Ne'er may we suffer want in presence of the Sun, and, living happy lives, may we attain old age.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहा त्वा सुमनसः सुचक्षसः प्रजावन्तो अनमीवा अनागसः ।
उद्यन्तं त्वा मित्रमहो दिवेदिवे ज्योग्जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य॥
verses.tr: viśvāhā tvā sumanasaḥ sucakṣasaḥ prajāvanto anamīvā anāgasaḥ udyantaṃ tvā mitramaho divedive jyogjīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya
verses.en: Cheerful in spirit, evermore, and keen of sight, with store of children, free from sickness and from sin, Long-living, may we look, O Surya, upon thee uprising day by day, thou great as Mitra is!

verses.sa:
महि ज्योतिर्बिभ्रतं त्वा विचक्षण भास्वन्तं चक्षुषेचक्षुषे मयः ।
आरोहन्तं बृहतः पाजसस्परि वयं जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य॥
verses.tr: mahi jyotirbibhrataṃ tvā vicakṣaṇa bhāsvantaṃ cakṣuṣecakṣuṣe mayaḥ ārohantaṃ bṛhataḥ pājasaspari vayaṃ jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya
verses.en: Surya, may we live long and look upon thee still, thee, O Far-seeing One, bringing the glorious light, The radiant God, the spring of joy to every eye, as thou art mounting up o'er the high shining flood.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते विश्वा भुवनानि केतुना प्र चेरते नि च विशन्ते अक्तुभिः ।
अनागास्त्वेन हरिकेश सूर्याऽह्नाह्ना नो वस्यसावस्यसोदिहि॥
verses.tr: yasya te viśvā bhuvanāni ketunā pra cerate ni ca viśante aktubhiḥ anāgāstvena harikeśa sūryā'hnāhnā no vasyasāvasyasodihi
verses.en: Thou by whose lustre all the world of life comes forth, and by thy beams again returns unto its rest, O Surya with the golden hair, ascend for us day after day, still bringing purer innocence.

verses.sa:
शं नो भव चक्षसा शं नो अह्ना शं भानुना शं हिमा शं घृणेन ।
यथा शमध्वञ्छमसद्दुरोणे तत्सूर्य द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā śaṃ bhānunā śaṃ himā śaṃ ghṛṇena yathā śamadhvañchamasadduroṇe tatsūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram
verses.en: Bless us with shine, bless us with perfect daylight, bless us with cold, with fervent heat and lustre. Bestow on us, O Surya, varied riches, to bless us in our home and when we travel.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं देवा उभयाय जन्मने शर्म यच्छत द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ।
अदत्पिबदूर्जयमानमाशितं तदस्मे शं योररपो दधातन॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ devā ubhayāya janmane śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade adatpibadūrjayamānamāśitaṃ tadasme śaṃ yorarapo dadhātana
verses.en: Gods, to our living creatures of both kinds vouchsafe protection, both to bipeds and to quadrupeds, That they may drink and eat invigorating food. So grant us health and strength and perfect innocence.

verses.sa:
यद्वो देवाश्चकृम जिह्वया गुरु मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेळनम् ।
अरावा यो नो अभि दुच्छुनायते तस्मिन्तदेनो वसवो नि धेतन॥
verses.tr: yadvo devāścakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḻanam arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmintadeno vasavo ni dhetana
verses.en: If by some grievous sin we have provoked the Gods, O Deities, with the tongue or thoughtlessness of heart, That guilt, O Vasus, lay upon the Evil One, on him who ever leads us into deep distress.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्न इन्द्र पृत्सुतौ यशस्वति शिमीवति क्रन्दसि प्राव सातये ।
यत्र गोषाता धृषितेषु खादिषु विष्वक्पतन्ति दिद्यवो नृषाह्ये॥
verses.tr: asminna indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye yatra goṣātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viṣvakpatanti didyavo nṛṣāhye
verses.en: O INDRA, in this battle great and glorious, in this loud din of war help us to victory, Where in the strife for kine among bold ring-decked men arrows fly all around and heroes are subdued.

verses.sa:
स नः क्षुमन्तं सदने व्यूर्णुहि गोअर्णसं रयिमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यम् ।
स्याम ते जयतः शक्र मेदिनो यथा वयमुश्मसि तद्वसो कृधि॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vyūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayimindra śravāyyam syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayamuśmasi tadvaso kṛdhi
verses.en: At home disclose to us opulence rich in food, streaming with milk, O Indra, meet to be renowned. Sakra, may we be thine, the friendly Conqueror's: even as we desire, O Vasu, so do thou.

verses.sa:
यो नो दास आर्यो वा पुरुष्टुताऽदेव इन्द्र युधये चिकेतति ।
अस्माभिष्टे सुषहाः सन्तु शत्रवस्त्वया वयं तान्वनुयाम संगमे॥
verses.tr: yo no dāsa āryo vā puruṣṭutā'deva indra yudhaye ciketati asmābhiṣṭe suṣahāḥ santu śatravastvayā vayaṃ tānvanuyāma saṃgame
verses.en: The godless man, much-lauded Indra, whether he be Dasa or be Arya, who would war with us,- Easy to conquer he for thee, with us, these foes: with thee may we subdue them in the clash of fight.

verses.sa:
यो दभ्रेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भूरिभिर्यो अभीके वरिवोविन्नृषाह्ये ।
तं विखादे सस्निमद्य श्रुतं नरमर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रमवसे करामहे॥
verses.tr: yo dabhrebhirhavyo yaśca bhūribhiryo abhīke varivovinnṛṣāhye taṃ vikhāde sasnimadya śrutaṃ naramarvāñcamindramavase karāmahe
verses.en: Him who must be invoked by many and by few, who standeth nigh with comfort in the war of men, Indra, famed Hero, winner in the deadly strife, let us bring hitherward to-day to favour us.

verses.sa:
स्ववृजं हि त्वामहमिन्द्र शुश्रवानानुदं वृषभ रध्रचोदनम् ।
प्र मुञ्चस्व परि कुत्सादिहा गहि किमु त्वावान्मुष्कयोर्बद्ध आसते॥
verses.tr: svavṛjaṃ hi tvāmahamindra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam pra muñcasva pari kutsādihā gahi kimu tvāvānmuṣkayorbaddha āsate
verses.en: For, Indra, I have heard thee called Self. capturer, One, Steer! who never yields, who urges even the churl. Release thyself from Kutsa and come hither. How shall one like thee sit still bound that he may not move?

verses.sa:
यो वां परिज्मा सुवृदश्विना रथो दोषामुषासो हव्यो हविष्मता ।
शश्वत्तमासस्तमु वामिदं वयं पितुर्न नाम सुहवं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ parijmā suvṛdaśvinā ratho doṣāmuṣāso havyo haviṣmatā śaśvattamāsastamu vāmidaṃ vayaṃ piturna nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe
verses.en: As 'twere the name of father, easy to invoke, we all assembled here invoke this Car of yours, Asvins, your swiftly-rolling circumambient Car which he who worships must invoke at eve and dawn.

verses.sa:
चोदयतं सूनृताः पिन्वतं धिय उत्पुरंधीरीरयतं तदुश्मसि ।
यशसं भागं कृणुतं नो अश्विना सोमं न चारुं मघवत्सु नस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya utpuraṃdhīrīrayataṃ taduśmasi yaśasaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cāruṃ maghavatsu naskṛtam
verses.en: Awake all pleasant strains and let the hymns flow forth: raise up abundant fulness: this is our desire. Asvins, bestow on us a glorious heritage, and give our princes treasure fair as Soma is.

verses.sa:
अमाजुरश्चिद्भवथो युवं भगोऽनाशोश्चिदवितारापमस्य चित् ।
अन्धस्य चिन्नासत्या कृशस्य चिद्युवामिदाहुर्भिषजा रुतस्य चित्॥
verses.tr: amājuraścidbhavatho yuvaṃ bhago'nāśościdavitārāpamasya cit andhasya cinnāsatyā kṛśasya cidyuvāmidāhurbhiṣajā rutasya cit
verses.en: Ye are the bliss of her who groweth old at home, and helpers of the slow although he linger last. Men call you too, Nasatyas, healers of the blind, the thin and feeble, and the man with broken bones.

verses.sa:
युवं च्यवानं सनयं यथा रथं पुनर्युवानं चरथाय तक्षथुः ।
निष्टौग्र्यमूहथुरद्भ्यस्परि विश्वेत्ता वां सवनेषु प्रवाच्या॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ niṣṭaugryamūhathuradbhyaspari viśvettā vāṃ savaneṣu pravācyā
verses.en: Ye made Cyavana, weak and worn with length of days, young again, like a car, that he had power to move. Ye lifted up the son of Tugra from the floods. At our libations must all these your acts be praised.

verses.sa:
पुराणा वां वीर्या३ प्र ब्रवा जनेऽथो हासथुर्भिषजा मयोभुवा ।
ता वां नु नव्याववसे करामहेऽयं नासत्या श्रदरिर्यथा दधत्॥
verses.tr: purāṇā vāṃ vīryā3 pra bravā jane'tho hāsathurbhiṣajā mayobhuvā tā vāṃ nu navyāvavase karāmahe'yaṃ nāsatyā śradariryathā dadhat
verses.en: We will declare among the folk your ancient deeds heroic; yea, ye were Physicians bringing health. You, you who must be lauded, will we bring for aid, so that this foe of ours, O Asvins, may believe.

verses.sa:
इयं वामह्वे शृणुतं मे अश्विना पुत्रायेव पितरा मह्यं शिक्षतम् ।
अनापिरज्ञा असजात्यामतिः पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरव स्पृतम्॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vāmahve śṛṇutaṃ me aśvinā putrāyeva pitarā mahyaṃ śikṣatam anāpirajñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśasterava spṛtam
verses.en: Listen to me, O Asvins; I have cried to you. Give me-your aid as sire and mother aid their son. Poor, without kin or friend or ties of blood am I. Save me before it be too late, from this my curse.

verses.sa:
युवं रथेन विमदाय शुन्ध्युवं न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषणाम् ।
युवं हवं वध्रिमत्या अगच्छतं युवं सुषुतिं चक्रथुः पुरंधये॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ rathena vimadāya śundhyuvaṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣaṇām yuvaṃ havaṃ vadhrimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣutiṃ cakrathuḥ puraṃdhaye
verses.en: Ye, mounted on your chariot brought to Vimada the comely maid of Purumitra as a bride. Ye, came unto the calling of the weakling's dame, and granted noble offspring to the happy wife.

verses.sa:
युवं विप्रस्य जरणामुपेयुषः पुनः कलेरकृणुतं युवद्वयः ।
युवं वन्दनमृश्यदादुदूपथुर्युवं सद्यो विश्पलामेतवे कृथः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇāmupeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kalerakṛṇutaṃ yuvadvayaḥ yuvaṃ vandanamṛśyadādudūpathuryuvaṃ sadyo viśpalāmetave kṛthaḥ
verses.en: Ye gave again the vigour of his youthful life to the sage Kali when old age was coming nigh. Ye rescued Vandana and raised him from the pit, and in a moment gave Vispala power to move.

verses.sa:
युवं ह रेभं वृषणा गुहा हितमुदैरयतं ममृवांसमश्विना ।
युवमृबीसमुत तप्तमत्रय ओमन्वन्तं चक्रथुः सप्तवध्रये॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitamudairayataṃ mamṛvāṃsamaśvinā yuvamṛbīsamuta taptamatraya omanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhraye
verses.en: Ye Asvins Twain, endowed with manly strength, brought forth Reblia when hidden in the cave and well-nigh dead, Freed Saptavadliri, and for Atri caused the pit heated with fire to be a pleasant resting-place.

verses.sa:
युवं श्वेतं पेदवेऽश्विनाश्वं नवभिर्वाजैर्नवती च वाजिनम् ।
चर्कृत्यं ददथुर्द्रावयत्सखं भगं न नृभ्यो हव्यं मयोभुवम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedave'śvināśvaṃ navabhirvājairnavatī ca vājinam carkṛtyaṃ dadathurdrāvayatsakhaṃ bhagaṃ na nṛbhyo havyaṃ mayobhuvam
verses.en: On Pedu ye bestowed, Asvins, a courser white, mighty with nine-and-ninety varied gifts of strength, A horse to be renowned, who bore his friend at speed, joy-giving, Bhaga-like to be invoked of men.

verses.sa:
न तं राजानावदिते कुतश्चन नांहो अश्नोति दुरितं नकिर्भयम् ।
यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी पुरोरथं कृणुथः पत्न्या सह॥
verses.tr: na taṃ rājānāvadite kutaścana nāṃho aśnoti duritaṃ nakirbhayam yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī purorathaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ patnyā saha
verses.en: From no side, ye Two Kings whom none may check or stay, doth grief, distress, or danger come u on the man Whom, Asvins swift to hear, borne on your glowing path, ye with your Consort make the foremost in the race.

verses.sa:
आ तेन यातं मनसो जवीयसा रथं यं वामृभवश्चक्रुरश्विना ।
यस्य योगे दुहिता जायते दिव उभे अहनी सुदिने विवस्वतः॥
verses.tr: ā tena yātaṃ manaso javīyasā rathaṃ yaṃ vāmṛbhavaścakruraśvinā yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva ubhe ahanī sudine vivasvataḥ
verses.en: Come on that Chariot which the Rbhus wrought for you, the Chariot, Asvins, that is speedier than thought, At harnessing whereof Heaven's Daughter springs to birth, and from Vivasvan come auspicious Night and Day.

verses.sa:
ता वर्तिर्यातं जयुषा वि पर्वतमपिन्वतं शयवे धेनुमश्विना ।
वृकस्य चिद्वर्तिकामन्तरास्याद्युवं शचीभिर्ग्रसिताममुञ्चतम्॥
verses.tr: tā vartiryātaṃ jayuṣā vi parvatamapinvataṃ śayave dhenumaśvinā vṛkasya cidvartikāmantarāsyādyuvaṃ śacībhirgrasitāmamuñcatam
verses.en: Come, Conquerors of the sundered mountain, to our home, Asvins who made the cow stream milk for Sayu's sake, Ye who delivered even from the wolf's deep throat and set again at liberty the swallowed quail.

verses.sa:
एतं वां स्तोममश्विनावकर्मातक्षाम भृगवो न रथम् ।
न्यमृक्षाम योषणां न मर्ये नित्यं न सूनुं तनयं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: etaṃ vāṃ stomamaśvināvakarmātakṣāma bhṛgavo na ratham nyamṛkṣāma yoṣaṇāṃ na marye nityaṃ na sūnuṃ tanayaṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: We have prepared this laud for you, O Asvins, and, like the Bhrgus, as a car have framed it, Have decked it as a maid to meet the bridegroom, and brought it as a son, our stay for ever.

verses.sa:
रथं यान्तं कुह को ह वां नरा प्रति द्युमन्तं सुविताय भूषति ।
प्रातर्यावाणं विभ्वं विशेविशे वस्तोर्वस्तोर्वहमानं धिया शमि॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ yāntaṃ kuha ko ha vāṃ narā prati dyumantaṃ suvitāya bhūṣati prātaryāvāṇaṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe vastorvastorvahamānaṃ dhiyā śami
verses.en: Your radiant Chariot-whither goes it on its way?-who decks it for you, Heroes, for its happy course, Starting at daybreak, visiting each morning every house, borne hitherward through prayer unto the sacrifice?

verses.sa:
कुह स्विद्दोषा कुह वस्तोरश्विना कुहाभिपित्वं करतः कुहोषतुः ।
को वां शयुत्रा विधवेव देवरं मर्यं न योषा कृणुते सधस्थ आ॥
verses.tr: kuha sviddoṣā kuha vastoraśvinā kuhābhipitvaṃ karataḥ kuhoṣatuḥ ko vāṃ śayutrā vidhaveva devaraṃ maryaṃ na yoṣā kṛṇute sadhastha ā
verses.en: Where are ye, Asvins, in the evening, where at morn? Where is your halting place, where rest ye for the night? Who brings you homeward, as the widow bed ward draws her husband's brother, as the bride attracts the groom?

verses.sa:
प्रातर्जरेथे जरणेव कापया वस्तोर्वस्तोर्यजता गच्छथो गृहम् ।
कस्य ध्वस्रा भवथः कस्य वा नरा राजपुत्रेव सवनाव गच्छथः॥
verses.tr: prātarjarethe jaraṇeva kāpayā vastorvastoryajatā gacchatho gṛham kasya dhvasrā bhavathaḥ kasya vā narā rājaputreva savanāva gacchathaḥ
verses.en: Early ye sing forth praise as with a herald's voice, and, meet for worship, go each morning to the house. Whom do ye ever bring to ruin? Unto whose libations come ye, Heroes, like two Sons of Kings?

verses.sa:
युवां मृगेव वारणा मृगण्यवो दोषा वस्तोर्हविषा नि ह्वयामहे ।
युवं होत्रामृतुथा जुह्वते नरेषं जनाय वहथः शुभस्पती॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ mṛgeva vāraṇā mṛgaṇyavo doṣā vastorhaviṣā ni hvayāmahe yuvaṃ hotrāmṛtuthā juhvate nareṣaṃ janāya vahathaḥ śubhaspatī
verses.en: Even as hunters follow two wild elephants, we with oblations call you down at morn and eve. To folk who pay you offierings at appointed times, Chiefs, Lords of splendour, ye bring food to strengthen them.

verses.sa:
युवां ह घोषा पर्यश्विना यती राज्ञ ऊचे दुहिता पृच्छे वां नरा ।
भूतं मे अह्न उत भूतमक्तवेऽश्वावते रथिने शक्तमर्वते॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ ha ghoṣā paryaśvinā yatī rājña ūce duhitā pṛcche vāṃ narā bhūtaṃ me ahna uta bhūtamaktave'śvāvate rathine śaktamarvate
verses.en: To you, O Asvins, came the daughter of a King, Ghosa, and said, O Heroes, this I beg of you: Be near me in the day, he near me in the night: help me to gain a car-borne chieftain rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
युवं कवी ष्ठः पर्यश्विना रथं विशो न कुत्सो जरितुर्नशायथः ।
युवोर्ह मक्षा पर्यश्विना मध्वासा भरत निष्कृतं न योषणा॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ kavī ṣṭhaḥ paryaśvinā rathaṃ viśo na kutso jariturnaśāyathaḥ yuvorha makṣā paryaśvinā madhvāsā bharata niṣkṛtaṃ na yoṣaṇā
verses.en: O Asvins, ye are wise: as Kutsa comes to men, bring your car nigh the folk of him who sings your praise. The bee, O Asvins, bears your honey in her mouth, as the maid carries it purified in her hand.

verses.sa:
युवं ह भुज्युं युवमश्विना वशं युवं शिञ्जारमुशनामुपारथुः ।
युवो ररावा परि सख्यमासते युवोरहमवसा सुम्नमा चके॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha bhujyuṃ yuvamaśvinā vaśaṃ yuvaṃ śiñjāramuśanāmupārathuḥ yuvo rarāvā pari sakhyamāsate yuvorahamavasā sumnamā cake
verses.en: To Bhujyu and to Vasa ye come near with help, O Asvins, to Sinjara and to Usana. Your worshipper secures your friendship for himself. Through your protection I desire felicity.

verses.sa:
युवं ह कृशं युवमश्विना शयुं युवं विधन्तं विधवामुरुष्यथः ।
युवं सनिभ्यः स्तनयन्तमश्विनाऽप व्रजमूर्णुथः सप्तास्यम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha kṛśaṃ yuvamaśvinā śayuṃ yuvaṃ vidhantaṃ vidhavāmuruṣyathaḥ yuvaṃ sanibhyaḥ stanayantamaśvinā'pa vrajamūrṇuthaḥ saptāsyam
verses.en: Krsa and Sayu ye protect, ye Asvins Twain: ye Two assist the widow and the worshipper; And ye throw open, Asvins, unto those who win the cattle-stall that thunders with its serenfold mouth.

verses.sa:
जनिष्ट योषा पतयत्कनीनको वि चारुहन्वीरुधो दंसना अनु ।
आस्मै रीयन्ते निवनेव सिन्धवोऽस्मा अह्ने भवति तत्पतित्वनम्॥
verses.tr: janiṣṭa yoṣā patayatkanīnako vi cāruhanvīrudho daṃsanā anu āsmai rīyante nivaneva sindhavo'smā ahne bhavati tatpatitvanam
verses.en: The Woman hath brought forth, the Infant hath appeared, the plants of wondrous beauty straightway have sprung up. To him the rivers run as down a deep descent, and he this day becomes their master and their lord.

verses.sa:
जीवं रुदन्ति वि मयन्ते अध्वरे दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं दीधियुर्नरः ।
वामं पितृभ्यो य इदं समेरिरे मयः पतिभ्यो जनयः परिष्वजे॥
verses.tr: jīvaṃ rudanti vi mayante adhvare dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ dīdhiyurnaraḥ vāmaṃ pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ samerire mayaḥ patibhyo janayaḥ pariṣvaje
verses.en: They mourn the living, cry aloud, at sacrifice: the men have set their thoughts upon a distant cast. A lovely thing for fathers who have gathered here,-a joy to husbands,-are the wives their arms shall clasp

verses.sa:
न तस्य विद्म तदु षु प्र वोचत युवा ह यद्युवत्याः क्षेति योनिषु ।
प्रियोस्रियस्य वृषभस्य रेतिनो गृहं गमेमाश्विना तदुश्मसि॥
verses.tr: na tasya vidma tadu ṣu pra vocata yuvā ha yadyuvatyāḥ kṣeti yoniṣu priyosriyasya vṛṣabhasya retino gṛhaṃ gamemāśvinā taduśmasi
verses.en: Of this we have no knowledge. Tall it forth to us, now the youth rests within the chambers of the bride. Fain would we reach the dwelling of the vigorous Steer who loves the kine, O Asvins: this is our desire.

verses.sa:
आ वामगन्त्सुमतिर्वाजिनीवसू न्यश्विना हृत्सु कामा अयंसत ।
अभूतं गोपा मिथुना शुभस्पती प्रिया अर्यम्णो दुर्याँ अशीमहि॥
verses.tr: ā vāmagantsumatirvājinīvasū nyaśvinā hṛtsu kāmā ayaṃsata abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhaspatī priyā aryamṇo duryāṃ aśīmahi
verses.en: Your favouring grace hath come, ye Lords of ample wealth: Asvins, our longings are stored up within your hearts. Ye, Lords of splendour, have become our twofold guard: may we as welcome friends reach Aryaman's abode.

verses.sa:
ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ धत्तं रयिं सहवीरं वचस्यवे ।
कृतं तीर्थं सुप्रपाणं शुभस्पती स्थाणुं पथेष्ठामप दुर्मतिं हतम्॥
verses.tr: tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā dhattaṃ rayiṃ sahavīraṃ vacasyave kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ patheṣṭhāmapa durmatiṃ hatam
verses.en: Even so, rejoicing in the dwelling-place of man, give hero sons and riches to the eloquent. Make a ford, Lords of splendour, where men well may drink: remove the spiteful tree-stump standing in the path.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदद्य कतमास्वश्विना विक्षु दस्रा मादयेते शुभस्पती ।
क ईं नि येमे कतमस्य जग्मतुर्विप्रस्य वा यजमानस्य वा गृहम्॥
verses.tr: kva svidadya katamāsvaśvinā vikṣu dasrā mādayete śubhaspatī ka īṃ ni yeme katamasya jagmaturviprasya vā yajamānasya vā gṛham
verses.en: O Asvins, Wonder-Workers, Lords of lustre, where and with what folk do ye delight yourselves to-day? Who hath detained them with him? Whither are they gone? Unto what sage's or what worshipper's abode?

verses.sa:
समानमु त्यं पुरुहूतमुक्थ्यं१ रथं त्रिचक्रं सवना गनिग्मतम् ।
परिज्मानं विदथ्यं सुवृक्तिभिर्वयं व्युष्टा उषसो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: samānamu tyaṃ puruhūtamukthyaṃ1 rathaṃ tricakraṃ savanā ganigmatam parijmānaṃ vidathyaṃ suvṛktibhirvayaṃ vyuṣṭā uṣaso havāmahe
verses.en: That general Car of yours, invoked by many a man, that comes to our libations, three-wheeled, meet for lauds, That circumambient Car, worthy of sacrifice, we call with our pure hymns at earliest flush of dawn.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्युजं नासत्याधि तिष्ठथः प्रातर्यावाणं मधुवाहनं रथम् ।
विशो येन गच्छथो यज्वरीर्नरा कीरेश्चिद्यज्ञं होतृमन्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: prātaryujaṃ nāsatyādhi tiṣṭhathaḥ prātaryāvāṇaṃ madhuvāhanaṃ ratham viśo yena gacchatho yajvarīrnarā kīreścidyajñaṃ hotṛmantamaśvinā
verses.en: Ye, O Nasatyas, mount that early-harnessed Car, that travels early, laden with its freight of balm, Wherewith ye, Heroes, visit clans who sacrifice, even the poor man's worship where the priest attends.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्युं वा मधुपाणिं सुहस्त्यमग्निधं वा धृतदक्षं दमूनसम् ।
विप्रस्य वा यत्सवनानि गच्छथोऽत आ यातं मधुपेयमश्विना॥
verses.tr: adhvaryuṃ vā madhupāṇiṃ suhastyamagnidhaṃ vā dhṛtadakṣaṃ damūnasam viprasya vā yatsavanāni gacchatho'ta ā yātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā
verses.en: If to the deft Adhvaryu with the meath in hand, or to the Kindler firm in strength, the household friend, Or to the sage's poured libations ye approach, come thence, O Asvins, now to drink the offered meath.

verses.sa:
अस्तेव सु प्रतरं लायमस्यन्भूषन्निव प्र भरा स्तोममस्मै ।
वाचा विप्रास्तरत वाचमर्यो नि रामय जरितः सोम इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: asteva su prataraṃ lāyamasyanbhūṣanniva pra bharā stomamasmai vācā viprāstarata vācamaryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram
verses.en: Even as an archer shoots afar his arrow, offer the laud to him with meet adornment. Quell with your voice the wicked's voice, O sages. Singer, make Indra rest beside the Soma.

verses.sa:
दोहेन गामुप शिक्षा सखायं प्र बोधय जरितर्जारमिन्द्रम् ।
कोशं न पूर्णं वसुना न्यृष्टमा च्यावय मघदेयाय शूरम्॥
verses.tr: dohena gāmupa śikṣā sakhāyaṃ pra bodhaya jaritarjāramindram kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭamā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram
verses.en: Draw thy Friend to thee like a cow at milking: O Singer, wake up Indra as a lover. Make thou the Hero haste to give us riches even as a vessel filled brimful with treasure.

verses.sa:
किमङ्ग त्वा मघवन्भोजमाहुः शिशीहि मा शिशयं त्वा शृणोमि ।
अप्नस्वती मम धीरस्तु शक्र वसुविदं भगमिन्द्रा भरा नः॥
verses.tr: kimaṅga tvā maghavanbhojamāhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi apnasvatī mama dhīrastu śakra vasuvidaṃ bhagamindrā bharā naḥ
verses.en: Why, Maghavan, do they call thee Bounteous; Giver? Quicken me: thou, I hear, art he who quickens. Sakra, let my intelligence be active, and bring us luck that finds great wealth, O Indra.

verses.sa:
त्वां जना ममसत्येष्विन्द्र संतस्थाना वि ह्वयन्ते समीके ।
अत्रा युजं कृणुते यो हविष्मान्नासुन्वता सख्यं वष्टि शूरः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣvindra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmānnāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ
verses.en: Standing, in battle for their rights, together, the people, Indra, in the fray invoke thee. Him who brings gifts the Hero makes his comrade: with him who pours no juice he seeks not friendship.

verses.sa:
धनं न स्यन्द्रं बहुलं यो अस्मै तीव्रान्त्सोमाँ आसुनोति प्रयस्वान् ।
तस्मै शत्रून्त्सुतुकान्प्रातरह्नो नि स्वष्ट्रान्युवति हन्ति वृत्रम्॥
verses.tr: dhanaṃ na syandraṃ bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrāntsomāṃ āsunoti prayasvān tasmai śatrūntsutukānprātarahno ni svaṣṭrānyuvati hanti vṛtram
verses.en: Whoso with plenteous food for him expresses strong Somas as much quickly-coming treasure, For him he overthrows in early morning his swift well-weaponed foes, and slays the tyrant.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्वयं दधिमा शंसमिन्द्रे यः शिश्राय मघवा काममस्मे ।
आराच्चित्सन्भयतामस्य शत्रुर्न्यस्मै द्युम्ना जन्या नमन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yasminvayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsamindre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmamasme ārāccitsanbhayatāmasya śatrurnyasmai dyumnā janyā namantām
verses.en: He unto whom we offer praises, Indra, Maghavan, who hath joined to ours his wishes,- Before him even afar the foe must tremble: low before him must bow all human glories.

verses.sa:
आराच्छत्रुमप बाधस्व दूरमुग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन ।
अस्मे धेहि यवमद्गोमदिन्द्र कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम्॥
verses.tr: ārācchatrumapa bādhasva dūramugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām
verses.en: With thy fierce bolt, O God invoked of many, drive to a distance from afar the foeman. O Indra, give us wealth in corn and cattle, and make thy singer's prayer gain strength and riches.

verses.sa:
प्र यमन्तर्वृषसवासो अग्मन्तीव्राः सोमा बहुलान्तास इन्द्रम् ।
नाह दामानं मघवा नि यंसन्नि सुन्वते वहति भूरि वामम्॥
verses.tr: pra yamantarvṛṣasavāso agmantīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram nāha dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsanni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam
verses.en: Indra, the swallower of strong libations rich in the boons they bring, the potent Somas, He, Maghavan, will not restrict his bounty he brings much wealth unto the Soma-presser.

verses.sa:
उत प्रहामतिदीव्या जयाति कृतं यच्छ्वघ्नी विचिनोति काले ।
यो देवकामो न धना रुणद्धि समित्तं राया सृजति स्वधावान्॥
verses.tr: uta prahāmatidīvyā jayāti kṛtaṃ yacchvaghnī vicinoti kāle yo devakāmo na dhanā ruṇaddhi samittaṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān
verses.en: Yea, by superior play he wins advantage, when he, a gambler, piles his gains in season. Celestial-natured, he o'erwhelms with riches the devotee who keeps not back his treasure.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema
verses.en: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners! May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
अच्छा म इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्विदः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत ।
परि ष्वजन्ते जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये॥
verses.tr: acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye
verses.en: In perfect unison all yearning hymns of mine that find the light of heaven have sung forth Indra's praise. As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.

verses.sa:
न घा त्वद्रिगप वेति मे मनस्त्वे इत्कामं पुरुहूत शिश्रय ।
राजेव दस्म नि षदोऽधि बर्हिष्यस्मिन्त्सु सोमेऽवपानमस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: na ghā tvadrigapa veti me manastve itkāmaṃ puruhūta śiśraya rājeva dasma ni ṣado'dhi barhiṣyasmintsu some'vapānamastu te
verses.en: Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O Much-invoked! Sit, Wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विषूवृदिन्द्रो अमतेरुत क्षुधः स इद्रायो मघवा वस्व ईशते ।
तस्येदिमे प्रवणे सप्त सिन्धवो वयो वर्धन्ति वृषभस्य शुष्मिणः॥
verses.tr: viṣūvṛdindro amateruta kṣudhaḥ sa idrāyo maghavā vasva īśate tasyedime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
verses.en: From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth. These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the potent Steer.

verses.sa:
वयो न वृक्षं सुपलाशमासदन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं मन्दिनश्चमूषदः ।
प्रैषामनीकं शवसा दविद्युतद्विदत्स्व१र्मनवे ज्योतिरार्यम्॥
verses.tr: vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśamāsadantsomāsa indraṃ mandinaścamūṣadaḥ praiṣāmanīkaṃ śavasā davidyutadvidatsva1rmanave jyotirāryam
verses.en: As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladdening Soma juices that the bowls contain. Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light.

verses.sa:
कृतं न श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति देवने संवर्गं यन्मघवा सूर्यं जयत् ।
न तत्ते अन्यो अनु वीर्यं शकन्न पुराणो मघवन्नोत नूतनः॥
verses.tr: kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūryaṃ jayat na tatte anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇo maghavannota nūtanaḥ
verses.en: As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghavan, before thee, none in recent time.

verses.sa:
विशंविशं मघवा पर्यशायत जनानां धेना अवचाकशद्वृषा ।
यस्याह शक्रः सवनेषु रण्यति स तीव्रैः सोमैः सहते पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: viśaṃviśaṃ maghavā paryaśāyata janānāṃ dhenā avacākaśadvṛṣā yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise. The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes.

verses.sa:
आपो न सिन्धुमभि यत्समक्षरन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं कुल्या इव ह्रदम् ।
वर्धन्ति विप्रा महो अस्य सादने यवं न वृष्टिर्दिव्येन दानुना॥
verses.tr: āpo na sindhumabhi yatsamakṣarantsomāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirdivyena dānunā
verses.en: When Soma streams together unto Indra flow like waters to the river, rivulets to the lake, In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.

verses.sa:
वृषा न क्रुद्धः पतयद्रजःस्वा यो अर्यपत्नीरकृणोदिमा अपः ।
स सुन्वते मघवा जीरदानवेऽविन्दज्ज्योतिर्मनवे हविष्मते॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayadrajaḥsvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate
verses.en: He rushes through the region like a furious Bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords. This Maghavan hath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.

verses.sa:
उज्जायतां परशुर्ज्योतिषा सह भूया ऋतस्य सुदुघा पुराणवत् ।
वि रोचतामरुषो भानुना शुचिः स्व१र्ण शुक्रं शुशुचीत सत्पतिः॥
verses.tr: ujjāyatāṃ paraśurjyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat vi rocatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ sva1rṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ
verses.en: Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice. Let the Red God shine bright with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema
verses.en: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान् ।
प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन॥
verses.tr: ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānastuviṣmān pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsyapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena
verses.en: May Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active, The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit.

verses.sa:
सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ ।
शीभं राजन्त्सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ्वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि॥
verses.tr: suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau śībhaṃ rājantsupathā yāhyarvāṅvardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni
verses.en: Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder. On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनम् ।
प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsastaviṣāsa enam pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemasmatrā sadhamādo vahantu
verses.en: Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder, Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour.

verses.sa:
एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्जः स्कम्भं धरुण आ वृषायसे ।
ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे॥
verses.tr: evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamūrjaḥ skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe
verses.en: So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat, Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.

verses.sa:
गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः ।
त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: gamannasme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā satsi barhiṣyanādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā
verses.en: May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud. Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands.

verses.sa:
पृथक्प्रायन्प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्यानि दुष्टरा ।
न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशन्त केपयः॥
verses.tr: pṛthakprāyanprathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śravasyāni duṣṭarā na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīrmaiva te nyaviśanta kepayaḥ
verses.en: Far went our earliest invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed. They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm.

verses.sa:
एवैवापागपरे सन्तु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे ।
इत्था ये प्रागुपरे सन्ति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना॥
verses.tr: evaivāpāgapare santu dūḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja āyuyujre itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā
verses.en: So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked. Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.

verses.sa:
गिरीँरज्रान्रेजमानाँ अधारयद्द्यौः क्रन्ददन्तरिक्षाणि कोपयत् ।
समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति॥
verses.tr: girīṃrajrānrejamānāṃ adhārayaddyauḥ krandadantarikṣāṇi kopayat samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati
verses.en: He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake. He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk.

verses.sa:
इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अङ्कुशं येनारुजासि मघवञ्छफारुजः ।
अस्मिन्त्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन्बोध्याभगः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavañchaphārujaḥ asmintsu te savane astvokyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavanbodhyābhagaḥ
verses.en: I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof. At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema
verses.en: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद्द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः ।
तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिन्धान एनं जरते स्वाधीः॥
verses.tr: divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmaddvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ
verses.en: First Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jatavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal.

verses.sa:
विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा ।
विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगन्थ॥
verses.tr: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha
verses.en: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.

verses.sa:
समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्व१न्तर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन् ।
तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन्॥
verses.tr: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsva1ntarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan
verses.en: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven, There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom.

verses.sa:
अक्रन्ददग्निः स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन् ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः॥
verses.tr: akrandadagniḥ stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ
verses.en: Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour.

verses.sa:
श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः ।
वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः॥
verses.tr: śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ
verses.en: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ।
वीळुं चिदद्रिमभिनत्परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च॥
verses.tr: viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ vīḻuṃ cidadrimabhinatparāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca
verses.en: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.

verses.sa:
उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।
इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन्॥
verses.tr: uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan
verses.en: So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre.

verses.sa:
दृशानो रुक्म उर्विया व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः ।
अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौर्जनयत्सुरेताः॥
verses.tr: dṛśāno rukma urviyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurjanayatsuretāḥ
verses.en: Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory, Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने ।
प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाऽभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ॥
verses.tr: yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchā'bhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha
verses.en: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter, Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.

verses.sa:
आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थउक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने ।
प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः॥
verses.tr: ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna ukthauktha ā bhaja śasyamāne priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ
verses.en: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to Surya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून्विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि ।
त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūnviśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ
verses.en: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.

verses.sa:
अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः ।
अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram
verses.en: Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaisvanara, hath been lauded by the Rsis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.

verses.sa:
प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्वा सीददपामुपस्थे ।
दधिर्यो धायि स ते वयांसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः॥
verses.tr: pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadvā sīdadapāmupasthe dadhiryo dhāyi sa te vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ
verses.en: Stablished for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body. The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters.

verses.sa:
इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे पशुं न नष्टं पदैरनु ग्मन् ।
गुहा चतन्तमुशिजो नमोभिरिच्छन्तो धीरा भृगवोऽविन्दन्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe paśuṃ na naṣṭaṃ padairanu gman guhā catantamuśijo namobhiricchanto dhīrā bhṛgavo'vindan
verses.en: Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints, Wise Bhrgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered.

verses.sa:
इमं त्रितो भूर्यविन्ददिच्छन्वैभूवसो मूर्धन्यघ्न्यायाः ।
स शेवृधो जात आ हर्म्येषु नाभिर्युवा भवति रोचनस्य॥
verses.tr: imaṃ trito bhūryavindadicchanvaibhūvaso mūrdhanyaghnyāyāḥ sa śevṛdho jāta ā harmyeṣu nābhiryuvā bhavati rocanasya
verses.en: On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him. Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो नमोभिः प्राञ्चं यज्ञं नेतारमध्वराणाम् ।
विशामकृण्वन्नरतिं पावकं हव्यवाहं दधतो मानुषेषु॥
verses.tr: mandraṃ hotāramuśijo namobhiḥ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ netāramadhvarāṇām viśāmakṛṇvannaratiṃ pāvakaṃ havyavāhaṃ dadhato mānuṣeṣu
verses.en: Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer, Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances.

verses.sa:
प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरा अमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् ।
नयन्तो गर्भं वनां धियं धुर्हिरिश्मश्रुं नार्वाणं धनर्चम्॥
verses.tr: pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrā amūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam nayanto garbhaṃ vanāṃ dhiyaṃ dhurhiriśmaśruṃ nārvāṇaṃ dhanarcam
verses.en: The foolish brought the ne'er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer. Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit.

verses.sa:
नि पस्त्यासु त्रितः स्तभूयन्परिवीतो योनौ सीददन्तः ।
अतः संगृभ्या विशां दमूना विधर्मणायन्त्रैरीयते नॄन्॥
verses.tr: ni pastyāsu tritaḥ stabhūyanparivīto yonau sīdadantaḥ ataḥ saṃgṛbhyā viśāṃ damūnā vidharmaṇāyantrairīyate nṝn
verses.en: Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surrounded Thence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion.

verses.sa:
अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः ।
श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः॥
verses.tr: asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ
verses.en: His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas.

verses.sa:
प्र जिह्वया भरते वेपो अग्निः प्र वयुनानि चेतसा पृथिव्याः ।
तमायवः शुचयन्तं पावकं मन्द्रं होतारं दधिरे यजिष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: pra jihvayā bharate vepo agniḥ pra vayunāni cetasā pṛthivyāḥ tamāyavaḥ śucayantaṃ pāvakaṃ mandraṃ hotāraṃ dadhire yajiṣṭham
verses.en: The tongue of Agni bears away the praise song, and, through his care for Earth, her operations. Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers.

verses.sa:
द्यावा यमग्निं पृथिवी जनिष्टामापस्त्वष्टा भृगवो यं सहोभिः ।
ईळेन्यं प्रथमं मातरिश्वा देवास्ततक्षुर्मनवे यजत्रम्॥
verses.tr: dyāvā yamagniṃ pṛthivī janiṣṭāmāpastvaṣṭā bhṛgavo yaṃ sahobhiḥ īḻenyaṃ prathamaṃ mātariśvā devāstatakṣurmanave yajatram
verses.en: That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvastar, and with might, the Bhrgus, Him Matarisvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं पुरुस्पृहो मानुषासो यजत्रम् ।
स यामन्नग्ने स्तुवते वयो धाः प्र देवयन्यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā devā dadhire havyavāhaṃ puruspṛho mānuṣāso yajatram sa yāmannagne stuvate vayo dhāḥ pra devayanyaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ
verses.en: Agni, whom Gods have made oblation bearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy, Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.

verses.sa:
जगृभ्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् ।
विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: jagṛbhmā te dakṣiṇamindra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Thy right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures! Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधं स्ववसं सुनीथं चतुःसमुद्रं धरुणं रयीणाम् ।
चर्कृत्यं शंस्यं भूरिवारमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: svāyudhaṃ svavasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇaṃ rayīṇām carkṛtyaṃ śaṃsyaṃ bhūrivāramasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures, Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
सुब्रह्माणं देववन्तं बृहन्तमुरुं गभीरं पृथुबुध्नमिन्द्र ।
श्रुतऋषिमुग्रमभिमातिषाहमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: subrahmāṇaṃ devavantaṃ bṛhantamuruṃ gabhīraṃ pṛthubudhnamindra śrutaṛṣimugramabhimātiṣāhamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations, Strong, with famed Rsis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
सनद्वाजं विप्रवीरं तरुत्रं धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् ।
दस्युहनं पूर्भिदमिन्द्र सत्यमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: sanadvājaṃ vipravīraṃ tarutraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam dasyuhanaṃ pūrbhidamindra satyamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting, True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
अश्वावन्तं रथिनं वीरवन्तं सहस्रिणं शतिनं वाजमिन्द्र ।
भद्रव्रातं विप्रवीरं स्वर्षामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvantaṃ rathinaṃ vīravantaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ vājamindra bhadravrātaṃ vipravīraṃ svarṣāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousand fold, O Indra, With manly sages, happy troops, light-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
प्र सप्तगुमृतधीतिं सुमेधां बृहस्पतिं मतिरच्छा जिगाति ।
य आङ्गिरसो नमसोपसद्योऽस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: pra saptagumṛtadhītiṃ sumedhāṃ bṛhaspatiṃ matiracchā jigāti ya āṅgiraso namasopasadyo'smabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Brhaspati, the song approaches, Angiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
वनीवानो मम दूतास इन्द्रं स्तोमाश्चरन्ति सुमतीरियानाः ।
हृदिस्पृशो मनसा वच्यमाना अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: vanīvāno mama dūtāsa indraṃ stomāścaranti sumatīriyānāḥ hṛdispṛśo manasā vacyamānā asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty, Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा यामि दद्धि तन्न इन्द्र बृहन्तं क्षयमसमं जनानाम् ।
अभि तद्द्यावापृथिवी गृणीतामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: yattvā yāmi daddhi tanna indra bṛhantaṃ kṣayamasamaṃ janānām abhi taddyāvāpṛthivī gṛṇītāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people. To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
अहं भुवं वसुनः पूर्व्यस्पतिरहं धनानि सं जयामि शश्वतः ।
मां हवन्ते पितरं न जन्तवोऽहं दाशुषे वि भजामि भोजनम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ bhuvaṃ vasunaḥ pūrvyaspatirahaṃ dhanāni saṃ jayāmi śaśvataḥ māṃ havante pitaraṃ na jantavo'haṃ dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam
verses.en: I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up. On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to thou man who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो रोधो वक्षो अथर्वणस्त्रिताय गा अजनयमहेरधि ।
अहं दस्युभ्यः परि नृम्णमा ददे गोत्रा शिक्षन्दधीचे मातरिश्वने॥
verses.tr: ahamindro rodho vakṣo atharvaṇastritāya gā ajanayamaheradhi ahaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pari nṛmṇamā dade gotrā śikṣandadhīce mātariśvane
verses.en: I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp. I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac.

verses.sa:
मह्यं त्वष्टा वज्रमतक्षदायसं मयि देवासोऽवृजन्नपि क्रतुम् ।
ममानीकं सूर्यस्येव दुष्टरं मामार्यन्ति कृतेन कर्त्वेन च॥
verses.tr: mahyaṃ tvaṣṭā vajramatakṣadāyasaṃ mayi devāso'vṛjannapi kratum mamānīkaṃ sūryasyeva duṣṭaraṃ māmāryanti kṛtena kartvena ca
verses.en: For me hath Tvastar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power. My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds.

verses.sa:
अहमेतं गव्ययमश्व्यं पशुं पुरीषिणं सायकेना हिरण्ययम् ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि दाशुषे यन्मा सोमास उक्थिनो अमन्दिषुः॥
verses.tr: ahametaṃ gavyayamaśvyaṃ paśuṃ purīṣiṇaṃ sāyakenā hiraṇyayam purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yanmā somāsa ukthino amandiṣuḥ
verses.en: I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt. I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad.

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो न परा जिग्य इद्धनं न मृत्यवेऽव तस्थे कदा चन ।
सोममिन्मा सुन्वन्तो याचता वसु न मे पूरवः सख्ये रिषाथन॥
verses.tr: ahamindro na parā jigya iddhanaṃ na mṛtyave'va tasthe kadā cana somaminmā sunvanto yācatā vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye riṣāthana
verses.en: Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death. Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Purus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अहमेताञ्छाश्वसतो द्वाद्वेन्द्रं ये वज्रं युधयेऽकृण्वत ।
आह्वयमानाँ अव हन्मनाहनं दृळ्हा वदन्ननमस्युर्नमस्विनः॥
verses.tr: ahametāñchāśvasato dvādvendraṃ ye vajraṃ yudhaye'kṛṇvata āhvayamānāṃ ava hanmanāhanaṃ dṛḻhā vadannanamasyurnamasvinaḥ
verses.en: These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray, The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers.

verses.sa:
अभी३दमेकमेको अस्मि निष्षाळभी द्वा किमु त्रयः करन्ति ।
खले न पर्षान्प्रति हन्मि भूरि किं मा निन्दन्ति शत्रवोऽनिन्द्राः॥
verses.tr: abhī3damekameko asmi niṣṣāḻabhī dvā kimu trayaḥ karanti khale na parṣānprati hanmi bhūri kiṃ mā nindanti śatravo'nindrāḥ
verses.en: This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me? Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me?

verses.sa:
अहं गुङ्गुभ्यो अतिथिग्वमिष्करमिषं न वृत्रतुरं विक्षु धारयम् ।
यत्पर्णयघ्न उत वा करञ्जहे प्राहं महे वृत्रहत्ये अशुश्रवि॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ guṅgubhyo atithigvamiṣkaramiṣaṃ na vṛtraturaṃ vikṣu dhārayam yatparṇayaghna uta vā karañjahe prāhaṃ mahe vṛtrahatye aśuśravi
verses.en: Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vrtra-conquering strength, When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parnaya.

verses.sa:
प्र मे नमी साप्य इषे भुजे भूद्गवामेषे सख्या कृणुत द्विता ।
दिद्युं यदस्य समिथेषु मंहयमादिदेनं शंस्यमुक्थ्यं करम्॥
verses.tr: pra me namī sāpya iṣe bhuje bhūdgavāmeṣe sakhyā kṛṇuta dvitā didyuṃ yadasya samitheṣu maṃhayamādidenaṃ śaṃsyamukthyaṃ karam
verses.en: With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine. As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise.

verses.sa:
प्र नेमस्मिन्ददृशे सोमो अन्तर्गोपा नेममाविरस्था कृणोति ।
स तिग्मशृङ्गं वृषभं युयुत्सन्द्रुहस्तस्थौ बहुले बद्धो अन्तः॥
verses.tr: pra nemasmindadṛśe somo antargopā nemamāvirasthā kṛṇoti sa tigmaśṛṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yuyutsandruhastasthau bahule baddho antaḥ
verses.en: One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other. He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region.

verses.sa:
आदित्यानां वसूनां रुद्रियाणां देवो देवानां न मिनामि धाम ।
ते मा भद्राय शवसे ततक्षुरपराजितमस्तृतमषाळ्हम्॥
verses.tr: ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ rudriyāṇāṃ devo devānāṃ na mināmi dhāma te mā bhadrāya śavase tatakṣuraparājitamastṛtamaṣāḻham
verses.en: I, as a God, ne'er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Adityas. These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.

verses.sa:
अहं दां गृणते पूर्व्यं वस्वहं ब्रह्म कृणवं मह्यं वर्धनम् ।
अहं भुवं यजमानस्य चोदितायज्वनः साक्षि विश्वस्मिन्भरे॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ dāṃ gṛṇate pūrvyaṃ vasvahaṃ brahma kṛṇavaṃ mahyaṃ vardhanam ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya coditāyajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasminbhare
verses.en: I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me. I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not.

verses.sa:
मां धुरिन्द्रं नाम देवता दिवश्च ग्मश्चापां च जन्तवः ।
अहं हरी वृषणा विव्रता रघू अहं वज्रं शवसे धृष्ण्वा ददे॥
verses.tr: māṃ dhurindraṃ nāma devatā divaśca gmaścāpāṃ ca jantavaḥ ahaṃ harī vṛṣaṇā vivratā raghū ahaṃ vajraṃ śavase dhṛṣṇvā dade
verses.en: The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name. I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength.

verses.sa:
अहमत्कं कवये शिश्नथं हथैरहं कुत्समावमाभिरूतिभिः ।
अहं शुष्णस्य श्नथिता वधर्यमं न यो रर आर्यं नाम दस्यवे॥
verses.tr: ahamatkaṃ kavaye śiśnathaṃ hathairahaṃ kutsamāvamābhirūtibhiḥ ahaṃ śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadharyamaṃ na yo rara āryaṃ nāma dasyave
verses.en: With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps. As Susna's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Aryan name to Dasyu foes.

verses.sa:
अहं पितेव वेतसूँरभिष्टये तुग्रं कुत्साय स्मदिभं च रन्धयम् ।
अहं भुवं यजमानस्य राजनि प्र यद्भरे तुजये न प्रियाधृषे॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ piteva vetasūṃrabhiṣṭaye tugraṃ kutsāya smadibhaṃ ca randhayam ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya rājani pra yadbhare tujaye na priyādhṛṣe
verses.en: Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him. I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts.

verses.sa:
अहं रन्धयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् ।
अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरन्धयम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ randhayaṃ mṛgayaṃ śrutarvaṇe yanmājihīta vayunā canānuṣak ahaṃ veśaṃ namramāyave'karamahaṃ savyāya paḍgṛbhimarandhayam
verses.en: I gave up Mrgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws. For Ayu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi.

verses.sa:
अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजम् ।
यद्वर्धयन्तं प्रथयन्तमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ sa yo navavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ saṃ vṛtreva dāsaṃ vṛtrahārujam yadvardhayantaṃ prathayantamānuṣagdūre pāre rajaso rocanākaram
verses.en: 1, I crushed Navavastva of the lofty car, the Dasa, as the Vrtra-slayer kills the fiends; When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase.

verses.sa:
अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा ।
यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ sūryasya pari yāmyāśubhiḥ praitaśebhirvahamāna ojasā yanmā sāvo manuṣa āha nirṇija ṛdhakkṛṣe dāsaṃ kṛtvyaṃ hathaiḥ
verses.en: I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun. When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows.

verses.sa:
अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुम् ।
अहं न्य१न्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ saptahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavasā turvaśaṃ yadum ahaṃ nya1nyaṃ sahasā sahaskaraṃ nava vrādhato navatiṃ ca vakṣayam
verses.en: Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga. I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power.

verses.sa:
अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि ।
अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā adhi ahamarṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukraturyudhā vidaṃ manave gātumiṣṭaye
verses.en: Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain. I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success.

verses.sa:
अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् ।
स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ tadāsu dhārayaṃ yadāsu na devaścana tvaṣṭādhārayadruśat spārhaṃ gavāmūdhassu vakṣaṇāsvā madhormadhu śvātryaṃ somamāśiram
verses.en: I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvastar's self, had there deposited,- Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice.

verses.sa:
एवा देवाँ इन्द्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः ।
विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणन्ति॥
verses.tr: evā devāṃ indro vivye nṝnpra cyautnena maghavā satyarādhāḥ viśvettā te harivaḥ śacīvo'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti
verses.en: Even thus hath Indra Maghavan, truly bounteous, sped Gods and men with mighty operation. The pious glorify all these thine exploits, Lord of Bay Coursers, Strong, and self resplendent.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे मन्दमानायान्धसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे ।
इन्द्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ
verses.en: I LAUD your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is shared by all men, who created all; Indra, whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इनः स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इन्द्रो मावते नरे ।
विश्वासु धूर्षु वाजकृत्येषु सत्पते वृत्रे वाप्स्व१भि शूर मन्दसे॥
verses.tr: so cinnu sakhyā narya inaḥ stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate nare viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satpate vṛtre vāpsva1bhi śūra mandase
verses.en: He with his friend is active, lauded, good to man, Indra who must be glorified by one like me. Hero, Lord of the brave, all cars are thy delight, warring with Vrtra, or for waters, or for spoil.

verses.sa:
के ते नर इन्द्र ये त इषे ये ते सुम्नं सधन्य१मियक्षान् ।
के ते वाजायासुर्याय हिन्विरे के अप्सु स्वासूर्वरासु पौंस्ये॥
verses.tr: ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye te sumnaṃ sadhanya1miyakṣān ke te vājāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsūrvarāsu pauṃsye
verses.en: Who are the men whom thou wilt further, Indra, who strive to win thy bliss allied with riches? Who urged thee forward to exert thy power divine, to valour, in the war for waters on their fields?

verses.sa:
भुवस्त्वमिन्द्र ब्रह्मणा महान्भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः ।
भुवो नॄँश्च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन्भरे ज्येष्ठश्च मन्त्रो विश्वचर्षणे॥
verses.tr: bhuvastvamindra brahmaṇā mahānbhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ bhuvo nṝṃścyautno viśvasminbhare jyeṣṭhaśca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe
verses.en: Thou, Indra, through the holy prayer art mighty, worthy of sacrifice at all libations. In every fight thou castest heroes on the ground: thou art the noblest song, O Lord of all the folk.

verses.sa:
अवा नु कं ज्यायान्यज्ञवनसो महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो विदुः ।
असो नु कमजरो वर्धाश्च विश्वेदेता सवना तूतुमा कृषे॥
verses.tr: avā nu kaṃ jyāyānyajñavanaso mahīṃ ta omātrāṃ kṛṣṭayo viduḥ aso nu kamajaro vardhāśca viśvedetā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe
verses.en: Help now, as Highest, those who toil at sacrifice: well do the people know thy great protecting might. Thou shalt be everlasting, Giver of success yea, on all these libations thou bestowest strength.

verses.sa:
एता विश्वा सवना तूतुमा कृषे स्वयं सूनो सहसो यानि दधिषे ।
वराय ते पात्रं धर्मणे तना यज्ञो मन्त्रो ब्रह्मोद्यतं वचः॥
verses.tr: etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe svayaṃ sūno sahaso yāni dadhiṣe varāya te pātraṃ dharmaṇe tanā yajño mantro brahmodyataṃ vacaḥ
verses.en: All these libations thou makest effectual, of which thou art thyself supporter, Son of Power. Therefore thy vessel is to be esteemed the best, sacrifice, holy text, prayer, and exalted speech.

verses.sa:
ये ते विप्र ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा वसूनां च वसुनश्च दावने ।
प्र ते सुम्नस्य मनसा पथा भुवन्मदे सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसः॥
verses.tr: ye te vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasunaśca dāvane pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvanmade sutasya somyasyāndhasaḥ
verses.en: They who with flowing Soma pray to thee, O Sage, to pour on them thy gifts of opulence and wealth, May they come forward, through their spirit, on the path of bliss, in the wild joy of Soma juice effused.

verses.sa:
महत्तदुल्बं स्थविरं तदासीद्येनाविष्टितः प्रविवेशिथापः ।
विश्वा अपश्यद्बहुधा ते अग्ने जातवेदस्तन्वो देव एकः॥
verses.tr: mahattadulbaṃ sthaviraṃ tadāsīdyenāviṣṭitaḥ praviveśithāpaḥ viśvā apaśyadbahudhā te agne jātavedastanvo deva ekaḥ
verses.en: Large was that covering, and firm of texture, folded wherein thou enteredst the waters. One Deity alone, O Jatavedas Agni, saw all thy forms in sundry places.

verses.sa:
को मा ददर्श कतमः स देवो यो मे तन्वो बहुधा पर्यपश्यत् ।
क्वाह मित्रावरुणा क्षियन्त्यग्नेर्विश्वाः समिधो देवयानीः॥
verses.tr: ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvo bahudhā paryapaśyat kvāha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyantyagnerviśvāḥ samidho devayānīḥ
verses.en: What God hath seen me? Who of all their number clearly beheld my forms in many places? Where lie, then, all the sacred logs of Agni that lead him God-ward, Varuna and Mitra?

verses.sa:
ऐच्छाम त्वा बहुधा जातवेदः प्रविष्टमग्ने अप्स्वोषधीषु ।
तं त्वा यमो अचिकेच्चित्रभानो दशान्तरुष्यादतिरोचमानम्॥
verses.tr: aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭamagne apsvoṣadhīṣu taṃ tvā yamo acikeccitrabhāno daśāntaruṣyādatirocamānam
verses.en: In many places, Agni Jatavedas, we sought thee hidden in the plants and waters. Then Yama marked thee, God of wondrous splendour! effulgent from thy tenfold secret dwelling,

verses.sa:
होत्रादहं वरुण बिभ्यदायं नेदेव मा युनजन्नत्र देवाः ।
तस्य मे तन्वो बहुधा निविष्टा एतमर्थं न चिकेताहमग्निः॥
verses.tr: hotrādahaṃ varuṇa bibhyadāyaṃ nedeva mā yunajannatra devāḥ tasya me tanvo bahudhā niviṣṭā etamarthaṃ na ciketāhamagniḥ
verses.en: I fled in fear from sacrificial worship, Varuna, lest the Gods should thus engage me. Thus were my forms laid down in many places. This, as my goal, I Agni saw before me.

verses.sa:
एहि मनुर्देवयुर्यज्ञकामोऽरंकृत्या तमसि क्षेष्यग्ने ।
सुगान्पथः कृणुहि देवयानान्वह हव्यानि सुमनस्यमानः॥
verses.tr: ehi manurdevayuryajñakāmo'raṃkṛtyā tamasi kṣeṣyagne sugānpathaḥ kṛṇuhi devayānānvaha havyāni sumanasyamānaḥ
verses.en: Come; man is pious and would fain do worship, he waits prepared: in gloom thou, Agni, dwellest. Make pathways leading God-ward clear and easy, and bear oblations with a kindly spirit.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः पूर्वे भ्रातरो अर्थमेतं रथीवाध्वानमन्वावरीवुः ।
तस्माद्भिया वरुण दूरमायं गौरो न क्षेप्नोरविजे ज्यायाः॥
verses.tr: agneḥ pūrve bhrātaro arthametaṃ rathīvādhvānamanvāvarīvuḥ tasmādbhiyā varuṇa dūramāyaṃ gauro na kṣepnoravije jyāyāḥ
verses.en: This goal mine elder brothers erst selected, as he who drives a car the way to travel. So,Varuna, I fled afar through terror, as flies the wild-bull from an archer's bowstring.

verses.sa:
कुर्मस्त आयुरजरं यदग्ने यथा युक्तो जातवेदो न रिष्याः ।
अथा वहासि सुमनस्यमानो भागं देवेभ्यो हविषः सुजात॥
verses.tr: kurmasta āyurajaraṃ yadagne yathā yukto jātavedo na riṣyāḥ athā vahāsi sumanasyamāno bhāgaṃ devebhyo haviṣaḥ sujāta
verses.en: We give thee life unwasting, Jatavedas, so that, employed, thou never shalt be injured. So, nobly born! shalt thou with kindly spirit bear to the Gods their share of men's oblations.

verses.sa:
प्रयाजान्मे अनुयाजाँश्च केवलानूर्जस्वन्तं हविषो दत्त भागम् ।
घृतं चापां पुरुषं चौषधीनामग्नेश्च दीर्घमायुरस्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: prayājānme anuyājāṃśca kevalānūrjasvantaṃ haviṣo datta bhāgam ghṛtaṃ cāpāṃ puruṣaṃ cauṣadhīnāmagneśca dīrghamāyurastu devāḥ
verses.en: Grant me the first oblations and the latter, entire, my forceful shares of holy presents, The soul of plants, the fatness of the waters, and let there be long life, ye Gods, to Agni.

verses.sa:
तव प्रयाजा अनुयाजाश्च केवल ऊर्जस्वन्तो हविषः सन्तु भागाः ।
तवाग्ने यज्ञो३ऽयमस्तु सर्वस्तुभ्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: tava prayājā anuyājāśca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ tavāgne yajño3'yamastu sarvastubhyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: Thine be the first oblations and the latter, entire, thy forceful shares of holy presents. Let all this sacrifice be thine, O Agni, and let the world's four regions bow before thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः शास्तन मा यथेह होता वृतो मनवै यन्निषद्य ।
प्र मे ब्रूत भागधेयं यथा वो येन पथा हव्यमा वो वहानि॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yanniṣadya pra me brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pathā havyamā vo vahāni
verses.en: Instruct me, all ye Gods, how I, elected your Priest, must seat me here, and how address you. Instruct me how to deal to each his portion, and by what ' path to bring you man's oblation.

verses.sa:
अहं होता न्यसीदं यजीयान्विश्वे देवा मरुतो मा जुनन्ति ।
अहरहरश्विनाध्वर्यवं वां ब्रह्मा समिद्भवति साहुतिर्वाम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ hotā nyasīdaṃ yajīyānviśve devā maruto mā junanti aharaharaśvinādhvaryavaṃ vāṃ brahmā samidbhavati sāhutirvām
verses.en: I sit as Priest most skilled in sacrificing: the Maruts and all Deities impel me. Asvins, each day yours is the Adhvaryu's duty: Brahman and wood are here: 'tis yours to offer.

verses.sa:
अयं यो होता किरु स यमस्य कमप्यूहे यत्समञ्जन्ति देवाः ।
अहरहर्जायते मासिमास्यथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo hotā kiru sa yamasya kamapyūhe yatsamañjanti devāḥ aharaharjāyate māsimāsyathā devā dadhire havyavāham
verses.en: Who is the Priest? Is he the Priest of Yama? On whom is thrust this God-appointed honour? He springs to life each month, each day that passes; so Gods have made him their oblation-bearer.

verses.sa:
मां देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहमपम्लुक्तं बहु कृच्छ्रा चरन्तम् ।
अग्निर्विद्वान्यज्ञं नः कल्पयाति पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम्॥
verses.tr: māṃ devā dadhire havyavāhamapamluktaṃ bahu kṛcchrā carantam agnirvidvānyajñaṃ naḥ kalpayāti pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum
verses.en: The Gods have made me bearer of oblations, who slipped away and passed through many troubles. Wise Agni shall ordain for us the worship, whether five-wayed, threefold, or seven-threaded.

verses.sa:
आ वो यक्ष्यमृतत्वं सुवीरं यथा वो देवा वरिवः कराणि ।
आ बाह्वोर्वज्रमिन्द्रस्य धेयामथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयाति॥
verses.tr: ā vo yakṣyamṛtatvaṃ suvīraṃ yathā vo devā varivaḥ karāṇi ā bāhvorvajramindrasya dheyāmathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāti
verses.en: So will I win you strength and life for ever. O Gods, that I may give you room and freedom. To Indra's arms would I consign the thunder; in all these battles shall he then be victor.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।
औक्षन्घृतैरस्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त॥
verses.tr: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan aukṣanghṛtairastṛṇanbarhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta
verses.en: The Deities three hundred and thirty-nine, have served and honoured Agni, Strewn sacred grass, anointed him with butter, and seated him as Priest, the Gods' Invoker.

verses.sa:
यमैच्छाम मनसा सो३ऽयमागाद्यज्ञस्य विद्वान्परुषश्चिकित्वान् ।
स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्नि हि षत्सदन्तरः पूर्वो अस्मत्॥
verses.tr: yamaicchāma manasā so3'yamāgādyajñasya vidvānparuṣaścikitvān sa no yakṣaddevatātā yajīyānni hi ṣatsadantaraḥ pūrvo asmat
verses.en: He hath arrived, he whom we sought with longing, who skilled in sacrifice well knows its courses. Let him discharge his sacrificial duties: let him sit down as Friend who was before Us.

verses.sa:
अराधि होता निषदा यजीयानभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यत् ।
यजामहै यज्ञियान्हन्त देवाँ ईळामहा ईड्याँ आज्येन॥
verses.tr: arādhi hotā niṣadā yajīyānabhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyat yajāmahai yajñiyānhanta devāṃ īḻāmahā īḍyāṃ ājyena
verses.en: Best Priest, he hath been won by being seated, for he hath looked on the well-ordered viands. Come, let us worship Gods who must be worshipped, and pouring oil, laud those who should be lauded.

verses.sa:
साध्वीमकर्देववीतिं नो अद्य यज्ञस्य जिह्वामविदाम गुह्याम् ।
स आयुरागात्सुरभिर्वसानो भद्रामकर्देवहूतिं नो अद्य॥
verses.tr: sādhvīmakardevavītiṃ no adya yajñasya jihvāmavidāma guhyām sa āyurāgātsurabhirvasāno bhadrāmakardevahūtiṃ no adya
verses.en: Now hath he made the feast of Gods effective: now have we found the secret tongue of worship. Now hath he come, sweet, robed in vital vigour, and made our calling on the Gods effective.

verses.sa:
तदद्य वाचः प्रथमं मसीय येनासुराँ अभि देवा असाम ।
ऊर्जाद उत यज्ञियासः पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषध्वम्॥
verses.tr: tadadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīya yenāsurāṃ abhi devā asāma ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam
verses.en: This prelude of my speech I now will utter, whereby we Gods may quell our Asura foemen. Eaters of strengthening food who merit worship, O ye Five Tribes, be pleased with mine oblation.

verses.sa:
पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषन्तां गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ।
पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān
verses.en: May the Five Tribes be pleased with mine oblation, and the Cow's Sons and all who merit worship. From earthly trouble may the earth protect us, and air's mid realm from woe that comes from heaven.

verses.sa:
तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान् ।
अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: tantuṃ tanvanrajaso bhānumanvihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvāmapo manurbhava janayā daivyaṃ janam
verses.en: Spinning the thread, follow the region's splendid light: guard thou the path ways well which wisdom hath prepared. Weave ye the knotless labour of the bards who sing: be Manu thou, and bring the Heavenly People forth.

verses.sa:
अक्षानहो नह्यतनोत सोम्या इष्कृणुध्वं रशना ओत पिंशत ।
अष्टावन्धुरं वहताभितो रथं येन देवासो अनयन्नभि प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iṣkṛṇudhvaṃ raśanā ota piṃśata aṣṭāvandhuraṃ vahatābhito rathaṃ yena devāso anayannabhi priyam
verses.en: Lovers of Soma, bind the chariot traces fast: set ye the reins in order and embellish them. Bring hitherward the car with seats where eight may sit, whereon the Gods have brought the treasure that we love.

verses.sa:
अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः ।
अत्रा जहाम ये असन्नशेवाः शिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān
verses.en: Here flows Asmanvati: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, and pass, my friends, the river. There let us leave the Powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा माया वेदपसामपस्तमो बिभ्रत्पात्रा देवपानानि शंतमा ।
शिशीते नूनं परशुं स्वायसं येन वृश्चादेतशो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā māyā vedapasāmapastamo bibhratpātrā devapānāni śaṃtamā śiśīte nūnaṃ paraśuṃ svāyasaṃ yena vṛścādetaśo brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: Tvastar, most deft of workmen, knew each magic art, bringing most blessed bowls that hold the drink of Gods. His axe, wrought of good metal, he is sharpening now, wherewith the radiant Brahmanaspati will cut.

verses.sa:
सतो नूनं कवयः सं शिशीत वाशीभिर्याभिरमृताय तक्षथ ।
विद्वांसः पदा गुह्यानि कर्तन येन देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः॥
verses.tr: sato nūnaṃ kavayaḥ saṃ śiśīta vāśībhiryābhiramṛtāya takṣatha vidvāṃsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ
verses.en: Now, O ye Sapient Ones, make ye the axes sharp wherewith ye fashion bowls to hold the Amrta. Knowing the secret places make ye ready that whereby the Gods have gotten immortality.

verses.sa:
गर्भे योषामदधुर्वत्समासन्यपीच्येन मनसोत जिह्वया ।
स विश्वाहा सुमना योग्या अभि सिषासनिर्वनते कार इज्जितिम्॥
verses.tr: garbhe yoṣāmadadhurvatsamāsanyapīcyena manasota jihvayā sa viśvāhā sumanā yogyā abhi siṣāsanirvanate kāra ijjitim
verses.en: Ye with a secret tongue and dark intention laid the maiden deep within, the calf within the mouth. They evermore are near us with their gracious help: successful is the song that strives for victory.

verses.sa:
तां सु ते कीर्तिं मघवन्महित्वा यत्त्वा भीते रोदसी अह्वयेताम् ।
प्रावो देवाँ आतिरो दासमोजः प्रजायै त्वस्यै यदशिक्ष इन्द्र॥
verses.tr: tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā yattvā bhīte rodasī ahvayetām prāvo devāṃ ātiro dāsamojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yadaśikṣa indra
verses.en: I SING thy fame that, Maghavan, through thy Greatness the heavens and earth invoked thee in their terror, Thou, aiding Gods, didst quell the power of Dasas, what time thou holpest many a race, O Indra.

verses.sa:
यदचरस्तन्वा वावृधानो बलानीन्द्र प्रब्रुवाणो जनेषु ।
मायेत्सा ते यानि युद्धान्याहुर्नाद्य शत्रुं ननु पुरा विवित्से॥
verses.tr: yadacarastanvā vāvṛdhāno balānīndra prabruvāṇo janeṣu māyetsā te yāni yuddhānyāhurnādya śatruṃ nanu purā vivitse
verses.en: When thou wast roaming, waxen strong in body, telling thy might, Indra, among the people, All that men called thy battles was illusion: no foe hast thou to-day, nor erst hast found one.

verses.sa:
क उ नु ते महिमनः समस्याऽस्मत्पूर्व ऋषयोऽन्तमापुः ।
यन्मातरं च पितरं च साकमजनयथास्तन्व१ः स्वायाः॥
verses.tr: ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyā'smatpūrva ṛṣayo'ntamāpuḥ yanmātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca sākamajanayathāstanva1ḥ svāyāḥ
verses.en: Who are the Rsis, then, who comprehended before our time the bounds of all thy greatness? For from thy body thou hast generated at the same time the Mother and the Father.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि ते असुर्याणि नामाऽदाभ्यानि महिषस्य सन्ति ।
त्वमङ्ग तानि विश्वानि वित्से येभिः कर्माणि मघवञ्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: catvāri te asuryāṇi nāmā'dābhyāni mahiṣasya santi tvamaṅga tāni viśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi maghavañcakartha
verses.en: Thou, Mighty Steer, hast four supremest natures, Asura natures that may ne'er be injured. All these, O Maghavan, thou surely knowest, wherewith thou hast performed thy great achievements.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वा दधिषे केवलानि यान्याविर्या च गुहा वसूनि ।
काममिन्मे मघवन्मा वि तारीस्त्वमाज्ञाता त्वमिन्द्रासि दाता॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yānyāviryā ca guhā vasūni kāmaminme maghavanmā vi tārīstvamājñātā tvamindrāsi dātā
verses.en: Thou hast all treasures in thy sole possession, treasures made manifest and treasures hidden. Defer not thou, O Maghavan, my longing: thou, art Director, Indra, thou art Giver.

verses.sa:
यो अदधाज्ज्योतिषि ज्योतिरन्तर्यो असृजन्मधुना सं मधूनि ।
अध प्रियं शूषमिन्द्राय मन्म ब्रह्मकृतो बृहदुक्थादवाचि॥
verses.tr: yo adadhājjyotiṣi jyotirantaryo asṛjanmadhunā saṃ madhūni adha priyaṃ śūṣamindrāya manma brahmakṛto bṛhadukthādavāci
verses.en: To him who set the light in things of splendour, and with all sweetness blent essential sweetness, To Indra hath this welcome hymn that strengthens been uttered by the votary Brhaduktha.

verses.sa:
दूरे तन्नाम गुह्यं पराचैर्यत्त्वा भीते अह्वयेतां वयोधै ।
उदस्तभ्नाः पृथिवीं द्यामभीके भ्रातुः पुत्रान्मघवन्तित्विषाणः॥
verses.tr: dūre tannāma guhyaṃ parācairyattvā bhīte ahvayetāṃ vayodhai udastabhnāḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmabhīke bhrātuḥ putrānmaghavantitviṣāṇaḥ
verses.en: Far is that secret name by which, in terror, the worlds invoked thee and thou gavest vigour The earth and heaven thou settest near each other, and Maghavan, madest bright thy Brother's Children.

verses.sa:
महत्तन्नाम गुह्यं पुरुस्पृग्येन भूतं जनयो येन भव्यम् ।
प्रत्नं जातं ज्योतिर्यदस्य प्रियं प्रियाः समविशन्त पञ्च॥
verses.tr: mahattannāma guhyaṃ puruspṛgyena bhūtaṃ janayo yena bhavyam pratnaṃ jātaṃ jyotiryadasya priyaṃ priyāḥ samaviśanta pañca
