verses.en: Great is that secret name and far-extending, whereby thou madest all that is and shall be. The Five Tribes whom he loveth well have entered the light he loveth that was made aforetime.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणादोत मध्यं पञ्च देवाँ ऋतुशः सप्तसप्त ।
चतुस्त्रिंशता पुरुधा वि चष्टे सरूपेण ज्योतिषा विव्रतेन॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī apṛṇādota madhyaṃ pañca devāṃ ṛtuśaḥ saptasapta catustriṃśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sarūpeṇa jyotiṣā vivratena
verses.en: He filled the heaven and earth and all between them, Gods five times sevenfold in their proper seasons. With four-and-thirty lights he looks around him, lights of one colour though their ways are divers.

verses.sa:
यदुष औच्छः प्रथमा विभानामजनयो येन पुष्टस्य पुष्टम् ।
यत्ते जामित्वमवरं परस्या महन्महत्या असुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: yaduṣa aucchaḥ prathamā vibhānāmajanayo yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam yatte jāmitvamavaraṃ parasyā mahanmahatyā asuratvamekam
verses.en: As first among the lights, O Dawn, thou shonest, whereby thou broughtest forth the Stay of Increase, Great art thou, matchless is thine Asura nature, who, high above, art kin to those beneath thee.

verses.sa:
विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाऽद्या ममार स ह्यः समान॥
verses.tr: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvā'dyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna
verses.en: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him. Behold the Gods' high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

verses.sa:
शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीळः ।
यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता॥
verses.tr: śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanādanīḻaḥ yacciketa satyamittanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā
verses.en: Strong is the Red Bird in his strength, great Hero, who from of old hath had no nest to dwell in. That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.

verses.sa:
ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या पौंस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री ।
ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: aibhirdade vṛṣṇyā pauṃsyāni yebhiraukṣadvṛtrahatyāya vajrī ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmamudajāyanta devāḥ
verses.en: Through these the Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in power to smite down Vrtra,- Who through the might of Indra's operation came forth as Gods in course of Law and Order.

verses.sa:
युजा कर्माणि जनयन्विश्वौजा अशस्तिहा विश्वमनास्तुराषाट् ।
पीत्वी सोमस्य दिव आ वृधानः शूरो निर्युधाधमद्दस्यून्॥
verses.tr: yujā karmāṇi janayanviśvaujā aśastihā viśvamanāsturāṣāṭ pītvī somasya diva ā vṛdhānaḥ śūro niryudhādhamaddasyūn
verses.en: All-strong, performing works with his companion, All-marking, rapid Victor, Curse-averter, The Hero, waxing, after draughts of Soma, blew far from heaven the Dasyus with his weapon.

verses.sa:
इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
संवेशने तन्व१श्चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva saṃveśane tanva1ścāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre
verses.en: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and he therewith united. Uniting with a body be thou welcome, dear to the Gods in their sublimest birthplace.

verses.sa:
तनूष्टे वाजिन्तन्वं१ नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धातु शर्म तुभ्यम् ।
अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवान्दिवीव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयाः॥
verses.tr: tanūṣṭe vājintanvaṃ1 nayantī vāmamasmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam ahruto maho dharuṇāya devāndivīva jyotiḥ svamā mimīyāḥ
verses.en: Bearing thy body, Vajin, may thy body afford us blessing and thyself protection. Unswerving, stablish as it were in heaven thine own light as the mighty God's supporter.

verses.sa:
वाज्यसि वाजिनेना सुवेनीः सुवितः स्तोमं सुवितो दिवं गाः ।
सुवितो धर्म प्रथमानु सत्या सुवितो देवान्त्सुवितोऽनु पत्म॥
verses.tr: vājyasi vājinenā suvenīḥ suvitaḥ stomaṃ suvito divaṃ gāḥ suvito dharma prathamānu satyā suvito devāntsuvito'nu patma
verses.en: Strong Steed art thou: go to the yearning Maidens with vigour, happily go to heaven and praises: Fly happily to the Gods with easy passage, according to the first and faithful statutes.

verses.sa:
महिम्न एषां पितरश्चनेशिरे देवा देवेष्वदधुरपि क्रतुम् ।
समविव्यचुरुत यान्यत्विषुरैषां तनूषु नि विविशुः पुनः॥
verses.tr: mahimna eṣāṃ pitaraścaneśire devā deveṣvadadhurapi kratum samavivyacuruta yānyatviṣuraiṣāṃ tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punaḥ
verses.en: Part of their grandeur have the Fathers also gained: the Gods have seated mental power in them as Gods. They have embraced within themselves all energies, which, issuing forth, again into their bodies pass.

verses.sa:
सहोभिर्विश्वं परि चक्रमू रजः पूर्वा धामान्यमिता मिमानाः ।
तनूषु विश्वा भुवना नि येमिरे प्रासारयन्त पुरुध प्रजा अनु॥
verses.tr: sahobhirviśvaṃ pari cakramū rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmānyamitā mimānāḥ tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire prāsārayanta purudha prajā anu
verses.en: They strode through all the region with victorious might, establishing the old immeasurable laws. They compassed in their bodies all existing things, and streamed forth offspring in many successive forms.

verses.sa:
द्विधा सूनवोऽसुरं स्वर्विदमास्थापयन्त तृतीयेन कर्मणा ।
स्वां प्रजां पितरः पित्र्यं सह आवरेष्वदधुस्तन्तुमाततम्॥
verses.tr: dvidhā sūnavo'suraṃ svarvidamāsthāpayanta tṛtīyena karmaṇā svāṃ prajāṃ pitaraḥ pitryaṃ saha āvareṣvadadhustantumātatam
verses.en: In two ways have the sons established in his place the Asura who finds the light, by the third act, As fathers, they have set their heritage on earth, their offspring, as a thread continuously spun out.

verses.sa:
नावा न क्षोदः प्रदिशः पृथिव्याः स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा ।
स्वां प्रजां बृहदुक्थो महित्वाऽऽवरेष्वदधादा परेषु॥
verses.tr: nāvā na kṣodaḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā svāṃ prajāṃ bṛhaduktho mahitvā''vareṣvadadhādā pareṣu
verses.en: As in a ship through billows, so through regions of air, with blessings, through toils and troubles Hath Brhaduktha brought his seed with glory, and placed it here and in the realms beyond us.

verses.sa: मा प्र गाम पथो वयं मा यज्ञादिन्द्र सोमिनः । मान्त स्थुर्नो अरातयः॥
verses.tr: mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñādindra sominaḥ mānta sthurno arātayaḥ
verses.en: Let us not, Indra, leave the path, the Soma-presser's sacrifice: Let no malignity dwell with us.

verses.sa: यो यज्ञस्य प्रसाधनस्तन्तुर्देवेष्वाततः । तमाहुतं नशीमहि॥
verses.tr: yo yajñasya prasādhanastanturdeveṣvātataḥ tamāhutaṃ naśīmahi
verses.en: May we obtain, completely wrought, the thread spun out to reach the Gods, That perfecteth the sacrifice.

verses.sa: मनो न्वा हुवामहे नाराशंसेन सोमेन । पितॄणां च मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: mano nvā huvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ
verses.en: We call the spirit hither with the Soma of our parted sires, Yea, with the Fathers' holy hymns.

verses.sa: आ त एतु मनः पुनः क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे । ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: ā ta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: Thy spirit come to thee again for wisdom, energy, and lire, That thou mayst long behold the sun!

verses.sa: पुनर्नः पितरो मनो ददातु दैव्यो जनः । जीवं व्रातं सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: punarnaḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi
verses.en: O Fathers, may the Heavenly Folk give us our spirit once again, That we may be with those who live.

verses.sa: वयं सोम व्रते तव मनस्तनूषु बिभ्रतः । प्रजावन्तः सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ soma vrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi
verses.en: O Soma with the spirit still within us, blest with progeny, May we be busied in the law.

sections.label: To call back a departing spirit
sections.name: Hymn 58

verses.sa: यत्ते यमं वैवस्वतं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away to Yama to Vivasvan's Son, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते दिवं यत्पृथिवीं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte divaṃ yatpṛthivīṃ mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, that passed away to earth and heaven, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते भूमिं चतुर्भृष्टिं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte bhūmiṃ caturbhṛṣṭiṃ mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, away to the four-eyed earth, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते चतस्रः प्रदिशो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away to the four quarters of the world, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते समुद्रमर्णवं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte samudramarṇavaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, away unto the billowy sea, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते मरीचीः प्रवतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte marīcīḥ pravato mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away to beams of light that flash and flow, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते अपो यदोषधीर्मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte apo yadoṣadhīrmano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, went to the waters and the plants, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते सूर्यं यदुषसं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte sūryaṃ yaduṣasaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, that visited the Sun and Dawn. We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते पर्वतान्बृहतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte parvatānbṛhato mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away, away to lofty mountain heights, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते विश्वमिदं जगन्मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte viśvamidaṃ jaganmano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away into this All, that lives and moves, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते पराः परावतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte parāḥ parāvato mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away to distant realms beyond our ken, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa: यत्ते भूतं च भव्यं च मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yatte bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca mano jagāma dūrakam tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase
verses.en: Thy spirit, that went far away to all that is and is to be, We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
प्र तार्यायुः प्रतरं नवीयः स्थातारेव क्रतुमता रथस्य ।
अध च्यवान उत्तवीत्यर्थं परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम्॥
verses.tr: pra tāryāyuḥ prataraṃ navīyaḥ sthātāreva kratumatā rathasya adha cyavāna uttavītyarthaṃ parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām
verses.en: His life hath been renewed and carried forward as two men, car-borne, by the skillful driver. One falls, then seeks the goal with quickened vigour. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
सामन्नु राये निधिमन्न्वन्नं करामहे सु पुरुध श्रवांसि ।
ता नो विश्वानि जरिता ममत्तु परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम्॥
verses.tr: sāmannu rāye nidhimannvannaṃ karāmahe su purudha śravāṃsi tā no viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām
verses.en: Here is the psalm for wealth, and food, in plenty: let us do many deeds to bring us glory. All these our doings shall delight the singer. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
अभी ष्व१र्यः पौंस्यैर्भवेम द्यौर्न भूमिं गिरयो नाज्रान् ।
ता नो विश्वानि जरिता चिकेत परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम्॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣva1ryaḥ pauṃsyairbhavema dyaurna bhūmiṃ girayo nājrān tā no viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām
verses.en: May we o'ercome our foes with acts of valour, as heaven is over earth, hills over lowlands. All these our deeds the singer hath considered. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
मो षु णः सोम मृत्यवे परा दाः पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
द्युभिर्हितो जरिमा सू नो अस्तु परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम्॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu ṇaḥ soma mṛtyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam dyubhirhito jarimā sū no astu parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām
verses.en: Give us not up as prey to death, O Sorna still let us look upon the Sun arising. Let our old age with passing days be kindly. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
असुनीते मनो अस्मासु धारय जीवातवे सु प्र तिरा न आयुः ।
रारन्धि नः सूर्यस्य संदृशि घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व॥
verses.tr: asunīte mano asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tirā na āyuḥ rārandhi naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśi ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva
verses.en: O Asuniti, keep the soul within us, and make the days we have to live yet longer. Grant that we still may look upon the sunlight: strengthen thy body with the oil we bring thee.

verses.sa:
असुनीते पुनरस्मासु चक्षुः पुनः प्राणमिह नो धेहि भोगम् ।
ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तमनुमते मृळया नः स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: asunīte punarasmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇamiha no dhehi bhogam jyokpaśyema sūryamuccarantamanumate mṛḻayā naḥ svasti
verses.en: Give us our sight again, O Asuniti, give us again our breath and our enjoyment. Long may we look upon the Sun uprising; O Anumati, favour thou and bless us.

verses.sa:
पुनर्नो असुं पृथिवी ददातु पुनर्द्यौर्देवी पुनरन्तरिक्षम् ।
पुनर्नः सोमस्तन्वं ददातु पुनः पूषा पथ्यां३ या स्वस्तिः॥
verses.tr: punarno asuṃ pṛthivī dadātu punardyaurdevī punarantarikṣam punarnaḥ somastanvaṃ dadātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ3 yā svastiḥ
verses.en: May Earth restore to us our vital spirit, may Heaven the Goddess and mid-air restore it. May Soma give us once again our body, and Pusan show the Path of peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
शं रोदसी सुबन्धवे यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।
भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ rodasī subandhave yahvī ṛtasya mātarā bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat
verses.en: May both Worlds bless Subandhu, young Mothers of everlasting Law. May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa:
अव द्वके अव त्रिका दिवश्चरन्ति भेषजा ।
क्षमा चरिष्ण्वेककं भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्॥
verses.tr: ava dvake ava trikā divaścaranti bheṣajā kṣamā cariṣṇvekakaṃ bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat
verses.en: Health-giving medicines descend sent down from heaven in twos and threes, Or wandering singly on the earth. May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रेरय गामनड्वाहं य आवहदुशीनराण्या अनः ।
भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्॥
verses.tr: samindreraya gāmanaḍvāhaṃ ya āvahaduśīnarāṇyā anaḥ bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat
verses.en: Drive forward thou the wagon-ox, O Indra, which brought Usinarani's wagon hither. May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa: आ जनं त्वेषसंदृशं माहीनानामुपस्तुतम् । अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः॥
verses.tr: ā janaṃ tveṣasaṃdṛśaṃ māhīnānāmupastutam aganma bibhrato namaḥ
verses.en: Bringing our homage we have come to one magnificent in look. Glorified of the mighty Gods

verses.sa: असमातिं नितोशनं त्वेषं निययिनं रथम् । भजेरथस्य सत्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: asamātiṃ nitośanaṃ tveṣaṃ niyayinaṃ ratham bhajerathasya satpatim
verses.en: To Asamati, spring of gifts, lord of the brave, a radiant car, The conqueror of Bhajeratha

verses.sa: यो जनान्महिषाँ इवाऽतितस्थौ पवीरवान् । उतापवीरवान्युधा॥
verses.tr: yo janānmahiṣāṃ ivā'titasthau pavīravān utāpavīravānyudhā
verses.en: Who, when the spear hath armed his hand, or even weaponless o'erthrows Men strong as buffaloes in fight;

verses.sa: यस्येक्ष्वाकुरुप व्रते रेवान्मराय्येधते । दिवीव पञ्च कृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: yasyekṣvākurupa vrate revānmarāyyedhate divīva pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Him in whose service flourishes Iksvaku, rich and dazzling-bright. As the Five Tribes that are in heaven.

verses.sa: इन्द्र क्षत्रासमातिषु रथप्रोष्ठेषु धारय । दिवीव सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: indra kṣatrāsamātiṣu rathaproṣṭheṣu dhāraya divīva sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: Indra, support the princely power of Rathaprosthas matched by none, Even as the Sun for all to see.

verses.sa: अगस्त्यस्य नद्भ्यः सप्ती युनक्षि रोहिता । पणीन्न्यक्रमीरभि विश्वान्राजन्नराधसः॥
verses.tr: agastyasya nadbhyaḥ saptī yunakṣi rohitā paṇīnnyakramīrabhi viśvānrājannarādhasaḥ
verses.en: Thou for Agastya's sister's sons yokest thy pair of ruddy steeds. Thou troddest niggards under foot, all those, O King, who brought no gifts.

verses.sa: अयं मातायं पिताऽयं जीवातुरागमत् । इदं तव प्रसर्पणं सुबन्धवेहि निरिहि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ mātāyaṃ pitā'yaṃ jīvāturāgamat idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subandhavehi nirihi
verses.en: This is the mother, this the sire, this one hath come to be thy life. What brings thee forth is even this. Now come, Subandhu, get thee forth.

verses.sa: यथा युगं वरत्रया नह्यन्ति धरुणाय कम् । एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: yathā yugaṃ varatrayā nahyanti dharuṇāya kam evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: As with the leather thong they bind the chariot yoke to hold it fast, So have I held thy spirit fast, held it for life and not for death, held it for thy security.

verses.sa: यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधारेमान्वनस्पतीन् । एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāremānvanaspatīn evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Even as this earth, the mighty earth, holds fast the monarchs of the wood. So have I held thy spirit fast, held it for life and not for death, held it for thy security.

verses.sa: यमादहं वैवस्वतात्सुबन्धोर्मन आभरम् । जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: yamādahaṃ vaivasvatātsubandhormana ābharam jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Subandlin's spirit I have brought from Yarna, from Vivasvan's Son, Brought it for life and not for death, yea, brought it for security.

verses.sa: न्य१ग्वातोऽव वाति न्यक्तपति सूर्यः । नीचीनमघ्न्या दुहे न्यग्भवतु ते रपः॥
verses.tr: nya1gvāto'va vāti nyaktapati sūryaḥ nīcīnamaghnyā duhe nyagbhavatu te rapaḥ
verses.en: The wind blows downward from on high, downward the Sun-God sends his heat, Downward the milch-cow pours her milk: so downward go thy pain and grief.

verses.sa: अयं मे हस्तो भगवानयं मे भगवत्तरः । अयं मे विश्वभेषजोऽयं शिवाभिमर्शनः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ me hasto bhagavānayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ
verses.en: Felicitous is this mine hand, yet more felicitous is this. This hand contains all healing balms, and this makes whole with gentle touch.

verses.sa:
इदमित्था रौद्रं गूर्तवचा ब्रह्म क्रत्वा शच्यामन्तराजौ ।
क्राणा यदस्य पितरा मंहनेष्ठाः पर्षत्पक्थे अहन्ना सप्त होतॄन्॥
verses.tr: idamitthā raudraṃ gūrtavacā brahma kratvā śacyāmantarājau krāṇā yadasya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣatpakthe ahannā sapta hotṝn
verses.en: The welcome speaker in the storm of battle uttered with might this prayer to win the Asvins, When the most liberal God, for Paktha, rescued his parents, and assailed the seven Hotras.

verses.sa:
स इद्दानाय दभ्याय वन्वञ्च्यवानः सूदैरमिमीत वेदिम् ।
तूर्वयाणो गूर्तवचस्तमः क्षोदो न रेत इतऊति सिञ्चत्॥
verses.tr: sa iddānāya dabhyāya vanvañcyavānaḥ sūdairamimīta vedim tūrvayāṇo gūrtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat
verses.en: Cyavana, purposing deceptive presents, with all ingredients, made the altar ready. Most sweet-voiced Turvayana poured oblations like floods of widely fertilizing water.

verses.sa:
मनो न येषु हवनेषु तिग्मं विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता ।
आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याऽश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ॥
verses.tr: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyā'śrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau
verses.en: To his oblations, swift as thought, ye hurried, and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant.

verses.sa:
कृष्णा यद्गोष्वरुणीषु सीदद्दिवो नपाताश्विना हुवे वाम् ।
वीतं मे यज्ञमा गतं मे अन्नं ववन्वांसा नेषमस्मृतध्रू॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇā yadgoṣvaruṇīṣu sīdaddivo napātāśvinā huve vām vītaṃ me yajñamā gataṃ me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣamasmṛtadhrū
verses.en: I call on you the Sons of Dyaus, the Asvins, that a dark cow to my red kine be added. Enjoy my sacrifice, come to my viands contented, not deceiving expectation. '

verses.sa:
प्रथिष्ट यस्य वीरकर्ममिष्णदनुष्ठितं नु नर्यो अपौहत् ।
पुनस्तदा वृहति यत्कनाया दुहितुरा अनुभृतमनर्वा॥
verses.tr: prathiṣṭa yasya vīrakarmamiṣṇadanuṣṭhitaṃ nu naryo apauhat punastadā vṛhati yatkanāyā duhiturā anubhṛtamanarvā

verses.sa:
मध्या यत्कर्त्वमभवदभीके कामं कृण्वाने पितरि युवत्याम् ।
मनानग्रेतो जहतुर्वियन्ता सानौ निषिक्तं सुकृतस्य योनौ॥
verses.tr: madhyā yatkartvamabhavadabhīke kāmaṃ kṛṇvāne pitari yuvatyām manānagreto jahaturviyantā sānau niṣiktaṃ sukṛtasya yonau

verses.sa:
पिता यत्स्वां दुहितरमधिष्कन्क्ष्मया रेतः संजग्मानो नि षिञ्चत् ।
स्वाध्योऽजनयन्ब्रह्म देवा वास्तोष्पतिं व्रतपां निरतक्षन्॥
verses.tr: pitā yatsvāṃ duhitaramadhiṣkankṣmayā retaḥ saṃjagmāno ni ṣiñcat svādhyo'janayanbrahma devā vāstoṣpatiṃ vratapāṃ niratakṣan

verses.sa:
स ईं वृषा न फेनमस्यदाजौ स्मदा परैदप दभ्रचेताः ।
सरत्पदा न दक्षिणा परावृङ्न ता नु मे पृशन्यो जगृभ्रे॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ vṛṣā na phenamasyadājau smadā paraidapa dabhracetāḥ saratpadā na dakṣiṇā parāvṛṅna tā nu me pṛśanyo jagṛbhre

verses.sa:
मक्षू न वह्निः प्रजाया उपब्दिरग्निं न नग्न उप सीददूधः ।
सनितेध्मं सनितोत वाजं स धर्ता जज्ञे सहसा यवीयुत्॥
verses.tr: makṣū na vahniḥ prajāyā upabdiragniṃ na nagna upa sīdadūdhaḥ sanitedhmaṃ sanitota vājaṃ sa dhartā jajñe sahasā yavīyut

verses.sa:
मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवग्वा ऋतं वदन्त ऋतयुक्तिमग्मन् ।
द्विबर्हसो य उप गोपमागुरदक्षिणासो अच्युता दुदुक्षन्॥
verses.tr: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktimagman dvibarhaso ya upa gopamāguradakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan
verses.en: Uttering praise to suit the rite Navagvas came speedily to win the damsel's friendship. They who approached the twice-strong stable's keeper, meedless would milk the rocks that naught had shaken.

verses.sa:
मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवीयो राधो न रेत ऋतमित्तुरण्यन् ।
शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः॥
verses.tr: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navīyo rādho na reta ṛtamitturaṇyan śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ
verses.en: Swift was new friendship with the maid they quickly accepted it as genuine seed and bounty. Milk which the cow Sabardugha had yielded was the bright heritage which to thee they offered.

verses.sa:
पश्वा यत्पश्चा वियुता बुधन्तेति ब्रवीति वक्तरी रराणः ।
वसोर्वसुत्वा कारवोऽनेहा विश्वं विवेष्टि द्रविणमुप क्षु॥
verses.tr: paśvā yatpaścā viyutā budhanteti bravīti vaktarī rarāṇaḥ vasorvasutvā kāravo'nehā viśvaṃ viveṣṭi draviṇamupa kṣu
verses.en: When afterwards they woke- and missed the cattle, the speaker thus in joyful mood addressed them: Matchless are singers throulgh the Vasu's nature; he bringeth them all food and all possessions.

verses.sa:
तदिन्न्वस्य परिषद्वानो अग्मन्पुरू सदन्तो नार्षदं बिभित्सन् ।
वि शुष्णस्य संग्रथितमनर्वा विदत्पुरुप्रजातस्य गुहा यत्॥
verses.tr: tadinnvasya pariṣadvāno agmanpurū sadanto nārṣadaṃ bibhitsan vi śuṣṇasya saṃgrathitamanarvā vidatpuruprajātasya guhā yat
verses.en: His followers then who dwelt in sundry places came and desired too slay the son of Nrsad. Resistless foe, be found the hidden treasure of Susna multiplied in numerous offspring.

verses.sa:
भर्गो ह नामोत यस्य देवाः स्व१र्ण ये त्रिषधस्थे निषेदुः ।
अग्निर्ह नामोत जातवेदाः श्रुधी नो होतॠतस्य होताध्रुक्॥
verses.tr: bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ sva1rṇa ye triṣadhasthe niṣeduḥ agnirha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī no hotaṝtasya hotādhruk
verses.en: Thou, called Effulgence, in whose threefold dwelling, as in the light of heaven, the Gods are sitting, Thou who art called Agni or Jatavedas, Priest, hear us, guileless Priest of holy worship.

verses.sa:
उत त्या मे रौद्रावर्चिमन्ता नासत्याविन्द्र गूर्तये यजध्यै ।
मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषे रराणा मन्दू हितप्रयसा विक्षु यज्यू॥
verses.tr: uta tyā me raudrāvarcimantā nāsatyāvindra gūrtaye yajadhyai manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā vikṣu yajyū
verses.en: And, Indra, bring, that I may laud and serve them, those Two resplendent glorious Nasatyas, Blithe, bounteous, man-like, to the sacrificer, honoured among our men with offered viands.

verses.sa:
अयं स्तुतो राजा वन्दि वेधा अपश्च विप्रस्तरति स्वसेतुः ।
स कक्षीवन्तं रेजयत्सो अग्निं नेमिं न चक्रमर्वतो रघुद्रु॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaśca viprastarati svasetuḥ sa kakṣīvantaṃ rejayatso agniṃ nemiṃ na cakramarvato raghudru
verses.en: This King is praised and honoured as Ordainer: himself the bridge, the Sage speeds o'er the waters. He hath stirred up Kaksivan, stirred up Agni, as the steed's swift wheel drives the felly onward.

verses.sa:
स द्विबन्धुर्वैतरणो यष्टा सबर्धुं धेनुमस्वं दुहध्यै ।
सं यन्मित्रावरुणा वृञ्ज उक्थैर्ज्येष्ठेभिरर्यमणं वरूथैः॥
verses.tr: sa dvibandhurvaitaraṇo yaṣṭā sabardhuṃ dhenumasvaṃ duhadhyai saṃ yanmitrāvaruṇā vṛñja ukthairjyeṣṭhebhiraryamaṇaṃ varūthaiḥ
verses.en: Vaitarana, doubly kinsman, sacrificer, shall milk the cow who ne'er hath calved, Sabardhu, When I encompass Varuna and Mitra with lauds, and Aryaman in safest shelter.

verses.sa:
तद्बन्धुः सूरिर्दिवि ते धियंधा नाभानेदिष्ठो रपति प्र वेनन् ।
सा नो नाभिः परमास्य वा घाऽहं तत्पश्चा कतिथश्चिदास॥
verses.tr: tadbandhuḥ sūrirdivi te dhiyaṃdhā nābhānediṣṭho rapati pra venan sā no nābhiḥ paramāsya vā ghā'haṃ tatpaścā katithaścidāsa
verses.en: Their kin, the Prince in heaven, thy nearest kinsman, turning his thought to thee thus speaks in kindness: This is our highest bond: I am his offspring. How many others came ere I succeeded?

verses.sa:
इयं मे नाभिरिह मे सधस्थमिमे मे देवा अयमस्मि सर्वः ।
द्विजा अह प्रथमजा ऋतस्येदं धेनुरदुहज्जायमाना॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ me nābhiriha me sadhasthamime me devā ayamasmi sarvaḥ dvijā aha prathamajā ṛtasyedaṃ dhenuraduhajjāyamānā
verses.en: Here is my kinship, here the place I dwell in: these are my Gods; I in full strength am present. Twice-born am I, the first-born Son of Order: the Cow milked this when first she had her being.

verses.sa:
अधासु मन्द्रो अरतिर्विभावाऽव स्यति द्विवर्तनिर्वनेषाट् ।
ऊर्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणिर्न शिशुर्दन्मक्षू स्थिरं शेवृधं सूत माता॥
verses.tr: adhāsu mandro aratirvibhāvā'va syati dvivartanirvaneṣāṭ ūrdhvā yacchreṇirna śiśurdanmakṣū sthiraṃ śevṛdhaṃ sūta mātā
verses.en: So mid these tribes he rests, the friendly envoy, borne on two paths, refulgent Lord of fuel. When, like a line, the Babe springs up erectly, his Mother straight hath borne him strong to bless us.

verses.sa:
अधा गाव उपमातिं कनाया अनु श्वान्तस्य कस्य चित्परेयुः ।
श्रुधि त्वं सुद्रविणो नस्त्वं याळाश्वघ्नस्य वावृधे सूनृताभिः॥
verses.tr: adhā gāva upamātiṃ kanāyā anu śvāntasya kasya citpareyuḥ śrudhi tvaṃ sudraviṇo nastvaṃ yāḻāśvaghnasya vāvṛdhe sūnṛtābhiḥ
verses.en: Then went the milch-kine forth to please the damsel, and for the good of every man that liveth. Hear us, O wealthy Lord; begin our worship. Thou hast grown mighty through Asvaghna's virtues.

verses.sa:
अध त्वमिन्द्र विद्ध्य१स्मान्महो राये नृपते वज्रबाहुः ।
रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीननेहसस्ते हरिवो अभिष्टौ॥
verses.tr: adha tvamindra viddhya1smānmaho rāye nṛpate vajrabāhuḥ rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnanehasaste harivo abhiṣṭau
verses.en: And take thou notice of us also, Indra, for ample riches, King whose arm wields thunder! Protect our wealthy nobles, guard our princes unmenaced near thee, Lord of Tawny Coursers.

verses.sa:
अध यद्राजाना गविष्टौ सरत्सरण्युः कारवे जरण्युः ।
विप्रः प्रेष्ठः स ह्येषां बभूव परा च वक्षदुत पर्षदेनान्॥
verses.tr: adha yadrājānā gaviṣṭau saratsaraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ sa hyeṣāṃ babhūva parā ca vakṣaduta parṣadenān
verses.en: When he goes forth, ye Pair of Kings, for booty, speeding to war and praise to please the singer,- I was the dearest sage of those about him,-let him lead these away and bring them safely.

verses.sa:
अधा न्वस्य जेन्यस्य पुष्टौ वृथा रेभन्त ईमहे तदू नु ।
सरण्युरस्य सूनुरश्वो विप्रश्चासि श्रवसश्च सातौ॥
verses.tr: adhā nvasya jenyasya puṣṭau vṛthā rebhanta īmahe tadū nu saraṇyurasya sūnuraśvo vipraścāsi śravasaśca sātau
verses.en: Now for this noble man's support and comfort, singing with easy voice we thus implore thee: Impetuous be his son and fleet his courser: and may I be his priest to win him glory.

verses.sa:
युवोर्यदि सख्यायास्मे शर्धाय स्तोमं जुजुषे नमस्वान् ।
विश्वत्र यस्मिन्ना गिरः समीचीः पूर्वीव गातुर्दाशत्सूनृतायै॥
verses.tr: yuvoryadi sakhyāyāsme śardhāya stomaṃ jujuṣe namasvān viśvatra yasminnā giraḥ samīcīḥ pūrvīva gāturdāśatsūnṛtāyai
verses.en: If, for our strength, the priest with adoration to win your friendship made the laud accepted, That laud shall be a branching road to virtue for every one to whom the songs are suited.

verses.sa:
स गृणानो अद्भिर्देववानिति सुबन्धुर्नमसा सूक्तैः ।
वर्धदुक्थैर्वचोभिरा हि नूनं व्यध्वैति पयस उस्रियायाः॥
verses.tr: sa gṛṇāno adbhirdevavāniti subandhurnamasā sūktaiḥ vardhadukthairvacobhirā hi nūnaṃ vyadhvaiti payasa usriyāyāḥ
verses.en: Glorified thus, with holy hymns and homage:-Of noble race, with Waters, God-attended May he enrich us for our prayers and praises: now can the cow be milked; the path is open.

verses.sa:
त ऊ षु णो महो यजत्रा भूत देवास ऊतये सजोषाः ।
ये वाजाँ अनयता वियन्तो ये स्था निचेतारो अमूराः॥
verses.tr: ta ū ṣu ṇo maho yajatrā bhūta devāsa ūtaye sajoṣāḥ ye vājāṃ anayatā viyanto ye sthā nicetāro amūrāḥ
verses.en: Be to us, then, ye Gods who merit worship, be ye of one accord our strong protection, Who went on various ways and brought us vigour, ye who are undeceivable explorers.

verses.sa:
ये यज्ञेन दक्षिणया समक्ता इन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमानश ।
तेभ्यो भद्रमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā indrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamānaśa tebhyo bhadramaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye, who, adorned with guerdon through the sacrifice, have won you Indra's friendship and eternal life, Even to you be happiness, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
य उदाजन्पितरो गोमयं वस्वृतेनाभिन्दन्परिवत्सरे वलम् ।
दीर्घायुत्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: ya udājanpitaro gomayaṃ vasvṛtenābhindanparivatsare valam dīrghāyutvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: The Fathers, who drave forth the wealth in cattle, have in the year's courses cleft Vala by Eternal Law: A lengthened life be yours, O ye Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
य ऋतेन सूर्यमारोहयन्दिव्यप्रथयन्पृथिवीं मातरं वि ।
सुप्रजास्त्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: ya ṛtena sūryamārohayandivyaprathayanpṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi suprajāstvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye raised the Sun to heaven by everlasting Law, and spread broad earth, the Mother, out on every side. Fair wealth of progeny be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
अयं नाभा वदति वल्गु वो गृहे देवपुत्रा ऋषयस्तच्छृणोतन ।
सुब्रह्मण्यमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ nābhā vadati valgu vo gṛhe devaputrā ṛṣayastacchṛṇotana subrahmaṇyamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: This kinsman in your dwelling place speaks pleasant words: give car to this, ye Rsis, children of the Gods. High Brahman dignity be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa: विरूपास इदृषयस्त इद्गम्भीरवेपसः । ते अङ्गिरसः सूनवस्ते अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे॥
verses.tr: virūpāsa idṛṣayasta idgambhīravepasaḥ te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavaste agneḥ pari jajñire
verses.en: Distinguished by their varied form, these Rsis have been deeply moved. These are the sons of Angirases: from Agni have they sprung to life.

verses.sa: ये अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे विरूपासो दिवस्परि । नवग्वो नु दशग्वो अङ्गिरस्तमो सचा देवेषु मंहते॥
verses.tr: ye agneḥ pari jajñire virūpāso divaspari navagvo nu daśagvo aṅgirastamo sacā deveṣu maṃhate
verses.en: Distinguished by their varied form, they sprang from Agni, from the sky. Navagva and Dasagva, noblest Angiras, he giveth bounty with the Gods.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण युजा निः सृजन्त वाघतो व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । सहस्रं मे ददतो अष्टकर्ण्य१ः श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत॥
verses.tr: indreṇa yujā niḥ sṛjanta vāghato vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinam sahasraṃ me dadato aṣṭakarṇya1ḥ śravo deveṣvakrata
verses.en: With Indra for associate the priests have cleared the stable full of steeds and kine, Giving to me a thousand with their eight marked cars, they gained renown among the Gods.

verses.sa: प्र नूनं जायतामयं मनुस्तोक्मेव रोहतु । यः सहस्रं शताश्वं सद्यो दानाय मंहते॥
verses.tr: pra nūnaṃ jāyatāmayaṃ manustokmeva rohatu yaḥ sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ sadyo dānāya maṃhate
verses.en: May this man's sons be multiplied; like springing corn may Manu grow, Who gives at once in bounteous gift a thousand kine, a hundred steeds.

verses.sa: न तमश्नोति कश्चन दिव इव सान्वारभम् । सावर्ण्यस्य दक्षिणा वि सिन्धुरिव पप्रथे॥
verses.tr: na tamaśnoti kaścana diva iva sānvārabham sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhuriva paprathe
verses.en: No one attains to him, as though a man would grasp the heights of heaven. Savarnya's sacrificial meed hath broadened like an ample flood.

verses.sa: उत दासा परिविषे स्मद्दिष्टी गोपरीणसा । यदुस्तुर्वश्च मामहे॥
verses.tr: uta dāsā pariviṣe smaddiṣṭī goparīṇasā yadusturvaśca māmahe
verses.en: Yadu and Turva, too, have given two Dasas, well-disposed, to serve, Together with great store of kine.

verses.sa:
सहस्रदा ग्रामणीर्मा रिषन्मनुः सूर्येणास्य यतमानैतु दक्षिणा ।
सावर्णेर्देवाः प्र तिरन्त्वायुर्यस्मिन्नश्रान्ता असनाम वाजम्॥
verses.tr: sahasradā grāmaṇīrmā riṣanmanuḥ sūryeṇāsya yatamānaitu dakṣiṇā sāvarṇerdevāḥ pra tirantvāyuryasminnaśrāntā asanāma vājam
verses.en: Blest be the hamlet's chief, most liberal Manu, and may his bounty rival that of Surya. May the God let Ssvarni's life be lengthened, with whom, unwearied, we have lived and prospered.

verses.sa:
परावतो ये दिधिषन्त आप्यं मनुप्रीतासो जनिमा विवस्वतः ।
ययातेर्ये नहुष्यस्य बर्हिषि देवा आसते ते अधि ब्रुवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: parāvato ye didhiṣanta āpyaṃ manuprītāso janimā vivasvataḥ yayāterye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devā āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ
verses.en: May they who would assume kinship from far away, Vivasvan's generations, dearly loved of men, Even the Gods who sit upon the sacred grass of Nahusa's son Yayati, bless and comfort us.

verses.sa:
विश्वा हि वो नमस्यानि वन्द्या नामानि देवा उत यज्ञियानि वः ।
ये स्थ जाता अदितेरद्भ्यस्परि ये पृथिव्यास्ते म इह श्रुता हवम्॥
verses.tr: viśvā hi vo namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devā uta yajñiyāni vaḥ ye stha jātā aditeradbhyaspari ye pṛthivyāste ma iha śrutā havam
verses.en: For worthy of obeisance, Gods, are all your names, worthy of adoration and of sacrifice. Ye who were born from waters, and from Aditi, and from the earth, do ye here listen to my call.

verses.sa:
येभ्यो माता मधुमत्पिन्वते पयः पीयूषं द्यौरदितिरद्रिबर्हाः ।
उक्थशुष्मान्वृषभरान्त्स्वप्नसस्ताँ आदित्याँ अनु मदा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: yebhyo mātā madhumatpinvate payaḥ pīyūṣaṃ dyauraditiradribarhāḥ ukthaśuṣmānvṛṣabharāntsvapnasastāṃ ādityāṃ anu madā svastaye
verses.en: I will rejoice in these Adityas for my weal, for whom the Mother pours forth water rich in balm, And Dyaus the Infinite, firm as a rock, sweet milk,-Gods active, strong through lauds, whose might the Bull upholds.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षसो अनिमिषन्तो अर्हणा बृहद्देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।
ज्योतीरथा अहिमाया अनागसो दिवो वर्ष्माणं वसते स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: nṛcakṣaso animiṣanto arhaṇā bṛhaddevāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ jyotīrathā ahimāyā anāgaso divo varṣmāṇaṃ vasate svastaye
verses.en: Looking on men, ne'er slumbering, they by their deserts attained as Gods to lofty immortality. Borne on refulgent cars, sinless, with serpents' powers, they robe them, for our welfare, in the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
सम्राजो ये सुवृधो यज्ञमाययुरपरिह्वृता दधिरे दिवि क्षयम् ।
ताँ आ विवास नमसा सुवृक्तिभिर्महो आदित्याँ अदितिं स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: samrājo ye suvṛdho yajñamāyayuraparihvṛtā dadhire divi kṣayam tāṃ ā vivāsa namasā suvṛktibhirmaho ādityāṃ aditiṃ svastaye
verses.en: Great Kings who bless us, who have come to sacrifice, who, ne'er assailed, have set their mansion in the sky, These I invite with adoration and with hymns, mighty Adityas, Aditi, for happiness.

verses.sa:
को वः स्तोमं राधति यं जुजोषथ विश्वे देवासो मनुषो यति ष्ठन ।
को वोऽध्वरं तुविजाता अरं करद्यो नः पर्षदत्यंहः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: ko vaḥ stomaṃ rādhati yaṃ jujoṣatha viśve devāso manuṣo yati ṣṭhana ko vo'dhvaraṃ tuvijātā araṃ karadyo naḥ parṣadatyaṃhaḥ svastaye
verses.en: Who offereth to you the laud that ye accept, O ye All-Gods of Manu, many as ye are? Who, Mighty Ones, will prepare for you the sacrifice to bear us over trouble to felicity?

verses.sa:
येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः ।
त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: yebhyo hotrāṃ prathamāmāyeje manuḥ samiddhāgnirmanasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye
verses.en: Ye to whom Manu, by seven priests, with kindled fire, offered the first oblation with his heart and soul, Vouchsafe us, ye Adityas, sheitcr free from fear, and make us good and easy paths to happiness.

verses.sa:
य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मन्तवः ।
ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetaso viśvasya sthāturjagataśca mantavaḥ te naḥ kṛtādakṛtādenasasparyadyā devāsaḥ pipṛtā svastaye
verses.en: Wise Deities, who have dominion o'er the world, ye thinkers over all that moves not and that moves, Save us from uncommitted and committed sin, preserve us from all sin to-day for happiness.

verses.sa:
भरेष्विन्द्रं सुहवं हवामहेंऽहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनम् ।
अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmaheṃ'homucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye
verses.en: In battles we invoke Indra still swift to hear, and all the holy Host of Heaven who banish grief, Agni, Mitra, and Varuna that we may gain, Dyays, Bhaga, Maruts, Prthivi for happiness:

verses.sa:
सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् ।
दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye
verses.en: Mightily-saving Earth, incomparable Heaven the good guide Aditi who gives secure defense The well-oared heavenly Ship that lets no waters in, free from defect, will we ascend for happiness.

verses.sa:
विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः ।
सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: viśve yajatrā adhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihrutaḥ satyayā vo devahūtyā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye
verses.en: Bless us, all Holy Ones, that we may have your help, guard and protect us from malignant injury. With fruitful invocation may we call on you, Gods, who give ear to us for grace, for happiness.

verses.sa:
अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः ।
आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: apāmīvāmapa viśvāmanāhutimapārātiṃ durvidatrāmaghāyataḥ āre devā dveṣo asmadyuyotanoru ṇaḥ śarma yacchatā svastaye
verses.en: Keep all disease afar and sordid sacrifice, keep off the wicked man's malicious enmity. Keep far away from us all hatred, O ye Gods, and give us ample shelter for our happiness.

verses.sa:
अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि ।
यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: ariṣṭaḥ sa marto viśva edhate pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari yamādityāso nayathā sunītibhirati viśvāni duritā svastaye
verses.en: Untouched by any evil, every mortal thrives, and, following the Law, spreads in his progeny. Whom ye with your good guidance, O Adityas, lead safely through all his pain and grief to happiness.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने ।
प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिन्द्र सानसिमरिष्यन्तमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ śūrasātā maruto hite dhane prātaryāvāṇaṃ rathamindra sānasimariṣyantamā ruhemā svastaye
verses.en: That which ye guard and grace in battle, O ye Gods, ye Maruts, where the prize is wealth, where heroes win, That conquering Car, O Indra, that sets forth at dawn, that never breaks, may we ascend for happiness.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नः पथ्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्य१प्सु वृजने स्वर्वति ।
स्वस्ति नः पुत्रकृथेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मरुतो दधातन॥
verses.tr: svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanvasu svastya1psu vṛjane svarvati svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana
verses.en: Vouchsafe us blessing in our paths and desert tracts, blessing in waters and in battle, for the light; Blessing upon the wombs that bring male children forth, and blessing, O ye Maruts, for the gain of wealth.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति ।
सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा॥
verses.tr: svastiriddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatyabhi yā vāmameti sā no amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā
verses.en: The noblest Svasti with abundant riches, who comes to what is good by distant pathway,- May she at home and far away preserve us, and dwell with us under the Gods' protection

verses.sa:
एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।
ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनाऽस्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन॥
verses.tr: evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī īśānāso naro amartyenā'stāvi jano divyo gayena
verses.en: Thus hath the thoughtful sage, the son of Plati, praised you, O Aditi and all Adityas, Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.

verses.sa:
कथा देवानां कतमस्य यामनि सुमन्तु नाम शृण्वतां मनामहे ।
को मृळाति कतमो नो मयस्करत्कतम ऊती अभ्या ववर्तति॥
verses.tr: kathā devānāṃ katamasya yāmani sumantu nāma śṛṇvatāṃ manāmahe ko mṛḻāti katamo no mayaskaratkatama ūtī abhyā vavartati
verses.en: What God, of those who hear, is he whose well-praised name we may record in this our sacrifice; and how? Who will be gracious? Who of many give us bliss? Who out of all the Host will come to lend us aid?

verses.sa:
क्रतूयन्ति क्रतवो हृत्सु धीतयो वेनन्ति वेनाः पतयन्त्या दिशः ।
न मर्डिता विद्यते अन्य एभ्यो देवेषु मे अधि कामा अयंसत॥
verses.tr: kratūyanti kratavo hṛtsu dhītayo venanti venāḥ patayantyā diśaḥ na marḍitā vidyate anya ebhyo deveṣu me adhi kāmā ayaṃsata
verses.en: The will and thoughts within my breast exert their power: they yearn with love, and fly to all the regions round. None other comforter is found save only these: my longings and my hopes are fixt upon the Gods.

verses.sa:
नरा वा शंसं पूषणमगोह्यमग्निं देवेद्धमभ्यर्चसे गिरा ।
सूर्यामासा चन्द्रमसा यमं दिवि त्रितं वातमुषसमक्तुमश्विना॥
verses.tr: narā vā śaṃsaṃ pūṣaṇamagohyamagniṃ deveddhamabhyarcase girā sūryāmāsā candramasā yamaṃ divi tritaṃ vātamuṣasamaktumaśvinā
verses.en: To Narasamsa and to Pusan I sing forth, unconcealable Agni kindled by the Gods. To Sun and Moon, two Moons, to Yama in the heaven, to Trita, Vata, Dawn, Night, and the Atvins Twain.

verses.sa:
कथा कविस्तुवीरवान्कया गिरा बृहस्पतिर्वावृधते सुवृक्तिभिः ।
अज एकपात्सुहवेभिॠक्वभिरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो३ हवीमनि॥
verses.tr: kathā kavistuvīravānkayā girā bṛhaspatirvāvṛdhate suvṛktibhiḥ aja ekapātsuhavebhiṝkvabhirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo3 havīmani
verses.en: How is the Sage extolled whom the loud singers praise? What voice, what hymn is used to laud Brhaspati? May Aja-Ekapad with Rkvans swift to hear, and Ahi of the Deep listen unto our call.

verses.sa:
दक्षस्य वादिते जन्मनि व्रते राजाना मित्रावरुणा विवाससि ।
अतूर्तपन्थाः पुरुरथो अर्यमा सप्तहोता विषुरूपेषु जन्मसु॥
verses.tr: dakṣasya vādite janmani vrate rājānā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi atūrtapanthāḥ pururatho aryamā saptahotā viṣurūpeṣu janmasu
verses.en: Aditi, to the birth of Daksa and the vow thou summonest the Kings Mitra and Varuna. With course unchecked, with many chariots Aryaman comes with the seven priests to tribes of varied sort.

verses.sa:
ते नो अर्वन्तो हवनश्रुतो हवं विश्वे शृण्वन्तु वाजिनो मितद्रवः ।
सहस्रसा मेधसाताविव त्मना महो ये धनं समिथेषु जभ्रिरे॥
verses.tr: te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ sahasrasā medhasātāviva tmanā maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire
verses.en: May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeding on their way; Winners of thousands where the priestly meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.

verses.sa:
प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं पुरंधिं स्तोमैः कृणुध्वं सख्याय पूषणम् ।
ते हि देवस्य सवितुः सवीमनि क्रतुं सचन्ते सचितः सचेतसः॥
verses.tr: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ puraṃdhiṃ stomaiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sakhyāya pūṣaṇam te hi devasya savituḥ savīmani kratuṃ sacante sacitaḥ sacetasaḥ
verses.en: Bring ye Purandbi, bring Vayu who yokes his steeds, for friendship bring ye Pusan with your songs of praise: They with one mind, one thought attend the sacrifice, urged by the favouring aid of Savitar the God.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त सस्रा नद्यो महीरपो वनस्पतीन्पर्वताँ अग्निमूतये ।
कृशानुमस्तॄन्तिष्यं सधस्थ आ रुद्रं रुद्रेषु रुद्रियं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: triḥ sapta sasrā nadyo mahīrapo vanaspatīnparvatāṃ agnimūtaye kṛśānumastṝntiṣyaṃ sadhastha ā rudraṃ rudreṣu rudriyaṃ havāmahe
verses.en: The thrice-seven wandering Rivers, yea, the mighty floods, the forest trees, the mountains, Agni to our aid, Krsanu, Tisya, archers to our gathering-place, and Rudra strong amid the Rudras we invoke.

verses.sa:
सरस्वती सरयुः सिन्धुरूर्मिभिर्महो महीरवसा यन्तु वक्षणीः ।
देवीरापो मातरः सूदयित्न्वो घृतवत्पयो मधुमन्नो अर्चत॥
verses.tr: sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhurūrmibhirmaho mahīravasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ devīrāpo mātaraḥ sūdayitnvo ghṛtavatpayo madhumanno arcata
verses.en: Let the great Streams come hither with their mighty help, Sindhu, Sarasvati, and Sarayu with waves. Ye Goddess Floods, ye Mothers, animating all, promise us water rich in fatness and in balm.

verses.sa:
उत माता बृहद्दिवा शृणोतु नस्त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः पिता वचः ।
ऋभुक्षा वाजो रथस्पतिर्भगो रण्वः शंसः शशमानस्य पातु नः॥
verses.tr: uta mātā bṛhaddivā śṛṇotu nastvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ pitā vacaḥ ṛbhukṣā vājo rathaspatirbhago raṇvaḥ śaṃsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ
verses.en: And let Brhaddiva, the Mother, hear our call, and Tvastar, Father, with the Goddesses and Dames. Rbhuksan, Vaja, Bhaga, and Rathaspati, and the sweet speech of him who labours guard us well!

verses.sa:
रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयो भद्रा रुद्राणां मरुतामुपस्तुतिः ।
गोभिः ष्याम यशसो जनेष्वा सदा देवास इळया सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumāṃ iva kṣayo bhadrā rudrāṇāṃ marutāmupastutiḥ gobhiḥ ṣyāma yaśaso janeṣvā sadā devāsa iḻayā sacemahi
verses.en: Pleasant to look on as a dwelling rich in food is the blest favour of the Maruts, Rudra's Sons. May we be famed among the folk for wealth in kine. and ever come to you, ye Gods, with sacred food.

verses.sa:
यां मे धियं मरुत इन्द्र देवा अददात वरुण मित्र यूयम् ।
तां पीपयत पयसेव धेनुं कुविद्गिरो अधि रथे वहाथ॥
verses.tr: yāṃ me dhiyaṃ maruta indra devā adadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam tāṃ pīpayata payaseva dhenuṃ kuvidgiro adhi rathe vahātha
verses.en: The thought which ye, O Maruts, Indra and ye Gods have given to me, and ye, Mitra and Varuna,- Cause this to grow and swell like a milch cow with milk. Will ye not bear away my songs upon your car?

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग प्रति यथा चिदस्य नः सजात्यस्य मरुतो बुबोधथ ।
नाभा यत्र प्रथमं संनसामहे तत्र जामित्वमदितिर्दधातु नः॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga prati yathā cidasya naḥ sajātyasya maruto bubodhatha nābhā yatra prathamaṃ saṃnasāmahe tatra jāmitvamaditirdadhātu naḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, do ye never, never recollect and call again to mind this our relationship? When next we meet together at the central point, even there shall Aditi confirm our brotherhood.

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी मातरा मही देवी देवाञ्जन्मना यज्ञिये इतः ।
उभे बिभृत उभयं भरीमभिः पुरू रेतांसि पितृभिश्च सिञ्चतः॥
verses.tr: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī mātarā mahī devī devāñjanmanā yajñiye itaḥ ubhe bibhṛta ubhayaṃ bharīmabhiḥ purū retāṃsi pitṛbhiśca siñcataḥ
verses.en: The Mothers, Heaven and Earth, those mighty Goddesses, worthy of sacrifice, ecune with the race of Gods. These Two with their support uphold both Gods and men, and with the Fathers pour the copious genial stream.

verses.sa:
वि षा होत्रा विश्वमश्नोति वार्यं बृहस्पतिररमतिः पनीयसी ।
ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदवीवशन्त मतिभिर्मनीषिणः॥
verses.tr: vi ṣā hotrā viśvamaśnoti vāryaṃ bṛhaspatiraramatiḥ panīyasī grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadavīvaśanta matibhirmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: This invocation wins all good that we desire Brhaspati, highly-praised Aramati, are here, Even where the stone that presses meath rings loudly out, and where the sages make their voices heard with hymns.

verses.sa:
एवा कविस्तुवीरवाँ ऋतज्ञा द्रविणस्युर्द्रविणसश्चकानः ।
उक्थेभिरत्र मतिभिश्च विप्रोऽपीपयद्गयो दिव्यानि जन्म॥
verses.tr: evā kavistuvīravāṃ ṛtajñā draviṇasyurdraviṇasaścakānaḥ ukthebhiratra matibhiśca vipro'pīpayadgayo divyāni janma
verses.en: Thus hath the sage, skilled in loud singers' duties, desiring riches, yearning after treasure, Gaya, the priestly singer, with his praises and hymns contented the Celestial people.

verses.sa:
एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।
ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन॥
verses.tr: evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena
verses.en: Thus hath the thoughtful sage the son of Plati, praised you, O Aaiti and all Adityas. Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा वायुः पूषा सरस्वती सजोषसः ।
आदित्या विष्णुर्मरुतः स्वर्बृहत्सोमो रुद्रो अदितिर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: agnirindro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ ādityā viṣṇurmarutaḥ svarbṛhatsomo rudro aditirbrahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: May Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuna consent, Aryaman, Vayu, Pusan, and Sarasvati, Adityas, Maruts, Visnu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा३ समोकसा ।
अन्तरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu satpatī mitho hinvānā tanvā3 samokasā antarikṣaṃ mahyā paprurojasā somo ghṛtaśrīrmahimānamīrayan
verses.en: Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vrtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on, And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament.

verses.sa:
तेषां हि मह्ना महतामनर्वणां स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यृतज्ञा ऋतावृधाम् ।
ये अप्सवमर्णवं चित्रराधसस्ते नो रासन्तां महये सुमित्र्याः॥
verses.tr: teṣāṃ hi mahnā mahatāmanarvaṇāṃ stomāṃ iyarmyṛtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām ye apsavamarṇavaṃ citrarādhasaste no rāsantāṃ mahaye sumitryāḥ
verses.en: Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty. These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great.

verses.sa:
स्वर्णरमन्तरिक्षाणि रोचना द्यावाभूमी पृथिवीं स्कम्भुरोजसा ।
पृक्षा इव महयन्तः सुरातयो देवाः स्तवन्ते मनुषाय सूरयः॥
verses.tr: svarṇaramantarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhurojasā pṛkṣā iva mahayantaḥ surātayo devāḥ stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ
verses.en: They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres. Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man.

verses.sa:
मित्राय शिक्ष वरुणाय दाशुषे या सम्राजा मनसा न प्रयुच्छतः ।
ययोर्धाम धर्मणा रोचते बृहद्ययोरुभे रोदसी नाधसी वृतौ॥
verses.tr: mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na prayucchataḥ yayordhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhadyayorubhe rodasī nādhasī vṛtau
verses.en: Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuna who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper, Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth.

verses.sa:
या गौर्वर्तनिं पर्येति निष्कृतं पयो दुहाना व्रतनीरवारतः ।
सा प्रब्रुवाणा वरुणाय दाशुषे देवेभ्यो दाशद्धविषा विवस्वते॥
verses.tr: yā gaurvartaniṃ paryeti niṣkṛtaṃ payo duhānā vratanīravārataḥ sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśaddhaviṣā vivasvate
verses.en: The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites, Speaking aloud to Varuna and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvan and the Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवक्षसो अग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृध ऋतस्य योनिं विमृशन्त आसते ।
द्यां स्कभित्व्य१प आ चक्रुरोजसा यज्ञं जनित्वी तन्वी३ नि मामृजुः॥
verses.tr: divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate dyāṃ skabhitvya1pa ā cakrurojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī3 ni māmṛjuḥ
verses.en: The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law. They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair.

verses.sa:
परिक्षिता पितरा पूर्वजावरी ऋतस्य योना क्षयतः समोकसा ।
द्यावापृथिवी वरुणाय सव्रते घृतवत्पयो महिषाय पिन्वतः॥
verses.tr: parikṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samokasā dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavatpayo mahiṣāya pinvataḥ
verses.en: Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law. Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuna the Steer.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यावाता वृषभा पुरीषिणेन्द्रवायू वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
देवाँ आदित्याँ अदितिं हवामहे ये पार्थिवासो दिव्यासो अप्सु ये॥
verses.tr: parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīṣiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā devāṃ ādityāṃ aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāso apsu ye
verses.en: Parjanya, Vata, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vayu, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman: We call on Aditi, Adityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टारं वायुमृभवो य ओहते दैव्या होतारा उषसं स्वस्तये ।
बृहस्पतिं वृत्रखादं सुमेधसमिन्द्रियं सोमं धनसा उ ईमहे॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyumṛbhavo ya ohate daivyā hotārā uṣasaṃ svastaye bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasamindriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe
verses.en: Tvastar and Vayu, those who count as Rbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness, Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Brhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म गामश्वं जनयन्त ओषधीर्वनस्पतीन्पृथिवीं पर्वताँ अपः ।
सूर्यं दिवि रोहयन्तः सुदानव आर्या व्रता विसृजन्तो अधि क्षमि॥
verses.tr: brahma gāmaśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīrvanaspatīnpṛthivīṃ parvatāṃ apaḥ sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami
verses.en: They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills. These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Aryas o'er the land.

verses.sa:
भुज्युमंहसः पिपृथो निरश्विना श्यावं पुत्रं वध्रिमत्या अजिन्वतम् ।
कमद्युवं विमदायोहथुर्युवं विष्णाप्वं१ विश्वकायाव सृजथः॥
verses.tr: bhujyumaṃhasaḥ pipṛtho niraśvinā śyāvaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinvatam kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyohathuryuvaṃ viṣṇāpvaṃ1 viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ
verses.en: O Asvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Syava, Vadhrmati's son. To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Visnapu back to Visvaka.

verses.sa:
पावीरवी तन्यतुरेकपादजो दिवो धर्ता सिन्धुरापः समुद्रियः ।
विश्वे देवासः शृणवन्वचांसि मे सरस्वती सह धीभिः पुरंध्या॥
verses.tr: pāvīravī tanyaturekapādajo divo dhartā sindhurāpaḥ samudriyaḥ viśve devāsaḥ śṛṇavanvacāṃsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā
verses.en: Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapad, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea: Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvati give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः सह धीभिः पुरंध्या मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
रातिषाचो अभिषाचः स्वर्विदः स्व१र्गिरो ब्रह्म सूक्तं जुषेरत॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ rātiṣāco abhiṣācaḥ svarvidaḥ sva1rgiro brahma sūktaṃ juṣerata
verses.en: With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones, Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn.

verses.sa:
देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
देवान्हुवे बृहच्छ्रवसः स्वस्तये ज्योतिष्कृतो अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसः ।
ये वावृधुः प्रतरं विश्ववेदस इन्द्रज्येष्ठासो अमृता ऋतावृधः॥
verses.tr: devānhuve bṛhacchravasaḥ svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasaḥ ye vāvṛdhuḥ prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice; Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रप्रसूता वरुणप्रशिष्टा ये सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषो भागमानशुः ।
मरुद्गणे वृजने मन्म धीमहि माघोने यज्ञं जनयन्त सूरयः॥
verses.tr: indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotiṣo bhāgamānaśuḥ marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūrayaḥ
verses.en: For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop, Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuna, have gotten for themselves a share of Surya's light

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।
रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु॥
verses.tr: indro vasubhiḥ pari pātu no gayamādityairno aditiḥ śarma yacchatu rudro rudrebhirdevo mṛḻayāti nastvaṣṭā no gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu
verses.en: May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Adityas lend us sure defence. May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvastar with the Dames further us to success.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् ।
देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्त्सवितारं सुदंससम्॥
verses.tr: aditirdyāvāpṛthivī ṛtaṃ mahadindrāviṣṇū marutaḥ svarbṛhat devāṃ ādityāṃ avase havāmahe vasūnrudrāntsavitāraṃ sudaṃsasam
verses.en: Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Visnu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky. We call upon Adityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
सरस्वान्धीभिर्वरुणो धृतव्रतः पूषा विष्णुर्महिमा वायुरश्विना ।
ब्रह्मकृतो अमृता विश्ववेदसः शर्म नो यंसन्त्रिवरूथमंहसः॥
verses.tr: sarasvāndhībhirvaruṇo dhṛtavrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇurmahimā vāyuraśvinā brahmakṛto amṛtā viśvavedasaḥ śarma no yaṃsantrivarūthamaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: With Holy Thoughts Sarasvan, firm-lawed Varuna, great Vayu, Pusan, Visnu, and the Asvins Twain, Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress.

verses.sa:
वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः सन्तु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः ।
वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā yajño vṛṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyā vṛṣaṇo devā vṛṣaṇo haviṣkṛtaḥ vṛṣaṇā dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāvarī vṛṣā parjanyo vṛṣaṇo vṛṣastubhaḥ
verses.en: Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods. Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे ।
यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā vṛṣaṇā vājasātaye purupraśastā vṛṣaṇā upa bruve yāvījire vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ
verses.en: To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud. May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods.

verses.sa:
धृतव्रताः क्षत्रिया यज्ञनिष्कृतो बृहद्दिवा अध्वराणामभिश्रियः ।
अग्निहोतार ऋतसापो अद्रुहोऽपो असृजन्ननु वृत्रतूर्ये॥
verses.tr: dhṛtavratāḥ kṣatriyā yajñaniṣkṛto bṛhaddivā adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyaḥ agnihotāra ṛtasāpo adruho'po asṛjannanu vṛtratūrye
verses.en: Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day, Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vrtra died.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताऽऽप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया ।
अन्तरिक्षं स्व१रा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी३ नि मामृजुः॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivī janayannabhi vratā''pa oṣadhīrvanināni yajñiyā antarikṣaṃ sva1rā paprurūtaye vaśaṃ devāsastanvī3 ni māmṛjuḥ
verses.en: The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees. They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful.

verses.sa:
धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः ।
आप ओषधीः प्र तिरन्तु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यन्तु मे हवम्॥
verses.tr: dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhago rātirvājino yantu me havam
verses.en: May they who bear up heaven, the Rbhus deft of hand, and Vata and Parjanya of the thundering Bull, The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call.

verses.sa:
समुद्रः सिन्धू रजो अन्तरिक्षमज एकपात्तनयित्नुरर्णवः ।
अहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणवद्वचांसि मे विश्वे देवास उत सूरयो मम॥
verses.tr: samudraḥ sindhū rajo antarikṣamaja ekapāttanayitnurarṇavaḥ ahirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me viśve devāsa uta sūrayo mama
verses.en: Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapad, The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear.

verses.sa:
स्याम वो मनवो देववीतये प्राञ्चं नो यज्ञं प्र णयत साधुया ।
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुदानव इमा ब्रह्म शस्यमानानि जिन्वत॥
verses.tr: syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāñcaṃ no yajñaṃ pra ṇayata sādhuyā ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata
verses.en: May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success. Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा पुरोहित ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेमि साधुया ।
क्षेत्रस्य पतिं प्रतिवेशमीमहे विश्वान्देवाँ अमृताँ अप्रयुच्छतः॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthāmanvemi sādhuyā kṣetrasya patiṃ prativeśamīmahe viśvāndevāṃ amṛtāṃ aprayucchataḥ
verses.en: I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time. We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss.

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठासः पितृवद्वाचमक्रत देवाँ ईळाना ऋषिवत्स्वस्तये ।
प्रीता इव ज्ञातयः काममेत्याऽस्मे देवासोऽव धूनुता वसु॥
verses.tr: vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitṛvadvācamakrata devāṃ īḻānā ṛṣivatsvastaye prītā iva jñātayaḥ kāmametyā'sme devāso'va dhūnutā vasu
verses.en: Vasistha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Rsi-like praying to the Gods for happiness. Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above.

verses.sa:
देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविन्दत् ।
तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद्विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिन्द्राय शंसन्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat turīyaṃ svijjanayadviśvajanyo'yāsya ukthamindrāya śaṃsan
verses.en: This holy hymn, sublime and seven headed, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered. Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.

verses.sa:
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।
विप्रं पदमङ्गिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनन्त॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta
verses.en: Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes, Angirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute.

verses.sa:
हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् ।
बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद्गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वाँ अगायत्॥
verses.tr: haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiraśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan bṛhaspatirabhikanikradadgā uta prāstauducca vidvāṃ agāyat
verses.en: Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison, Brhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.

verses.sa:
अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठन्तीरनृतस्य सेतौ ।
बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः॥
verses.tr: avo dvābhyāṃ para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīranṛtasya setau bṛhaspatistamasi jyotiricchannudusrā ākarvi hi tisra āvaḥ
verses.en: Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood. Brhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.

verses.sa:
विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृन्तत् ।
बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः॥
verses.tr: vibhidyā puraṃ śayathemapācīṃ nistrīṇi sākamudadherakṛntat bṛhaspatiruṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gāmarkaṃ viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ
verses.en: When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters. Brhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण ।
स्वेदाञ्जिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत्पणिमा गा अमुष्णात्॥
verses.tr: indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa svedāñjibhirāśiramicchamāno'rodayatpaṇimā gā amuṣṇāt
verses.en: As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle. Seeking the milk-draught with sweat shining comrades he stole the Pani's kine and left him weeping.

verses.sa:
स ईं सत्येभिः सखिभिः शुचद्भिर्गोधायसं वि धनसैरदर्दः ।
ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्वृषभिर्वराहैर्घर्मस्वेदेभिर्द्रविणं व्यानट्॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairadardaḥ brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairgharmasvedebhirdraviṇaṃ vyānaṭ
verses.en: He with bright faithful Friends, winners of booty, hath rent the milker of the cows asunder. Brhaspati with wild boars strong and mighty, sweating with heat, hath gained a rich possession.

verses.sa:
ते सत्येन मनसा गोपतिं गा इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः ।
बृहस्पतिर्मिथोअवद्यपेभिरुदुस्रिया असृजत स्वयुग्भिः॥
verses.tr: te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ bṛhaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ
verses.en: They, longing for the kine, with faithful spirit incited with their hymns the Lord of cattle. Brhaspati freed the radiant cows with comrades self-yoked, averting shame from one another.

verses.sa:
तं वर्धयन्तो मतिभिः शिवाभिः सिंहमिव नानदतं सधस्थे ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं शूरसातौ भरेभरे अनु मदेम जिष्णुम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nānadataṃ sadhasthe bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madema jiṣṇum
verses.en: In our assembly with auspicious praises exalting him who roareth like a lion, Maywe, in every fight where heroes conquer, rejoice in strong Brhaspati the Victor.

verses.sa:
यदा वाजमसनद्विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयन्तो नाना सन्तो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा॥
verses.tr: yadā vājamasanadviśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sadma bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā
verses.en: When he had won him every sort of booty and gone to heaven and its most lofty mansions, Men praised Brhaspati the Mighty, bringing the light within their mouths from sundry places.

verses.sa:
सत्यामाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः ।
पश्चा मृधो अप भवन्तु विश्वास्तद्रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे॥
verses.tr: satyāmāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhyavatha svebhirevaiḥ paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvāstadrodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve
verses.en: Fulfil the prayer that begs for vital vigour: aid in your wonted manner even the humble. Let all our foes be turned and driven backward. Hear this, O Heaven and Earth, ye All-producers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य वि मूर्धानमभिनदर्बुदस्य ।
अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धून्देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः॥
verses.tr: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūndevairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ
verses.en: Indra with mighty strength cleft asunder the head of Arbuda the watery monster, Slain Ahi, and set free the Seven Rivers. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.

verses.sa:
उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः ।
गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिमभ्य१र्का अनावन्॥
verses.tr: udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatimabhya1rkā anāvan
verses.en: Like birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud, Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain, thus to Brhaspati our hymns have sounded.

verses.sa:
सं गोभिराङ्गिरसो नक्षमाणो भग इवेदर्यमणं निनाय ।
जने मित्रो न दम्पती अनक्ति बृहस्पते वाजयाशूँरिवाजौ॥
verses.tr: saṃ gobhirāṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ivedaryamaṇaṃ nināya jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśūṃrivājau
verses.en: The Son of Angirases, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us. As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband: as for the race, Brhaspati, nerve our coursers.

verses.sa:
साध्वर्या अतिथिनीरिषिराः स्पार्हाः सुवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः ।
बृहस्पतिः पर्वतेभ्यो वितूर्या निर्गा ऊपे यवमिव स्थिविभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sādhvaryā atithinīriṣirāḥ spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nirgā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ
verses.en: Brhaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnowing- baskets, The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.

verses.sa:
आप्रुषायन्मधुन ऋतस्य योनिमवक्षिपन्नर्क उल्कामिव द्योः ।
बृहस्पतिरुद्धरन्नश्मनो गा भूम्या उद्नेव वि त्वचं बिभेद॥
verses.tr: āpruṣāyanmadhuna ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyoḥ bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacaṃ bibheda
verses.en: As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flaming meteor down from heaven. So from the rock Brhaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.

verses.sa:
अप ज्योतिषा तमो अन्तरिक्षादुद्नः शीपालमिव वात आजत् ।
बृहस्पतिरनुमृश्या वलस्याऽभ्रमिव वात आ चक्र आ गाः॥
verses.tr: apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudnaḥ śīpālamiva vāta ājat bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyā'bhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ
verses.en: Forth from mid air with light he drave the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the fiver. Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brhaspati gathered to himself the cattle,

verses.sa:
यदा वलस्य पीयतो जसुं भेद्बृहस्पतिरग्नितपोभिरर्कैः ।
दद्भिर्न जिह्वा परिविष्टमाददाविर्निधीँरकृणोदुस्रियाणाम्॥
verses.tr: yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhedbṛhaspatiragnitapobhirarkaiḥ dadbhirna jihvā pariviṣṭamādadāvirnidhīṃrakṛṇodusriyāṇām
verses.en: Brhaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala, Consumed.him as tongues cat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिरमत हि त्यदासां नाम स्वरीणां सदने गुहा यत् ।
आण्डेव भित्त्वा शकुनस्य गर्भमुदुस्रियाः पर्वतस्य त्मनाजत्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiramata hi tyadāsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat āṇḍeva bhittvā śakunasya garbhamudusriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat
verses.en: That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brhaspati discovered, And drave, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the egg's disclosure.

verses.sa:
अश्नापिनद्धं मधु पर्यपश्यन्मत्स्यं न दीन उदनि क्षियन्तम् ।
निष्टज्जभार चमसं न वृक्षाद्बृहस्पतिर्विरवेणा विकृत्य॥
verses.tr: aśnāpinaddhaṃ madhu paryapaśyanmatsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam niṣṭajjabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣādbṛhaspatirviraveṇā vikṛtya
verses.en: He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water. Brhaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.

verses.sa:
सोषामविन्दत्स स्व१ः सो अग्निं सो अर्केण वि बबाधे तमांसि ।
बृहस्पतिर्गोवपुषो वलस्य निर्मज्जानं न पर्वणो जभार॥
verses.tr: soṣāmavindatsa sva1ḥ so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi bṛhaspatirgovapuṣo valasya nirmajjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra
verses.en: He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness. As from a joint, Brhaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle.

verses.sa:
हिमेव पर्णा मुषिता वनानि बृहस्पतिनाकृपयद्वलो गाः ।
अनानुकृत्यमपुनश्चकार यात्सूर्यामासा मिथ उच्चरातः॥
verses.tr: himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayadvalo gāḥ anānukṛtyamapunaścakāra yātsūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ
verses.en: As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brhaspati had taken. He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the Sun and Moon ascend alternate.

verses.sa:
अभि श्यावं न कृशनेभिरश्वं नक्षत्रेभिः पितरो द्यामपिंशन् ।
रात्र्यां तमो अदधुर्ज्योतिरहन्बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः॥
verses.tr: abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhiraśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapiṃśan rātryāṃ tamo adadhurjyotirahanbṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ
verses.en: Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorated heaven With constellations. They set the light in day, in night the darkness. Brhaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle.

verses.sa:
इदमकर्म नमो अभ्रियाय यः पूर्वीरन्वानोनवीति ।
बृहस्पतिः स हि गोभिः सो अश्वैः स वीरेभिः स नृभिर्नो वयो धात्॥
verses.tr: idamakarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīranvānonavīti bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhirno vayo dhāt
verses.en: This homage have we offered to the Cloud God who thunders out to many in succession. May this Brhaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.

verses.sa:
भद्रा अग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य संदृशो वामी प्रणीतिः सुरणा उपेतयः ।
यदीं सुमित्रा विशो अग्र इन्धते घृतेनाहुतो जरते दविद्युतत्॥
verses.tr: bhadrā agnervadhryaśvasya saṃdṛśo vāmī praṇītiḥ suraṇā upetayaḥ yadīṃ sumitrā viśo agra indhate ghṛtenāhuto jarate davidyutat
verses.en: Auspicious is the aspect of Vadhryasva's fire good is its guidance, pleasant are its visitings. When first the people Of Sumitra kindle it, with butter poured thereon it crackles and shines bright.

verses.sa:
घृतमग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वर्धनं घृतमन्नं घृतम्वस्य मेदनम् ।
घृतेनाहुत उर्विया वि पप्रथे सूर्य इव रोचते सर्पिरासुतिः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtamagnervadhryaśvasya vardhanaṃ ghṛtamannaṃ ghṛtamvasya medanam ghṛtenāhuta urviyā vi paprathe sūrya iva rocate sarpirāsutiḥ
verses.en: Butter is that which makes Vadhryaiva's fire growstrong: the butter is its food, the butter makes it fat. It spreads abroad when butter hath been offered it, and balmed with streams of butter shines forth like the Sun.

verses.sa:
यत्ते मनुर्यदनीकं सुमित्रः समीधे अग्ने तदिदं नवीयः ।
स रेवच्छोच स गिरो जुषस्व स वाजं दर्षि स इह श्रवो धाः॥
verses.tr: yatte manuryadanīkaṃ sumitraḥ samīdhe agne tadidaṃ navīyaḥ sa revacchoca sa giro juṣasva sa vājaṃ darṣi sa iha śravo dhāḥ
verses.en: Still newest is this face of thine, O Agni, which Manu and Sumitra have enkindled. So richly shine, accept our songs with favour, so give us strengthening food, so send us glory.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा पूर्वमीळितो वध्र्यश्वः समीधे अग्ने स इदं जुषस्व ।
स नः स्तिपा उत भवा तनूपा दात्रं रक्षस्व यदिदं ते अस्मे॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā pūrvamīḻito vadhryaśvaḥ samīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva sa naḥ stipā uta bhavā tanūpā dātraṃ rakṣasva yadidaṃ te asme
verses.en: Accept this offering, Agni, whom aforetime Vadhryasva, hath entreated and enkindled. Guard well our homes and ople, guard our bodies, protect thy girt to us which thou hast granted.

verses.sa:
भवा द्युम्नी वाध्र्यश्वोत गोपा मा त्वा तारीदभिमातिर्जनानाम् ।
शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनः सुमित्रः प्र नु वोचं वाध्र्यश्वस्य नाम॥
verses.tr: bhavā dyumnī vādhryaśvota gopā mā tvā tārīdabhimātirjanānām śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavanaḥ sumitraḥ pra nu vocaṃ vādhryaśvasya nāma
verses.en: Be splendid, guard us Kinsman of Vadhryasva: let not the enmity of men o'ercome thee, Like the bold hero Cyavana, I Sumitra tell forth the title of Vadhryaiva's Kinsman.

verses.sa:
समज्र्या पर्वत्या३ वसूनि दासा वृत्राण्यार्या जिगेथ ।
शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनो जनानां त्वमग्ने पृतनायूँरभि ष्याः॥
verses.tr: samajryā parvatyā3 vasūni dāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā jigetha śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavano janānāṃ tvamagne pṛtanāyūṃrabhi ṣyāḥ
verses.en: All treasures hast thou won, of plains and mountains, and quelled the Dasas' and Aryas' hatred. Like the bold hero Cyavana, O Agni, mayst thou subdue the men who long for battle.

verses.sa:
दीर्घतन्तुर्बृहदुक्षायमग्निः सहस्रस्तरीः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।
द्युमान्द्युमत्सु नृभिर्मृज्यमानः सुमित्रेषु दीदयो देवयत्सु॥
verses.tr: dīrghatanturbṛhadukṣāyamagniḥ sahasrastarīḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā dyumāndyumatsu nṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu
verses.en: Deft Agni hath a lengthened thread, tall oxen, a thousand heifers, numberless devices. Decked by the men, splendid among the splendid, shine brightly forth amid devout Sumitras.

verses.sa:
त्वे धेनुः सुदुघा जातवेदोऽसश्चतेव समना सबर्धुक् ।
त्वं नृभिर्दक्षिणावद्भिरग्ने सुमित्रेभिरिध्यसे देवयद्भिः॥
verses.tr: tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo'saścateva samanā sabardhuk tvaṃ nṛbhirdakṣiṇāvadbhiragne sumitrebhiridhyase devayadbhiḥ
verses.en: Thine is the teeming cow, O Jatavedas, who pours at once her ceaseless flow, Sabardhuk, Thou. art lit up by men enriched with guerdon, O Agni, by the pious-souled Sumitras.

verses.sa:
देवाश्चित्ते अमृता जातवेदो महिमानं वाध्र्यश्व प्र वोचन् ।
यत्सम्पृच्छं मानुषीर्विश आयन्त्वं नृभिरजयस्त्वावृधेभिः॥
verses.tr: devāścitte amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhryaśva pra vocan yatsampṛcchaṃ mānuṣīrviśa āyantvaṃ nṛbhirajayastvāvṛdhebhiḥ
verses.en: Even Immortal Gods, O Jatavedas, Vadhryasva's Kinsman, have declared thy grandeur. When human tribes drew near with supplication thou conqueredst with men whom thou hadst strengthened.

verses.sa:
पितेव पुत्रमबिभरुपस्थे त्वामग्ने वध्र्यश्वः सपर्यन् ।
जुषाणो अस्य समिधं यविष्ठोत पूर्वाँ अवनोर्व्राधतश्चित्॥
verses.tr: piteva putramabibharupasthe tvāmagne vadhryaśvaḥ saparyan juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvāṃ avanorvrādhataścit
verses.en: Like as a father bears his son, O Agni, Vadhryasva bare thee in his lap and served thee. Thou, Youngest God, having enjoyed his fuel, didst vanquish those of old though they were mighty.

verses.sa:
शश्वदग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य शत्रून्नृभिर्जिगाय सुतसोमवद्भिः ।
समनं चिददहश्चित्रभानोऽव व्राधन्तमभिनद्वृधश्चित्॥
verses.tr: śaśvadagnirvadhryaśvasya śatrūnnṛbhirjigāya sutasomavadbhiḥ samanaṃ cidadahaścitrabhāno'va vrādhantamabhinadvṛdhaścit
