verses.en: Vadhryasva's Agni evermore hath vanquished his foes with heroes who had pressed the Soma. Lord of bright rays, thou burntest up the battle, subduing, as our help, e'en mighty foemen.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वृत्रहा सनकात्प्रेद्धो नमसोपवाक्यः ।
स नो अजामीँरुत वा विजामीनभि तिष्ठ शर्धतो वाध्र्यश्व॥
verses.tr: ayamagnirvadhryaśvasya vṛtrahā sanakātpreddho namasopavākyaḥ sa no ajāmīṃruta vā vijāmīnabhi tiṣṭha śardhato vādhryaśva
verses.en: This Agni of Vadhryasva, Vrtra-slayer, lit from of old, must be invoked with homage. As such assail our enemies, Vadhryasva, whether the foes be strangers or be kinsmen.

verses.sa:
इमां मे अग्ने समिधं जुषस्वेळस्पदे प्रति हर्या घृताचीम् ।
वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्याः सुदिनत्वे अह्नामूर्ध्वो भव सुक्रतो देवयज्या॥
verses.tr: imāṃ me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḻaspade prati haryā ghṛtācīm varṣmanpṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahnāmūrdhvo bhava sukrato devayajyā
verses.en: Enjoy, O Agni, this my Fuel, welcome the oil-filled ladle where we pour libation. Rise up for worship of the Gods, wise Agni, on the earth's height, while days are bright with beauty.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामग्रयावेह यातु नराशंसो विश्वरूपेभिरश्वैः ।
ऋतस्य पथा नमसा मियेधो देवेभ्यो देवतमः सुषूदत्॥
verses.tr: ā devānāmagrayāveha yātu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhiraśvaiḥ ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ suṣūdat
verses.en: May he who goes before the Gods come hither with steeds whose shapes are varied, Narasarhsa. May he, most Godlike, speed our offered viands with homage God-ward on the path of Order.

verses.sa:
शश्वत्तममीळते दूत्याय हविष्मन्तो मनुष्यासो अग्निम् ।
वहिष्ठैरश्वैः सुवृता रथेना ऽऽदेवान्वक्षि नि षदेह होता॥
verses.tr: śaśvattamamīḻate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim vahiṣṭhairaśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathenā ''devānvakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā
verses.en: Men with oblations laud most constant Agni, and pray him to perform an envoy's duty. With lightly-rolling car and best draught-horses, bring the Gods hither and sit down as Hotar.

verses.sa:
वि प्रथतां देवजुष्टं तिरश्चा दीर्घं द्राघ्मा सुरभि भूत्वस्मे ।
अहेळता मनसा देव बर्हिरिन्द्रज्येष्ठाँ उशतो यक्षि देवान्॥
verses.tr: vi prathatāṃ devajuṣṭaṃ tiraścā dīrghaṃ drāghmā surabhi bhūtvasme aheḻatā manasā deva barhirindrajyeṣṭhāṃ uśato yakṣi devān
verses.en: May the delight of Gods spread out transversely: may it be with us long in length and fragrant. O Holy Grass divine, with friendly spirit bring thou the willing Gods whose Chief is Indra.

verses.sa:
दिवो वा सानु स्पृशता वरीयः पृथिव्या वा मात्रया वि श्रयध्वम् ।
उशतीर्द्वारो महिना महद्भिर्देवं रथं रथयुर्धारयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: divo vā sānu spṛśatā varīyaḥ pṛthivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam uśatīrdvāro mahinā mahadbhirdevaṃ rathaṃ rathayurdhārayadhvam
verses.en: Touch ye the far-extending height of heaven or spring apart to suit the wide earth's measure. Yearning, ye Doors, with those sublime in greatness, seize eagerly the heavenly Car that cometh.

verses.sa:
देवी दिवो दुहितरा सुशिल्पे उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
आ वां देवास उशती उशन्त उरौ सीदन्तु सुभगे उपस्थे॥
verses.tr: devī divo duhitarā suśilpe uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau ā vāṃ devāsa uśatī uśanta urau sīdantu subhage upasthe
verses.en: Here in this shrine may Dawn and Night, the Daughters of Heaven, the skillful Goddesses, be seated. In your wide lap, auspicious, willing Ladies may the Gods seat them with a willing spirit.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा बृहदग्निः समिद्धः प्रिया धामान्यदितेरुपस्थे ।
पुरोहितावृत्विजा यज्ञे अस्मिन्विदुष्टरा द्रविणमा यजेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo grāvā bṛhadagniḥ samiddhaḥ priyā dhāmānyaditerupasthe purohitāvṛtvijā yajñe asminviduṣṭarā draviṇamā yajethām
verses.en: Up stands the stone, high burns the fire enkindled: Aditi's lap contains the Friendly Natures Ye Two Chief Priests who serve at this our worship, may ye, more skilled, win for us rich possessions.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरिदं वरीय आ सीदत चकृमा वः स्योनम् ।
मनुष्वद्यज्ञं सुधिता हवींषीळा देवी घृतपदी जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: tisro devīrbarhiridaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakṛmā vaḥ syonam manuṣvadyajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḻā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta
verses.en: On our wide grass, Three Goddesses be seated: for you have we prepared and made it pleasant. May Ila, she whose foot drops oil, the Goddess, taste, man-like, sacrifice and well-set presents.

verses.sa:
देव त्वष्टर्यद्ध चारुत्वमानड्यदङ्गिरसामभवः सचाभूः ।
स देवानां पाथ उप प्र विद्वाँ उशन्यक्षि द्रविणोदः सुरत्नः॥
verses.tr: deva tvaṣṭaryaddha cārutvamānaḍyadaṅgirasāmabhavaḥ sacābhūḥ sa devānāṃ pātha upa pra vidvāṃ uśanyakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ
verses.en: Since thou, God Tvastar, hast made beauty perfect, since thou hast been the Angirases' Companion, Willing, most wealthy, Giver of possessions, grant us the Gods' assembly, thou who knowest.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते रशनया नियूया देवानां पाथ उप वक्षि विद्वान् ।
स्वदाति देवः कृणवद्धवींष्यवतां द्यावापृथिवी हवं मे॥
verses.tr: vanaspate raśanayā niyūyā devānāṃ pātha upa vakṣi vidvān svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṃṣyavatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havaṃ me
verses.en: Well-knowing, binding with thy cord, bring hither, Lord of the Wood, the Deities' assembly. The God prepare and season our oblations may Heaven and Earth be gracious to my calling.

verses.sa:
आग्ने वह वरुणमिष्टये न इन्द्रं दिवो मरुतो अन्तरिक्षात् ।
सीदन्तु बर्हिर्विश्व आ यजत्राः स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: āgne vaha varuṇamiṣṭaye na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt sīdantu barhirviśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām
verses.en: Agni, bring hither Varuna to help us, Indra from heaven, from air's mid-realm the Maruts. On sacred grass all Holy ones be seated and let the Immortal Gods rejoice in Svaha.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते प्रथमं वाचो अग्रं यत्प्रैरत नामधेयं दधानाः ।
यदेषां श्रेष्ठं यदरिप्रमासीत्प्रेणा तदेषां निहितं गुहाविः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsītpreṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ
verses.en: When-men, Brhaspati, giving names to objects, sent out Vak's first and earliest utterances, All that was excellent and spotless, treasured within them, was disclosed through their affection.

verses.sa:
सक्तुमिव तितउना पुनन्तो यत्र धीरा मनसा वाचमक्रत ।
अत्रा सखायः सख्यानि जानते भद्रैषां लक्ष्मीर्निहिताधि वाचि॥
verses.tr: saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci
verses.en: Where, like men cleansing corn-flour in a cribble, the wise in spirit have created language, Friends see and recognize the marks of friendship: their speech retains the blessed sign imprinted.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन वाचः पदवीयमायन्तामन्वविन्दन्नृषिषु प्रविष्टाम् ।
तामाभृत्या व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा तां सप्त रेभा अभि सं नवन्ते॥
verses.tr: yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyantāmanvavindannṛṣiṣu praviṣṭām tāmābhṛtyā vyadadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante
verses.en: With sacrifice the trace of Vak they followed, and found her harbouring within the Rsis. They brought her, dealt her forth in many places: seven singers make her tones resound in concert.

verses.sa:
उत त्वः पश्यन्न ददर्श वाचमुत त्वः शृण्वन्न शृणोत्येनाम् ।
उतो त्वस्मै तन्वं१ वि सस्रे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः॥
verses.tr: uta tvaḥ paśyanna dadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanna śṛṇotyenām uto tvasmai tanvaṃ1 vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ
verses.en: One man hath ne'er seen Vak, and yet he seeth: one man hath hearing but hath never heard her. But to another hath she shown her beauty as a fond well-dressed woman to her husband.

verses.sa:
उत त्वं सख्ये स्थिरपीतमाहुर्नैनं हिन्वन्त्यपि वाजिनेषु ।
अधेन्वा चरति माययैष वाचं शुश्रुवाँ अफलामपुष्पाम्॥
verses.tr: uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvāṃ aphalāmapuṣpām
verses.en: One man they call a laggard, dull in friendship: they never urge him on to deeds of valour. He wanders on in profitless illusion: the Voice he heard yields neither fruit, nor blossom.

verses.sa:
यस्तित्याज सचिविदं सखायं न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति ।
यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति नहि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थाम्॥
verses.tr: yastityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām
verses.en: No part in Vak hath he who hath abandoned his own dear friend who knows the truth of friendship. Even if he hears her still in vain he listens: naught knows he of the path of righteous action.

verses.sa:
अक्षण्वन्तः कर्णवन्तः सखायो मनोजवेष्वसमा बभूवुः ।
आदघ्नास उपकक्षास उ त्वे ह्रदा इव स्नात्वा उ त्वे ददृश्रे॥
verses.tr: akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo manojaveṣvasamā babhūvuḥ ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre
verses.en: Unequal in the quickness of their spirit are friends endowed alike with eyes and hearing. Some look like tanks that reach the mouth or shoulder, others like pools of water fit to bathe in.

verses.sa:
हृदा तष्टेषु मनसो जवेषु यद्ब्राह्मणाः संयजन्ते सखायः ।
अत्राह त्वं वि जहुर्वेद्याभिरोहब्रह्माणो वि चरन्त्यु त्वे॥
verses.tr: hṛdā taṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yadbrāhmaṇāḥ saṃyajante sakhāyaḥ atrāha tvaṃ vi jahurvedyābhirohabrahmāṇo vi carantyu tve
verses.en: When friendly Brahmans sacrifice together with mental impulse which the heart hath fashioned, They leave one far behind through their attainments, and some who count as Brahmans wander elsewhere.

verses.sa:
इमे ये नार्वाङ्न परश्चरन्ति न ब्राह्मणासो न सुतेकरासः ।
त एते वाचमभिपद्य पापया सिरीस्तन्त्रं तन्वते अप्रजज्ञयः॥
verses.tr: ime ye nārvāṅna paraścaranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsaḥ ta ete vācamabhipadya pāpayā sirīstantraṃ tanvate aprajajñayaḥ
verses.en: Those men who step not back and move not forward, nor Brahmans nor preparers of libations, Having attained to Vak in sinful fashion spin out their thread in ignorance like spinsters.

verses.sa:
सर्वे नन्दन्ति यशसागतेन सभासाहेन सख्या सखायः ।
किल्बिषस्पृत्पितुषणिर्ह्येषामरं हितो भवति वाजिनाय॥
verses.tr: sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ kilbiṣaspṛtpituṣaṇirhyeṣāmaraṃ hito bhavati vājināya
verses.en: All friends are joyful in the friend who cometh in triumph, having conquered in assembly. He is their blame-averter, food-provider prepared is he and fit for deed of vigour.

verses.sa:
ऋचां त्वः पोषमास्ते पुपुष्वान्गायत्रं त्वो गायति शक्वरीषु ।
ब्रह्मा त्वो वदति जातविद्यां यज्ञस्य मात्रां वि मिमीत उ त्वः॥
verses.tr: ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣamāste pupuṣvāngāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ
verses.en: One plies his constant task reciting verses. one sings the holy psalm in Sakvari measures. One more, the Brahman, tells the lore of being, and one lays down the rules of sacrificing.

verses.sa: देवानां नु वयं जाना प्र वोचाम विपन्यया । उक्थेषु शस्यमानेषु यः पश्यादुत्तरे युगे॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ nu vayaṃ jānā pra vocāma vipanyayā uktheṣu śasyamāneṣu yaḥ paśyāduttare yuge
verses.en: Let US with tuneful skill proclaim these generations of the Gods, That one may see them when these hymns are chanted in a future age.

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणस्पतिरेता सं कर्मार इवाधमत् । देवानां पूर्व्ये युगेऽसतः सदजायत॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspatiretā saṃ karmāra ivādhamat devānāṃ pūrvye yuge'sataḥ sadajāyata
verses.en: These Brahmanaspati produced with blast and smelting, like a Smith, Existence, in an earlier age of Gods, from Non-existence sprang.

verses.sa: देवानां युगे प्रथमेऽसतः सदजायत । तदाशा अन्वजायन्त तदुत्तानपदस्परि॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ yuge prathame'sataḥ sadajāyata tadāśā anvajāyanta taduttānapadaspari
verses.en: Existence, in the earliest age of Gods, from Non-existence sprang. Thereafter were the regions born. This sprang from the Productive Power.

verses.sa: भूर्जज्ञ उत्तानपदो भुव आशा अजायन्त । अदितेर्दक्षो अजायत दक्षाद्वदितिः परि॥
verses.tr: bhūrjajña uttānapado bhuva āśā ajāyanta aditerdakṣo ajāyata dakṣādvaditiḥ pari
verses.en: Earth sprang from the Productive Power the regions from the earth were born. Daksa was born of Aditi, and Aditi was Daksa's Child.

verses.sa: अदितिर्ह्यजनिष्ट दक्ष या दुहिता तव । तां देवा अन्वजायन्त भद्रा अमृतबन्धवः॥
verses.tr: aditirhyajaniṣṭa dakṣa yā duhitā tava tāṃ devā anvajāyanta bhadrā amṛtabandhavaḥ
verses.en: For Aditi, O Daksa, she who is thy Daughter, was brought forth. After her were the blessed Gods born sharers of immortal life.

verses.sa: यद्देवा अदः सलिले सुसंरब्धा अतिष्ठत । अत्रा वो नृत्यतामिव तीव्रो रेणुरपायत॥
verses.tr: yaddevā adaḥ salile susaṃrabdhā atiṣṭhata atrā vo nṛtyatāmiva tīvro reṇurapāyata
verses.en: When ye, O Gods, in yonder deep close clasping one another stood, Thence, as of dancers, from your feet a thickening cloud of dust arose.

verses.sa: यद्देवा यतयो यथा भुवनान्यपिन्वत । अत्रा समुद्र आ गूळ्हमा सूर्यमजभर्तन॥
verses.tr: yaddevā yatayo yathā bhuvanānyapinvata atrā samudra ā gūḻhamā sūryamajabhartana
verses.en: When, O ye Gods, like Yatis, ye caused all existing things to grow, Then ye brought Surya forward who was lying hidden in the sea.

verses.sa: अष्टौ पुत्रासो अदितेर्ये जातास्तन्व१स्परि । देवाँ उप प्रैत्सप्तभिः परा मार्ताण्डमास्यत्॥
verses.tr: aṣṭau putrāso aditerye jātāstanva1spari devāṃ upa praitsaptabhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍamāsyat
verses.en: Eight are the Sons of Aditi who from her body sprang to life. With seven she went to meet the Gods she cast Martanda far away.

verses.sa: सप्तभिः पुत्रैरदितिरुप प्रैत्पूर्व्यं युगम् । प्रजायै मृत्यवे त्वत्पुनर्मार्ताण्डमाभरत्॥
verses.tr: saptabhiḥ putrairaditirupa praitpūrvyaṃ yugam prajāyai mṛtyave tvatpunarmārtāṇḍamābharat
verses.en: So with her Seven Sons Aditi went forth to meet the earlier age. She brought Martanda thitherward to spring to life and die again.

verses.sa:
जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः ।
अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा॥
verses.tr: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā
verses.en: Thou wast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there, the Maruts strengthened Indra when. his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

verses.sa:
द्रुहो निषत्ता पृशनी चिदेवैः पुरू शंसेन वावृधुष्ट इन्द्रम् ।
अभीवृतेव ता महापदेन ध्वान्तात्प्रपित्वादुदरन्त गर्भाः॥
verses.tr: druho niṣattā pṛśanī cidevaiḥ purū śaṃsena vāvṛdhuṣṭa indram abhīvṛteva tā mahāpadena dhvāntātprapitvādudaranta garbhāḥ
verses.en: There with fiend's ways e'en Prsni was seated: with much laudation they exalted Indra. As if encompassed by the Mighty-footed, from darkness, near at hand, forth came the Children.

verses.sa:
ऋष्वा ते पादा प्र यज्जिगास्यवर्धन्वाजा उत ये चिदत्र ।
त्वमिन्द्र सालावृकान्त्सहस्रमासन्दधिषे अश्विना ववृत्याः॥
verses.tr: ṛṣvā te pādā pra yajjigāsyavardhanvājā uta ye cidatra tvamindra sālāvṛkāntsahasramāsandadhiṣe aśvinā vavṛtyāḥ
verses.en: High are thy feet when on thy way thou goest: the strength thou foundest here hath lent thee vigour. Thousand hyenas in thy mouth thou holdest. O Indra, mayst thou turn the Asvins hither.

verses.sa:
समना तूर्णिरुप यासि यज्ञमा नासत्या सख्याय वक्षि ।
वसाव्यामिन्द्र धारयः सहस्राऽश्विना शूर ददतुर्मघानि॥
verses.tr: samanā tūrṇirupa yāsi yajñamā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi vasāvyāmindra dhārayaḥ sahasrā'śvinā śūra dadaturmaghāni
verses.en: Speeding at once to sacrifice thou comest for friendship thou art bringing both Nasatyas. Thou hadst a thousand treasures in possession. The Asvins, O thou Hero, gave thee riches.

verses.sa:
मन्दमान ऋतादधि प्रजायै सखिभिरिन्द्र इषिरेभिरर्थम् ।
आभिर्हि माया उप दस्युमागान्मिहः प्र तम्रा अवपत्तमांसि॥
verses.tr: mandamāna ṛtādadhi prajāyai sakhibhirindra iṣirebhirartham ābhirhi māyā upa dasyumāgānmihaḥ pra tamrā avapattamāṃsi
verses.en: Glad, for the race that rests on holy Order, with friends who hasten to their goal, hath Indra With these his magic powers assailed the Dasyu: he cast away the gloomy mists, the darkness.

verses.sa:
सनामाना चिद्ध्वसयो न्यस्मा अवाहन्निन्द्र उषसो यथानः ।
ऋष्वैरगच्छः सखिभिर्निकामैः साकं प्रतिष्ठा हृद्या जघन्थ॥
verses.tr: sanāmānā ciddhvasayo nyasmā avāhannindra uṣaso yathānaḥ ṛṣvairagacchaḥ sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ sākaṃ pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha
verses.en: Two of like name for him didst thou demolish, as Indra striking down the car of Usas. With thy beloved lofty Friends thou camest, and with the assurance of thine heart thou slewest.

verses.sa:
त्वं जघन्थ नमुचिं मखस्युं दासं कृण्वान ऋषये विमायम् ।
त्वं चकर्थ मनवे स्योनान्पथो देवत्राञ्जसेव यानान्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ jaghantha namuciṃ makhasyuṃ dāsaṃ kṛṇvāna ṛṣaye vimāyam tvaṃ cakartha manave syonānpatho devatrāñjaseva yānān
verses.en: War-loving Namuci thou smotest, robbing the Dasa of his magic for the Rsi. For man thou madest ready pleasant pathways, paths leading as it were directly God-ward.

verses.sa:
त्वमेतानि पप्रिषे वि नामेशान इन्द्र दधिषे गभस्तौ ।
अनु त्वा देवाः शवसा मदन्त्युपरिबुध्नान्वनिनश्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: tvametāni papriṣe vi nāmeśāna indra dadhiṣe gabhastau anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madantyuparibudhnānvaninaścakartha
verses.en: These names of thine thou hast fulfilled completely: as Lord, thou boldest in thine arm, O Indra. In thee, through thy great might, the Gods are joyful: the roots of trees hast thou directed upward.

verses.sa:
चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् ।
पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु॥
verses.tr: cakraṃ yadasyāpsvā niṣattamuto tadasmai madhviccacchadyāt pṛthivyāmatiṣitaṃ yadūdhaḥ payo goṣvadadhā oṣadhīṣu
verses.en: May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters. Thou from the udder which o'er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.

verses.sa:
अश्वादियायेति यद्वदन्त्योजसो जातमुत मन्य एनम् ।
मन्योरियाय हर्म्येषु तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद॥
verses.tr: aśvādiyāyeti yadvadantyojaso jātamuta manya enam manyoriyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda
verses.en: When others call him offspring of the Courser, my meaning is that Mighty Power produced him. He came from Manyu and remained in houses: whence he hath sprung is known to Indra only.

verses.sa:
वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः ।
अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्य१स्मान्निधयेव बद्धान्॥
verses.tr: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣurmumugdhya1smānnidhayeva baddhān
verses.en: Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rsis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra: Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision deliver us as men whom snares entangle.

verses.sa:
वसूनां वा चर्कृष इयक्षन्धिया वा यज्ञैर्वा रोदस्योः ।
अर्वन्तो वा ये रयिमन्तः सातौ वनंअ वा ये सुश्रुणं सुश्रुतो धुः॥
verses.tr: vasūnāṃ vā carkṛṣa iyakṣandhiyā vā yajñairvā rodasyoḥ arvanto vā ye rayimantaḥ sātau vanaṃa vā ye suśruṇaṃ suśruto dhuḥ
verses.en: I AM prepared to laud with song or worship the Noble Ones who are in earth and heaven, Or Coursers who have triumphed in, the contest, or those who famed, have won the prize with glory.

verses.sa:
हव एषामसुरो नक्षत द्यां श्रवस्यता मनसा निंसत क्षाम् ।
चक्षाणा यत्र सुविताय देवा द्यौर्न वारेभिः कृणवन्त स्वैः॥
verses.tr: hava eṣāmasuro nakṣata dyāṃ śravasyatā manasā niṃsata kṣām cakṣāṇā yatra suvitāya devā dyaurna vārebhiḥ kṛṇavanta svaiḥ
verses.en: Their call, the call of Gods, went up to heaven: they kissed the ground with glory-seeking spirit, There where the Gods look on for happy fortune, and like the kindly heavens bestow their bounties.

verses.sa:
इयमेषाममृतानां गीः सर्वताता ये कृपणन्त रत्नम् ।
धियं च यज्ञं च साधन्तस्ते नो धान्तु वसव्य१मसामि॥
verses.tr: iyameṣāmamṛtānāṃ gīḥ sarvatātā ye kṛpaṇanta ratnam dhiyaṃ ca yajñaṃ ca sādhantaste no dhāntu vasavya1masāmi
verses.en: This is the song of those Immortal Beings who long for treasures in their full perfection. May these, completing prayers and sacrifices, bestow upon us wealth where naught is wanting.

verses.sa:
आ तत्त इन्द्रायवः पनन्ताऽभि य ऊर्वं गोमन्तं तितृत्सान् ।
सकृत्स्वं१ ये पुरुपुत्रां महीं सहस्रधारां बृहतीं दुदुक्षन्॥
verses.tr: ā tatta indrāyavaḥ panantā'bhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān sakṛtsvaṃ1 ye puruputrāṃ mahīṃ sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan
verses.en: Those living men extolled thy deed, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose Sons are many and her streams past number.

verses.sa:
शचीव इन्द्रमवसे कृणुध्वमनानतं दमयन्तं पृतन्यून् ।
ऋभुक्षणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिं भर्ता यो वज्रं नर्यं पुरुक्षुः॥
verses.tr: śacīva indramavase kṛṇudhvamanānataṃ damayantaṃ pṛtanyūn ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktiṃ bhartā yo vajraṃ naryaṃ purukṣuḥ
verses.en: Sacivan, win to your assistance Indra who never bends, who overcomes his foemen. Rbhuksan, Maghavan, the hymn's upholder, who, rich in food, bears man's kind friend, the thunder.

verses.sa:
यद्वावान पुरुतमं पुराषाळा वृत्रहेन्द्रो नामान्यप्राः ।
अचेति प्रासहस्पतिस्तुविष्मान्यदीमुश्मसि कर्तवे करत्तत्॥
verses.tr: yadvāvāna purutamaṃ purāṣāḻā vṛtrahendro nāmānyaprāḥ aceti prāsahaspatistuviṣmānyadīmuśmasi kartave karattat
verses.en: Since he who won of old anew hath triumphed, Indra hath earned his name of Vrtra-slayer. He hath appeared, the mighty Lord of Conquest. What we would have him do let him accomplish.

verses.sa:
प्र सु व आपो महिमानमुत्तमं कारुर्वोचाति सदने विवस्वतः ।
प्र सप्तसप्त त्रेधा हि चक्रमुः प्र सृत्वरीणामति सिन्धुरोजसा॥
verses.tr: pra su va āpo mahimānamuttamaṃ kārurvocāti sadane vivasvataḥ pra saptasapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sṛtvarīṇāmati sindhurojasā
verses.en: The singer, O ye Waters in Vivasvan's place, shall tell your grandeur forth that is beyond compare. The Rivers have come forward triply, seven and seven. Sindhu in might surpasses all the streams that flow.

verses.sa:
प्र तेऽरदद्वरुणो यातवे पथः सिन्धो यद्वाजाँ अभ्यद्रवस्त्वम् ।
भूम्या अधि प्रवता यासि सानुना यदेषामग्रं जगतामिरज्यसि॥
verses.tr: pra te'radadvaruṇo yātave pathaḥ sindho yadvājāṃ abhyadravastvam bhūmyā adhi pravatā yāsi sānunā yadeṣāmagraṃ jagatāmirajyasi
verses.en: Varuna cut the channels for thy forward course, O Sindhu, when thou rannest on to win the race. Thou speedest o'er precipitous ridges of the earth, when thou art Lord and Leader of these moving floods.

verses.sa:
दिवि स्वनो यतते भूम्योपर्यनन्तं शुष्ममुदियर्ति भानुना ।
अभ्रादिव प्र स्तनयन्ति वृष्टयः सिन्धुर्यदेति वृषभो न रोरुवत्॥
verses.tr: divi svano yatate bhūmyoparyanantaṃ śuṣmamudiyarti bhānunā abhrādiva pra stanayanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sindhuryadeti vṛṣabho na roruvat
verses.en: His roar is lifted up to heaven above the earth: he puts forth endless vigour with a flash of light. Like floods of rain that fall- in thunder from the cloud, so Sindhu rushes on bellowing like a bull.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा सिन्धो शिशुमिन्न मातरो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः ।
राजेव युध्वा नयसि त्वमित्सिचौ यदासामग्रं प्रवतामिनक्षसि॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā sindho śiśuminna mātaro vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ rājeva yudhvā nayasi tvamitsicau yadāsāmagraṃ pravatāminakṣasi
verses.en: Like mothers to their calves, like milch kine with their milk, so, Sindhu, unto thee the roaring rivers run. Thou leadest as a warrior king thine army's wings what time thou comest in the van of these swift streams.

verses.sa:
इमं मे गङ्गे यमुने सरस्वति शुतुद्रि स्तोमं सचता परुष्ण्या ।
असिक्न्या मरुद्वृधे वितस्तयाऽऽर्जीकीये शृणुह्या सुषोमया॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇyā asiknyā marudvṛdhe vitastayā''rjīkīye śṛṇuhyā suṣomayā
verses.en: Favour ye this my laud, O Ganga, Yamuna, O Sutudri, Parusni and Sarasvati: With Asikni, Vitasta, O Marudvrdha, O Arjikiya with Susoma hear my call.

verses.sa:
तृष्टामया प्रथमं यातवे सजूः सुसर्त्वा रसया श्वेत्या त्या ।
त्वं सिन्धो कुभया गोमतीं क्रुमुं मेहत्न्वा सरथं याभिरीयसे॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ susartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ krumuṃ mehatnvā sarathaṃ yābhirīyase
verses.en: First with Trstama thou art eager to flow forth, with Rasa, and Susartu, and with Svetya here, With Kubha; and with these, Sindhu and Mehatnu, thou seekest in thy course Krumu and Gomati.

verses.sa:
ऋजीत्येनी रुशती महित्वा परि ज्रयांसि भरते रजांसि ।
अदब्धा सिन्धुरपसामपस्तमाऽश्वा न चित्रा वपुषीव दर्शता॥
verses.tr: ṛjītyenī ruśatī mahitvā pari jrayāṃsi bharate rajāṃsi adabdhā sindhurapasāmapastamā'śvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā
verses.en: Flashing and whitely-gleaming in her mightiness, she moves along her ample volumes through the realms, Most active of the active, Sindhu unrestrained, like to a dappled mare, beautiful, fair to see.

verses.sa:
स्वश्वा सिन्धुः सुरथा सुवासा हिरण्ययी सुकृता वाजिनीवती ।
ऊर्णावती युवतिः सीलमावत्युताधि वस्ते सुभगा मधुवृधम्॥
verses.tr: svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatyutādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham
verses.en: Rich in good steeds is Sindhu, rich in cars and robes, rich in gold, nobly-fashioned, rich in ample wealth. Blest Silamavati and young Urnavati invest themselves with raiment rich in store of sweets.

verses.sa:
सुखं रथं युयुजे सिन्धुरश्विनं तेन वाजं सनिषदस्मिन्नाजौ ।
महान्ह्यस्य महिमा पनस्यतेऽदब्धस्य स्वयशसो विरप्शिनः॥
verses.tr: sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhuraśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ saniṣadasminnājau mahānhyasya mahimā panasyate'dabdhasya svayaśaso virapśinaḥ
verses.en: Sindhu hath yoked her car, light-rolling, drawn by steeds, and with that car shall she win booty in this fight. So have I praised its power, mighty and unrestrained, of independent glory, roaring as it runs.

verses.sa:
आ व ऋञ्जस ऊर्जां व्युष्टिष्विन्द्रं मरुतो रोदसी अनक्तन ।
उभे यथा नो अहनी सचाभुवा सदःसदो वरिवस्यात उद्भिदा॥
verses.tr: ā va ṛñjasa ūrjāṃ vyuṣṭiṣvindraṃ maruto rodasī anaktana ubhe yathā no ahanī sacābhuvā sadaḥsado varivasyāta udbhidā
verses.en: I GRASP at you when power and strength begin to dawn: bedew ye, Indra and the Maruts, Heaven and Earth, That Day and Night, in every hall of sacrifice, may wait on us and bless us when they first spring forth.

verses.sa:
तदु श्रेष्ठं सवनं सुनोतनाऽत्यो न हस्तयतो अद्रिः सोतरि ।
विदद्ध्य१र्यो अभिभूति पौंस्यं महो राये चित्तरुते यदर्वतः॥
verses.tr: tadu śreṣṭhaṃ savanaṃ sunotanā'tyo na hastayato adriḥ sotari vidaddhya1ryo abhibhūti pauṃsyaṃ maho rāye cittarute yadarvataḥ
verses.en: Press the libation out, most excellent of all: the Pressing-stone is grasped like a hand-guided steed. So let it win the valour that subdues the foe, and the fleet courser's might that speeds to ample wealth.

verses.sa:
तदिद्ध्यस्य सवनं विवेरपो यथा पुरा मनवे गातुमश्रेत् ।
गोअर्णसि त्वाष्ट्रे अश्वनिर्णिजि प्रेमध्वरेष्वध्वराँ अशिश्रयुः॥
verses.tr: tadiddhyasya savanaṃ viverapo yathā purā manave gātumaśret goarṇasi tvāṣṭre aśvanirṇiji premadhvareṣvadhvarāṃ aśiśrayuḥ
verses.en: Juice that this Stone pours out removes defect of ours, as in old time it brought prosperity to man. At sacrifices they established holy rites on Tvastar's milk-blent juice bright with the hue of steeds.

verses.sa:
अप हत रक्षसो भङ्गुरावत स्कभायत निॠतिं सेधतामतिम् ।
आ नो रयिं सर्ववीरं सुनोतन देवाव्यं भरत श्लोकमद्रयः॥
verses.tr: apa hata rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvata skabhāyata niṝtiṃ sedhatāmatim ā no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ sunotana devāvyaṃ bharata ślokamadrayaḥ
verses.en: Drive ye the treacherous demons far away from us: keep Nirrti afar and banish Penury. Pour riches forth for us with troops of hero sons, and bear ye up, O Stones, the song that visits Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदा वोऽमवत्तरेभ्यो विभ्वना चिदाश्वपस्तरेभ्यः ।
वायोश्चिदा सोमरभस्तरेभ्योऽग्नेश्चिदर्च पितुकृत्तरेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: divaścidā vo'mavattarebhyo vibhvanā cidāśvapastarebhyaḥ vāyościdā somarabhastarebhyo'gneścidarca pitukṛttarebhyaḥ
verses.en: To you who are more mighty than the heavens themselves, who, finishing your task with more than Vibhvan's speed, More rapidly than Vayu seize the Soma juice, better than Agni give us food, to you I sing.

verses.sa:
भुरन्तु नो यशसः सोत्वन्धसो ग्रावाणो वाचा दिविता दिवित्मता ।
नरो यत्र दुहते काम्यं मध्वाघोषयन्तो अभितो मिथस्तुरः॥
verses.tr: bhurantu no yaśasaḥ sotvandhaso grāvāṇo vācā divitā divitmatā naro yatra duhate kāmyaṃ madhvāghoṣayanto abhito mithasturaḥ
verses.en: Stirred be the glorious Stones: let it press out the juice, the Stone with heavenly song that reaches up to heaven, There where the men draw forth the meath for which they long, sending their voice around in rivalry of speed.

verses.sa:
सुन्वन्ति सोमं रथिरासो अद्रयो निरस्य रसं गविषो दुहन्ति ते ।
दुहन्त्यूधरुपसेचनाय कं नरो हव्या न मर्जयन्त आसभिः॥
verses.tr: sunvanti somaṃ rathirāso adrayo nirasya rasaṃ gaviṣo duhanti te duhantyūdharupasecanāya kaṃ naro havyā na marjayanta āsabhiḥ
verses.en: The Stones press out the Soma, swift as car-borne men, and, eager for the spoil, drain forth the sap thereof To fill the beaker, they exhaust the udder's store, as the men purify oblations with their lips.

verses.sa:
एते नरः स्वपसो अभूतन य इन्द्राय सुनुथ सोममद्रयः ।
वामंवामं वो दिव्याय धाम्ने वसुवसु वः पार्थिवाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: ete naraḥ svapaso abhūtana ya indrāya sunutha somamadrayaḥ vāmaṃvāmaṃ vo divyāya dhāmne vasuvasu vaḥ pārthivāya sunvate
verses.en: Ye, present men, have been most skillful in your work, even ye, O Stones who pressed Soma for Indra's drink. May all ye have of fair go to the Heavenly Race, and all your treasure to the earthly worshipper.

verses.sa:
अभ्रप्रुषो न वाचा प्रुषा वसु हविष्मन्तो न यज्ञा विजानुषः ।
सुमारुतं न ब्रह्माणमर्हसे गणमस्तोष्येषां न शोभसे॥
verses.tr: abhrapruṣo na vācā pruṣā vasu haviṣmanto na yajñā vijānuṣaḥ sumārutaṃ na brahmāṇamarhase gaṇamastoṣyeṣāṃ na śobhase
verses.en: As with their voice from cloud they sprinkle treasure so are the wise man's liberal sacrifices. I praise their Company that merits worship as the good Maruts' priest to pay them honour.

verses.sa:
श्रिये मर्यासो अञ्जीँरकृण्वत सुमारुतं न पूर्वीरति क्षपः ।
दिवस्पुत्रास एता न येतिर आदित्यासस्ते अक्रा न वावृधुः॥
verses.tr: śriye maryāso añjīṃrakṛṇvata sumārutaṃ na pūrvīrati kṣapaḥ divasputrāsa etā na yetira ādityāsaste akrā na vāvṛdhuḥ
verses.en: The youths have wrought their ornaments for glory through many nights,-this noble band of Maruts. Like stags the Sons of Dyatis have striven onward, the Sons of Aditi grown strong like pillars.

verses.sa:
प्र ये दिवः पृथिव्या न बर्हणा त्मना रिरिच्रे अभ्रान्न सूर्यः ।
पाजस्वन्तो न वीराः पनस्यवो रिशादसो न मर्या अभिद्यवः॥
verses.tr: pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrānna sūryaḥ pājasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśādaso na maryā abhidyavaḥ
verses.en: They who extend beyond the earth and heaven, by their own mass, as from the cloud spreads Surya; Like mighty Heroes covetous of glory, like heavenly gallants who destroy the wicked.

verses.sa:
युष्माकं बुध्ने अपां न यामनि विथुर्यति न मही श्रथर्यति ।
विश्वप्सुर्यज्ञो अर्वागयं सु वः प्रयस्वन्तो न सत्राच आ गत॥
verses.tr: yuṣmākaṃ budhne apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati viśvapsuryajño arvāgayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata
verses.en: When ye come nigh, as in the depth of waters, the earth is loosened, as it were, and shaken. This your all-feeding sacrifice approaches: come all united, fraught, as 'twere with viands.

verses.sa:
यूयं धूर्षु प्रयुजो न रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिष्मन्तो न भासा व्युष्टिषु ।
श्येनासो न स्वयशसो रिशादसः प्रवासो न प्रसितासः परिप्रुषः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ dhūrṣu prayujo na raśmibhirjyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyuṣṭiṣu śyenāso na svayaśaso riśādasaḥ pravāso na prasitāsaḥ paripruṣaḥ
verses.en: Ye are like horses fastened to the chariot poles, luminous with your beams, with splendour as at dawn; Like self-bright falcons, punishers of wicked men, like hovering birds urged forward, scattering rain around.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्वहध्वे मरुतः पराकाद्यूयं महः संवरणस्य वस्वः ।
विदानासो वसवो राध्यस्याऽऽराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोत॥
verses.tr: pra yadvahadhve marutaḥ parākādyūyaṃ mahaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ vidānāso vasavo rādhyasyā''rācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyota
verses.en: When ye come forth, O Maruts, from the distance, from the great treasury of rich possessions, Knowing, O Vasus, boons that should be granted, even from afar drive back the men who hate us.

verses.sa:
य उदृचि यज्ञे अध्वरेष्ठा मरुद्भ्यो न मानुषो ददाशत् ।
रेवत्स वयो दधते सुवीरं स देवानामपि गोपीथे अस्तु॥
verses.tr: ya udṛci yajñe adhvareṣṭhā marudbhyo na mānuṣo dadāśat revatsa vayo dadhate suvīraṃ sa devānāmapi gopīthe astu
verses.en: He who, engaged in the rite's final duty brings, as a man, oblation to the Maruts, Wins him life's wealthy fulness, blest with heroes: he shall be present, too, where Gods drink Soma.

verses.sa:
ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमा आदित्येन नाम्ना शम्भविष्ठाः ।
ते नोऽवन्तु रथतूर्मनीषां महश्च यामन्नध्वरे चकानाः॥
verses.tr: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmā ādityena nāmnā śambhaviṣṭhāḥ te no'vantu rathatūrmanīṣāṃ mahaśca yāmannadhvare cakānāḥ
verses.en: For these are helps adored at sacrifices, bringing good fortune by their name Adityas. Speeding on cars let them protect our praises, delighting in our sacrifice and worship.

verses.sa:
विप्रासो न मन्मभिः स्वाध्यो देवाव्यो३ न यज्ञैः स्वप्नसः ।
राजानो न चित्राः सुसंदृशः क्षितीनां न मर्या अरेपसः॥
verses.tr: viprāso na manmabhiḥ svādhyo devāvyo3 na yajñaiḥ svapnasaḥ rājāno na citrāḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ kṣitīnāṃ na maryā arepasaḥ
verses.en: Ye by your hymns are like high-thoughted singers, skillful, inviting Gods with sacrifices; Fair to behold, like Kings, with bright adornment, like spotless gallants, leaders of the people:

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न ये भ्राजसा रुक्मवक्षसो वातासो न स्वयुजः सद्यऊतयः ।
प्रज्ञातारो न ज्येष्ठाः सुनीतयः सुशर्माणो न सोमा ऋतं यते॥
verses.tr: agnirna ye bhrājasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate
verses.en: Like fire with flashing flame, breast-bound with chains of gold, like tempest-blasts, self-moving, swift to lend your aid; As best of all foreknowers, excellent to guide, like Somas, good to guard the man who follows Law.

verses.sa:
वातासो न ये धुनयो जिगत्नवोऽग्नीनां न जिह्वा विरोकिणः ।
वर्मण्वन्तो न योधाः शिमीवन्तः पितॄणां न शंसाः सुरातयः॥
verses.tr: vātāso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokiṇaḥ varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ
verses.en: Shakers of all, like gales of wind they travel, like tongues of burning fires in their effulgence. Mighty are they as warriors clad in armour, and, like the Fathers' prayers, Most Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
रथानां न ये१राः सनाभयो जिगीवांसो न शूरा अभिद्यवः ।
वरेयवो न मर्या घृतप्रुषोऽभिस्वर्तारो अर्कं न सुष्टुभः॥
verses.tr: rathānāṃ na ye1rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhidyavaḥ vareyavo na maryā ghṛtapruṣo'bhisvartāro arkaṃ na suṣṭubhaḥ
verses.en: Like spokes of car-wheels in one nave united, ever victorious like heavenly Heroes, Shedding their precious balm like youthful suitors, they raise their voice and chant their psalm as singers.

verses.sa:
अश्वासो न ये ज्येष्ठास आशवो दिधिषवो न रथ्यः सुदानवः ।
आपो न निम्नैरुदभिर्जिगत्नवो विश्वरूपा अङ्गिरसो न सामभिः॥
verses.tr: aśvāso na ye jyeṣṭhāsa āśavo didhiṣavo na rathyaḥ sudānavaḥ āpo na nimnairudabhirjigatnavo viśvarūpā aṅgiraso na sāmabhiḥ
verses.en: They who are fleet to travel like the noblest steeds, long to obtain the prize like bounteous charioteers, Like waters speeding on with their precipitous floods, like omniform Angirases with Sama-hymns.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाणो न सूरयः सिन्धुमातर आदर्दिरासो अद्रयो न विश्वहा ।
शिशूला न क्रीळयः सुमातरो महाग्रामो न यामन्नुत त्विषा॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇo na sūrayaḥ sindhumātara ādardirāso adrayo na viśvahā śiśūlā na krīḻayaḥ sumātaro mahāgrāmo na yāmannuta tviṣā
verses.en: Born from the stream, like press-stones are the Princes, for ever like the stones that crush in pieces; Sons of a beauteous Dame, like playful children, like a great host upon the march with splendour.

verses.sa:
उषसां न केतवोऽध्वरश्रियः शुभंयवो नाञ्जिभिर्व्यश्वितन् ।
सिन्धवो न ययियो भ्राजदृष्टयः परावतो न योजनानि ममिरे॥
verses.tr: uṣasāṃ na ketavo'dhvaraśriyaḥ śubhaṃyavo nāñjibhirvyaśvitan sindhavo na yayiyo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ parāvato na yojanāni mamire
verses.en: Like rays of Dawn, the visitors of sacrifice, they shine with ornaments as eager to be bright. Like rivers hasting on, glittering with their spears, from far away they measure out the distances.

verses.sa:
सुभागान्नो देवाः कृणुता सुरत्नानस्मान्त्स्तोतॄन्मरुतो वावृधानाः ।
अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गात सनाद्धि वो रत्नधेयानि सन्ति॥
verses.tr: subhāgānno devāḥ kṛṇutā suratnānasmāntstotṝnmaruto vāvṛdhānāḥ adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāddhi vo ratnadheyāni santi
verses.en: Gods, send us happiness and make us wealthy, letting us singers prosper, O ye Maruts. Bethink you of our praise and of our friendship: ye from of old have riches to vouchsafe us.

verses.sa:
अपश्यमस्य महतो महित्वममर्त्यस्य मर्त्यासु विक्षु ।
नाना हनू विभृते सं भरेते असिन्वती बप्सती भूर्यत्तः॥
verses.tr: apaśyamasya mahato mahitvamamartyasya martyāsu vikṣu nānā hanū vibhṛte saṃ bharete asinvatī bapsatī bhūryattaḥ
verses.en: I HAVE beheld the might of this Great Being. Immortal in the midst of tribes of mortals. His jaws now open and now shut together: much they devour, insatiately chewing.

verses.sa:
गुहा शिरो निहितमृधगक्षी असिन्वन्नत्ति जिह्वया वनानि ।
अत्राण्यस्मै पड्भिः सं भरन्त्युत्तानहस्ता नमसाधि विक्षु॥
verses.tr: guhā śiro nihitamṛdhagakṣī asinvannatti jihvayā vanāni atrāṇyasmai paḍbhiḥ saṃ bharantyuttānahastā namasādhi vikṣu
verses.en: His eyes are turned away, his head is hidden: unsated with his tongue he eats the fuel. With hands upraised, with reverence in the houses, for him they quickly bring his food together.

verses.sa:
प्र मातुः प्रतरं गुह्यमिच्छन्कुमारो न वीरुधः सर्पदुर्वीः ।
ससं न पक्वमविदच्छुचन्तं रिरिह्वांसं रिप उपस्थे अन्तः॥
verses.tr: pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhyamicchankumāro na vīrudhaḥ sarpadurvīḥ sasaṃ na pakvamavidacchucantaṃ ririhvāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ
verses.en: Seeking, as 'twere, his Mother's secret bosom, he, like a child, creeps on through wide-spread bushes. One he finds glowing like hot food made ready, and kissing deep within the earth's realms.

verses.sa:
तद्वामृतं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीमि जायमानो मातरा गर्भो अत्ति ।
नाहं देवस्य मर्त्यश्चिकेताऽग्निरङ्ग विचेताः स प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: tadvāmṛtaṃ rodasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti nāhaṃ devasya martyaściketā'gniraṅga vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ
verses.en: This holy Law I tell you, Earth and Heaven: the Infant at his birth devours his Parents. No knowledge of the God have I, a mortal. Yea, Agni knoweth best, for he hath wisdom.

verses.sa:
यो अस्मा अन्नं तृष्वा३दधात्याज्यैर्घृतैर्जुहोति पुष्यति ।
तस्मै सहस्रमक्षभिर्वि चक्षेऽग्ने विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि त्वम्॥
verses.tr: yo asmā annaṃ tṛṣvā3dadhātyājyairghṛtairjuhoti puṣyati tasmai sahasramakṣabhirvi cakṣe'gne viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi tvam
verses.en: This man who quickly gives him food, who offers his gifts of oil and butter and supports him, - Him with his thousand eyes he closely looks on: thou showest him thy face from all sides, Agni.

verses.sa:
किं देवेषु त्यज एनश्चकर्थाऽग्ने पृच्छामि नु त्वामविद्वान् ।
अक्रीळन्क्रीळन्हरिरत्तवेऽदन्वि पर्वशश्चकर्त गामिवासिः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaścakarthā'gne pṛcchāmi nu tvāmavidvān akrīḻankrīḻanharirattave'danvi parvaśaścakarta gāmivāsiḥ
verses.en: Agni, hast thou committed sin or treason among the Gods? In ignorance I ask thee. Playing, not playing, he gold-hued and toothless, hath cut his food up as the knife a victim.

verses.sa:
विषूचो अश्वान्युयुजे वनेजा ऋजीतिभी रशनाभिर्गृभीतान् ।
चक्षदे मित्रो वसुभिः सुजातः समानृधे पर्वभिर्वावृधानः॥
verses.tr: viṣūco aśvānyuyuje vanejā ṛjītibhī raśanābhirgṛbhītān cakṣade mitro vasubhiḥ sujātaḥ samānṛdhe parvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ
verses.en: He born in wood hath yoked his horses rushing in all directions, held with reins that glitter. The well-born friend hath carved his food with Vasus: in all his limbs he hath increased and prospered.

verses.sa:
अग्निः सप्तिं वाजम्भरं ददात्यग्निर्वीरं श्रुत्यं कर्मनिष्ठाम् ।
अग्नी रोदसी वि चरत्समञ्जन्नग्निर्नारीं वीरकुक्षिं पुरंधिम्॥
verses.tr: agniḥ saptiṃ vājambharaṃ dadātyagnirvīraṃ śrutyaṃ karmaniṣṭhām agnī rodasī vi caratsamañjannagnirnārīṃ vīrakukṣiṃ puraṃdhim
verses.en: Agni bestows the fleet prize-winning courser: Agni, the hero famed and firm in duty. Agni pervades and decks the earth and heaven, and fills the fruitful dame who teems with heroes.

verses.sa:
अग्नेरप्नसः समिदस्तु भद्राऽग्निर्मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।
अग्निरेकं चोदयत्समत्स्वग्निर्वृत्राणि दयते पुरूणि॥
verses.tr: agnerapnasaḥ samidastu bhadrā'gnirmahī rodasī ā viveśa agnirekaṃ codayatsamatsvagnirvṛtrāṇi dayate purūṇi
verses.en: Blest be the wood that feeds the active Agni: within the two great worlds hath Agni entered. Agni impels a single man to battle, and with him rends in pieces many a foeman.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ह त्यं जरतः कर्णमावाऽग्निरद्भ्यो निरदहज्जरूथम् ।
अग्निरत्रिं घर्म उरुष्यदन्तरग्निर्नृमेधं प्रजयासृजत्सम्॥
verses.tr: agnirha tyaṃ jarataḥ karṇamāvā'gniradbhyo niradahajjarūtham agniratriṃ gharma uruṣyadantaragnirnṛmedhaṃ prajayāsṛjatsam
verses.en: Agni rejoiced the car of him who praised him, and from the waters burnt away Jarutha. Agni saved Atri in the fiery cave, and made Nrmedha rich with troops of children.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्दाद्द्रविणं वीरपेशा अग्निॠषिं यः सहस्रा सनोति ।
अग्निर्दिवि हव्यमा ततानाऽग्नेर्धामानि विभृता पुरुत्रा॥
verses.tr: agnirdāddraviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agniṝṣiṃ yaḥ sahasrā sanoti agnirdivi havyamā tatānā'gnerdhāmāni vibhṛtā purutrā
verses.en: Agni hath granted wealth that decks the hero, and sent the sage who wins a thousand cattle. Agni hath made oblations rise to heaven: to every place are Agni's laws extended.

verses.sa:
अग्निमुक्थैॠषयो वि ह्वयन्तेऽग्निं नरो यामनि बाधितासः ।
अग्निं वयो अन्तरिक्षे पतन्तोऽग्निः सहस्रा परि याति गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: agnimukthaiṝṣayo vi hvayante'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām
verses.en: With songs of praise the Rsis call on Agni; on Agni, heroes worsted in the foray. Birds flying in the region call on Agni around a thousand cattle Agni wanders.

verses.sa:
अग्निं विश ईळते मानुषीर्या अग्निं मनुषो नहुषो वि जाताः ।
अग्निर्गान्धर्वीं पथ्यामृतस्याऽग्नेर्गव्यूतिर्घृत आ निषत्ता॥
verses.tr: agniṃ viśa īḻate mānuṣīryā agniṃ manuṣo nahuṣo vi jātāḥ agnirgāndharvīṃ pathyāmṛtasyā'gnergavyūtirghṛta ā niṣattā
verses.en: Races of human birth pay Agni worship, men who have sprung from Nahus' line adore him. Stablished in holy oil is Agni's pasture, on the Gandharva path of Law and Order.

verses.sa:
अग्नये ब्रह्म ऋभवस्ततक्षुरग्निं महामवोचामा सुवृक्तिम् ।
अग्ने प्राव जरितारं यविष्ठाऽग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: agnaye brahma ṛbhavastatakṣuragniṃ mahāmavocāmā suvṛktim agne prāva jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭhā'gne mahi draviṇamā yajasva
verses.en: The Rbhus fabricated prayer for Agni, and we with mighty hymns have called on Agni. Agni, Most Youthful God, protect the singer: win us by worship, Agni, great possessions.

verses.sa:
य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत्पिता नः ।
स आशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdatpitā naḥ sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarāṃ ā viveśa
verses.en: He who sate down as Hotar-priest, the Rsi, our Father, offering up all things existing,- He, seeking through his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.

verses.sa:
किं स्विदासीदधिष्ठानमारम्भणं कतमत्स्वित्कथासीत् ।
यतो भूमिं जनयन्विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathāsīt yato bhūmiṃ janayanviśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ
verses.en: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that supported him? How was it? Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens.

verses.sa:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात् ।
सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन्देव एकः॥
verses.tr: viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayandeva ekaḥ
verses.en: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He, the Sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them, with his arms as wings, together.

verses.sa:
किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तद्यदध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन्॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan
verses.en: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा ।
शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ
verses.en: Nine highest, lowest, sacrificial natures, and these thy mid-most here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessed, and come thyself, exalted, to our worship.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām muhyantvanye abhito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu
verses.en: Bring thou thyself, exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let other men around us live in folly here let us have a rich and liberal patron.

verses.sa:
वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम ।
स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा॥
verses.tr: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā
verses.en: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous.

verses.sa:
चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेने अजनन्नन्नमाने ।
यदेदन्ता अददृहन्त पूर्व आदिद्द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम्॥
verses.tr: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannannamāne yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādiddyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām
verses.en: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness. Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मा विमना आद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत संदृक् ।
तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तऋषीन्पर एकमाहुः॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā saptaṛṣīnpara ekamāhuḥ
verses.en: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence. Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One, beyond the Seven Rsis.

verses.sa:
यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा ।
यो देवानां नामधा एक एव तं सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā
verses.en: Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing, Even he alone, the Deities' name-giver, him other beings seek for information.

verses.sa:
त आयजन्त द्रविणं समस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना ।
असूर्ते सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि॥
verses.tr: ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni
verses.en: To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,-Rsis of old, in numerous troops, as singers, Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.

verses.sa:
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति ।
कं स्विद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त विश्वे॥
verses.tr: paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti kaṃ svidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve
verses.en: That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and Gods had being,- What was the germ primeval which the waters received where all the Gods were seen together?

verses.sa:
तमिद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे ।
अजस्य नाभावध्येकमर्पितं यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together. It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.

verses.sa:
न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानाऽन्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव ।
नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चाऽसुतृप उक्थशासश्चरन्ति॥
verses.tr: na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānā'nyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cā'sutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti
verses.en: Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you. Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters wander and are discontented.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मन्योऽविधद्वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक् ।
साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता॥
verses.tr: yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā
verses.en: He who hath reverenced thee, Manyu, destructive bolt, breeds for himself forthwith all conquering energy. Arya and Dasa will we conquer with thine aid, with thee the Conqueror, with conquest conquest-sped.

verses.sa:
मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
मन्युं विश ईळते मानुषीर्याः पाहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ manyuṃ viśa īḻate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Manyu was Indra, yea, the God, was Manyu, Manyu was Hotar, Varuna, Jatavedas. The tribes of human lineage worship Manyu. Accordant with thy fervour, Manyu, guard us.

verses.sa:
अभीहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान्तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून् ।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः॥
verses.tr: abhīhi manyo tavasastavīyāntapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ
verses.en: Come hither, Manyu, mightier than the mighty; chase, with thy fervour for ally, our foemen. Slayer of foes, of Vrtra, and of Dasyu, bring thou to us all kinds of wealth and treasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयम्भूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः ।
विश्वचर्षणिः सहुरिः सहावानस्मास्वोजः पृतनासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayambhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahāvānasmāsvojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi
verses.en: For thou art, Manyu, of surpassing vigour, fierce, queller of the foe, and self-existent, Shared by all men, victorious, subduer: vouchsafe to us superior strength in battles.

verses.sa:
अभागः सन्नप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः ।
तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीळाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदेयाय मेहि॥
verses.tr: abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḻāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladeyāya mehi
verses.en: I have departed, still without a portion, wise God! according to thy will, the Mighty. I, feeble man, was wroth thee, O Manyu I am myself; come thou to give me vigour.

verses.sa:
अयं ते अस्म्युप मेह्यर्वाङ्प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वधायः ।
मन्यो वज्रिन्नभि मामा ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूँरुत बोध्यापेः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te asmyupa mehyarvāṅpratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ manyo vajrinnabhi māmā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃruta bodhyāpeḥ
verses.en: Come hither. I am all thine own; advancing turn thou to me, Victorious, All-supporter! Come to me, Manyu, Wielder of the Thunder: bethink thee of thy friend, and slay the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ।
जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभा उपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव॥
verses.tr: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva
verses.en: Approach, and on my right hand hold thy station: so shall we slay a multitude of foemen. The best of meath I offer to support thee: may we be first to drink thereof in quiet.

verses.sa:
त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणासो धृषिता मरुत्वः ।
तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना अभि प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः॥
verses.tr: tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇāso dhṛṣitā marutvaḥ tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā abhi pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ
verses.en: Borne on with thee, O Manyu girt by Maruts, let our brave men, impetuous, bursting forward, March on, like flames of fire in form, exulting, with pointed arrows, sharpening their weapons.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि ।
हत्वाय शत्रून्वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi hatvāya śatrūnvi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.en: Flashing like fire, be thou, O conquering Manyu, invoked, O Victor, as our army's leader. Slay thou our foes, distribute their possessions: show forth thy vigour, scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa:
सहस्व मन्यो अभिमातिमस्मे रुजन्मृणन्प्रमृणन्प्रेहि शत्रून् ।
उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयस एकज त्वम्॥
verses.tr: sahasva manyo abhimātimasme rujanmṛṇanpramṛṇanprehi śatrūn ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam
verses.en: O Manyu, overcome thou our assailant on! breaking, slaying, crushing down the foemen. They have not hindered thine impetuous vigour: Mighty, Sole born! thou makest them thy subjects.

verses.sa:
एको बहूनामसि मन्यवीळितो विशंविशं युधये सं शिशाधि ।
अकृत्तरुक्त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्महे॥
verses.tr: eko bahūnāmasi manyavīḻito viśaṃviśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi akṛttaruktvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe
verses.en: Alone or many thou art worshipped, Manyu: sharpen the spirit of each clan for battle. With thee to aid, O thou of perfect splendour, we will uplift the glorious shout for conquest.

verses.sa:
विजेषकृदिन्द्र इवानवब्रवो३ऽस्माकं मन्यो अधिपा भवेह ।
प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ॥
verses.tr: vijeṣakṛdindra ivānavabravo3'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha
verses.en: Unyielding bringing victory like Indra, O Manyu, be thou here our Sovran Ruler. To thy dear name, O Victor, we sing praises: we know the spring from which thou art come hither.

verses.sa:
आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्ष्यभिभूत उत्तरम् ।
क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि॥
verses.tr: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣyabhibhūta uttaram kratvā no manyo saha medyedhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji
verses.en: Twin-born with power, destructive bolt of thunder, the highest conquering might is thine, Subduer! Be friendly to its in thy spirit, Manyu, O Much-invoked, in shock of mighty battle.

verses.sa:
संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं दत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः ।
भियं दधाना हृदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ bhiyaṃ dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām
verses.en: For spoil let Varuna and Manyu give us the wealth of both sides gathered and collected; And let our enemies with stricken spirits, o'erwhelmed with terror, slink away defeated.

verses.sa: सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः । ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ ṛtenādityāstiṣṭhanti divi somo adhi śritaḥ
verses.en: Truth is the base that bears the earth; by Surya are the heavens sustained. By Law the Adityas stand secure, and Soma holds his place in heaven.

verses.sa: सोमेनादित्या बलिनः सोमेन पृथिवी मही । अथो नक्षत्राणामेषामुपस्थे सोम आहितः॥
verses.tr: somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī atho nakṣatrāṇāmeṣāmupasthe soma āhitaḥ
verses.en: By Soma are the Adityas strong, by Soma mighty is the earth. Thus Soma in the midst of all these constellations hath his place.

verses.sa: सोमं मन्यते पपिवान्यत्सम्पिंषन्त्योषधिम् । सोमं यं ब्रह्माणो विदुर्न तस्याश्नाति कश्चन॥
verses.tr: somaṃ manyate papivānyatsampiṃṣantyoṣadhim somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidurna tasyāśnāti kaścana
verses.en: One thinks, when they have brayed the plant, that he hath drunk the Soma's juice; Of him whom Brahmans truly know as Soma no one ever tastes.

verses.sa: आच्छद्विधानैर्गुपितो बार्हतैः सोम रक्षितः । ग्राव्णामिच्छृण्वन्तिष्ठसि न ते अश्नाति पार्थिवः॥
verses.tr: ācchadvidhānairgupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ grāvṇāmicchṛṇvantiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ
verses.en: Soma, secured by sheltering rules, guarded by hymns in Brhati, Thou standest listening to the stones none tastes of thee who dwells on earth.

verses.sa: यत्त्वा देव प्रपिबन्ति तत आ प्यायसे पुनः । वायुः सोमस्य रक्षिता समानां मास आकृतिः॥
verses.tr: yattvā deva prapibanti tata ā pyāyase punaḥ vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ
verses.en: When they begin to drink thee then, O God, thou swellest out again. Vayu is Soma's guardian God. The Moon is that which shapes the years.

verses.sa: रैभ्यासीदनुदेयी नाराशंसी न्योचनी । सूर्याया भद्रमिद्वासो गाथयैति परिष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: raibhyāsīdanudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī sūryāyā bhadramidvāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtam
verses.en: Raibhi was her dear bridal friend, and Narasamsi led her home. Lovely was Surya's robe: she came to that which Gatha had adorned.

verses.sa: चित्तिरा उपबर्हणं चक्षुरा अभ्यञ्जनम् । द्यौर्भूमिः कोश आसीद्यदयात्सूर्या पतिम्॥
verses.tr: cittirā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣurā abhyañjanam dyaurbhūmiḥ kośa āsīdyadayātsūryā patim
verses.en: Thought was the pillow of her couch, sight was the unguent for her eyes: Her treasury was earth and heaven when Surya went unto her Lord.

verses.sa: स्तोमा आसन्प्रतिधयः कुरीरं छन्द ओपशः । सूर्याया अश्विना वराऽग्निरासीत्पुरोगवः॥
verses.tr: stomā āsanpratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ sūryāyā aśvinā varā'gnirāsītpurogavaḥ
verses.en: Hymns were the cross-bars of the pole, Kurira-metre decked the car: The bridesmen were the Asvin Pair Agni was leader of the train.

verses.sa: सोमो वधूयुरभवदश्विनास्तामुभा वरा । सूर्यां यत्पत्ये शंसन्तीं मनसा सविताददात्॥
verses.tr: somo vadhūyurabhavadaśvināstāmubhā varā sūryāṃ yatpatye śaṃsantīṃ manasā savitādadāt
verses.en: Soma was he who wooed the maid: the groomsmen were both Asvins, when The Sun-God Savitar bestowed his willing Surya on her Lord.

verses.sa: मनो अस्या अन आसीद्द्यौरासीदुत च्छदिः । शुक्रावनड्वाहावास्तां यदयात्सूर्या गृहम्॥
verses.tr: mano asyā ana āsīddyaurāsīduta cchadiḥ śukrāvanaḍvāhāvāstāṃ yadayātsūryā gṛham
verses.en: Her spirit was the bridal car; the covering thereof was heaven: Bright were both Steers that drew it when Surya approached her husband's, home.

verses.sa: ऋक्सामाभ्यामभिहितौ गावौ ते सामनावितः । श्रोत्रं ते चक्रे आस्तां दिवि पन्थाश्चराचारः॥
verses.tr: ṛksāmābhyāmabhihitau gāvau te sāmanāvitaḥ śrotraṃ te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāścarācāraḥ
verses.en: Thy Steers were steady, kept in place by holy verse and Sama-hymn: All car were thy two chariot wheels: thy path was tremulous in the sky,

verses.sa: शुची ते चक्रे यात्या व्यानो अक्ष आहतः । अनो मनस्मयं सूर्याऽऽरोहत्प्रयती पतिम्॥
verses.tr: śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ ano manasmayaṃ sūryā''rohatprayatī patim
verses.en: Clean, as thou wentest, were thy wheels wind, was the axle fastened there. Surya, proceeding to her Lord, mounted a spirit-fashioned car.

verses.sa: सूर्याया वहतुः प्रागात्सविता यमवासृजत् । अघासु हन्यन्ते गावोऽर्जुन्योः पर्युह्यते॥
verses.tr: sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgātsavitā yamavāsṛjat aghāsu hanyante gāvo'rjunyoḥ paryuhyate
verses.en: The bridal pomp of Surya, which Savitar started, moved along. In Magha days are oxen slain, in Arjuris they wed the bride.

verses.sa:
यदश्विना पृच्छमानावयातं त्रिचक्रेण वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तद्वामजानन्पुत्रः पितराववृणीत पूषा॥
verses.tr: yadaśvinā pṛcchamānāvayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ viśve devā anu tadvāmajānanputraḥ pitarāvavṛṇīta pūṣā
verses.en: When on your three-wheeled chariot, O Asvins, ye came as wooers unto Surya's bridal, Then all the Gods agreed to your proposal Pusan as Son elected you as Fathers.

verses.sa: यदयातं शुभस्पती वरेयं सूर्यामुप । क्वैकं चक्रं वामासीत्क्व देष्ट्राय तस्थथुः॥
verses.tr: yadayātaṃ śubhaspatī vareyaṃ sūryāmupa kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vāmāsītkva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ
verses.en: O ye Two Lords of lustre, then when ye to Surya's wooing came, Where was one chariot wheel of yours? Where stood ye for die Sire's command?

verses.sa: द्वे ते चक्रे सूर्ये ब्रह्माण ऋतुथा विदुः । अथैकं चक्रं यद्गुहा तदद्धातय इद्विदुः॥
verses.tr: dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ athaikaṃ cakraṃ yadguhā tadaddhātaya idviduḥ
verses.en: The Brahmans, by their seasons, know, O Surya, those two wheels of thine: One kept concealed, those only who are skilled in highest truths have learned.

verses.sa: सूर्यायै देवेभ्यो मित्राय वरुणाय च । ये भूतस्य प्रचेतस इदं तेभ्योऽकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca ye bhūtasya pracetasa idaṃ tebhyo'karaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: To Surya and the Deities, to Mitra and to Varuna. Who know aright the thing that is, this adoration have I paid.

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीळन्तौ परि यातो अध्वरम् ।
विश्वान्यन्यो भुवनाभिचष्ट ऋतूँरन्यो विदधज्जायते पुनः॥
verses.tr: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḻantau pari yāto adhvaram viśvānyanyo bhuvanābhicaṣṭa ṛtūṃranyo vidadhajjāyate punaḥ
verses.en: By their own power these Twain in close succession move; They go as playing children round the sacrifice. One of the Pair beholdeth all existing things; the other ordereth seasons and is born again.

verses.sa:
नवोनवो भवति जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेत्यग्रम् ।
भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधात्यायन्प्र चन्द्रमास्तिरते दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: navonavo bhavati jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmetyagram bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhātyāyanpra candramāstirate dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: He, born afresh, is new and new for ever ensign of days he goes before the Mornings Coming, he orders f6r the Gods their portion. The Moon prolongs the days of our existence.

verses.sa:
सुकिंशुकं शल्मलिं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुवृतं सुचक्रम् ।
आ रोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य लोकं स्योनं पत्ये वहतुं कृणुष्व॥
verses.tr: sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram ā roha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonaṃ patye vahatuṃ kṛṇuṣva
verses.en: Mount this, all-shaped, gold-hued, with strong wheels, fashioned of Kimsuka and Salmali, light-rolling, Bound for the world of life immortal, Surya: make for thy lord a happy bridal journey.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्वातः पतिवती ह्ये३षा विश्वावसुं नमसा गीर्भिरीळे ।
अन्यामिच्छ पितृषदं व्यक्तां स ते भागो जनुषा तस्य विद्धि॥
verses.tr: udīrṣvātaḥ pativatī hye3ṣā viśvāvasuṃ namasā gīrbhirīḻe anyāmiccha pitṛṣadaṃ vyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi
verses.en: Rise up from hence: this maiden hath a husband. I laud Visvavasu with hymns and homage. Seek in her father's home another fair one, and find the portion from of old assigned thee.

verses.sa: उदीर्ष्वातो विश्वावसो नमसेळा महे त्वा । अन्यामिच्छ प्रफर्व्यं१ सं जायां पत्या सृज॥
verses.tr: udīrṣvāto viśvāvaso namaseḻā mahe tvā anyāmiccha prapharvyaṃ1 saṃ jāyāṃ patyā sṛja
verses.en: Rise up from hence, Visvavasu: with reverence we worship thee. Seek thou another willing maid, and with her husband leave the bride.

verses.sa:
अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्था येभिः सखायो यन्ति नो वरेयम् ।
समर्यमा सं भगो नो निनीयात्सं जास्पत्यं सुयममस्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam samaryamā saṃ bhago no ninīyātsaṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devāḥ
verses.en: Straight in direction be the paths, and thornless, whereon our fellows travel to the wooing. Let Aryaman and Bhaga lead us: perfect, O Gods, the union of the wife and husband.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद्येन त्वाबध्नात्सविता सुशेवः ।
ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोकेऽरिष्टां त्वा सह पत्या दधामि॥
verses.tr: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśādyena tvābadhnātsavitā suśevaḥ ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke'riṣṭāṃ tvā saha patyā dadhāmi
verses.en: Now from the noose of Varuna I free thee, wherewith Most Blessed Savitar hath bound thee. In Law's seat, to the world of virtuous action, I give thee up uninjured with thy consort.

verses.sa: प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः सुबद्धाममुतस्करम् । यथेयमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रा सुभगासति॥
verses.tr: preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskaram yatheyamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati
verses.en: Hence, and not thence, I send these free. I make thee softly fettered there. That, Bounteous Indra, she may live blest in her fortune and her sons.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतो नयतु हस्तगृह्याऽश्विना त्वा प्र वहतां रथेन ।
गृहान्गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो वशिनी त्वं विदथमा वदासि॥
verses.tr: pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyā'śvinā tvā pra vahatāṃ rathena gṛhāngaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathamā vadāsi
verses.en: Let Pusan take thy hand and hence conduct thee; may the two Asvins on their car transport thee. Go to the house to be the household's mistress and speak as lady ito thy gathered people.

verses.sa:
इह प्रियं प्रजया ते समृध्यतामस्मिन्गृहे गार्हपत्याय जागृहि ।
एना पत्या तन्वं१ सं सृजस्वाधा जिव्री विदथमा वदाथः॥
verses.tr: iha priyaṃ prajayā te samṛdhyatāmasmingṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi enā patyā tanvaṃ1 saṃ sṛjasvādhā jivrī vidathamā vadāthaḥ
verses.en: Happy be thou and prosper with thy children here: be vigilant to rule thy household in this home. Closely unite thy body with this; man, thy lord. So shall ye, full of years, address your company.

verses.sa: नीललोहितं भवति कृत्यासक्तिर्व्यज्यते । एधन्ते अस्या ज्ञातयः पतिर्बन्धेषु बध्यते॥
verses.tr: nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyāsaktirvyajyate edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patirbandheṣu badhyate
verses.en: Her hue is blue and red: the fiend who clingeth close is driven off. Well thrive the kinsmen of this bride the husband is bound fast in bonds.

verses.sa: परा देहि शामुल्यं ब्रह्मभ्यो वि भजा वसु । कृत्यैषा पद्वती भूत्व्या जाया विशते पतिम्॥
verses.tr: parā dehi śāmulyaṃ brahmabhyo vi bhajā vasu kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvyā jāyā viśate patim
verses.en: Give thou the woollen robe away: deal treasure to the Brahman priests. This female fiend hath got her feet, and as a wife attends her lord.

verses.sa: अश्रीरा तनूर्भवति रुशती पापयामुया । पतिर्यद्वध्वो३ वाससा स्वमङ्गमभिधित्सते॥
verses.tr: aśrīrā tanūrbhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā patiryadvadhvo3 vāsasā svamaṅgamabhidhitsate
verses.en: Unlovely is his body when it glistens with this wicked fiend, What time the husband wraps about his limbs the garment of his wife.

verses.sa: ये वध्वश्चन्द्रं वहतुं यक्ष्मा यन्ति जनादनु । पुनस्तान्यज्ञिया देवा नयन्तु यत आगताः ॥३॥
verses.tr: ye vadhvaścandraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janādanu punastānyajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ 3
verses.en: Consumptions, from her people, which follow the bride's resplendent train,- These let the Holy Gods again bear to the place from which they came.

verses.sa: मा विदन्परिपन्थिनो य आसीदन्ति दम्पती । सुगेभिर्दुर्गमतीतामप द्रान्त्वरातयः॥
verses.tr: mā vidanparipanthino ya āsīdanti dampatī sugebhirdurgamatītāmapa drāntvarātayaḥ
verses.en: Let not the highway thieves who lie in ambush find the wedded pair. By pleasant ways let them escape the danger, and let foes depart.

verses.sa: सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूरिमां समेत पश्यत । सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वायाऽथास्तं वि परेतन॥
verses.tr: sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyā'thāstaṃ vi paretana
verses.en: Signs of good fortune mark the bride come all of you and look at her. Wish her prosperity, and then return unto your homes again.

verses.sa: तृष्टमेतत्कटुकमेतदपाष्ठवद्विषवन्नैतदत्तवे । सूर्यां यो ब्रह्मा विद्यात्स इद्वाधूयमर्हति॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṭametatkaṭukametadapāṣṭhavadviṣavannaitadattave sūryāṃ yo brahmā vidyātsa idvādhūyamarhati
verses.en: Pungent is this, and bitter this, filled, as it were, with arrow-barbs, Empoisoned and not fit for use. The Brahman who knows Surya well deserves the garment of the bride.

verses.sa: आशसनं विशसनमथो अधिविकर्तनम् । सूर्यायाः पश्य रूपाणि तानि ब्रह्मा तु शुन्धति॥
verses.tr: āśasanaṃ viśasanamatho adhivikartanam sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmā tu śundhati
verses.en: The fringe, the cloth that decks her head, and then the triply parted robe,- Behold the hues which Surya wears these doth the Brahman purify.

verses.sa:
गृभ्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः ।
भगो अर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर्मह्यं त्वादुर्गार्हपत्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhirmahyaṃ tvādurgārhapatyāya devāḥ
verses.en: I take thy hand in mine for happy fortune that thou mayst reach old age with me thy husband. Gods, Aryaman, Bhaga, Savitar, Purandhi, have given thee to be my household's mistress.

verses.sa:
तां पूषञ्छिवतमामेरयस्व यस्यां बीजं मनुष्या३ वपन्ति ।
या न ऊरू उशती विश्रयाते यस्यामुशन्तः प्रहराम शेपम्॥
verses.tr: tāṃ pūṣañchivatamāmerayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā3 vapanti yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāte yasyāmuśantaḥ praharāma śepam
verses.en: O Pusan, send her on as most auspicious, her who shall be the sharer of my pleasures; Her who shall twine her loving arms about me, and welcome all my love and mine embraces.

verses.sa: तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यवहन्त्सूर्यां वहतुना सह । पुनः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह॥
verses.tr: tubhyamagre paryavahantsūryāṃ vahatunā saha punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha
verses.en: For thee, with bridal train, they, first, escorted Surya to her home. Give to the husband in return, Agni, the wife with progeny.

verses.sa: पुनः पत्नीमग्निरदादायुषा सह वर्चसा । दीर्घायुरस्या यः पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: punaḥ patnīmagniradādāyuṣā saha varcasā dīrghāyurasyā yaḥ patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: Agni hath given the bride again with splendour and with ample life. Long lived be he who is her lord; a hundred autumns let him live.

verses.sa: सोमः प्रथमो विविदे गन्धर्वो विविद उत्तरः । तृतीयो अग्निष्टे पतिस्तुरीयस्ते मनुष्यजाः॥
verses.tr: somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ tṛtīyo agniṣṭe patisturīyaste manuṣyajāḥ
verses.en: Soma obtained her first of all; next the Gandharva was her lord. Agni was thy third husband: now one born of woman is thy fourth.

verses.sa: सोमो ददद्गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो दददग्नये । रयिं च पुत्राँश्चादादग्निर्मह्यमथो इमाम्॥
verses.tr: somo dadadgandharvāya gandharvo dadadagnaye rayiṃ ca putrāṃścādādagnirmahyamatho imām
verses.en: Soma to the Gandharva, and to Agni the Gandharva gave: And Agni hath bestowed on me riches and sons and this my spouse.

verses.sa: इहैव स्तं मा वि यौष्टं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतम् । क्रीळन्तौ पुत्रैर्नप्तृभिर्मोदमानौ स्वे गृहे॥
verses.tr: ihaiva staṃ mā vi yauṣṭaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnutam krīḻantau putrairnaptṛbhirmodamānau sve gṛhe
verses.en: Be ye not parted; dwell ye here reach the full time of human life. With sons and grandsons sport and play, rejoicing in your own abode.

verses.sa:
आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिराजरसाय समनक्त्वर्यमा ।
अदुर्मङ्गलीः पतिलोकमा विश शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatirājarasāya samanaktvaryamā adurmaṅgalīḥ patilokamā viśa śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: So may Prajapati bring children forth to us; may Aryaman adorn us till old age come nigh. Not inauspicious enter thou thy husband's house: bring blessing to our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
अघोरचक्षुरपतिघ्न्येधि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुमनाः सुवर्चाः ।
वीरसूर्देवकामा स्योना शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: aghoracakṣurapatighnyedhi śivā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvarcāḥ vīrasūrdevakāmā syonā śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Not evil-eyed, no slayer of thy husband, bring weal to cattle, radiant, gentlehearted; Loving the Gods, delightful, bearing heroes, bring blessing to our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa: इमां त्वमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रां सुभगां कृणु । दशास्यां पुत्राना धेहि पतिमेकादशं कृधि॥
verses.tr: imāṃ tvamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrāṃ subhagāṃ kṛṇu daśāsyāṃ putrānā dhehi patimekādaśaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: O Bounteous Indra, make this bride blest in her sons and fortunate. Vouchsafe to her ten sons, and make her husband the eleventh man.

verses.sa: सम्राज्ञी श्वशुरे भव सम्राज्ञी श्वश्र्वां भव । ननान्दरि सम्राज्ञी भव सम्राज्ञी अधि देवृषु॥
verses.tr: samrājñī śvaśure bhava samrājñī śvaśrvāṃ bhava nanāndari samrājñī bhava samrājñī adhi devṛṣu
verses.en: Over thy husband's father and thy husband's mother bear full sway. Over the sister of thy lord, over his brothers rule supreme.

verses.sa: समञ्जन्तु विश्वे देवाः समापो हृदयानि नौ । सं मातरिश्वा सं धाता समु देष्ट्री दधातु नौ॥
verses.tr: samañjantu viśve devāḥ samāpo hṛdayāni nau saṃ mātariśvā saṃ dhātā samu deṣṭrī dadhātu nau
verses.en: So may the Universal Gods, so may the Waters join our hearts. May Matarisvan, Dhatar, and Destri together bind us close.

verses.sa:
वि हि सोतोरसृक्षत नेन्द्रं देवममंसत ।
यत्रामदद्वृषाकपिरर्यः पुष्टेषु मत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vi hi sotorasṛkṣata nendraṃ devamamaṃsata yatrāmadadvṛṣākapiraryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Men have abstained from pouring juice they count not Indra as a God. Where at the votary's store my friend Vrsakapi hath drunk his fill. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
परा हीन्द्र धावसि वृषाकपेरति व्यथिः ।
नो अह प्र विन्दस्यन्यत्र सोमपीतये विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaperati vyathiḥ no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, heedless passest by the ill Vrsakapi hath wrought; Yet nowhere else thou findest place wherein to drink the Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
किमयं त्वां वृषाकपिश्चकार हरितो मृगः ।
यस्मा इरस्यसीदु न्व१र्यो वा पुष्टिमद्वसु विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: kimayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiścakāra harito mṛgaḥ yasmā irasyasīdu nva1ryo vā puṣṭimadvasu viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: What hath he done to injure thee, this tawny beast Vrsakapi, With whom thou art so angry now? What is the votary's foodful store? Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
यमिमं त्वं वृषाकपिं प्रियमिन्द्राभिरक्षसि ।
श्वा न्वस्य जम्भिषदपि कर्णे वराहयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: yamimaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ priyamindrābhirakṣasi śvā nvasya jambhiṣadapi karṇe varāhayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Soon may the hound who hunts the boar seize him and bite him in the car, O Indra, that Vrsakapi whom thou protectest as a friend, Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
प्रिया तष्टानि मे कपिर्व्यक्ता व्यदूदुषत् ।
शिरो न्वस्य राविषं न सुगं दुष्कृते भुवं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: priyā taṣṭāni me kapirvyaktā vyadūduṣat śiro nvasya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Kapi hath marred the beauteous things, all deftly wrought, that were my joy. In pieces will I rend his head; the sinner's portion shall be woe. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
न मत्स्त्री सुभसत्तरा न सुयाशुतरा भुवत् ।
न मत्प्रतिच्यवीयसी न सक्थ्युद्यमीयसी विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: na matstrī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat na matpraticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: No Dame hath ampler charms than 1, or greater wealth of love's delights. None with more ardour offers all her beauty to her lord's embrace. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
उवे अम्ब सुलाभिके यथेवाङ्ग भविष्यति ।
भसन्मे अम्ब सक्थि मे शिरो मे वीव हृष्यति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅga bhaviṣyati bhasanme amba sakthi me śiro me vīva hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Mother whose love is quickly won, I say what verily will be. My breast, O Mother, and my head and both my hips seem quivering. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
किं सुबाहो स्वङ्गुरे पृथुष्टो पृथुजाघने ।
किं शूरपत्नि नस्त्वमभ्यमीषि वृषाकपिं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane kiṃ śūrapatni nastvamabhyamīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Dame with the lovely hands and arms, with broad hair-plaits add ample hips, Why, O thou Hero's wife, art thou angry with our Vrsakapi? Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
अवीरामिव मामयं शरारुरभि मन्यते ।
उताहमस्मि वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी मरुत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārurabhi manyate utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: This noxious creature looks on me as one bereft of hero's love, Yet Heroes for my sons have I, the Maruts' Friend and Indra's Queen. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
संहोत्रं स्म पुरा नारी समनं वाव गच्छति ।
वेधा ऋतस्य वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी महीयते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: From olden time the matron goes to feast and general sacrifice. Mother of Heroes, Indra's Queen, the rite's ordainer is extolled. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राणीमासु नारिषु सुभगामहमश्रवम् ।
नह्यस्या अपरं चन जरसा मरते पतिर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu subhagāmahamaśravam nahyasyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: So have I heard Indrani called most fortunate among these Dames, For never shall her Consort die in future time through length of days. Supreme is Indra overall.

verses.sa:
नाहमिन्द्राणि रारण सख्युर्वृषाकपेॠते ।
यस्येदमप्यं हविः प्रियं देवेषु गच्छति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākapeṝte yasyedamapyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Never, Indralni, have I joyed without my friend Vrsakapi, Whose welcome offering here, made pure with water, goeth to the Gods. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
वृषाकपायि रेवति सुपुत्र आदु सुस्नुषे ।
घसत्त इन्द्र उक्षणः प्रियं काचित्करं हविर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ādu susnuṣe ghasatta indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Wealthy Vrsakapayi, blest with sons and consorts of thy sons,

verses.sa:
उक्ष्णो हि मे पञ्चदश साकं पचन्ति विंशतिम् ।
उताहमद्मि पीव इदुभा कुक्षी पृणन्ति मे विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim utāhamadmi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: The planets and satellites whose motion is seen to be destroyed in the sky are thirty-five. In the beginning, all the planets and satellites were dependent on the last part of Revati Tara, they started moving according to the divine law, separated from Revati Tara.

verses.sa:
वृषभो न तिग्मशृङ्गोऽन्तर्यूथेषु रोरुवत् ।
मन्थस्त इन्द्र शं हृदे यं ते सुनोति भावयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo'ntaryūtheṣu roruvat manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Like as a bull with pointed horn, loud bellowing amid the herds, Sweet to thine heart, O Indra, is the brew which she who tends thee pours. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
न सेशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या३ कपृत् ।
सेदीशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: na seśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā3 kapṛt sedīśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

verses.sa:
न सेशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते ।
सेदीशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या३ कपृद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: na seśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate sedīśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā3 kapṛdviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

verses.sa:
अयमिन्द्र वृषाकपिः परस्वन्तं हतं विदत् ।
असिं सूनां नवं चरुमादेधस्यान आचितं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ayamindra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carumādedhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: O Indra this Vrsakapi hath found a slain wild animal, Dresser, and new-made pan, and knife, and wagon with a load of wood. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
अयमेमि विचाकशद्विचिन्वन्दासमार्यम् ।
पिबामि पाकसुत्वनोऽभि धीरमचाकशं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: ayamemi vicākaśadvicinvandāsamāryam pibāmi pākasutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Distinguishing the Dasa and the Arya, viewing all, I go. I look upon the wise, and drink the simple votary's Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
धन्व च यत्कृन्तत्रं च कति स्वित्ता वि योजना ।
नेदीयसो वृषाकपेऽस्तमेहि गृहाँ उप विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: dhanva ca yatkṛntatraṃ ca kati svittā vi yojanā nedīyaso vṛṣākape'stamehi gṛhāṃ upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: The desert plains and steep descents, how many leagues in length they spread! Go to the nearest houses, go unto thine home, Vrsakapi. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
पुनरेहि वृषाकपे सुविता कल्पयावहै ।
य एष स्वप्ननंशनोऽस्तमेषि पथा पुनर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano'stameṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
