verses.en: Turn thee again Vrsakapi: we twain will bring thee happiness. Thou goest homeward on thy way along this path which leads to sleep. Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
यदुदञ्चो वृषाकपे गृहमिन्द्राजगन्तन ।
क्व१ स्य पुल्वघो मृगः कमगञ्जनयोपनो विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: yadudañco vṛṣākape gṛhamindrājagantana kva1 sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kamagañjanayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: When, Indra and Vrsakapi, ye travelled upward to your home, Where was that noisome beast, to whom went it, the beast that troubles man? Supreme is Indra over all.

verses.sa:
पर्शुर्ह नाम मानवी साकं ससूव विंशतिम् ।
भद्रं भल त्यस्या अभूद्यस्या उदरमामयद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः॥
verses.tr: parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim bhadraṃ bhala tyasyā abhūdyasyā udaramāmayadviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
verses.en: Daughter of Manu, Parsu bare a score of children at a birth. Her portion verily was bliss although her burthen caused her grief.

verses.sa:
रक्षोहणं वाजिनमा जिघर्मि मित्रं प्रथिष्ठमुप यामि शर्म ।
शिशानो अग्निः क्रतुभिः समिद्धः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam
verses.en: I BALM with oil the mighty Raksas-slayer; to the most famous Friend I come for shelter Enkindled, sharpened by our rites, may Agni protect us in the day and night from evil.

verses.sa:
अयोदंष्ट्रो अर्चिषा यातुधानानुप स्पृश जातवेदः समिद्धः ।
आ जिह्वया मूरदेवान्रभस्व क्रव्यादो वृक्त्व्यपि धत्स्वासन्॥
verses.tr: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ ā jihvayā mūradevānrabhasva kravyādo vṛktvyapi dhatsvāsan
verses.en: O Jatavedas with the teeth of iron, enkindled with thy flame attack the demons. Seize with thy longue the foolish gods' adorers: rend, put within thy mouth the raw-flesh caters.

verses.sa:
उभोभयाविन्नुप धेहि दंष्ट्रा हिंस्रः शिशानोऽवरं परं च ।
उतान्तरिक्षे परि याहि राजञ्जम्भैः सं धेह्यभि यातुधानान्॥
verses.tr: ubhobhayāvinnupa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca utāntarikṣe pari yāhi rājañjambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān
verses.en: Apply thy teeth, the upper and the lower, thou who hast both, enkindled and destroying. Roam also in the air, O King, around us, and with thy jaws assail the wicked spirits.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरिषूः संनममानो अग्ने वाचा शल्याँ अशनिभिर्दिहानः ।
ताभिर्विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्प्रतीचो बाहून्प्रति भङ्ध्येषाम्॥
verses.tr: yajñairiṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyāṃ aśanibhirdihānaḥ tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānānpratīco bāhūnprati bhaṅdhyeṣām
verses.en: Bending thy shafts through sacrifices, Agni, whetting their points with song as if with whetstones, Pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas, and break their arms uplifted to attack thee.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वचं यातुधानस्य भिन्धि हिंस्राशनिर्हरसा हन्त्वेनम् ।
प्र पर्वाणि जातवेदः शृणीहि क्रव्यात्क्रविष्णुर्वि चिनोतु वृक्णम्॥
verses.tr: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanirharasā hantvenam pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyātkraviṣṇurvi cinotu vṛkṇam
verses.en: Pierce through the Yatudhana's skin, O Agni; let the destroying dart with fire consume him. Rend his joints, Jatavedas, let the cater of flesh, flesh-seeking, track his mangled body.

verses.sa:
यत्रेदानीं पश्यसि जातवेदस्तिष्ठन्तमग्न उत वा चरन्तम् ।
यद्वान्तरिक्षे पथिभिः पतन्तं तमस्ता विध्य शर्वा शिशानः॥
verses.tr: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedastiṣṭhantamagna uta vā carantam yadvāntarikṣe pathibhiḥ patantaṃ tamastā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ
verses.en: Where now thou seest Agni Jatavedas, one of these demons standing still or roaming, Or flying on those paths in air's mid region, sharpen the shaft and as an archer pierce him.

verses.sa:
उतालब्धं स्पृणुहि जातवेद आलेभानादृष्टिभिर्यातुधानात् ।
अग्ने पूर्वो नि जहि शोशुचान आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्तमदन्त्वेनीः॥
verses.tr: utālabdhaṃ spṛṇuhi jātaveda ālebhānādṛṣṭibhiryātudhānāt agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkāstamadantvenīḥ
verses.en: Tear from the evil spirit, Jatavedas, what he hath seized and with his spears hath captured. Blazing before him strike him down, O Agni; let spotted carrion-eating kites devour him.

verses.sa:
इह प्र ब्रूहि यतमः सो अग्ने यो यातुधानो य इदं कृणोति ।
तमा रभस्व समिधा यविष्ठ नृचक्षसश्चक्षुषे रन्धयैनम्॥
verses.tr: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti tamā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaścakṣuṣe randhayainam
verses.en: Here tell this forth, O Agni: whosoever is, he himself, or acteth as, a demon, Him grasp, O thou Most Youthful, with thy fuel. to the Mati-seer's eye give him as booty.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णेनाग्ने चक्षुषा रक्ष यज्ञं प्राञ्चं वसुभ्यः प्र णय प्रचेतः ।
हिंस्रं रक्षांस्यभि शोशुचानं मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना नृचक्षः॥
verses.tr: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyabhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ
verses.en: With keen glance guard the sacrifice, O Agni: thou Sage, conduct it onward to the Vasus. Let not the fiends, O Man-beholder, harm thee burning against the Raksasas to slay them.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षा रक्षः परि पश्य विक्षु तस्य त्रीणि प्रति शृणीह्यग्रा ।
तस्याग्ने पृष्टीर्हरसा शृणीहि त्रेधा मूलं यातुधानस्य वृश्च॥
verses.tr: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca
verses.en: Look on the fiend mid men, as Man-beholder: rend thou his three extremities in pieces. Demolish with thy flame his ribs, O Agni, the Yatudhana's root destroy thou triply.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्यातुधानः प्रसितिं त एत्वृतं यो अग्ने अनृतेन हन्ति ।
तमर्चिषा स्फूर्जयञ्जातवेदः समक्षमेनं गृणते नि वृङ्धि॥
verses.tr: triryātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti tamarciṣā sphūrjayañjātavedaḥ samakṣamenaṃ gṛṇate ni vṛṅdhi
verses.en: Thrice, Agni, let thy noose surround the demon who with his falsehood injures Holy Order. Loud roaring with thy flame, O Jatavedas, crush him and cast him down before the singer.

verses.sa:
तदग्ने चक्षुः प्रति धेहि रेभे शफारुजं येन पश्यसि यातुधानम् ।
अथर्ववज्ज्योतिषा दैव्येन सत्यं धूर्वन्तमचितं न्योष॥
verses.tr: tadagne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujaṃ yena paśyasi yātudhānam atharvavajjyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantamacitaṃ nyoṣa
verses.en: Lead thou the worshipper that eye, O Agni, wherewith thou lookest on the hoof-armed demon. With light celestial in Atharvan's manner burn up the foot who ruins truth with falsehood.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपातो यद्वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः ।
मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या३ जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्॥
verses.tr: yadagne adya mithunā śapāto yadvācastṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ manyormanasaḥ śaravyā3 jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān
verses.en: Agni, what curse the pair this day have uttered, what heated word the worshippers have spoken, Each arrowy taunt sped from the angry spirit,-pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas.

verses.sa:
परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान्पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि ।
परार्चिषा मूरदेवाञ्छृणीहि परासुतृपो अभि शोशुचानः॥
verses.tr: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānānparāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpo abhi śośucānaḥ
verses.en: With fervent heat exterminate the demons; destroy the fiends with burning flame, O Agni. Destroy with fire the foolish gods' adorers; blaze and destroy the insatiable monsters.

verses.sa:
पराद्य देवा वृजिनं शृणन्तु प्रत्यगेनं शपथा यन्तु तृष्टाः ।
वाचास्तेनं शरव ऋच्छन्तु मर्मन्विश्वस्यैतु प्रसितिं यातुधानः॥
verses.tr: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyagenaṃ śapathā yantu tṛṣṭāḥ vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marmanviśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ
verses.en: May Gods destroy this day the evil-doer may each hot curse of his return and blast him. Let arrows pierce the liar in his vitals, and Visva's net enclose the Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यः पौरुषेयेण क्रविषा समङ्क्ते यो अश्व्येन पशुना यातुधानः ।
यो अघ्न्याया भरति क्षीरमग्ने तेषां शीर्षाणि हरसापि वृश्च॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca
verses.en: The fiend who smears himself with flesh of cattle, with flesh of horses and of human bodies, Who steals the milch-cow's milk away, O Agni,-tear off the heads of such with fiery fury.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरीणं पय उस्रियायास्तस्य माशीद्यातुधानो नृचक्षः ।
पीयूषमग्ने यतमस्तितृप्सात्तं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा विध्य मर्मन्॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyāstasya māśīdyātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ pīyūṣamagne yatamastitṛpsāttaṃ pratyañcamarciṣā vidhya marman
verses.en: The cow gives milk each year, O Man-regarder: let not the Yatudhana ever taste it. If one would glut him with the biesting, Agni, pierce with thy flame his vitals as he meets thee.

verses.sa:
विषं गवां यातुधानाः पिबन्त्वा वृश्च्यन्तामदितये दुरेवाः ।
परैनान्देवः सविता ददातु परा भागमोषधीनां जयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānāḥ pibantvā vṛścyantāmaditaye durevāḥ paraināndevaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām
verses.en: Let the fiends drink the poison of the cattle; may Aditi cast off the evildoers. May the God Savitar give them up to ruin, and be their share of plants and herbs denied them.

verses.sa:
सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
अनु दह सहमूरान्क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः॥
verses.tr: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ anu daha sahamūrānkravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ
verses.en: Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Raksasas in fight o'ercome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, the flesh-devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अधरादुदक्तात्त्वं पश्चादुत रक्षा पुरस्तात् ।
प्रति ते ते अजरासस्तपिष्ठा अघशंसं शोशुचतो दहन्तु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne adharādudaktāttvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt prati te te ajarāsastapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu
verses.en: Guard us, O Agni, from above and under, protect us from behind us and before us; And may thy flames, most fierce and never wasting, glowing with fervent heat, consume the sinner.

verses.sa:
पश्चात्पुरस्तादधरादुदक्तात्कविः काव्येन परि पाहि राजन् ।
सखे सखायमजरो जरिम्णेऽग्ने मर्ताँ अमर्त्यस्त्वं नः॥
verses.tr: paścātpurastādadharādudaktātkaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan sakhe sakhāyamajaro jarimṇe'gne martāṃ amartyastvaṃ naḥ
verses.en: From rear, from front, from under, from above us, O King, protect us as a Sage with wisdom. Guard to old age thy friend, O Friend, Eternal: O Agni, as Immortal, guard us mortals.

verses.sa: परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि । धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम्॥
verses.tr: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām
verses.en: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day, destroyer of our treacherous foes.

verses.sa: विषेण भङ्गुरावतः प्रति ष्म रक्षसो दह । अग्ने तिग्मेन शोचिषा तपुरग्राभिॠष्टिभिः॥
verses.tr: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati ṣma rakṣaso daha agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhiṝṣṭibhiḥ
verses.en: Burn with thy poison turned against the treacherous brood of Raksasas, O Agni, with thy sharpened glow, with lances armed with points of flame.

verses.sa: प्रत्यग्ने मिथुना दह यातुधाना किमीदिना । सं त्वा शिशामि जागृह्यदब्धं विप्र मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: pratyagne mithunā daha yātudhānā kimīdinā saṃ tvā śiśāmi jāgṛhyadabdhaṃ vipra manmabhiḥ
verses.en: Burn thou the paired Kimidins, burn, Agni, the Yatudhana pairs. I sharpen thee, Infallible, with hymns. O Sage, be vigilant.

verses.sa: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणीहि विश्वतः प्रति । यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं वि रुज वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ vi ruja vīryam
verses.en: Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame demolish them on every side. Break thou the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Raksasa.

verses.sa:
हविष्पान्तमजरं स्वर्विदि दिविस्पृश्याहुतं जुष्टमग्नौ ।
तस्य भर्मणे भुवनाय देवा धर्मणे कं स्वधया पप्रथन्त॥
verses.tr: haviṣpāntamajaraṃ svarvidi divispṛśyāhutaṃ juṣṭamagnau tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe kaṃ svadhayā paprathanta
verses.en: Dear, ageless sacrificial drink is offered in light-discovering, heaven-pervading Agni. The Gods spread forth through his Celestial Nature, that he might bear the world up and sustain it.

verses.sa:
गीर्णं भुवनं तमसापगूळ्हमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ ।
तस्य देवाः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापोऽरणयन्नोषधीः सख्ये अस्य॥
verses.tr: gīrṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tamasāpagūḻhamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpo'raṇayannoṣadhīḥ sakhye asya
verses.en: The world was swallowed and concealed in darkness: Agni was born, and light became apparent. The Deities, the broad earth, and the heavens, and plants, and waters gloried in his friendship.

verses.sa:
देवेभिर्न्विषितो यज्ञियेभिरग्निं स्तोषाण्यजरं बृहन्तम् ।
यो भानुना पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामाततान रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: devebhirnviṣito yajñiyebhiragniṃ stoṣāṇyajaraṃ bṛhantam yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmātatāna rodasī antarikṣam
verses.en: Inspired by Gods who claim our adoration, I now will laud Eternal Lofty Agni, Him who hath spread abroad the earth with lustre, this heaven, and both the worlds, and air's mid-region.

verses.sa:
यो होतासीत्प्रथमो देवजुष्टो यं समाञ्जन्नाज्येना वृणानाः ।
स पतत्रीत्वरं स्था जगद्यच्छ्वात्रमग्निरकृणोज्जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: yo hotāsītprathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjannājyenā vṛṇānāḥ sa patatrītvaraṃ sthā jagadyacchvātramagnirakṛṇojjātavedāḥ
verses.en: Earliest Priest whom all the Gods accepted, and chose him, and anointed him with butter, He swiftly made all things that fly, stand, travel, all that hath motion, Agni Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यज्जातवेदो भुवनस्य मूर्धन्नतिष्ठो अग्ने सह रोचनेन ।
तं त्वाहेम मतिभिर्गीर्भिरुक्थैः स यज्ञियो अभवो रोदसिप्राः॥
verses.tr: yajjātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhannatiṣṭho agne saha rocanena taṃ tvāhema matibhirgīrbhirukthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ
verses.en: Because thou, Agni, Jatavedas, stoodest at the world's head with thy refulgent splendour, We sent thee forth with hymns and songs and praises: thou filledst heaven and earth, God meet for worship.

verses.sa:
मूर्धा भुवो भवति नक्तमग्निस्ततः सूर्यो जायते प्रातरुद्यन् ।
मायामू तु यज्ञियानामेतामपो यत्तूर्णिश्चरति प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktamagnistataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyan māyāmū tu yajñiyānāmetāmapo yattūrṇiścarati prajānan
verses.en: Head of the world is Agni in the night-time; then, as the Sun, at morn springs up and rises. Then to his task goes the prompt Priest foreknowing the wondrous power of Gods who must be honoured.

verses.sa:
दृशेन्यो यो महिना समिद्धोऽरोचत दिवियोनिर्विभावा ।
तस्मिन्नग्नौ सूक्तवाकेन देवा हविर्विश्व आजुहवुस्तनूपाः॥
verses.tr: dṛśenyo yo mahinā samiddho'rocata diviyonirvibhāvā tasminnagnau sūktavākena devā havirviśva ājuhavustanūpāḥ
verses.en: Lovely is he who, kindled in his greatness, hath shone forth, seated in the heavens, refulgent. With resonant hymns all Gods who guard our bodies have offered up oblation in this Agni.

verses.sa:
सूक्तवाकं प्रथममादिदग्निमादिद्धविरजनयन्त देवाः ।
स एषां यज्ञो अभवत्तनूपास्तं द्यौर्वेद तं पृथिवी तमापः॥
verses.tr: sūktavākaṃ prathamamādidagnimādiddhavirajanayanta devāḥ sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavattanūpāstaṃ dyaurveda taṃ pṛthivī tamāpaḥ
verses.en: First the Gods brought the hymnal into being; then they engendered Agni, then oblation. He was their sacrifice that guards our bodies: him the heavens know, the earth, the waters know him.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽजनयन्ताग्निं यस्मिन्नाजुहवुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
सो अर्चिषा पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामृजूयमानो अतपन्महित्वा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāso'janayantāgniṃ yasminnājuhavurbhuvanāni viśvā so arciṣā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmṛjūyamāno atapanmahitvā
verses.en: He, Agni, whom the Gods have generated, in whom they offered up all worlds and creatures, He with his bright glow heated earth and heaven, urging himself right onward in his grandeur.

verses.sa:
स्तोमेन हि दिवि देवासो अग्निमजीजनञ्छक्तिभी रोदसिप्राम् ।
तमू अकृण्वन्त्रेधा भुवे कं स ओषधीः पचति विश्वरूपाः॥
verses.tr: stomena hi divi devāso agnimajījanañchaktibhī rodasiprām tamū akṛṇvantredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ
verses.en: Then by the laud the Gods engendered Agni in heaven, who fills both worlds through strength and vigour. They made him to appear in threefold essence: he ripens plants of every form and nature.

verses.sa:
यदेदेनमदधुर्यज्ञियासो दिवि देवाः सूर्यमादितेयम् ।
यदा चरिष्णू मिथुनावभूतामादित्प्रापश्यन्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: yadedenamadadhuryajñiyāso divi devāḥ sūryamāditeyam yadā cariṣṇū mithunāvabhūtāmāditprāpaśyanbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: What time the Gods, whose due is worship, set him as Surya, Son of Aditi, in heaven, When the Pair, ever wandering, sprang to being, all creatures that existed looked upon them.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मा अग्निं भुवनाय देवा वैश्वानरं केतुमह्नामकृण्वन् ।
आ यस्ततानोषसो विभातीरपो ऊर्णोति तमो अर्चिषा यन्॥
verses.tr: viśvasmā agniṃ bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketumahnāmakṛṇvan ā yastatānoṣaso vibhātīrapo ūrṇoti tamo arciṣā yan
verses.en: For all the world of life the Gods made Agni Vaisvanara to be the days' bright Banner,- Him who hath spread abroad the radiant Mornings, and, coming with his light, unveils the darkness.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरं कवयो यज्ञियासोऽग्निं देवा अजनयन्नजुर्यम् ।
नक्षत्रं प्रत्नममिनच्चरिष्णु यक्षस्याध्यक्षं तविषं बृहन्तम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaraṃ kavayo yajñiyāso'gniṃ devā ajanayannajuryam nakṣatraṃ pratnamaminaccariṣṇu yakṣasyādhyakṣaṃ taviṣaṃ bṛhantam
verses.en: The wise and holy Deities engendered Agni Vaisvanara whom age ne'er touches. The Ancient Star that wanders on for ever, lofty and. strong, Lord of the Living Being.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरं विश्वहा दीदिवांसं मन्त्रैरग्निं कविमच्छा वदामः ।
यो महिम्ना परिबभूवोर्वी उतावस्तादुत देवः परस्तात्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsaṃ mantrairagniṃ kavimacchā vadāmaḥ yo mahimnā paribabhūvorvī utāvastāduta devaḥ parastāt
verses.en: We call upon the Sage with holy verses, Agni Vaisvanara the ever-beaming, Who hath surpassed both heaven and earth in greatness: lie is a God below, a God above us.

verses.sa:
द्वे स्रुती अशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: I have heard mention of two several pathways, ways of the Fathers and of Gods and mortals. On these two paths each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.

verses.sa:
द्वे समीची बिभृतश्चरन्तं शीर्षतो जातं मनसा विमृष्टम् ।
स प्रत्यङ्विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थावप्रयुच्छन्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः॥
verses.tr: dve samīcī bibhṛtaścarantaṃ śīrṣato jātaṃ manasā vimṛṣṭam sa pratyaṅviśvā bhuvanāni tasthāvaprayucchantaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ
verses.en: These two united paths bear him who journeys born from the head and pondered with the spirit He stands directed to all things existing, hasting, unresting in his fiery splendour.

verses.sa:
यत्रा वदेते अवरः परश्च यज्ञन्योः कतरो नौ वि वेद ।
आ शेकुरित्सधमादं सखायो नक्षन्त यज्ञं क इदं वि वोचत्॥
verses.tr: yatrā vadete avaraḥ paraśca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda ā śekuritsadhamādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat
verses.en: Which of us twain knows where they speak together, upper and lower of the two rite-leaders? Our friends have helped to gather our assembly. They came to sacrifice; who will announce it?

verses.sa:
कत्यग्नयः कति सूर्यासः कत्युषासः कत्यु स्विदापः ।
नोपस्पिजं वः पितरो वदामि पृच्छामि वः कवयो विद्मने कम्॥
verses.tr: katyagnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ katyuṣāsaḥ katyu svidāpaḥ nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam
verses.en: How many are the Fires and Suns in number? What is the number of the Dawns and Waters? Not jestingly I speak to you, O Fathers. Sages, I ask you this for information.

verses.sa:
यावन्मात्रमुषसो न प्रतीकं सुपर्ण्यो३ वसते मातरिश्वः ।
तावद्दधात्युप यज्ञमायन्ब्राह्मणो होतुरवरो निषीदन्॥
verses.tr: yāvanmātramuṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo3 vasate mātariśvaḥ tāvaddadhātyupa yajñamāyanbrāhmaṇo hoturavaro niṣīdan
verses.en: As great as is the fair-winged Morning's presence to him who dwells beside us, Matarisvan! Is what the Brahman does when he approaches to sacrifice and sits below the Hotar.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं स्तवा नृतमं यस्य मह्ना विबबाधे रोचना वि ज्मो अन्तान् ।
आ यः पप्रौ चर्षणीधृद्वरोभिः प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचानो महित्वा॥
verses.tr: indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mahnā vibabādhe rocanā vi jmo antān ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇīdhṛdvarobhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā
verses.en: I WILL extol the most heroic Indra who with his might forced earth and sky asunder; Who hath filled all with width as man's Upholder, surpassing floods and rivers in his greatness.

verses.sa:
स सूर्यः पर्युरू वरांस्येन्द्रो ववृत्याद्रथ्येव चक्रा ।
अतिष्ठन्तमपस्यं१ न सर्गं कृष्णा तमांसि त्विष्या जघान॥
verses.tr: sa sūryaḥ paryurū varāṃsyendro vavṛtyādrathyeva cakrā atiṣṭhantamapasyaṃ1 na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna
verses.en: Surya is he: throughout the wide expanses shall Indra turn him, swift as car-wheels, hither, Like a stream resting not but ever active he hath destroyed, with light, the black hued darkness.

verses.sa:
समानमस्मा अनपावृदर्च क्ष्मया दिवो असमं ब्रह्म नव्यम् ।
वि यः पृष्ठेव जनिमान्यर्य इन्द्रश्चिकाय न सखायमीषे॥
verses.tr: samānamasmā anapāvṛdarca kṣmayā divo asamaṃ brahma navyam vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimānyarya indraścikāya na sakhāyamīṣe
verses.en: To him I sing a holy prayer, incessant new, matchless, common to the earth and heaven, Who marks, as they were backs, all living creatures: ne'er doth he fail a friend, the noble Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रेरयं सगरस्य बुध्नात् ।
यो अक्षेणेव चक्रिया शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम्॥
verses.tr: indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sagarasya budhnāt yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhirviṣvaktastambha pṛthivīmuta dyām
verses.en: I will send forth my songs in flow unceasing, like water from the ocean's depth, to Indra. Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.

verses.sa:
आपान्तमन्युस्तृपलप्रभर्मा धुनिः शिमीवाञ्छरुमाँ ऋजीषी ।
सोमो विश्वान्यतसा वनानि नार्वागिन्द्रं प्रतिमानानि देभुः॥
verses.tr: āpāntamanyustṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumāṃ ṛjīṣī somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nārvāgindraṃ pratimānāni debhuḥ
verses.en: Rousing with draughts, the Shaker, rushing onward, impetuous, very strong, armed as with arrows Is Soma; forest trees and all the bushes deceive not Indra with their offered likeness.

verses.sa:
न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी न धन्व नान्तरिक्षं नाद्रयः सोमो अक्षाः ।
यदस्य मन्युरधिनीयमानः शृणाति वीळु रुजति स्थिराणि॥
verses.tr: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ yadasya manyuradhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḻu rujati sthirāṇi
verses.en: Soma hath flowed to him whom naught can equal, the earth, the heavens, the firmament, the mountains,- When heightened in his ire his indignation shatters the firm and breaks the strong in pieces.

verses.sa:
जघान वृत्रं स्वधितिर्वनेव रुरोज पुरो अरदन्न सिन्धून् ।
बिभेद गिरिं नवमिन्न कुम्भमा गा इन्द्रो अकृणुत स्वयुग्भिः॥
verses.tr: jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradanna sindhūn bibheda giriṃ navaminna kumbhamā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ
verses.en: As an axe fells the tree so be slew Vrtra, brake down the strongholds and dug out the rivers. He cleft the mountain like a new-made pitcher. Indra brought forth the kine with his Companions.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदृणया इन्द्र धीरोऽसिर्न पर्व वृजिना शृणासि ।
प्र ये मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम युजं न जना मिनन्ति मित्रम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadṛṇayā indra dhīro'sirna parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram
verses.en: Wise art thou, Punisher of guilt, O Indra. The sword lops limbs, thou smitest down the sinner, The men who injure, as it were a comrade, the lofty Law of Varuna and Mitra.

verses.sa:
प्र ये मित्रं प्रार्यमणं दुरेवाः प्र संगिरः प्र वरुणं मिनन्ति ।
न्य१मित्रेषु वधमिन्द्र तुम्रं वृषन्वृषाणमरुषं शिशीहि॥
verses.tr: pra ye mitraṃ prāryamaṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇaṃ minanti nya1mitreṣu vadhamindra tumraṃ vṛṣanvṛṣāṇamaruṣaṃ śiśīhi
verses.en: Men who lead evil lives, who break agreements, and injure Varuna, Aryaman and Mitra,- Against these foes, O Mighty Indra, sharpen, as furious death, thy Bull of fiery colour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिव इन्द्र ईशे पृथिव्या इन्द्रो अपामिन्द्र इत्पर्वतानाम् ।
इन्द्रो वृधामिन्द्र इन्मेधिराणामिन्द्रः क्षेमे योगे हव्य इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra itparvatānām indro vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ
verses.en: Indra is Sovran Lord of Earth and Heaven, Indra is Lord of waters and of mountains. Indra is Lord of prosperers and sages Indra must be invoked in rest and effort.

verses.sa:
प्राक्तुभ्य इन्द्रः प्र वृधो अहभ्यः प्रान्तरिक्षात्प्र समुद्रस्य धासेः ।
प्र वातस्य प्रथसः प्र ज्मो अन्तात्प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचे प्र क्षितिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: prāktubhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahabhyaḥ prāntarikṣātpra samudrasya dhāseḥ pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmo antātpra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ
verses.en: Vaster than days and nights, Giver of increase, vaster than firmament and flood of ocean, Vaster than bounds of earth and wind's extension, vaster than rivers and our lands is Indra.

verses.sa:
प्र शोशुचत्या उषसो न केतुरसिन्वा ते वर्ततामिन्द्र हेतिः ।
अश्मेव विध्य दिव आ सृजानस्तपिष्ठेन हेषसा द्रोघमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: pra śośucatyā uṣaso na keturasinvā te vartatāmindra hetiḥ aśmeva vidhya diva ā sṛjānastapiṣṭhena heṣasā droghamitrān
verses.en: Forward, as herald of refulgent Morning, let thine insatiate arrow fly, O Indra. And pierce, as 'twere a stone launched forth from heaven, with hottest blaze the men who love deception.

verses.sa:
अन्वह मासा अन्विद्वनान्यन्वोषधीरनु पर्वतासः ।
अन्विन्द्रं रोदसी वावशाने अन्वापो अजिहत जायमानम्॥
verses.tr: anvaha māsā anvidvanānyanvoṣadhīranu parvatāsaḥ anvindraṃ rodasī vāvaśāne anvāpo ajihata jāyamānam
verses.en: Him, verily, the moons, the mountains followed, the tall trees followed and the plants and herbage. Yearning with love both Worlds approached, the Waters waited on Indra when he first had being.

verses.sa:
कर्हि स्वित्सा त इन्द्र चेत्यासदघस्य यद्भिनदो रक्ष एषत् ।
मित्रक्रुवो यच्छसने न गावः पृथिव्या आपृगमुया शयन्ते॥
verses.tr: karhi svitsā ta indra cetyāsadaghasya yadbhinado rakṣa eṣat mitrakruvo yacchasane na gāvaḥ pṛthivyā āpṛgamuyā śayante
verses.en: Where was the vengeful dart when thou, O Indra, clavest the demon ever beat on outrage? When fiends lay there upon the ground extended like cattle in the place of immolation?

verses.sa:
शत्रूयन्तो अभि ये नस्ततस्रे महि व्राधन्त ओगणास इन्द्र ।
अन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्तां सुज्योतिषो अक्तवस्ताँ अभि ष्युः॥
verses.tr: śatrūyanto abhi ye nastatasre mahi vrādhanta ogaṇāsa indra andhenāmitrāstamasā sacantāṃ sujyotiṣo aktavastāṃ abhi ṣyuḥ
verses.en: Those who are set in enmity against us, the Oganas, O Indra, waxen mighty,- Let blinding darkness follow those our foemen, while these shall have bright shining nights to light them.

verses.sa:
पुरूणि हि त्वा सवना जनानां ब्रह्माणि मन्दन्गृणतामृषीणाम् ।
इमामाघोषन्नवसा सहूतिं तिरो विश्वाँ अर्चतो याह्यर्वाङ्॥
verses.tr: purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānāṃ brahmāṇi mandangṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām imāmāghoṣannavasā sahūtiṃ tiro viśvāṃ arcato yāhyarvāṅ
verses.en: May plentiful libations of the people, and singing Rsis' holy prayers rejoice thee. Hearing with love this common invocation, come unto us, pass by all those who praise thee.

verses.sa:
एवा ते वयमिन्द्र भुञ्जतीनां विद्याम सुमतीनां नवानाम् ।
विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विश्वामित्रा उत त इन्द्र नूनम्॥
verses.tr: evā te vayamindra bhuñjatīnāṃ vidyāma sumatīnāṃ navānām vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto viśvāmitrā uta ta indra nūnam
verses.en: O Indra, thus may we be made partakers of thy new favours that shall bring us profit. Singing with love, may we the Visvamitras win daylight even now through thee, O Indra.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in the fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् । स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वाऽत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम्॥
verses.tr: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
verses.en: A THOUSAND heads hath Purusa, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. On every side pervading earth he fills a space ten fingers wide.

verses.sa: पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् । उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति॥
verses.tr: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
verses.en: This Purusa is all that yet hath been and all that is to be; The Lord of Immortality which waxes greater still by food.

verses.sa: एतावानस्य महिमाऽतो ज्यायाँश्च पूरुषः । पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि॥
verses.tr: etāvānasya mahimā'to jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi
verses.en: So mighty is his greatness; yea, greater than this is Purusa. All creatures are one-fourth of him, three-fourths eternal life in heaven.

verses.sa: त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः । ततो विष्वङ्व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि॥
verses.tr: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ tato viṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi
verses.en: With three-fourths Purusa went up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he strode out to every side over what cats not and what cats.

verses.sa: तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः । स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः॥
verses.tr: tasmādvirāḻajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
verses.en: From him Viraj was born; again Purusa from Viraj was born. As soon as he was born he spread eastward and westward o'er the earth.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत । वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ
verses.en: When Gods prepared the sacrifice with Purusa as their offering, Its oil was spring, the holy gift was autumn; summer was the wood.

verses.sa: तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः । तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये॥
verses.tr: taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye
verses.en: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusa born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sadhyas and Rsis sacrificed.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम् । पशून्ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान्ग्राम्याश्च ये॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam paśūntāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye
verses.en: From that great general sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of-the air, and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे । छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata
verses.en: From that great general sacrifice Rcas and Sama-hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sa: तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः । गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः॥
verses.tr: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ
verses.en: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth: From it were generated kine, from it the goats and sheep were born.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् । मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete
verses.en: When they divided Purusa how many portions did they make? What do they call his mouth, his arms? What do they call his thighs and feet?

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः । ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata
verses.en: The Brahman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rajanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sudra was produced.

verses.sa: चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत । मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत॥
verses.tr: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata
verses.en: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Indra and Agni from his mouth were born, and Vayu from his breath.

verses.sa: नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत । पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokāṃ akalpayan
verses.en: Forth from his navel came mid-air the sky was fashioned from his head Earth from his feet, and from his car the regions. Thus they formed the worlds.

verses.sa: सप्तास्यासन्परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः । देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: saptāsyāsanparidhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum
verses.en: Seven fencing-sticks had he, thrice seven layers of fuel were prepared, When the Gods, offering sacrifice, bound, as their victim, Purusa.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
verses.en: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sidhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa:
सं जागृवद्भिर्जरमाण इध्यते दमे दमूना इषयन्निळस्पदे ।
विश्वस्य होता हविषो वरेण्यो विभुर्विभावा सुषखा सखीयते॥
verses.tr: saṃ jāgṛvadbhirjaramāṇa idhyate dame damūnā iṣayanniḻaspade viśvasya hotā haviṣo vareṇyo vibhurvibhāvā suṣakhā sakhīyate
verses.en: Brisk, at the place of Ila, hymned by men who wake, our own familiar Friend is kindled in the house; Hotar of all oblation, worthy of our choice, Lord, beaming, trusty friend to one who loveth him.

verses.sa:
स दर्शतश्रीरतिथिर्गृहेगृहे वनेवने शिश्रिये तक्ववीरिव ।
जनंजनं जन्यो नाति मन्यते विश आ क्षेति विश्यो३ विशंविशम्॥
verses.tr: sa darśataśrīratithirgṛhegṛhe vanevane śiśriye takvavīriva janaṃjanaṃ janyo nāti manyate viśa ā kṣeti viśyo3 viśaṃviśam
verses.en: He, excellent in glory, guest in every house, finds like a swift-winged bird a home in every tree. Benevolent to men, he scorns no living man: Friend to the tribes of men he dwells with every tribe.

verses.sa:
सुदक्षो दक्षैः क्रतुनासि सुक्रतुरग्ने कविः काव्येनासि विश्ववित् ।
वसुर्वसूनां क्षयसि त्वमेक इद्द्यावा च यानि पृथिवी च पुष्यतः॥
verses.tr: sudakṣo dakṣaiḥ kratunāsi sukraturagne kaviḥ kāvyenāsi viśvavit vasurvasūnāṃ kṣayasi tvameka iddyāvā ca yāni pṛthivī ca puṣyataḥ
verses.en: Most sage with insight, passing skillful with thy powers art thou, O Agni, wise with wisdom, knowing all. As Vasu, thou alone art Lord of all good things, of all the treasures that the heavens and earth produce.

verses.sa:
प्रजानन्नग्ने तव योनिमृत्वियमिळायास्पदे घृतवन्तमासदः ।
आ ते चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयोऽरेपसः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः॥
verses.tr: prajānannagne tava yonimṛtviyamiḻāyāspade ghṛtavantamāsadaḥ ā te cikitra uṣasāmivetayo'repasaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ
verses.en: Foreknowing well, O Agni, thou in Ila's place hast occupied thy regular station balmed with oil. Marked are thy comings like the comings of the Dawns, the rays of him who shineth spotless as the Sun.

verses.sa:
तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतश्चित्राश्चिकित्र उषसां न केतवः ।
यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमास्ये॥
verses.tr: tava śriyo varṣyasyeva vidyutaścitrāścikitra uṣasāṃ na ketavaḥ yadoṣadhīrabhisṛṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsye
verses.en: Thy glories are, as lightnings from the rainy cloud, marked, many-hued, like heralds of the Dawns' approach, When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.

verses.sa:
तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः ।
तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा॥
verses.tr: tamoṣadhīrdadhire garbhamṛtviyaṃ tamāpo agniṃ janayanta mātaraḥ tamitsamānaṃ vaninaśca vīrudho'ntarvatīśca suvate ca viśvahā
verses.en: Him, duly coming as their germ, have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life. So in like manner do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.

verses.sa:
वातोपधूत इषितो वशाँ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे ।
आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो३ यथा पृथक्छर्धांस्यग्ने अजराणि धक्षतः॥
verses.tr: vātopadhūta iṣito vaśāṃ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase ā te yatante rathyo3 yathā pṛthakchardhāṃsyagne ajarāṇi dhakṣataḥ
verses.en: When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, swift piercing through thy food according to thy will, Thy never-ceasing blazes, longing to consume, like men on chariots, Agni, strive on every side.

verses.sa:
मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् ।
तमिदर्भे हविष्या समानमित्तमिन्महे वृणते नान्यं त्वत्॥
verses.tr: medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim tamidarbhe haviṣyā samānamittaminmahe vṛṇate nānyaṃ tvat
verses.en: Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, Waker of knowledge, chief Controller of the thought,- Him, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect at sacrificial offerings great and small alike.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदत्र वृणते त्वायवो होतारमग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
यद्देवयन्तो दधति प्रयांसि ते हविष्मन्तो मनवो वृक्तबर्हिषः॥
verses.tr: tvāmidatra vṛṇate tvāyavo hotāramagne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ yaddevayanto dadhati prayāṃsi te haviṣmanto manavo vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
verses.en: Here, Api, the arrangers, those attached to thee, elect thee as their Priest in sacred gatherings, When men with strewn clipt grass and sacrificial gifts offer thee entertainment, piously inclined.

verses.sa:
तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः ।
तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे॥
verses.tr: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame
verses.en: Thine is the Herald's task and Cleanser's duly timed; Leader art thou, and Kindler for the pious man. Thou art Director, thou the ministering Priest: thou art the Brahman, Lord and Master in our home.

verses.sa:
यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय मर्त्यः समिधा दाशदुत वा हविष्कृति ।
तस्य होता भवसि यासि दूत्य१मुप ब्रूषे यजस्यध्वरीयसि॥
verses.tr: yastubhyamagne amṛtāya martyaḥ samidhā dāśaduta vā haviṣkṛti tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtya1mupa brūṣe yajasyadhvarīyasi
verses.en: When mortal man presents to thee Immortal God, Agni, his fuel or his sacrificial gift, Then thou art his Adhvaryu, Hotar, messenger, callest the Gods and orderest the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इमा अस्मै मतयो वाचो अस्मदाँ ऋचो गिरः सुष्टुतयः समग्मत ।
वसूयवो वसवे जातवेदसे वृद्धासु चिद्वर्धनो यासु चाकनत्॥
verses.tr: imā asmai matayo vāco asmadāṃ ṛco giraḥ suṣṭutayaḥ samagmata vasūyavo vasave jātavedase vṛddhāsu cidvardhano yāsu cākanat
verses.en: From us these hymns in concert have gone forth to him, these. holy words, these Rcas, songs and eulogies, Eager for wealth, to Jatavedas fain for wealth: when they have waxen strong they please their Strengthener.

verses.sa:
इमां प्रत्नाय सुष्टुतिं नवीयसीं वोचेयमस्मा उशते शृणोतु नः ।
भूया अन्तरा हृद्यस्य निस्पृशे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः॥
verses.tr: imāṃ pratnāya suṣṭutiṃ navīyasīṃ voceyamasmā uśate śṛṇotu naḥ bhūyā antarā hṛdyasya nispṛśe jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ
verses.en: This newest eulogy will I speak forth to him, the Ancient One who loves it. May he hear our voice. May it come near his heart and make it stir with love, as a fond well-dressed matron clings about her lord.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणो वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः ।
कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनये चारुमग्नये॥
verses.tr: yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaye cārumagnaye
verses.en: He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and rams, when duly set apart, are offered up,- To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice, Disposer, with my heart I bring a fair hymn forth.

verses.sa:
अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः ।
वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम्॥
verses.tr: ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam
verses.en: Into thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, oil into ladle. Vouchsafe us wealth. strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य वो रथ्यं विश्पतिं विशां होतारमक्तोरतिथिं विभावसुम् ।
शोचञ्छुष्कासु हरिणीषु जर्भुरद्वृषा केतुर्यजतो द्यामशायत॥
verses.tr: yajñasya vo rathyaṃ viśpatiṃ viśāṃ hotāramaktoratithiṃ vibhāvasum śocañchuṣkāsu hariṇīṣu jarbhuradvṛṣā keturyajato dyāmaśāyata
verses.en: I PRAISE your Charioteer of sacrifice, the Lord of men, Priest of the tribes, refulgent, Guest of night. Blazing amid dry plants, snatching amid the green, the Strong, the Holy Herald hath attained to heaven.

verses.sa:
इममञ्जस्पामुभये अकृण्वत धर्माणमग्निं विदथस्य साधनम् ।
अक्तुं न यह्वमुषसः पुरोहितं तनूनपातमरुषस्य निंसते॥
verses.tr: imamañjaspāmubhaye akṛṇvata dharmāṇamagniṃ vidathasya sādhanam aktuṃ na yahvamuṣasaḥ purohitaṃ tanūnapātamaruṣasya niṃsate
verses.en: Him, Agni, Gods and men have made their chief support, who drinks the fatness and completes the sacrifice. With kisses they caress the Grandson of the Red, like the swift ray of light, the Household Priest of Dawn.

verses.sa:
बळस्य नीथा वि पणेश्च मन्महे वया अस्य प्रहुता आसुरत्तवे ।
यदा घोरासो अमृतत्वमाशतादिज्जनस्य दैव्यस्य चर्किरन्॥
verses.tr: baḻasya nīthā vi paṇeśca manmahe vayā asya prahutā āsurattave yadā ghorāso amṛtatvamāśatādijjanasya daivyasya carkiran
verses.en: Yea, we discriminate his and the niggard's ways: his branches evermore are sent forth to consume. When his terrific flames have reached the Immortal's world, then men remember and extol the Heavenly Folk.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि प्रसितिर्द्यौरुरु व्यचो नमो मह्य१रमतिः पनीयसी ।
इन्द्रो मित्रो वरुणः सं चिकित्रिरेऽथो भगः सविता पूतदक्षसः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya hi prasitirdyaururu vyaco namo mahya1ramatiḥ panīyasī indro mitro varuṇaḥ saṃ cikitrire'tho bhagaḥ savitā pūtadakṣasaḥ
verses.en: For then the net of Law, Dyaus, and the wide expanse, Earth, Worship, and Devotion meet for highest praise, Varuna, Indra, Mitra were of one accord, and Savitar and Bhaga, Lords of holy might.

verses.sa:
प्र रुद्रेण ययिना यन्ति सिन्धवस्तिरो महीमरमतिं दधन्विरे ।
येभिः परिज्मा परियन्नुरु ज्रयो वि रोरुवज्जठरे विश्वमुक्षते॥
verses.tr: pra rudreṇa yayinā yanti sindhavastiro mahīmaramatiṃ dadhanvire yebhiḥ parijmā pariyannuru jrayo vi roruvajjaṭhare viśvamukṣate
verses.en: Onward, with ever-roaming Rudra, speed the floods: over Aramati the Mighty have they run. With them Parijman, moving round his vast domain, loud bellowing, bedews all things that are within.

verses.sa:
क्राणा रुद्रा मरुतो विश्वकृष्टयो दिवः श्येनासो असुरस्य नीळयः ।
तेभिश्चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमेन्द्रो देवेभिरर्वशेभिरर्वशः॥
verses.tr: krāṇā rudrā maruto viśvakṛṣṭayo divaḥ śyenāso asurasya nīḻayaḥ tebhiścaṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamendro devebhirarvaśebhirarvaśaḥ
verses.en: Straightway the Rudras, Maruts visiting all men, Falcons of Dyaus, home-dwellers with the Asura,- Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman look on with these, and the swift-moving Indra with swift-moving Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे भुजं शशमानास आशत सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये ।
प्र ये न्वस्यार्हणा ततक्षिरे युजं वज्रं नृषदनेषु कारवः॥
verses.tr: indre bhujaṃ śaśamānāsa āśata sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye pra ye nvasyārhaṇā tatakṣire yujaṃ vajraṃ nṛṣadaneṣu kāravaḥ
verses.en: With Indra have they found enjoyment, they who toil, in the light's beauty, in the very Strong One's strength; The singers who in men's assemblies forged for him, according to his due, his friend the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
सूरश्चिदा हरितो अस्य रीरमदिन्द्रादा कश्चिद्भयतज तवीयसः ।
भीमस्य वृष्णो जठरादभिश्वसो दिवेदिवे सहुरिः स्तन्नबाधितः॥
verses.tr: sūraścidā harito asya rīramadindrādā kaścidbhayataja tavīyasaḥ bhīmasya vṛṣṇo jaṭharādabhiśvaso divedive sahuriḥ stannabādhitaḥ
verses.en: Even the Sun's Bay Coursers hath lie held in check: each one fears Indra as the mightiest of all. Unhindered, from the air's vault thunders day by day the loud triumphant breathing of the fearful Bull.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं वो अद्य रुद्राय शिक्वसे क्षयद्वीराय नमसा दिदिष्टन ।
येभिः शिवः स्ववाँ एवयावभिर्दिवः सिषक्ति स्वयशा निकामभिः॥
verses.tr: stomaṃ vo adya rudrāya śikvase kṣayadvīrāya namasā didiṣṭana yebhiḥ śivaḥ svavāṃ evayāvabhirdivaḥ siṣakti svayaśā nikāmabhiḥ
verses.en: With humble adoration show this day your song of praise to mighty Rudra, Ruler of the brave: With whom, the Eager Ones, going their ordered course, he comes from heaven Self-bright, auspicious, strong to guard.

verses.sa:
ते हि प्रजाया अभरन्त वि श्रवो बृहस्पतिर्वृषभः सोमजामयः ।
यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमो वि धारयद्देवा दक्षैर्भृगवः सं चिकित्रिरे॥
verses.tr: te hi prajāyā abharanta vi śravo bṛhaspatirvṛṣabhaḥ somajāmayaḥ yajñairatharvā prathamo vi dhārayaddevā dakṣairbhṛgavaḥ saṃ cikitrire
verses.en: For these have spread abroad the fame of human kind, the Bull Brhaspati and Soma's brotherhood. Atharvan first by sacrifices made men sure: through skill the Bhrgus were esteemed of all as Gods.

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी भूरिरेतसा नराशंसश्चतुरङ्गो यमोऽदितिः ।
देवस्त्वष्टा द्रविणोदा ऋभुक्षणः प्र रोदसी मरुतो विष्णुरर्हिरे॥
verses.tr: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā narāśaṃsaścaturaṅgo yamo'ditiḥ devastvaṣṭā draviṇodā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pra rodasī maruto viṣṇurarhire
verses.en: For these, the Earth and Heaven with their abundant seed, four-bodied Narasmsa, Yama, Aditi, God Tvastar Wealth-bestower, the Rbhuksanas, Rodasi, Maruts, Visnu, claim and merit praise.

verses.sa:
उत स्य न उशिजामुर्विया कविरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो३ हवीमनि ।
सूर्यामासा विचरन्ता दिविक्षिता धिया शमीनहुषी अस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: uta sya na uśijāmurviyā kavirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo3 havīmani sūryāmāsā vicarantā divikṣitā dhiyā śamīnahuṣī asya bodhatam
verses.en: And may he too give car, the Sage, from far away, the Dragon of the Deep, to this our yearning call. Ye Sun and Moon who dwell in heaven and move in turn, and with your thought, O Earth and Sky, observe this well.

verses.sa:
प्र नः पूषा चरथं विश्वदेव्योऽपां नपादवतु वायुरिष्टये ।
आत्मानं वस्यो अभि वातमर्चत तदश्विना सुहवा यामनि श्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: pra naḥ pūṣā carathaṃ viśvadevyo'pāṃ napādavatu vāyuriṣṭaye ātmānaṃ vasyo abhi vātamarcata tadaśvinā suhavā yāmani śrutam
verses.en: Dear to all Gods, may Pasan guard the ways we go, the Waters' child and Vayu help us to success. Sing lauds for your great bliss to Wind, the breath of all: ye Asvins prompt to hear, hear this upon your way.

verses.sa:
विशामासामभयानामधिक्षितं गीर्भिरु स्वयशसं गृणीमसि ।
ग्नाभिर्विश्वाभिरदितिमनर्वणमक्तोर्युवानं नृमणा अधा पतिम्॥
verses.tr: viśāmāsāmabhayānāmadhikṣitaṃ gīrbhiru svayaśasaṃ gṛṇīmasi gnābhirviśvābhiraditimanarvaṇamaktoryuvānaṃ nṛmaṇā adhā patim
verses.en: With hymns of praise we sing him who is throned as Lord over these fearless tribes, the Self-resplendent One. We praise Night's youthful Lord benevolent to men, the foeless One, the free, with all celestial Dames.

verses.sa:
रेभदत्र जनुषा पूर्वो अङ्गिरा ग्रावाण ऊर्ध्वा अभि चक्षुरध्वरम् ।
येभिर्विहाया अभवद्विचक्षणः पाथः सुमेकं स्वधितिर्वनन्वति॥
verses.tr: rebhadatra januṣā pūrvo aṅgirā grāvāṇa ūrdhvā abhi cakṣuradhvaram yebhirvihāyā abhavadvicakṣaṇaḥ pāthaḥ sumekaṃ svadhitirvananvati
verses.en: By reason of his birth here Angiras first sang: the pressing-stones upraised beheld the sacrifice- The stones through which the Sage became exceeding vast, and the sharp axe obtains in fight the beauteous place.

verses.sa: महि द्यावापृथिवी भूतमुर्वी नारी यह्वी न रोदसी सदं नः । तेभिर्नः पातं सह्यस एभिर्नः पातं शूषणि॥
verses.tr: mahi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūtamurvī nārī yahvī na rodasī sadaṃ naḥ tebhirnaḥ pātaṃ sahyasa ebhirnaḥ pātaṃ śūṣaṇi
verses.en: Mighty are ye, and far-extended, Heaven and Earth: both Worlds are evermore to us like two young Dames. Guard us thereby from stronger foe; guard us hereby to give us strength.

verses.sa: यज्ञेयज्ञे स मर्त्यो देवान्त्सपर्यति । यः सुम्नैर्दीर्घश्रुत्तम आविवासत्येनान्॥
verses.tr: yajñeyajñe sa martyo devāntsaparyati yaḥ sumnairdīrghaśruttama āvivāsatyenān
verses.en: In each succeeding sacrifice that mortal honoureth the Gods, He who, most widely known and famed for happiness, inviteth them.

verses.sa: विश्वेषामिरज्यवो देवानां वार्महः । विश्वे हि विश्वमहसो विश्वे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियाः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāmirajyavo devānāṃ vārmahaḥ viśve hi viśvamahaso viśve yajñeṣu yajñiyāḥ
verses.en: Ye who are Rulers over all, great is your sovran power as Gods. Ye all possess all majesty: all must be served in sacrifice.

verses.sa: ते घा राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्रा अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा । कद्रुद्रो नृणां स्तुतो मरुतः पूषणो भगः॥
verses.tr: te ghā rājāno amṛtasya mandrā aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā kadrudro nṛṇāṃ stuto marutaḥ pūṣaṇo bhagaḥ
verses.en: These are the joyous Kings of Immortality, Parijman, Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuna. What else is Rudra, praised of men? the Maruts, Bhaga, Pusana?

verses.sa: उत नो नक्तमपां वृषण्वसू सूर्यामासा सदनाय सधन्या । सचा यत्साद्येषामहिर्बुध्नेषु बुध्न्यः॥
verses.tr: uta no naktamapāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū sūryāmāsā sadanāya sadhanyā sacā yatsādyeṣāmahirbudhneṣu budhnyaḥ
verses.en: Come also to our dwelling, Lords of ample wealth, common partakers of our waters, Sun and Moon, When the great Dragon of the Deep hath settled down upon their floors.

verses.sa: उत नो देवावश्विना शुभस्पती धामभिर्मित्रावरुणा उरुष्यताम् । महः स राय एषतेऽति धन्वेव दुरिता॥
verses.tr: uta no devāvaśvinā śubhaspatī dhāmabhirmitrāvaruṇā uruṣyatām mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate'ti dhanveva duritā
verses.en: And let the Asvins, Lords of splendour, set us free,- both Gods, and, with their Laws, Mitra and Varuna. Through woes, as over desert lands, he speeds to ample opulence.

verses.sa: उत नो रुद्रा चिन्मृळतामश्विना विश्वे देवासो रथस्पतिर्भगः । ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षणः परिज्मा विश्ववेदसः॥
verses.tr: uta no rudrā cinmṛḻatāmaśvinā viśve devāso rathaspatirbhagaḥ ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ parijmā viśvavedasaḥ
verses.en: Yea, let the Asvins Twain he gracious unto us, even Rudras, and all Gods, Bhaga, Rathaspati; Parijman, Rbhu, Vaja, O Lords of all wealth Rbhuksanas.

verses.sa: ऋभुॠभुक्षा ऋभुर्विधतो मद आ ते हरी जूजुवानस्य वाजिना । दुष्टरं यस्य साम चिदृधग्यज्ञो न मानुषः॥
verses.tr: ṛbhuṝbhukṣā ṛbhurvidhato mada ā te harī jūjuvānasya vājinā duṣṭaraṃ yasya sāma cidṛdhagyajño na mānuṣaḥ
verses.en: Prompt is Rbhuksan, prompt the worshipper's strong drink: may thy fleet Bay Steeds, thine who speedest on, approach. Not mans but God's is sacrifice whose psalm is unassailable.

verses.sa:
कृधी नो अह्रयो देव सवितः स च स्तुषे मघोनाम् ।
सहो न इन्द्रो वह्निभिर्न्येषां चर्षणीनां चक्रं रश्मिं न योयुवे॥
verses.tr: kṛdhī no ahrayo deva savitaḥ sa ca stuṣe maghonām saho na indro vahnibhirnyeṣāṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ cakraṃ raśmiṃ na yoyuve
verses.en: O God Savitar, harmed by none, lauded, give us a place among wealthy princes. With his Car-steeds at once 'hath our Indra guided the reins and the car of these men.

verses.sa: ऐषु द्यावापृथिवी धातं महदस्मे वीरेषु विश्वचर्षणि श्रवः । पृक्षं वाजस्य सातये पृक्षं रायोत तुर्वणे॥
verses.tr: aiṣu dyāvāpṛthivī dhātaṃ mahadasme vīreṣu viśvacarṣaṇi śravaḥ pṛkṣaṃ vājasya sātaye pṛkṣaṃ rāyota turvaṇe
verses.en: To these men present here, O Heaven and Earth, to us grant lofty fame extending over all mankind. Give us a steed to win us strength, a steed with wealth for victory.

verses.sa: एतं शंसमिन्द्रास्मयुष्ट्वं कूचित्सन्तं सहसावन्नभिष्टये । सदा पाह्यभिष्टये मेदतां वेदता वसो॥
verses.tr: etaṃ śaṃsamindrāsmayuṣṭvaṃ kūcitsantaṃ sahasāvannabhiṣṭaye sadā pāhyabhiṣṭaye medatāṃ vedatā vaso
verses.en: This speaker, Indra-for thou art our Friend-wherever he may be, guard thou, Victor! for help, ever for help Thy wisdom, Vasu! prosper him.

verses.sa: एतं मे स्तोमं तना न सूर्ये द्युतद्यामानं वावृधन्त नृणाम् । संवननं नाश्व्यं तष्टेवानपच्युतम्॥
verses.tr: etaṃ me stomaṃ tanā na sūrye dyutadyāmānaṃ vāvṛdhanta nṛṇām saṃvananaṃ nāśvyaṃ taṣṭevānapacyutam
verses.en: So have they strengthened this mine hymn which seems to take its bright path to the Sun, and reconciles the men: Thus forms a carpenter the yoke of horses, not to be displaced.

verses.sa: वावर्त येषां राया युक्तैषां हिरण्ययी । नेमधिता न पौंस्या वृथेव विष्टान्ता॥
verses.tr: vāvarta yeṣāṃ rāyā yuktaiṣāṃ hiraṇyayī nemadhitā na pauṃsyā vṛtheva viṣṭāntā
verses.en: Whose chariot-seat hath come again laden with wealth and bright with gold, Lightly, with piercing ends, as 'twere two ranks of heroes ranged for fight.

verses.sa: प्र तद्दुःशीमे पृथवाने वेने प्र रामे वोचमसुरे मघवत्सु । ये युक्त्वाय पञ्च शतास्मयु पथा विश्राव्येषाम्॥
verses.tr: pra tadduḥśīme pṛthavāne vene pra rāme vocamasure maghavatsu ye yuktvāya pañca śatāsmayu pathā viśrāvyeṣām
verses.en: This to Duhsima Prthavana have I sung, to Vena, Rama, to the nobles, and the King. They yoked five hundred, and their love of us was famed upon their way.

verses.sa: अधीन्न्वत्र सप्ततिं च सप्त च । सद्यो दिदिष्ट तान्वः सद्यो दिदिष्ट पार्थ्यः सद्यो दिदिष्ट मायवः॥
verses.tr: adhīnnvatra saptatiṃ ca sapta ca sadyo didiṣṭa tānvaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa pārthyaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa māyavaḥ
verses.en: Besides, they showed us seven -and-seventy horses here. Tanva at once displayed his gift, Parthya at once displayed his gift; and straightway Mayava showed his.

verses.sa:
प्रैते वदन्तु प्र वयं वदाम ग्रावभ्यो वाचं वदता वदद्भ्यः ।
यदद्रयः पर्वताः साकमाशवः श्लोकं घोषं भरथेन्द्राय सोमिनः॥
verses.tr: praite vadantu pra vayaṃ vadāma grāvabhyo vācaṃ vadatā vadadbhyaḥ yadadrayaḥ parvatāḥ sākamāśavaḥ ślokaṃ ghoṣaṃ bharathendrāya sominaḥ
verses.en: Let these speak loudly forth; let us speak out aloud: to the loud speaking Pressing-stones address the speech; When, rich with Soma juice, Stones of the mountain, ye, united, swift to Indra bring the sound of praise.

verses.sa:
एते वदन्ति शतवत्सहस्रवदभि क्रन्दन्ति हरितेभिरासभिः ।
विष्ट्वी ग्रावाणः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया होतुश्चित्पूर्वे हविरद्यमाशत॥
verses.tr: ete vadanti śatavatsahasravadabhi krandanti haritebhirāsabhiḥ viṣṭvī grāvāṇaḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā hotuścitpūrve haviradyamāśata
verses.en: They speak out like a hundred, like a thousand men: they cry aloud to us with their green-tinted mouths, While, pious Stones, they ply their task with piety, and, even before the Hotar, taste the offered food.

verses.sa:
एते वदन्त्यविदन्नना मधु न्यूङ्खयन्ते अधि पक्व आमिषि ।
वृक्षस्य शाखामरुणस्य बप्सतस्ते सूभर्वा वृषभाः प्रेमराविषुः॥
verses.tr: ete vadantyavidannanā madhu nyūṅkhayante adhi pakva āmiṣi vṛkṣasya śākhāmaruṇasya bapsataste sūbharvā vṛṣabhāḥ premarāviṣuḥ
verses.en: Loudly they speak, for they have found the savoury meath: they make a humming sound over the meat prepared. As they devour the branch of the Red-coloured Tree, these, the well-pastured Bulls, have uttered bellowings.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वदन्ति मदिरेण मन्दिनेन्द्रं क्रोशन्तोऽविदन्नना मधु ।
संरभ्या धीराः स्वसृभिरनर्तिषुराघोषयन्तः पृथिवीमुपब्दिभिः॥
verses.tr: bṛhadvadanti madireṇa mandinendraṃ krośanto'vidannanā madhu saṃrabhyā dhīrāḥ svasṛbhiranartiṣurāghoṣayantaḥ pṛthivīmupabdibhiḥ
verses.en: They cry aloud, with strong exhilarating drink, calling on Indra now, for they have found the meath. Bold, with the sisters they have danced, embraced by them, making the earth reecho with their ringing sound.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा वाचमक्रतोप द्यव्याखरे कृष्णा इषिरा अनर्तिषुः ।
न्य१ङ्नि यन्त्युपरस्य निष्कृतं पुरू रेतो दधिरे सूर्यश्वितः॥
verses.tr: suparṇā vācamakratopa dyavyākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ nya1ṅni yantyuparasya niṣkṛtaṃ purū reto dadhire sūryaśvitaḥ
verses.en: The Eagles have sent forth their cry aloft in heaven; in the sky's vault the dark impetuous ones have danced. Then downward to the nether stone's fixt place they sink, and, splendid as the Sun, effuse their copious stream.

verses.sa:
उग्रा इव प्रवहन्तः समायमुः साकं युक्ता वृषणो बिभ्रतो धुरः ।
यच्छ्वसन्तो जग्रसाना अराविषुः शृण्व एषां प्रोथथो अर्वतामिव॥
verses.tr: ugrā iva pravahantaḥ samāyamuḥ sākaṃ yuktā vṛṣaṇo bibhrato dhuraḥ yacchvasanto jagrasānā arāviṣuḥ śṛṇva eṣāṃ prothatho arvatāmiva
verses.en: Like strong ones drawing, they have put forth all their strength: the Bulls, harnessed together, bear the chariot-poles. When they have bellowed, panting, swallowing their food, the sound of their loud snorting is like that of steeds.

verses.sa:
दशावनिभ्यो दशकक्ष्येभ्यो दशयोक्त्रेभ्यो दशयोजनेभ्यः ।
दशाभीशुभ्यो अर्चताजरेभ्यो दश धुरो दश युक्ता वहद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: daśāvanibhyo daśakakṣyebhyo daśayoktrebhyo daśayojanebhyaḥ daśābhīśubhyo arcatājarebhyo daśa dhuro daśa yuktā vahadbhyaḥ
verses.en: To these who have ten workers and a tenfold girth, to these who have ten yoke-straps and ten binding thongs, To these who bear ten reins, the eternal, sing ye praise, to these who bear ten car-poles, ten when they are yoked.

verses.sa:
ते अद्रयो दशयन्त्रास आशवस्तेषामाधानं पर्येति हर्यतम् ।
त ऊ सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसोंऽशोः पीयूषं प्रथमस्य भेजिरे॥
verses.tr: te adrayo daśayantrāsa āśavasteṣāmādhānaṃ paryeti haryatam ta ū sutasya somyasyāndhasoṃ'śoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamasya bhejire
verses.en: These Stones with ten conductors, rapid in their course, with lovely revolution travel round and round. They have been first to drink the flowing Soma juice, first to enjoy the milky fluid of the stalk.

verses.sa:
ते सोमादो हरी इन्द्रस्य निंसतेंऽशुं दुहन्तो अध्यासते गवि ।
तेभिर्दुग्धं पपिवान्त्सोम्यं मध्विन्द्रो वर्धते प्रथते वृषायते॥
verses.tr: te somādo harī indrasya niṃsateṃ'śuṃ duhanto adhyāsate gavi tebhirdugdhaṃ papivāntsomyaṃ madhvindro vardhate prathate vṛṣāyate
verses.en: These Soma-eaters kiss Indra's Bay-coloured Steeds: draining. the stalk they sit upon the ox's hide. Indra, when he hath drunk Soma-nicath drawn by them, waxes in strength, is famed, is mighty as a Bull.

verses.sa:
वृषा वो अंशुर्न किला रिषाथनेळावन्तः सदमित्स्थनाशिताः ।
रैवत्येव महसा चारवः स्थन यस्य ग्रावाणो अजुषध्वमध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vo aṃśurna kilā riṣāthaneḻāvantaḥ sadamitsthanāśitāḥ raivatyeva mahasā cāravaḥ sthana yasya grāvāṇo ajuṣadhvamadhvaram
verses.en: Strong is your stalk; ye, verily, never shall be harmed; ye have refreshment, ye are ever satisfied. Fair are ye, as it were, through splendour of his wealth, his in whose sacrifice, O Stones, ye find delight.

verses.sa:
तृदिला अतृदिलासो अद्रयोऽश्रमणा अशृथिता अमृत्यवः ।
अनातुरा अजराः स्थामविष्णवः सुपीवसो अतृषिता अतृष्णजः॥
verses.tr: tṛdilā atṛdilāso adrayo'śramaṇā aśṛthitā amṛtyavaḥ anāturā ajarāḥ sthāmaviṣṇavaḥ supīvaso atṛṣitā atṛṣṇajaḥ
verses.en: Bored deep, but not pierced through with holes, are ye, O Stones, not loosened, never weary, and exempt from death, Eternal, undiseased, moving in sundry ways, unthirsting, full of fatness, void of all desire.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा एव वः पितरो युगेयुगे क्षेमकामासः सदसो न युञ्जते ।
अजुर्यासो हरिषाचो हरिद्रव आ द्यां रवेण पृथिवीमशुश्रवुः॥
verses.tr: dhruvā eva vaḥ pitaro yugeyuge kṣemakāmāsaḥ sadaso na yuñjate ajuryāso hariṣāco haridrava ā dyāṃ raveṇa pṛthivīmaśuśravuḥ
verses.en: Your fathers, verily, stand firm from age to age: they, loving rest, are not dissevered from their seat. Untouched by time, ne'er lacking green plants and green trees, they with their voice have caused the heavens and earth to hear.

verses.sa:
तदिद्वदन्त्यद्रयो विमोचने यामन्नञ्जस्पा इव घेदुपब्दिभिः ।
वपन्तो बीजमिव धान्याकृतः पृञ्चन्ति सोमं न मिनन्ति बप्सतः॥
verses.tr: tadidvadantyadrayo vimocane yāmannañjaspā iva ghedupabdibhiḥ vapanto bījamiva dhānyākṛtaḥ pṛñcanti somaṃ na minanti bapsataḥ
verses.en: This, this the Stones proclaim, what time they are disjoined, and when with ringing sounds they move and drink the balm. Like tillers of the ground when they are sowing seed, they mix the Soma, nor, devouring, diminish it.

verses.sa:
सुते अध्वरे अधि वाचमक्रता ऽऽक्रीळयो न मातरं तुदन्तः ।
वि षू मुञ्चा सुषुवुषो मनीषां वि वर्तन्तामद्रयश्चायमानाः॥
verses.tr: sute adhvare adhi vācamakratā ''krīḻayo na mātaraṃ tudantaḥ vi ṣū muñcā suṣuvuṣo manīṣāṃ vi vartantāmadrayaścāyamānāḥ
verses.en: They have raised high their voice for juice, for sacrifice, striking the Mother earth as though they danced thereon. So loose thou too his thought who hath effused the sap, and let the Stones which we are honouring be disjoined.

verses.sa:
हये जाये मनसा तिष्ठ घोरे वचांसि मिश्रा कृणवावहै नु ।
न नौ मन्त्रा अनुदितास एते मयस्करन्परतरे चनाहन्॥
verses.tr: haye jāye manasā tiṣṭha ghore vacāṃsi miśrā kṛṇavāvahai nu na nau mantrā anuditāsa ete mayaskaranparatare canāhan
verses.en: Ho there, my consort! Stay, thou fierce-souled lady, and let us reason for a while together. Such thoughts as these of ours, while yet unspoken in days gone by have never brought us comfort.

verses.sa:
किमेता वाचा कृणवा तवाहं प्राक्रमिषमुषसामग्रियेव ।
पुरूरवः पुनरस्तं परेहि दुरापना वात इवाहमस्मि॥
verses.tr: kimetā vācā kṛṇavā tavāhaṃ prākramiṣamuṣasāmagriyeva purūravaḥ punarastaṃ parehi durāpanā vāta ivāhamasmi
verses.en: What am I now to do with this thy saying? I have gone from thee like the first of Mornings. Pururavas, return thou to thy dwelling: I, like the wind, am difficult to capture.

verses.sa:
इषुर्न श्रिय इषुधेरसना गोषाः शतसा न रंहिः ।
अवीरे क्रतौ वि दविद्युतन्नोरा न मायुं चितयन्त धुनयः॥
verses.tr: iṣurna śriya iṣudherasanā goṣāḥ śatasā na raṃhiḥ avīre kratau vi davidyutannorā na māyuṃ citayanta dhunayaḥ
verses.en: Like a shaft sent for glory from the quiver, or swift-steed winning cattle winning hundreds. The lightning seemed to flash, as cowards planned it. The minstrels bleated like a lamb in trouble.

verses.sa:
सा वसु दधती श्वशुराय वय उषो यदि वष्ट्यन्तिगृहात् ।
अस्तं ननक्षे यस्मिञ्चाकन्दिवा नक्तं श्नथिता वैतसेन॥
verses.tr: sā vasu dadhatī śvaśurāya vaya uṣo yadi vaṣṭyantigṛhāt astaṃ nanakṣe yasmiñcākandivā naktaṃ śnathitā vaitasena
verses.en: Giving her husband's father life and riches, from the near dwelling, when her lover craved her, She sought the home wherein she found her pleasure, accepting day and night her lord's embraces.

verses.sa:
त्रिः स्म माह्नः श्नथयो वैतसेनोत स्म मेऽव्यत्यै पृणासि ।
पुरूरवोऽनु ते केतमायं राजा मे वीर तन्व१स्तदासीः॥
verses.tr: triḥ sma māhnaḥ śnathayo vaitasenota sma me'vyatyai pṛṇāsi purūravo'nu te ketamāyaṃ rājā me vīra tanva1stadāsīḥ
verses.en: Thrice in the day didst thou embrace thy consort, though coldly she received thy fond caresses. To thy desires, Pururavas, I yielded: so wast thou king, O hero, of my body.

verses.sa:
या सुजूर्णिः श्रेणिः सुम्नआपिर्ह्रदेचक्षुर्न ग्रन्थिनी चरण्युः ।
ता अञ्जयोऽरुणयो न सस्रुः श्रिये गावो न धेनवोऽनवन्त॥
verses.tr: yā sujūrṇiḥ śreṇiḥ sumnaāpirhradecakṣurna granthinī caraṇyuḥ tā añjayo'ruṇayo na sasruḥ śriye gāvo na dhenavo'navanta
verses.en: The maids Sujirni, Sreni, Sumne-api, Charanyu, Granthini, and Hradecaksus,- These like red kine have hastened forth, the bright ones, and like milch-cows have lowed in emulation.

verses.sa:
समस्मिञ्जायमान आसत ग्ना उतेमवर्धन्नद्य१ः स्वगूर्ताः ।
महे यत्त्वा पुरूरवो रणायाऽवर्धयन्दस्युहत्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: samasmiñjāyamāna āsata gnā utemavardhannadya1ḥ svagūrtāḥ mahe yattvā purūravo raṇāyā'vardhayandasyuhatyāya devāḥ
verses.en: While he was born the Dames sate down together, the Rivers with free kindness gave him nurture; And then, Pururavas, the Gods increased thee for mighty battle, to destroy the Dasyus.

verses.sa: सचा यदासु जहतीष्वत्कममानुषीषु मानुषो निषेवे । अप स्म मत्तरसन्ती न भुज्युस्ता अत्रसन्रथस्पृशो नाश्वाः॥
verses.tr: sacā yadāsu jahatīṣvatkamamānuṣīṣu mānuṣo niṣeve apa sma mattarasantī na bhujyustā atrasanrathaspṛśo nāśvāḥ
verses.en: When I, a mortal, wooed to mine embraces these heavenly nymphs who laid aside their raiment, Like a scared snake they fled from me in terror, like chariot horses when the car has touched them.

verses.sa:
यदासु मर्तो अमृतासु निस्पृक्सं क्षोणीभिः क्रतुभिर्न पृङ्क्ते ।
ता आतयो न तन्वः शुम्भत स्वा अश्वासो न क्रीळयो दन्दशानाः॥
verses.tr: yadāsu marto amṛtāsu nispṛksaṃ kṣoṇībhiḥ kratubhirna pṛṅkte tā ātayo na tanvaḥ śumbhata svā aśvāso na krīḻayo dandaśānāḥ
verses.en: When, loving these Immortal Ones, the mortal hath converse with the nymphs as they allow him. Like swans they show the beauty of their bodies, like horses in their play they bite and nibble.

verses.sa:
विद्युन्न या पतन्ती दविद्योद्भरन्ती मे अप्या काम्यानि ।
जनिष्टो अपो नर्यः सुजातः प्रोर्वशी तिरत दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: vidyunna yā patantī davidyodbharantī me apyā kāmyāni janiṣṭo apo naryaḥ sujātaḥ prorvaśī tirata dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: She who flashed brilliant as the falling lightning brought me delicious presents from the waters. Now from the flood be born a strong young hero May Uruvasi prolong her life for ever

verses.sa:
जज्ञिष इत्था गोपीथ्याय हि दधाथ तत्पुरूरवो म ओजः ।
अशासं त्वा विदुषी सस्मिन्नहन्न म आशृणोः किमभुग्वदासि॥
verses.tr: jajñiṣa itthā gopīthyāya hi dadhātha tatpurūravo ma ojaḥ aśāsaṃ tvā viduṣī sasminnahanna ma āśṛṇoḥ kimabhugvadāsi
verses.en: Thy birth hath made me drink from earthly milch-kine: this power, Pururavas, hast thou vouchsafed me. I knew, and, warned thee, on that day. Thou wouldst not hear me. What sayest thou, when naught avails thee?

verses.sa:
कदा सूनुः पितरं जात इच्छाच्चक्रन्नाश्रु वर्तयद्विजानन् ।
को दम्पती समनसा वि यूयोदध यदग्निः श्वशुरेषु दीदयत्॥
verses.tr: kadā sūnuḥ pitaraṃ jāta icchāccakrannāśru vartayadvijānan ko dampatī samanasā vi yūyodadha yadagniḥ śvaśureṣu dīdayat
verses.en: When will the son be born and seek his father? Mourner-like, will he weep when first he knows him? Who shall divide the accordant wife and husband, while fire is shining with thy consort's parents?

verses.sa:
प्रति ब्रवाणि वर्तयते अश्रु चक्रन्न क्रन्ददाध्ये शिवायै ।
प्र तत्ते हिनवा यत्ते अस्मे परेह्यस्तं नहि मूर मापः॥
verses.tr: prati bravāṇi vartayate aśru cakranna krandadādhye śivāyai pra tatte hinavā yatte asme parehyastaṃ nahi mūra māpaḥ
verses.en: I will console him when his tears are falling: he shall not weep and cry for care that blesses. That which is thine, between us, will I send thee. Go home again, thou fool; thou hast not won me.

verses.sa:
सुदेवो अद्य प्रपतेदनावृत्परावतं परमां गन्तवा उ ।
अधा शयीत निॠतेरुपस्थेऽधैनं वृका रभसासो अद्युः॥
verses.tr: sudevo adya prapatedanāvṛtparāvataṃ paramāṃ gantavā u adhā śayīta niṝterupasthe'dhainaṃ vṛkā rabhasāso adyuḥ
verses.en: Thy lover shall flee forth this day for ever, to seek, without return, the farthest distance. Then let his bed be in Destruction's bosom, and there let fierce rapacious wolves devour him.

verses.sa:
पुरूरवो मा मृथा मा प्र पप्तो मा त्वा वृकासो अशिवास उ क्षन् ।
न वै स्त्रैणानि सख्यानि सन्ति सालावृकाणां हृदयान्येता॥
verses.tr: purūravo mā mṛthā mā pra papto mā tvā vṛkāso aśivāsa u kṣan na vai straiṇāni sakhyāni santi sālāvṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayānyetā
verses.en: Nay, do not die, Pururavas, nor vanish: let not the evil-omened wolves devour thee. With women there can be no lasting friendship: hearts of hyenas are the hearts of women.

verses.sa:
यद्विरूपाचरं मर्त्येष्ववसं रात्रीः शरदश्चतस्रः ।
घृतस्य स्तोकं सकृदह्न आश्नां तादेवेदं तातृपाणा चरामि॥
verses.tr: yadvirūpācaraṃ martyeṣvavasaṃ rātrīḥ śaradaścatasraḥ ghṛtasya stokaṃ sakṛdahna āśnāṃ tādevedaṃ tātṛpāṇā carāmi
verses.en: When amid men in altered shape I sojourned, and through four autumns spent the nights among them, I tasted once a day a drop of butter; and even now with that am I am contented.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षप्रां रजसो विमानीमुप शिक्षाम्युर्वशीं वसिष्ठः ।
उप त्वा रातिः सुकृतस्य तिष्ठान्नि वर्तस्व हृदयं तप्यते मे॥
verses.tr: antarikṣaprāṃ rajaso vimānīmupa śikṣāmyurvaśīṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ upa tvā rātiḥ sukṛtasya tiṣṭhānni vartasva hṛdayaṃ tapyate me
verses.en: I, her best love, call Urvasi to meet me, her who fills air and measures out the region. Let the gift brought by piety approach thee. Turn thou to me again: my heart is troubled.

verses.sa:
इति त्वा देवा इम आहुरैळ यथेमेतद्भवसि मृत्युबन्धुः ।
प्रजा ते देवान्हविषा यजाति स्वर्ग उ त्वमपि मादयासे॥
verses.tr: iti tvā devā ima āhuraiḻa yathemetadbhavasi mṛtyubandhuḥ prajā te devānhaviṣā yajāti svarga u tvamapi mādayāse
verses.en: Thus speak these Gods to thee, O son of Ila: As death hath verily got thee for his subject, Thy sons shall serve the Gods with their oblation, and thou, moreover, shalt rejoice in Svarga.

verses.sa:
प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी प्र ते वन्वे वनुषो हर्यतं मदम् ।
घृतं न यो हरिभिश्चारु सेचत आ त्वा विशन्तु हरिवर्पसं गिरः॥
verses.tr: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī pra te vanve vanuṣo haryataṃ madam ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secata ā tvā viśantu harivarpasaṃ giraḥ
verses.en: In the great synod will I laud thy two Bay Steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-God, His who pours lovely oil as 'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.

verses.sa:
हरिं हि योनिमभि ये समस्वरन्हिन्वन्तो हरी दिव्यं यथा सदः ।
आ यं पृणन्ति हरिभिर्न धेनव इन्द्राय शूषं हरिवन्तमर्चत॥
verses.tr: hariṃ hi yonimabhi ye samasvaranhinvanto harī divyaṃ yathā sadaḥ ā yaṃ pṛṇanti haribhirna dhenava indrāya śūṣaṃ harivantamarcata
verses.en: Ye who in concert sing unto the gold hued place, like Bay Steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat, For Indra laud ye strength allied with Tawny Steeds, laud him whom cows content as 'twere with yellow drops.

verses.sa:
सो अस्य वज्रो हरितो य आयसो हरिर्निकामो हरिरा गभस्त्योः ।
द्युम्नी सुशिप्रो हरिमन्युसायक इन्द्रे नि रूपा हरिता मिमिक्षिरे॥
verses.tr: so asya vajro harito ya āyaso harirnikāmo harirā gabhastyoḥ dyumnī suśipro harimanyusāyaka indre ni rūpā haritā mimikṣire
verses.en: His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms; Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage. In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue.

verses.sa:
दिवि न केतुरधि धायि हर्यतो विव्यचद्वज्रो हरितो न रंह्या ।
तुददहिं हरिशिप्रो य आयसः सहस्रशोका अभवद्धरिम्भरः॥
verses.tr: divi na keturadhi dhāyi haryato vivyacadvajro harito na raṃhyā tudadahiṃ hariśipro ya āyasaḥ sahasraśokā abhavaddharimbharaḥ
verses.en: As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunderbolt spread out as in a race. That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.

verses.sa:
त्वंत्वमहर्यथा उपस्तुतः पूर्वेभिरिन्द्र हरिकेश यज्वभिः ।
त्वं हर्यसि तव विश्वमुक्थ्य१मसामि राधो हरिजात हर्यतम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃtvamaharyathā upastutaḥ pūrvebhirindra harikeśa yajvabhiḥ tvaṃ haryasi tava viśvamukthya1masāmi rādho harijāta haryatam
verses.en: Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old. hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired. All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect pleasant gift, O Golden-hued from birth.

verses.sa:
ता वज्रिणं मन्दिनं स्तोम्यं मद इन्द्रं रथे वहतो हर्यता हरी ।
पुरूण्यस्मै सवनानि हर्यत इन्द्राय सोमा हरयो दधन्विरे॥
verses.tr: tā vajriṇaṃ mandinaṃ stomyaṃ mada indraṃ rathe vahato haryatā harī purūṇyasmai savanāni haryata indrāya somā harayo dadhanvire
verses.en: These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, Thunder-armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill. Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have the gold-hued Soma juices run.

verses.sa:
अरं कामाय हरयो दधन्विरे स्थिराय हिन्वन्हरयो हरी तुरा ।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्जोषमीयते सो अस्य कामं हरिवन्तमानशे॥
verses.tr: araṃ kāmāya harayo dadhanvire sthirāya hinvanharayo harī turā arvadbhiryo haribhirjoṣamīyate so asya kāmaṃ harivantamānaśe
verses.en: The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong. He who speeds on with Bay Steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.

verses.sa:
हरिश्मशारुर्हरिकेश आयसस्तुरस्पेये यो हरिपा अवर्धत ।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्वाजिनीवसुरति विश्वा दुरिता पारिषद्धरी॥
verses.tr: hariśmaśārurharikeśa āyasasturaspeye yo haripā avardhata arvadbhiryo haribhirvājinīvasurati viśvā duritā pāriṣaddharī
verses.en: At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the Iron One with yellow beard and yellow hair. He, Lord of Tawny Coursers, Lord of fleet-foot Mares, will bear his Bay Steeds safely over all distress.

verses.sa:
स्रुवेव यस्य हरिणी विपेततुः शिप्रे वाजाय हरिणी दविध्वतः ।
प्र यत्कृते चमसे मर्मृजद्धरी पीत्वा मदस्य हर्यतस्यान्धसः॥
verses.tr: sruveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śipre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ pra yatkṛte camase marmṛjaddharī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ
verses.en: His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles move apart, what time, for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir, When, while the bowl stands there, he grooms his Tawny Steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he loves.

verses.sa:
उत स्म सद्म हर्यतस्य पस्त्यो३रत्यो न वाजं हरिवाँ अचिक्रदत् ।
मही चिद्धि धिषणाहर्यदोजसा बृहद्वयो दधिषे हर्यतश्चिदा॥
verses.tr: uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyo3ratyo na vājaṃ harivāṃ acikradat mahī ciddhi dhiṣaṇāharyadojasā bṛhadvayo dadhiṣe haryataścidā
verses.en: Yea, to the Dear One's seat in homes of heaven and earth the Bay Steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food. Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the Beloved One hath gained high power of life,

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी हर्यमाणो महित्वा नव्यंनव्यं हर्यसि मन्म नु प्रियम् ।
प्र पस्त्यमसुर हर्यतं गोराविष्कृधि हरये सूर्याय॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī haryamāṇo mahitvā navyaṃnavyaṃ haryasi manma nu priyam pra pastyamasura haryataṃ gorāviṣkṛdhi haraye sūryāya
verses.en: Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new. O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा हर्यन्तं प्रयुजो जनानां रथे वहन्तु हरिशिप्रमिन्द्र ।
पिबा यथा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वो हर्यन्यज्ञं सधमादे दशोणिम्॥
verses.tr: ā tvā haryantaṃ prayujo janānāṃ rathe vahantu hariśipramindra pibā yathā pratibhṛtasya madhvo haryanyajñaṃ sadhamāde daśoṇim
verses.en: O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee, delightful, golden-visored, on thy car, That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest, at the feast, drink of our offered meath.

verses.sa:
अपाः पूर्वेषां हरिवः सुतानामथो इदं सवनं केवलं ते ।
ममद्धि सोमं मधुमन्तमिन्द्र सत्रा वृषञ्जठर आ वृषस्व॥
verses.tr: apāḥ pūrveṣāṃ harivaḥ sutānāmatho idaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te mamaddhi somaṃ madhumantamindra satrā vṛṣañjaṭhara ā vṛṣasva
verses.en: Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest; and thine especially is this libation. Gladden thee, Indra, with the meath-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One! within thee.

verses.sa: या ओषधीः पूर्वा जाता देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा । मनै नु बभ्रूणामहं शतं धामानि सप्त च॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca
verses.en: Herbs that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than the Gods,- Of these, whose hue is brown, will I declare the hundred powers and seven.

verses.sa: शतं वो अम्ब धामानि सहस्रमुत वो रुहः । अधा शतक्रत्वो यूयमिमं मे अगदं कृत॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ adhā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta
verses.en: Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand are your growths. Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from disease.

verses.sa: ओषधीः प्रति मोदध्वं पुष्पवतीः प्रसूवरीः । अश्वा इव सजित्वरीर्वीरुधः पारयिष्ण्वः॥
verses.tr: oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvaṃ puṣpavatīḥ prasūvarīḥ aśvā iva sajitvarīrvīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ
verses.en: Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing fruit, Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in the race.

verses.sa: ओषधीरिति मातरस्तद्वो देवीरुप ब्रुवे । सनेयमश्वं गां वास आत्मानं तव पूरुष॥
verses.tr: oṣadhīriti mātarastadvo devīrupa bruve saneyamaśvaṃ gāṃ vāsa ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa
verses.en: Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the Goddesses: Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self, O man.

verses.sa: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता । गोभाज इत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम्॥
verses.tr: aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam
verses.en: The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sa: यत्रौषधीः समग्मत राजानः समिताविव । विप्रः स उच्यते भिषग्रक्षोहामीवचातनः॥
verses.tr: yatrauṣadhīḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāviva vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣagrakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ
verses.en: He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd of men,- Physician/Vaidya is that Bipra/sage's name, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease.

verses.sa: अश्वावतीं सोमावतीमूर्जयन्तीमुदोजसम् । आवित्सि सर्वा ओषधीरस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīmūrjayantīmudojasam āvitsi sarvā oṣadhīrasmā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishments, in strengthening power,- All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole again.

verses.sa: उच्छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठादिवेरते । धनं सनिष्यन्तीनामात्मानं तव पूरुष॥
verses.tr: ucchuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhādiverate dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāmātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa
verses.en: The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle from the stall,- Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital breath, O man.

verses.sa: इष्कृतिर्नाम वो माताऽथो यूयं स्थ निष्कृतीः । सीराः पतत्रिणीः स्थन यदामयति निष्कृथ॥
verses.tr: iṣkṛtirnāma vo mātā'tho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ sīrāḥ patatriṇīḥ sthana yadāmayati niṣkṛtha
verses.en: Reliever is your mother's name, and hence Restorers are ye called. Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings disease.

verses.sa: अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेन इव व्रजमक्रमुः । ओषधीः प्राचुच्यवुर्यत्किं च तन्वो३ रपः॥
verses.tr: ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajamakramuḥ oṣadhīḥ prācucyavuryatkiṃ ca tanvo3 rapaḥ
verses.en: Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold. The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was there.

verses.sa: यदिमा वाजयन्नहमोषधीर्हस्त आदधे । आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा॥
verses.tr: yadimā vājayannahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā
verses.en: When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs within my hand, The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.

verses.sa: यस्यौषधीः प्रसर्पथाङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः । ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधध्व उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव॥
verses.tr: yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathāṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhyamaśīriva
verses.en: He through whose frame, O Plants, ye creep member by member, joint by joint,- From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of strife.

verses.sa: साकं यक्ष्म प्र पत चाषेण किकिदीविना । साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā
verses.en: Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and kingfisher. Fly with the wind's impetuous speed, vanish together with the storm.

verses.sa: अन्या वो अन्यामवत्वन्यान्यस्या उपावत । ताः सर्वाः संविदाना इदं मे प्रावता वचः॥
verses.tr: anyā vo anyāmavatvanyānyasyā upāvata tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ
verses.en: Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to each, All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of mine.

verses.sa: याः फलिनीर्या अफला अपुष्पा याश्च पुष्पिणीः । बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and the blossomless, Urged onward by Brhaspati, release us from our pain and grief;

verses.sa: मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्या३दथो वरुण्यादुत । अथो यमस्य पड्बीशात्सर्वस्माद्देवकिल्बिषात्॥
verses.tr: muñcantu mā śapathyā3datho varuṇyāduta atho yamasya paḍbīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt
verses.en: Release me from the curse's plague and woe that comes from Varuna; Free me from Yama's fetter, from sin and offence against the Gods.

verses.sa: अवपतन्तीरवदन्दिव ओषधयस्परि । यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः॥
