verses.tr: avapatantīravadandiva oṣadhayaspari yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ
verses.en: What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earthward, thus they spake: No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we pervade,

verses.sa: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः । तासां त्वमस्युत्तमारं कामाय शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ tāsāṃ tvamasyuttamāraṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: Of all the many Plants whose King is, Soma, Plants of hundred forms, Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet to the heart.

verses.sa: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्विष्ठिताः पृथिवीमनु । बृहस्पतिप्रसूता अस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃ datta vīryam
verses.en: O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that o'erspread the earth, Urged onward by Brhaspati, combine your virtue in this Plant.

verses.sa: मा वो रिषत्खनिता यस्मै चाहं खनामि वः । द्विपच्चतुष्पदस्माकं सर्वमस्त्वनातुरम्॥
verses.tr: mā vo riṣatkhanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ dvipaccatuṣpadasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam
verses.en: Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for whom I dig: And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.

verses.sa: याश्चेदमुपशृण्वन्ति याश्च दूरं परागताः । सर्वाः संगत्य वीरुधोऽस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāgatāḥ sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃ datta vīryam
verses.en: All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have departed far away, Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon this Herb.

verses.sa: ओषधयः सं वदन्ते सोमेन सह राज्ञा । यस्मै कृणोति ब्राह्मणस्तं राजन्पारयामसि॥
verses.tr: oṣadhayaḥ saṃ vadante somena saha rājñā yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājanpārayāmasi
verses.en: With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy and say: O King, we save from death the man whose cure a Brahman undertakes.

verses.sa: त्वमुत्तमास्योषधे तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः । उपस्तिरस्तु सो३ऽस्माकं यो अस्माँ अभिदासति॥
verses.tr: tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ upastirastu so3'smākaṃ yo asmāṃ abhidāsati
verses.en: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते प्रति मे देवतामिहि मित्रो वा यद्वरुणो वासि पूषा ।
आदित्यैर्वा यद्वसुभिर्मरुत्वान्त्स पर्जन्यं शंतनवे वृषाय॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate prati me devatāmihi mitro vā yadvaruṇo vāsi pūṣā ādityairvā yadvasubhirmarutvāntsa parjanyaṃ śaṃtanave vṛṣāya
verses.en: Come, be thou Mitra, Varuna, or Pusan, come, O Brhaspati, to mine oblation: With Maruts, Vasus, or Adityas, make thou Parjanya pour for Santanu his rain-drops.

verses.sa:
आ देवो दूतो अजिरश्चिकित्वान्त्वद्देवापे अभि मामगच्छत् ।
प्रतीचीनः प्रति मामा ववृत्स्व दधामि ते द्युमतीं वाचमासन्॥
verses.tr: ā devo dūto ajiraścikitvāntvaddevāpe abhi māmagacchat pratīcīnaḥ prati māmā vavṛtsva dadhāmi te dyumatīṃ vācamāsan
verses.en: The God, intelligent, the speedy envoy whom thou hast sent hath come to me, Devapi: Address thyself to me and turn thee hither within thy lips will I put brilliant language.

verses.sa:
अस्मे धेहि द्युमतीं वाचमासन्बृहस्पते अनमीवामिषिराम् ।
यया वृष्टिं शंतनवे वनाव दिवो द्रप्सो मधुमाँ आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: asme dhehi dyumatīṃ vācamāsanbṛhaspate anamīvāmiṣirām yayā vṛṣṭiṃ śaṃtanave vanāva divo drapso madhumāṃ ā viveśa
verses.en: Within my mouth, Brhaspati, deposit speech lucid, vigorous, and free from weakness, Thereby to win for Santanu the rain-fall. The meath-rich drop from heaven hath passed within it.

verses.sa:
आ नो द्रप्सा मधुमन्तो विशन्त्विन्द्र देह्यधिरथं सहस्रम् ।
नि षीद होत्रमृतुथा यजस्व देवान्देवापे हविषा सपर्य॥
verses.tr: ā no drapsā madhumanto viśantvindra dehyadhirathaṃ sahasram ni ṣīda hotramṛtuthā yajasva devāndevāpe haviṣā saparya
verses.en: Let the sweet drops descend on us, O Indra: give us enough to lade a thousand wagons. Sit to thy Hotar task; pay worship duly, and serve the Gods, Devapi, with oblation.

verses.sa:
आर्ष्टिषेणो होत्रमृषिर्निषीदन्देवापिर्देवसुमतिं चिकित्वान् ।
स उत्तरस्मादधरं समुद्रमपो दिव्या असृजद्वर्ष्या अभि॥
verses.tr: ārṣṭiṣeṇo hotramṛṣirniṣīdandevāpirdevasumatiṃ cikitvān sa uttarasmādadharaṃ samudramapo divyā asṛjadvarṣyā abhi
verses.en: Knowing the God's good-will, Devapi, Rsi, the son of Rstisena, sate as Hotar. He hath brought down from heaven's most lofty summit the ocean of the rain, celestial waters.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्त्समुद्रे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्नापो देवेभिर्निवृता अतिष्ठन् ।
ता अद्रवन्नार्ष्टिषेणेन सृष्टा देवापिना प्रेषिता मृक्षिणीषु॥
verses.tr: asmintsamudre adhyuttarasminnāpo devebhirnivṛtā atiṣṭhan tā adravannārṣṭiṣeṇena sṛṣṭā devāpinā preṣitā mṛkṣiṇīṣu
verses.en: Gathered together in that highest ocean, the waters stood by deities obstructed. They hurried down set free by Arstisena, in gaping clefts, urged onward by Devapi.

verses.sa:
यद्देवापिः शंतनवे पुरोहितो होत्राय वृतः कृपयन्नदीधेत् ।
देवश्रुतं वृष्टिवनिं रराणो बृहस्पतिर्वाचमस्मा अयच्छत्॥
verses.tr: yaddevāpiḥ śaṃtanave purohito hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet devaśrutaṃ vṛṣṭivaniṃ rarāṇo bṛhaspatirvācamasmā ayacchat
verses.en: When as chief priest for Santanu, Devapi, chosen for Hotar's duty, prayed beseeching, Graciously pleased Brhaspati vouchsafed him a voice that reached the Gods and won the waters.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवापिः शुशुचानो अग्न आर्ष्टिषेणो मनुष्यः समीधे ।
विश्वेभिर्देवैरनुमद्यमानः प्र पर्जन्यमीरया वृष्टिमन्तम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā devāpiḥ śuśucāno agna ārṣṭiṣeṇo manuṣyaḥ samīdhe viśvebhirdevairanumadyamānaḥ pra parjanyamīrayā vṛṣṭimantam
verses.en: O Agni whom Devapi Arstisena, the mortal man, hath kindled in his glory, Joying in him with all the Gods together, urge on the sender of the rain, Parjanya.

verses.sa:
त्वां पूर्व ऋषयो गीर्भिरायन्त्वामध्वरेषु पुरुहूत विश्वे ।
सहस्राण्यधिरथान्यस्मे आ नो यज्ञं रोहिदश्वोप याहि॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ pūrva ṛṣayo gīrbhirāyantvāmadhvareṣu puruhūta viśve sahasrāṇyadhirathānyasme ā no yajñaṃ rohidaśvopa yāhi
verses.en: All ancient Rsis with their songs approached thee, even thee, O Much-invoked, at sacrifices. We have provided wagon-loads in thousands: come to the solemn rite, Lord of Red Horses.

verses.sa:
एतान्यग्ने नवतिर्नव त्वे आहुतान्यधिरथा सहस्रा ।
तेभिर्वर्धस्व तन्वः शूर पूर्वीर्दिवो नो वृष्टिमिषितो रिरीहि॥
verses.tr: etānyagne navatirnava tve āhutānyadhirathā sahasrā tebhirvardhasva tanvaḥ śūra pūrvīrdivo no vṛṣṭimiṣito rirīhi
verses.en: The wagon-loads, the nine-and-ninety thousand, these have been offered up to thee, O Agni. Hero, with these increase thy many bodies, and, stimulated, send us rain from heaven.

verses.sa:
एतान्यग्ने नवतिं सहस्रा सं प्र यच्छ वृष्ण इन्द्राय भागम् ।
विद्वान्पथ ऋतुशो देवयानानप्यौलानं दिवि देवेषु धेहि॥
verses.tr: etānyagne navatiṃ sahasrā saṃ pra yaccha vṛṣṇa indrāya bhāgam vidvānpatha ṛtuśo devayānānapyaulānaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi
verses.en: Give thou these ninety thousand loads, O Agni, to Indra, to the Bull, to be his portion. Knowing the paths which Deities duly travel, set mid the Gods in heaven Aulana also.

verses.sa:
अग्ने बाधस्व वि मृधो वि दुर्गहाऽपामीवामप रक्षांसि सेध ।
अस्मात्समुद्राद्बृहतो दिवो नोऽपां भूमानमुप नः सृजेह॥
verses.tr: agne bādhasva vi mṛdho vi durgahā'pāmīvāmapa rakṣāṃsi sedha asmātsamudrādbṛhato divo no'pāṃ bhūmānamupa naḥ sṛjeha
verses.en: O Agni, drive afar our foes, our troubles chase malady away and wicked demons. From this air-ocean, from the lofty heavens, send down on us a mighty flood of waters.

verses.sa:
कं नश्चित्रमिषण्यसि चिकित्वान्पृथुग्मानं वाश्रं वावृधध्यै ।
कत्तस्य दातु शवसो व्युष्टौ तक्षद्वज्रं वृत्रतुरमपिन्वत्॥
verses.tr: kaṃ naścitramiṣaṇyasi cikitvānpṛthugmānaṃ vāśraṃ vāvṛdhadhyai kattasya dātu śavaso vyuṣṭau takṣadvajraṃ vṛtraturamapinvat
verses.en: What Splendid One, Loud-voiced, Far striding, dost thou, well knowing, urge us to exalt with praises? What give we him? When his might dawned, he fashioned the Vrtra-slaying bolt, and sent us waters.

verses.sa:
स हि द्युता विद्युता वेति साम पृथुं योनिमसुरत्वा ससाद ।
स सनीळेभिः प्रसहानो अस्य भ्रातुर्न ऋते सप्तथस्य मायाः॥
verses.tr: sa hi dyutā vidyutā veti sāma pṛthuṃ yonimasuratvā sasāda sa sanīḻebhiḥ prasahāno asya bhrāturna ṛte saptathasya māyāḥ
verses.en: He goes to end his work with lightning flashes: wide is the seat his Asura glory gives him. With his Companions, not without his Brother, he quells Saptatha's magic devices.

verses.sa:
स वाजं यातापदुष्पदा यन्त्स्वर्षाता परि षदत्सनिष्यन् ।
अनर्वा यच्छतदुरस्य वेदो घ्नञ्छिश्नदेवाँ अभि वर्पसा भूत्॥
verses.tr: sa vājaṃ yātāpaduṣpadā yantsvarṣātā pari ṣadatsaniṣyan anarvā yacchatadurasya vedo ghnañchiśnadevāṃ abhi varpasā bhūt
verses.en: On most auspicious path he goes to battle he toiled to win heaven's light, full fain to gain it; He seized the hundred-gated castle's treasure by craft, unchecked, and slew the lustful demons.

verses.sa:
स यह्व्यो३ऽवनीर्गोष्वर्वा ऽऽजुहोति प्रधन्यासु सस्रिः ।
अपादो यत्र युज्यासोऽरथा द्रोण्यश्वास ईरते घृतं वाः॥
verses.tr: sa yahvyo3'vanīrgoṣvarvā ''juhoti pradhanyāsu sasriḥ apādo yatra yujyāso'rathā droṇyaśvāsa īrate ghṛtaṃ vāḥ
verses.en: Fighting for kine, the prize of war, and I roaming among the berd be brings the young streams hither, Where, footless, joined, without a car to bear them, with jars for steeds, they pour their flood like butter.

verses.sa:
स रुद्रेभिरशस्तवार ऋभ्वा हित्वी गयमारेअवद्य आगात् ।
वम्रस्य मन्ये मिथुना विवव्री अन्नमभीत्यारोदयन्मुषायन्॥
verses.tr: sa rudrebhiraśastavāra ṛbhvā hitvī gayamāreavadya āgāt vamrasya manye mithunā vivavrī annamabhītyārodayanmuṣāyan
verses.en: Bold, unsolicited for wealth, with Rudras he came, the Blameless, having left his dwelling, Came, seized the food of Vamra and his consort, and left the couple weeping and unsheltered.

verses.sa:
स इद्दासं तुवीरवं पतिर्दन्षळक्षं त्रिशीर्षाणं दमन्यत् ।
अस्य त्रितो न्वोजसा वृधानो विपा वराहमयोअग्रया हन्॥
verses.tr: sa iddāsaṃ tuvīravaṃ patirdanṣaḻakṣaṃ triśīrṣāṇaṃ damanyat asya trito nvojasā vṛdhāno vipā varāhamayoagrayā han
verses.en: Lord of the dwelling, he subdued the demon who roared aloud, six-eyed and triple-headed. Trta, made stronger by the might he lent him, struck down the boar with shaft whose point was iron.

verses.sa:
स द्रुह्वणे मनुष ऊर्ध्वसान आ साविषदर्शसानाय शरुम् ।
स नृतमो नहुषोऽस्मत्सुजातः पुरोऽभिनदर्हन्दस्युहत्ये॥
verses.tr: sa druhvaṇe manuṣa ūrdhvasāna ā sāviṣadarśasānāya śarum sa nṛtamo nahuṣo'smatsujātaḥ puro'bhinadarhandasyuhatye
verses.en: He raised himself on high and shot his arrow against the guileful and oppressive foeman. Strong, glorious, manliest, for us he shattered the forts of Nabus when he slew the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
सो अभ्रियो न यवस उदन्यन्क्षयाय गातुं विदन्नो अस्मे ।
उप यत्सीददिन्दुं शरीरैः श्येनोऽयोपाष्टिर्हन्ति दस्यून्॥
verses.tr: so abhriyo na yavasa udanyankṣayāya gātuṃ vidanno asme upa yatsīdadinduṃ śarīraiḥ śyeno'yopāṣṭirhanti dasyūn
verses.en: He, like a cloud that rains upon the pasture, hath found for us the way to dwell in safety. When the Hawk comes in body to the Soma, armed with his iron claws he slays the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
स व्राधतः शवसानेभिरस्य कुत्साय शुष्णं कृपणे परादात् ।
अयं कविमनयच्छस्यमानमत्कं यो अस्य सनितोत नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: sa vrādhataḥ śavasānebhirasya kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ kṛpaṇe parādāt ayaṃ kavimanayacchasyamānamatkaṃ yo asya sanitota nṛṇām
verses.en: He with his potent Friends gave up the mighty, gave Gusnia up to Kutsa for affliction. He led the lauded Kavi, he delivered Atka as prey to him and to his heroes.

verses.sa:
अयं दशस्यन्नर्येभिरस्य दस्मो देवेभिर्वरुणो न मायी ।
अयं कनीन ऋतुपा अवेद्यमिमीताररुं यश्चतुष्पात्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ daśasyannaryebhirasya dasmo devebhirvaruṇo na māyī ayaṃ kanīna ṛtupā avedyamimītāraruṃ yaścatuṣpāt
verses.en: He, with his Gods who love mankind, the Wondrous, giving like Varuna who works with magic, Was known, yet young as guardian of the seasons; and he quelled Araru, four-footed demon.

verses.sa:
अस्य स्तोमेभिरौशिज ऋजिश्वा व्रजं दरयद्वृषभेण पिप्रोः ।
सुत्वा यद्यजतो दीदयद्गीः पुर इयानो अभि वर्पसा भूत्॥
verses.tr: asya stomebhirauśija ṛjiśvā vrajaṃ darayadvṛṣabheṇa piproḥ sutvā yadyajato dīdayadgīḥ pura iyāno abhi varpasā bhūt
verses.en: Through lauds of him hath Ausija Rjisvan burst, with the Mighty's aid, the stall of Pipru. When the saint pressed the juice and shone as singer, he seized the forts and with his craft subdued them.

verses.sa:
एवा महो असुर वक्षथाय वम्रकः पड्भिरुप सर्पदिन्द्रम् ।
स इयानः करति स्वस्तिमस्मा इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः॥
verses.tr: evā maho asura vakṣathāya vamrakaḥ paḍbhirupa sarpadindram sa iyānaḥ karati svastimasmā iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ
verses.en: So, swiftly Asura, for exaltation, hath the great Vamraka come nigh to Indra. He will, when supplicated, bring him blessing: he hath brought all, food, strength, a happy dwelling.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र दृह्य मघवन्त्वावदिद्भुज इह स्तुतः सुतपा बोधि नो वृधे ।
देवेभिर्नः सविता प्रावतु श्रुतमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: indra dṛhya maghavantvāvadidbhuja iha stutaḥ sutapā bodhi no vṛdhe devebhirnaḥ savitā prāvatu śrutamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Be, like thyself, O Indra, strong for our delight: here lauded, aid us, Maghavan, drinker of the juice. Savitar with the Gods protect us: hear ye Twain. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
भराय सु भरत भागमृत्वियं प्र वायवे शुचिपे क्रन्ददिष्टये ।
गौरस्य यः पयसः पीतिमानश आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: bharāya su bharata bhāgamṛtviyaṃ pra vāyave śucipe krandadiṣṭaye gaurasya yaḥ payasaḥ pītimānaśa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Bring swift, for offering, the snare that suits the time, to the pure-drinker Vayu, roaring as he goes, To him who hath approached the draught of shining milk. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवः सविता साविषद्वय ऋजूयते यजमानाय सुन्वते ।
यथा देवान्प्रतिभूषेम पाकवदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: ā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣadvaya ṛjūyate yajamānāya sunvate yathā devānpratibhūṣema pākavadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: May Savitar the God send us full life, to each who sacrifices, lives aright and pours the juice That we with simple hearts may wait upon the Gods. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अस्मे सुमना अस्तु विश्वहा राजा सोमः सुवितस्याध्येतु नः ।
यथायथा मित्रधितानि संदधुरा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: indro asme sumanā astu viśvahā rājā somaḥ suvitasyādhyetu naḥ yathāyathā mitradhitāni saṃdadhurā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: May Indra evermore be gracious unto us, and may King Soma meditate our happiness, Even as men secure the comfort of a friend. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र उक्थेन शवसा परुर्दधे बृहस्पते प्रतरीतास्यायुषः ।
यज्ञो मनुः प्रमतिर्नः पिता हि कमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: indra ukthena śavasā parurdadhe bṛhaspate pratarītāsyāyuṣaḥ yajño manuḥ pramatirnaḥ pitā hi kamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Indra hath given the body with its song and strength: Brhaspati, thou art the lengthener of life. The sacrifice is Manu, Providence, our Sire. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु सुकृतं दैव्यं सहोऽग्निर्गृहे जरिता मेधिरः कविः ।
यज्ञश्च भूद्विदथे चारुरन्तम आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: indrasya nu sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho'gnirgṛhe jaritā medhiraḥ kaviḥ yajñaśca bhūdvidathe cārurantama ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Indra possesseth might celestial nobly formed: the singer in the hotise is Agni, prudent Sage. lie is the sacrifice in synod, fair, most near. We ask for freedom and complete felicity,

verses.sa:
न वो गुहा चकृम भूरि दुष्कृतं नाविष्ट्यं वसवो देवहेळनम् ।
माकिर्नो देवा अनृतस्य वर्पस आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: na vo guhā cakṛma bhūri duṣkṛtaṃ nāviṣṭyaṃ vasavo devaheḻanam mākirno devā anṛtasya varpasa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Not often have we sinned against you secretly, nor, Vasus, have we openly provoked the Gods. Not one of its, ye Gods, hath worn an alien shape. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
अपामीवां सविता साविषन्न्य१ग्वरीय इदप सेधन्त्वद्रयः ।
ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: apāmīvāṃ savitā sāviṣannya1gvarīya idapa sedhantvadrayaḥ grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: May Savitar remove from us our malady, and may the Mountains keep it far away from where The press-stone as it sheds the meath rings loudly forth. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा वसवोऽस्तु सोतरि विश्वा द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत ।
स नो देवः सविता पायुरीड्य आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo grāvā vasavo'stu sotari viśvā dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota sa no devaḥ savitā pāyurīḍya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Ye Vasus, let the stone, the presser stand erect: avert all enmities and keep them far remote. Our guard to be adored is Savitar this God. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जं गावो यवसे पीवो अत्तन ऋतस्य याः सदने कोशे अङ्ग्ध्वे ।
तनूरेव तन्वो अस्तु भेषजमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: ūrjaṃ gāvo yavase pīvo attana ṛtasya yāḥ sadane kośe aṅgdhve tanūreva tanvo astu bheṣajamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Eat strength and fatness in the pasture, kine, who are balmed at the reservoir and at the seat of Law. So let your body be our body's medicine. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
क्रतुप्रावा जरिता शश्वतामव इन्द्र इद्भद्रा प्रमतिः सुतावताम् ।
पूर्णमूधर्दिव्यं यस्य सिक्तय आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: kratuprāvā jaritā śaśvatāmava indra idbhadrā pramatiḥ sutāvatām pūrṇamūdhardivyaṃ yasya siktaya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: The singer fills the spirit: all mens, love hath he. Indra takes kindly care of those who pour the juice. For his libation is the heavenly udder full. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
चित्रस्ते भानुः क्रतुप्रा अभिष्टिः सन्ति स्पृधो जरणिप्रा अधृष्टाः ।
रजिष्ठया रज्या पश्व आ गोस्तूतूर्षति पर्यग्रं दुवस्युः॥
verses.tr: citraste bhānuḥ kratuprā abhiṣṭiḥ santi spṛdho jaraṇiprā adhṛṣṭāḥ rajiṣṭhayā rajyā paśva ā gostūtūrṣati paryagraṃ duvasyuḥ
verses.en: Wondrous thy spirit-filling light, triumphant; thy hosts save from decay and are resistless. The pious votary by straightest pathway speeds to possess the best of all the cattle.

verses.sa:
उद्बुध्यध्वं समनसः सखायः समग्निमिन्ध्वं बहवः सनीळाः ।
दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीमिन्द्रावतोऽवसे नि ह्वये वः॥
verses.tr: udbudhyadhvaṃ samanasaḥ sakhāyaḥ samagnimindhvaṃ bahavaḥ sanīḻāḥ dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīmindrāvato'vase ni hvaye vaḥ
verses.en: Wake with one mind, my friends, and kindle Agni, ye who are many and who dwell together. Agni and Dadhikras and Dawn the Goddess, you, Gods with Indra, I call down to help us.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रा कृणुध्वं धिय आ तनुध्वं नावमरित्रपरणीं कृणुध्वम् ।
इष्कृणुध्वमायुधारं कृणुध्वं प्राञ्चं यज्ञं प्र णयता सखायः॥
verses.tr: mandrā kṛṇudhvaṃ dhiya ā tanudhvaṃ nāvamaritraparaṇīṃ kṛṇudhvam iṣkṛṇudhvamāyudhāraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ pra ṇayatā sakhāyaḥ
verses.en: Make pleasant hymns, spin out your songs and praises: build ye a ship equipped with oars for transport. Prepare the implements, make all things ready, and let the sacrifice, my friends, go forward.

verses.sa:
युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम् ।
गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात्॥
verses.tr: yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt
verses.en: Lay on the yokes, and fasten well the traces: formed is the furrow, sow the seed within it. Through song may we find bearing fraught with plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.

verses.sa: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक् । धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया॥
verses.tr: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā
verses.en: Wise, through desire of bliss from Gods, the skillful bind the traces fast, And lay the yokes on either side.

verses.sa: निराहावान्कृणोतन सं वरत्रा दधातन । सिञ्चामहा अवतमुद्रिणं वयं सुषेकमनुपक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: nirāhāvānkṛṇotana saṃ varatrā dadhātana siñcāmahā avatamudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanupakṣitam
verses.en: Arrange the buckets in their place securely fasten on the straps. We will pour forth the well that hath a copious stream, fair-flowing well that never fails.

verses.sa: इष्कृताहावमवतं सुवरत्रं सुषेचनम् । उद्रिणं सिञ्चे अक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: iṣkṛtāhāvamavataṃ suvaratraṃ suṣecanam udriṇaṃ siñce akṣitam
verses.en: I pour the water from the well with pails prepared and goodly straps, Unfailing, full, with plenteous stream.

verses.sa:
प्रीणीताश्वान्हितं जयाथ स्वस्तिवाहं रथमित्कृणुध्वम् ।
द्रोणाहावमवतमश्मचक्रमंसत्रकोशं सिञ्चता नृपाणम्॥
verses.tr: prīṇītāśvānhitaṃ jayātha svastivāhaṃ rathamitkṛṇudhvam droṇāhāvamavatamaśmacakramaṃsatrakośaṃ siñcatā nṛpāṇam
verses.en: Refresh the horses, win the prize before you: equip a chariot fraught with happy fortune. Pour forth the well with stone wheel, wooden buckets, the drink of heroes, with the trough for armour.

verses.sa:
व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्म सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि ।
पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहता तम्॥
verses.tr: vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varma sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni puraḥ kṛṇudhvamāyasīradhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroccamaso dṛṃhatā tam
verses.en: Prepare the cow-stall, for there drink your heroes: stitch ye the coats of armour, wide and many. Make iron forts, secure from all assailants let not your pitcher leak: stay it securely.

verses.sa:
आ वो धियं यज्ञियां वर्त ऊतये देवा देवीं यजतां यज्ञियामिह ।
सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः॥
verses.tr: ā vo dhiyaṃ yajñiyāṃ varta ūtaye devā devīṃ yajatāṃ yajñiyāmiha sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
verses.en: Hither, for help, I turn the holy heavenly mind of you the Holy Gods, that longs for sacrifice. May it pour milk for us, even as a stately cow who, having sought the pasture, yields a thousand streams.

verses.sa:
आ तू षिञ्च हरिमीं द्रोरुपस्थे वाशीभिस्तक्षताश्मन्मयीभिः ।
परि ष्वजध्वं दश कक्ष्याभिरुभे धुरौ प्रति वह्निं युनक्त॥
verses.tr: ā tū ṣiñca harimīṃ drorupasthe vāśībhistakṣatāśmanmayībhiḥ pari ṣvajadhvaṃ daśa kakṣyābhirubhe dhurau prati vahniṃ yunakta
verses.en: Pour golden juice within the wooden vessel: with stone-made axes fashion ye and form it. Embrace and compass it with tenfold girdle, and to both chariot-poles attach the car-horse.

verses.sa:
उभे धुरौ वह्निरापिब्दमानोऽन्तर्योनेव चरति द्विजानिः ।
वनस्पतिं वन आस्थापयध्वं नि षू दधिध्वमखनन्त उत्सम्॥
verses.tr: ubhe dhurau vahnirāpibdamāno'ntaryoneva carati dvijāniḥ vanaspatiṃ vana āsthāpayadhvaṃ ni ṣū dadhidhvamakhananta utsam
verses.en: Between both poles the car-horse goes pressed closely, as in his dwelling moves the doubly-wedded. Lay in the wood the Soviran of the Forest, and sink the well although ye do not dig it.

verses.sa:
कपृन्नरः कपृथमुद्दधातन चोदयत खुदत वाजसातये ।
निष्टिग्र्यः पुत्रमा च्यावयोतय इन्द्रं सबाध इह सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: kapṛnnaraḥ kapṛthamuddadhātana codayata khudata vājasātaye niṣṭigryaḥ putramā cyāvayotaya indraṃ sabādha iha somapītaye
verses.en: Indra is he, O men, who gives us happiness: sport, urge the giver of delight to win us strength Bring quickly down, O priests, hither to give us aid, to drink the Soma, Indra Son of Nistigri.

verses.sa:
प्र ते रथं मिथूकृतमिन्द्रोऽवतु धृष्णुया ।
अस्मिन्नाजौ पुरुहूत श्रवाय्ये धनभक्षेषु नोऽव॥
verses.tr: pra te rathaṃ mithūkṛtamindro'vatu dhṛṣṇuyā asminnājau puruhūta śravāyye dhanabhakṣeṣu no'va
verses.en: For thee may Indra boldly speed the car that works on either side. Favour us, Much-invoked! in this most glorious fight against the raiders of our wealth.

verses.sa:
उत्स्म वातो वहति वासोऽस्या अधिरथं यदजयत्सहस्रम् ।
रथीरभून्मुद्गलानी गविष्टौ भरे कृतं व्यचेदिन्द्रसेना॥
verses.tr: utsma vāto vahati vāso'syā adhirathaṃ yadajayatsahasram rathīrabhūnmudgalānī gaviṣṭau bhare kṛtaṃ vyacedindrasenā
verses.en: Loose in the wind the woman's robe was streaming what time she won a car-load worth a thousand. The charioteer in fight was Mudgalani: she Indra's dart, heaped up the prize of battle.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्यच्छ जिघांसतो वज्रमिन्द्राभिदासतः ।
दासस्य वा मघवन्नार्यस्य वा सनुतर्यवया वधम्॥
verses.tr: antaryaccha jighāṃsato vajramindrābhidāsataḥ dāsasya vā maghavannāryasya vā sanutaryavayā vadham
verses.en: O Indra, cast thy bolt among assailants who would slaughter us: The weapon both of Dasa and of Arya foe keep far away, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
उद्नो ह्रदमपिबज्जर्हृषाणः कूटं स्म तृंहदभिमातिमेति ।
प्र मुष्कभारः श्रव इच्छमानोऽजिरं बाहू अभरत्सिषासन्॥
verses.tr: udno hradamapibajjarhṛṣāṇaḥ kūṭaṃ sma tṛṃhadabhimātimeti pra muṣkabhāraḥ śrava icchamāno'jiraṃ bāhū abharatsiṣāsan
verses.en: The bull in joy had drunk a lake of water. His shattering horn encountered an opponent. Swiftly, in vigorous strength, eager for glory, he stretched his forefeet, fain to win and triumph.

verses.sa:
न्यक्रन्दयन्नुपयन्त एनममेहयन्वृषभं मध्य आजेः ।
तेन सूभर्वं शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः प्रधने जिगाय॥
verses.tr: nyakrandayannupayanta enamamehayanvṛṣabhaṃ madhya ājeḥ tena sūbharvaṃ śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pradhane jigāya
verses.en: They came anear the bull; they made him thunder, made him pour rain down ere the fight was ended. And Mudgala thereby won in the contest well-pastured kine in hundreds and in thousands.

verses.sa:
ककर्दवे वृषभो युक्त आसीदवावचीत्सारथिरस्य केशी ।
दुधेर्युक्तस्य द्रवतः सहानस ऋच्छन्ति ष्मा निष्पदो मुद्गलानीम्॥
verses.tr: kakardave vṛṣabho yukta āsīdavāvacītsārathirasya keśī dudheryuktasya dravataḥ sahānasa ṛcchanti ṣmā niṣpado mudgalānīm
verses.en: In hope of victory that bull was harnessed: Kesi the driver urged him on with shouting. As he ran swiftly with the car behind him his lifted heels pressed close on Mudgalani.

verses.sa:
उत प्रधिमुदहन्नस्य विद्वानुपायुनग्वंसगमत्र शिक्षन् ।
इन्द्र उदावत्पतिमघ्न्यानामरंहत पद्याभिः ककुद्मान्॥
verses.tr: uta pradhimudahannasya vidvānupāyunagvaṃsagamatra śikṣan indra udāvatpatimaghnyānāmaraṃhata padyābhiḥ kakudmān
verses.en: Deftly for him he stretched the car-pole forward, guided the bull thereto and firmly yoked him. Indra vouchsafed the lord of cows his favour: with mighty steps the buffalo ran onward.

verses.sa:
शुनमष्ट्राव्यचरत्कपर्दी वरत्रायां दार्वानह्यमानः ।
नृम्णानि कृण्वन्बहवे जनाय गाः पस्पशानस्तविषीरधत्त॥
verses.tr: śunamaṣṭrāvyacaratkapardī varatrāyāṃ dārvānahyamānaḥ nṛmṇāni kṛṇvanbahave janāya gāḥ paspaśānastaviṣīradhatta
verses.en: Touched by the goad the shaggy beast went nobly, bound to the pole by the yoke's thong of leather. Performing deeds of might for many people, he, looking on the cows, gained strength and vigour.

verses.sa:
इमं तं पश्य वृषभस्य युञ्जं काष्ठाया मध्ये द्रुघणं शयानम् ।
येन जिगाय शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः पृतनाज्येषु॥
verses.tr: imaṃ taṃ paśya vṛṣabhasya yuñjaṃ kāṣṭhāyā madhye drughaṇaṃ śayānam yena jigāya śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pṛtanājyeṣu
verses.en: Here look upon this mace, this bull's companion, now lying midway on the field of battle. Therewith hath Mudgala in ordered contest won for cattle for himself, a hundred thousand.

verses.sa:
आरे अघा को न्वि१त्था ददर्श यं युञ्जन्ति तम्वा स्थापयन्ति ।
नास्मै तृणं नोदकमा भरन्त्युत्तरो धुरो वहति प्रदेदिशत्॥
verses.tr: āre aghā ko nvi1tthā dadarśa yaṃ yuñjanti tamvā sthāpayanti nāsmai tṛṇaṃ nodakamā bharantyuttaro dhuro vahati pradediśat
verses.en: Far is the evil: who hath here beheld it? Hither they bring the bull whom they are yoking.. To this they give not either food or water. Reaching beyond the pole it gives directions.

verses.sa:
परिवृक्तेव पतिविद्यमानट् पीप्याना कूचक्रेणेव सिञ्चन् ।
एषैष्या चिद्रथ्या जयेम सुमङ्गलं सिनवदस्तु सातम्॥
verses.tr: parivṛkteva patividyamānaṭ pīpyānā kūcakreṇeva siñcan eṣaiṣyā cidrathyā jayema sumaṅgalaṃ sinavadastu sātam
verses.en: Like one forsaken, she hath found a husband, and teemed as if her breast were full and flowing. With swiftly-racing chariot may we conquer, and rich and blessed be our gains in battle.

verses.sa: त्वं विश्वस्य जगतश्चक्षुरिन्द्रासि चक्षुषः । वृषा यदाजिं वृषणा सिषाससि चोदयन्वध्रिणा युजा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viśvasya jagataścakṣurindrāsi cakṣuṣaḥ vṛṣā yadājiṃ vṛṣaṇā siṣāsasi codayanvadhriṇā yujā
verses.en: Thou, Indra, art the mark whereon the eyes of all life rest, when thou, A Bull who drivest with thy bull, wilt win the race together with thy weakling friend.

verses.sa:
आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayatsākamindraḥ
verses.en: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people, With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra. subdued at once a hundred armies.

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा॥
verses.tr: saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā
verses.en: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle, Indra. the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.

verses.sa:
स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्यु१ग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता॥
verses.tr: sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyu1gradhanvā pratihitābhirastā
verses.en: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band rings hosts together, Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः ।
प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrāṃ apabādhamānaḥ prabhañjantsenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām
verses.en: Brhaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen. Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies.

verses.sa:
बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित्॥
verses.tr: balavijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvānvājī sahamāna ugraḥ abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit
verses.en: Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.

verses.sa:
गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ।
इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम्॥
verses.tr: gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam
verses.en: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it.- Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.

verses.sa:
अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्यो३ऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु॥
verses.tr: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḻayudhyo3'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu
verses.en: Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless, may he protect our armies in our battles.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम्॥
verses.tr: indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram
verses.en: Indra guide these: Brhaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम् ।
महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात्॥
verses.tr: indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt
verses.en: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts, and Adityas. Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि ।
उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः॥
verses.tr: uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi udvṛtrahanvājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ
verses.en: Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits of my warring heroes. Urge on the strong steeds' might, O Vrtra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ उ देवा अवता हवेषु॥
verses.tr: asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmāṃ u devā avatā haveṣu
verses.en: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army. May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset.

verses.sa:
अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām
verses.en: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies and depart, O Apva. Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.

verses.sa: प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु । उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ॥
verses.tr: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha
verses.en: Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defense. Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.

verses.sa:
असावि सोमः पुरुहूत तुभ्यं हरिभ्यां यज्ञमुप याहि तूयम् ।
तुभ्यं गिरो विप्रवीरा इयाना दधन्विर इन्द्र पिबा सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ haribhyāṃ yajñamupa yāhi tūyam tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya
verses.en: Soma hath flowed for thee, Invoked of mat Speed to our sacrifice with both thy Coursers. To thee have streamed the songs or mighty singers, imploring, Indra, drink of our libation.

verses.sa:
अप्सु धूतस्य हरिवः पिबेह नृभिः सुतस्य जठरं पृणस्व ।
मिमिक्षुर्यमद्रय इन्द्र तुभ्यं तेभिर्वर्धस्व मदमुक्थवाहः॥
verses.tr: apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva mimikṣuryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ
verses.en: Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters, and fill thee full, O Lord of Tawny Horses. O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mixed for thee enhance thy rapture.

verses.sa:
प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम् ।
इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः॥
verses.tr: progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee, the Bull, O thou whom Bay Steeds carry. Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.

verses.sa:
ऊती शचीवस्तव वीर्येण वयो दधाना उशिज ऋतज्ञाः ।
प्रजावदिन्द्र मनुषो दुरोणे तस्थुर्गृणन्तः सधमाद्यासः॥
verses.tr: ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ prajāvadindra manuṣo duroṇe tasthurgṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ
verses.en: O Mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in Order, Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children.

verses.sa:
प्रणीतिभिष्टे हर्यश्व सुष्टोः सुषुम्नस्य पुरुरुचो जनासः ।
मंहिष्ठामूतिं वितिरे दधाना स्तोतार इन्द्र तव सूनृताभिः॥
verses.tr: praṇītibhiṣṭe haryaśva suṣṭoḥ suṣumnasya pururuco janāsaḥ maṃhiṣṭhāmūtiṃ vitire dadhānā stotāra indra tava sūnṛtābhiḥ
verses.en: Through thy directions, Lord of Tawny Coursers, thine who art firm, splendid, and blest, the people Obtain most liberal aid for their salvation, and praise thee, Indra, through thine excellencies.

verses.sa:
उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवो हरिभ्यां सोमस्य याहि पीतये सुतस्य ।
इन्द्र त्वा यज्ञः क्षममाणमानड्दाश्वाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतः॥
verses.tr: upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇamānaḍdāśvāṃ asyadhvarasya praketaḥ
verses.en: Lord of the Bays, come with thy two Bay Horses, come to our prayers, to drink the juice of Soma. To thee comes sacrifice which thou acceptest: thou, skilled in holy rites, art he who giveth.

verses.sa:
सहस्रवाजमभिमातिषाहं सुतेरणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिम् ।
उप भूषन्ति गिरो अप्रतीतमिन्द्रं नमस्या जरितुः पनन्त॥
verses.tr: sahasravājamabhimātiṣāhaṃ suteraṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktim upa bhūṣanti giro apratītamindraṃ namasyā jarituḥ pananta
verses.en: Him of a thousand powers, subduing foemen, Maghavan praised with hymns and pleased with Soma,- Even him our songs approach, resistless Indra: the adorations of the singer laud him.

verses.sa:
सप्तापो देवीः सुरणा अमृक्ता याभिः सिन्धुमतर इन्द्र पूर्भित् ।
नवतिं स्रोत्या नव च स्रवन्तीर्देवेभ्यो गातुं मनुषे च विन्दः॥
verses.tr: saptāpo devīḥ suraṇā amṛktā yābhiḥ sindhumatara indra pūrbhit navatiṃ srotyā nava ca sravantīrdevebhyo gātuṃ manuṣe ca vindaḥ
verses.en: The way to bliss for Gods and man thou foundest, Indra, seven lovely floods, divine, untroubled, Wherewith thou, rending forts, didst move the ocean, and nine-and-ninety flowing streams of water.

verses.sa:
अपो महीरभिशस्तेरमुञ्चोऽजागरास्वधि देव एकः ।
इन्द्र यास्त्वं वृत्रतूर्ये चकर्थ ताभिर्विश्वायुस्तन्वं पुपुष्याः॥
verses.tr: apo mahīrabhiśasteramuñco'jāgarāsvadhi deva ekaḥ indra yāstvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakartha tābhirviśvāyustanvaṃ pupuṣyāḥ
verses.en: Thou from the curse didst free the mighty Waters, and as their only God didst watch and guard them. O Indra, cherish evermore thy body with those which thou hast won in quelling Vrtra.

verses.sa:
वीरेण्यः क्रतुरिन्द्रः सुशस्तिरुतापि धेना पुरुहूतमीट्टे ।
आर्दयद्वृत्रमकृणोदु लोकं ससाहे शक्रः पृतना अभिष्टिः॥
verses.tr: vīreṇyaḥ kraturindraḥ suśastirutāpi dhenā puruhūtamīṭṭe ārdayadvṛtramakṛṇodu lokaṃ sasāhe śakraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ
verses.en: Heroic power and noble praise is Indra yea, the song worships him invoked of many. Vrtra he quelled, and gave men room and freedom: Gakra, victorious, hath conquered armies.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghayan, auspicious Indra. best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa: कदा वसो स्तोत्रं हर्यत आव श्मशा रुधद्वाः । दीर्घं सुतं वाताप्याय॥
verses.tr: kadā vaso stotraṃ haryata āva śmaśā rudhadvāḥ dīrghaṃ sutaṃ vātāpyāya
verses.en: When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.

verses.sa: हरी यस्य सुयुजा विव्रता वेरर्वन्तानु शेपा । उभा रजी न केशिना पतिर्दन्॥
verses.tr: harī yasya suyujā vivratā verarvantānu śepā ubhā rajī na keśinā patirdan
verses.en: He whose two Bay Steeds harnessed well, swerving, pursue the Bird's tail-plumes, With Rowing manes, like heaven and earth, he is the Lord with power to give.

verses.sa: अप योरिन्द्रः पापज आ मर्तो न शश्रमाणो बिभीवान् । शुभे यद्युयुजे तविषीवान्॥
verses.tr: apa yorindraḥ pāpaja ā marto na śaśramāṇo bibhīvān śubhe yadyuyuje taviṣīvān
verses.en: Bereft of skill is Indra, if, like some outwearied man he fears The sinner, when the Mighty hath prepared himself for victory.

verses.sa: सचायोरिन्द्रश्चर्कृष आँ उपानसः सपर्यन् । नदयोर्विव्रतयोः शूर इन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: sacāyorindraścarkṛṣa āṃ upānasaḥ saparyan nadayorvivratayoḥ śūra indraḥ
verses.en: Indra with these drives round, until he meets with one to worship him: Indra is Master of the pair who snort and swerve upon their way.

verses.sa: अधि यस्तस्थौ केशवन्ता व्यचस्वन्ता न पुष्ट्यै । वनोति शिप्राभ्यां शिप्रिणीवान्॥
verses.tr: adhi yastasthau keśavantā vyacasvantā na puṣṭyai vanoti śiprābhyāṃ śipriṇīvān
verses.en: Borne onward by the long-maned Steeds who stretch themselves as 'twere for food, The God who wears the helm defends them with his jaws.

verses.sa: प्रास्तौदृष्वौजा ऋष्वेभिस्ततक्ष शूरः शवसा । ऋभुर्न क्रतुभिर्मातरिश्वा॥
verses.tr: prāstaudṛṣvaujā ṛṣvebhistatakṣa śūraḥ śavasā ṛbhurna kratubhirmātariśvā
verses.en: The Mighty sang with Lofty Ones: the Hero fashioned with his strength, Like skillful Matarisvan with his power and might,

verses.sa: वज्रं यश्चक्रे सुहनाय दस्यवे हिरीमशो हिरीमान् । अरुतहनुरद्भुतं न रजः॥
verses.tr: vajraṃ yaścakre suhanāya dasyave hirīmaśo hirīmān arutahanuradbhutaṃ na rajaḥ
verses.en: The bolt, which pierced at once the vitals of the Dasyu easy to be slain, With jaw uninjured like the wondrous firmament.

verses.sa: अव नो वृजिना शिशीह्यृचा वनेमानृचः । नाब्रह्मा यज्ञ ऋधग्जोषति त्वे॥
verses.tr: ava no vṛjinā śiśīhyṛcā vanemānṛcaḥ nābrahmā yajña ṛdhagjoṣati tve
verses.en: Grind off our sins: with song will we conquer the men who sing no hymns: Not easily art thou pleased with prayerless sacrifice.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वा यत्ते त्रेतिनी भूद्यज्ञस्य धूर्षु सद्मन् । सजूर्नावं स्वयशसं सचायोः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvā yatte tretinī bhūdyajñasya dhūrṣu sadman sajūrnāvaṃ svayaśasaṃ sacāyoḥ
verses.en: When threefold flame burns high for thee, to rest on poles of sacrifice, Thou with the living joyest in the self-bright Ship.

verses.sa: श्रिये ते पृश्निरुपसेचनी भूच्छ्रिये दर्विररेपाः । यया स्वे पात्रे सिञ्चस उत्॥
verses.tr: śriye te pṛśnirupasecanī bhūcchriye darvirarepāḥ yayā sve pātre siñcasa ut
verses.en: Thy glory was the speckled cup, thy glory was the flawless scoop. Wherewith thou pourest into thy receptacle.

verses.sa:
शतं वा यदसुर्य प्रति त्वा सुमित्र इत्थास्तौद्दुर्मित्र इत्थास्तौत् ।
आवो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सपुत्रं प्रावो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सवत्सम्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vā yadasurya prati tvā sumitra itthāstauddurmitra itthāstaut āvo yaddasyuhatye kutsaputraṃ prāvo yaddasyuhatye kutsavatsam
verses.en: As hundreds, O Immortal God, have sung to thee, so hath Sumitra, yea, Durmitra praised thee here, What time thou holpest Kutsa's son, when Dasyus fell, yea, holpest Kutsa's darling when the Dasyus died.

verses.sa:
उभा उ नूनं तदिदर्थयेथे वि तन्वाथे धियो वस्त्रापसेव ।
सध्रीचीना यातवे प्रेमजीगः सुदिनेव पृक्ष आ तंसयेथे॥
verses.tr: ubhā u nūnaṃ tadidarthayethe vi tanvāthe dhiyo vastrāpaseva sadhrīcīnā yātave premajīgaḥ sudineva pṛkṣa ā taṃsayethe
verses.en: This very thing ye Twain hold as your object: ye weave your songs as skillful men weave garments. That ye may come united have I waked you: ye spread out food like days of lovely weather.

verses.sa:
उष्टारेव फर्वरेषु श्रयेथे प्रायोगेव श्वात्र्या शासुरेथः ।
दूतेव हि ष्ठो यशसा जनेषु माप स्थातं महिषेवावपानात्॥
verses.tr: uṣṭāreva pharvareṣu śrayethe prāyogeva śvātryā śāsurethaḥ dūteva hi ṣṭho yaśasā janeṣu māpa sthātaṃ mahiṣevāvapānāt
verses.en: Like two plough-bulls ye move along in traces, and seek like eager guests your bidder's banquet. Ye are like glorious envoys mid the people: like bulls, approach the place where ye are watered.

verses.sa:
साकंयुजा शकुनस्येव पक्षा पश्वेव चित्रा यजुरा गमिष्टम् ।
अग्निरिव देवयोर्दीदिवांसा परिज्मानेव यजथः पुरुत्रा॥
verses.tr: sākaṃyujā śakunasyeva pakṣā paśveva citrā yajurā gamiṣṭam agniriva devayordīdivāṃsā parijmāneva yajathaḥ purutrā
verses.en: Like the two pinions of a bird, connected, like two choice animals, ye have sought our worship. Bright as the fire the votary hath kindled, ye sacrifice in many a spot as roamers.

verses.sa:
आपी वो अस्मे पितरेव पुत्रोग्रेव रुचा नृपतीव तुर्यै ।
इर्येव पुष्ट्यै किरणेव भुज्यै श्रुष्टीवानेव हवमा गमिष्टम्॥
verses.tr: āpī vo asme pitareva putrogreva rucā nṛpatīva turyai iryeva puṣṭyai kiraṇeva bhujyai śruṣṭīvāneva havamā gamiṣṭam
verses.en: Ye are our kinsmen, like two sons, two fathers, strong in your splendour and like kings for conquest; Like rays for our enjoyment, Lords to feed us, ye, like quick bearers, have obeyed our calling.

verses.sa:
वंसगेव पूषर्या शिम्बाता मित्रेव ऋता शतरा शातपन्ता ।
वाजेवोच्चा वयसा घर्म्येष्ठा मेषेवेषा सपर्या३ पुरीषा॥
verses.tr: vaṃsageva pūṣaryā śimbātā mitreva ṛtā śatarā śātapantā vājevoccā vayasā gharmyeṣṭhā meṣeveṣā saparyā3 purīṣā
verses.en: You are like two pleasantly moving well-fed (hills) like Mitra and Varuna, the two bestowers of felicity, veracious, possessors of infinite wealth, happy, like two horses plump with fodder, abiding in the firmament, like two rams (are you) to be nourished with sacrificial food, to be cherished (with oblations).

verses.sa:
सृण्येव जर्भरी तुर्फरीतू नैतोशेव तुर्फरी पर्फरीका ।
उदन्यजेव जेमना मदेरू ता मे जराय्वजरं मरायु॥
verses.tr: sṛṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū naitośeva turpharī parpharīkā udanyajeva jemanā maderū tā me jarāyvajaraṃ marāyu
verses.en: You are like two mad elephants bending their forequarters and smiting the foe, like the two sons of Nitosa destroying (foes), and cherishing (friends); you are bright as two water-born (jewels), do you, who are victorious, (render) my decaying mortal body free from decay.

verses.sa:
पज्रेव चर्चरं जारं मरायु क्षद्मेवार्थेषु तर्तरीथ उग्रा ।
ऋभू नापत्खरमज्रा खरज्रुर्वायुर्न पर्फरत्क्षयद्रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: pajreva carcaraṃ jāraṃ marāyu kṣadmevārtheṣu tartarītha ugrā ṛbhū nāpatkharamajrā kharajrurvāyurna parpharatkṣayadrayīṇām
verses.en: Fierce (Asvins), like two powerful (heroes), you enable this moving, perishable mortal (frame) to cross over to the objects (of its destination) as over water; extremely strong, like the Rbhus, your chariot, attained its destination swift as the wind, it pervaded (everywhere), it dispensed riches.

verses.sa:
घर्मेव मधु जठरे सनेरू भगेविता तुर्फरी फारिवारम् ।
पतरेव चचरा चन्द्रनिर्णिङ्मनऋङ्गा मनन्या३ न जग्मी॥
verses.tr: gharmeva madhu jaṭhare sanerū bhagevitā turpharī phārivāram patareva cacarā candranirṇiṅmanaṛṅgā mananyā3 na jagmī
verses.en: With your bellies full of the Soma, like two saucepans, preservers of wealth, destroyers of enemies. (you are) armed with hatchets, moving like two flying (birds) with forms like the moon, attaining success through the mind, like two laudable beings, (you are) approaching (the sacrifice).

verses.sa:
बृहन्तेव गम्भरेषु प्रतिष्ठां पादेव गाधं तरते विदाथः ।
कर्णेव शासुरनु हि स्मराथोंऽशेव नो भजतं चित्रमप्नः॥
verses.tr: bṛhanteva gambhareṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ pādeva gādhaṃ tarate vidāthaḥ karṇeva śāsuranu hi smarāthoṃ'śeva no bhajataṃ citramapnaḥ
verses.en: Like giants, ye will find firm ground to stand on in depths, like feet for one who fords a shallow. Like cars ye will attend to him who orders: ye Two enjoy our wondrous work as sharers.

verses.sa:
आरङ्गरेव मध्वेरयेथे सारघेव गवि नीचीनबारे ।
कीनारेव स्वेदमासिष्विदाना क्षामेवोर्जा सूयवसात्सचेथे॥
verses.tr: āraṅgareva madhverayethe sāragheva gavi nīcīnabāre kīnāreva svedamāsiṣvidānā kṣāmevorjā sūyavasātsacethe
verses.en: Like toiling bees ye bring to us your honey, as bees into the hide that opens downward.

verses.sa:
ऋध्याम स्तोमं सनुयाम वाजमा नो मन्त्रं सरथेहोप यातम् ।
यशो न पक्वं मधु गोष्वन्तरा भूतांशो अश्विनोः काममप्राः॥
verses.tr: ṛdhyāma stomaṃ sanuyāma vājamā no mantraṃ sarathehopa yātam yaśo na pakvaṃ madhu goṣvantarā bhūtāṃśo aśvinoḥ kāmamaprāḥ
verses.en: May we increase the laud and gain us vigour: come to our song, ye whom one chariot carries. Filled be our kine with ripened meath like glory: Bhutamsa hath fulfilled the Asvins' longing.

verses.sa:
आविरभून्महि माघोनमेषां विश्वं जीवं तमसो निरमोचि ।
महि ज्योतिः पितृभिर्दत्तमागादुरुः पन्था दक्षिणाया अदर्शि॥
verses.tr: āvirabhūnmahi māghonameṣāṃ viśvaṃ jīvaṃ tamaso niramoci mahi jyotiḥ pitṛbhirdattamāgāduruḥ panthā dakṣiṇāyā adarśi
verses.en: These men's great bounty hath been manifested, and the whole world of life set free from darkness. Great light hath come, vouchsafed us by the Fathers: apparent is the spacious path of Guerdon.

verses.sa:
उच्चा दिवि दक्षिणावन्तो अस्थुर्ये अश्वदाः सह ते सूर्येण ।
हिरण्यदा अमृतत्वं भजन्ते वासोदाः सोम प्र तिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pra tiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: High up in heaven abide the Guerdon-givers: they who give steeds dwell with the Sun for ever. They who give gold are blest with life eternal. they who give robes prolong their lives, O Soma.

verses.sa:
दैवी पूर्तिर्दक्षिणा देवयज्या न कवारिभ्यो नहि ते पृणन्ति ।
अथा नरः प्रयतदक्षिणासोऽवद्यभिया बहवः पृणन्ति॥
verses.tr: daivī pūrtirdakṣiṇā devayajyā na kavāribhyo nahi te pṛṇanti athā naraḥ prayatadakṣiṇāso'vadyabhiyā bahavaḥ pṛṇanti
verses.en: Not from the niggards-for they give not freely-comes Meed at sacrifice, Gods' satisfaction: Yea, many men with hands stretched out with Guerdon present their gifts because they dread dishonour.

verses.sa:
शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते हविः ।
ये पृणन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति संगमे ते दक्षिणां दुहते सप्तमातरम्॥
verses.tr: śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate haviḥ ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti saṃgame te dakṣiṇāṃ duhate saptamātaram
verses.en: These who observe mankind regard oblation as streamy Vayu and light-finding Arka. They satisfy and give their gifts in synod, and pour in streams the seven-mothered Guerdon.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणावान्प्रथमो हूत एति दक्षिणावान्ग्रामणीरग्रमेति ।
तमेव मन्ये नृपतिं जनानां यः प्रथमो दक्षिणामाविवाय॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāvānprathamo hūta eti dakṣiṇāvāngrāmaṇīragrameti tameva manye nṛpatiṃ janānāṃ yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇāmāvivāya
verses.en: He who brings Guerdon comes as first invited: chief of the hamlet comes the Guerdon-bearer. Him I account the ruler of the people who was the first to introduce the Guerdon.

verses.sa:
तमेव ऋषिं तमु ब्रह्माणमाहुर्यज्ञन्यं सामगामुक्थशासम् ।
स शुक्रस्य तन्वो वेद तिस्रो यः प्रथमो दक्षिणया रराध॥
verses.tr: tameva ṛṣiṃ tamu brahmāṇamāhuryajñanyaṃ sāmagāmukthaśāsam sa śukrasya tanvo veda tisro yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇayā rarādha
verses.en: They call him Rsi, Brahman, Sama-chanter, reciter of the laud, leader of worship. The brightly-shining God's three forms he knoweth who first bestowed the sacrificial Guerdon.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणाश्वं दक्षिणा गां ददाति दक्षिणा चन्द्रमुत यद्धिरण्यम् ।
दक्षिणान्नं वनुते यो न आत्मा दक्षिणां वर्म कृणुते विजानन्॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāśvaṃ dakṣiṇā gāṃ dadāti dakṣiṇā candramuta yaddhiraṇyam dakṣiṇānnaṃ vanute yo na ātmā dakṣiṇāṃ varma kṛṇute vijānan
verses.en: Guerdon bestows the horse, bestows the bullock, Guerdon bestows, moreover, gold that Rsisters. Guerdon gives food which is our life and spirit. He who is wise takes Guerdon for his armour.

verses.sa:
न भोजा मम्रुर्न न्यर्थमीयुर्न रिष्यन्ति न व्यथन्ते ह भोजाः ।
इदं यद्विश्वं भुवनं स्वश्चैतत्सर्वं दक्षिणैभ्यो ददाति॥
verses.tr: na bhojā mamrurna nyarthamīyurna riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ idaṃ yadviśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ svaścaitatsarvaṃ dakṣiṇaibhyo dadāti
verses.en: The liberal die not, never are they ruined: the liberal suffer neither harm nor trouble. The light of heaven, the universe about us,-all this doth sacrificial Guerdon give them.

verses.sa:
भोजा जिग्युः सुरभिं योनिमग्रे भोजा जिग्युर्वध्वं१ या सुवासाः ।
भोजा जिग्युरन्तःपेयं सुराया भोजा जिग्युर्ये अहूताः प्रयन्ति॥
verses.tr: bhojā jigyuḥ surabhiṃ yonimagre bhojā jigyurvadhvaṃ1 yā suvāsāḥ bhojā jigyurantaḥpeyaṃ surāyā bhojā jigyurye ahūtāḥ prayanti
verses.en: First have the liberal gained a fragrant dwelling, and got themselves a bride in fair apparel. The liberal have obtained their draught of liquor, and conquered those who, unprovoked, assailed them.

verses.sa:
भोजायाश्वं सं मृजन्त्याशुं भोजायास्ते कन्या३ शुम्भमाना ।
भोजस्येदं पुष्करिणीव वेश्म परिष्कृतं देवमानेव चित्रम्॥
verses.tr: bhojāyāśvaṃ saṃ mṛjantyāśuṃ bhojāyāste kanyā3 śumbhamānā bhojasyedaṃ puṣkariṇīva veśma pariṣkṛtaṃ devamāneva citram
verses.en: They deck the fleet steed for the bounteous giver: the maid adorns herself and waits to meet him. His home is like a lake with lotus blossoms, like the Gods' palaces adorned and splendid.

verses.sa:
भोजमश्वाः सुष्ठुवाहो वहन्ति सुवृद्रथो वर्तते दक्षिणायाः ।
भोजं देवासोऽवता भरेषु भोजः शत्रून्त्समनीकेषु जेता॥
verses.tr: bhojamaśvāḥ suṣṭhuvāho vahanti suvṛdratho vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ bhojaṃ devāso'vatā bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūntsamanīkeṣu jetā
verses.en: Steeds good at draught convey the liberal giver, and lightly rolling moves the car of Guerdon. Assist, ye Gods, the liberal man in battles: the liberal giver conquers foes in combat.

verses.sa:
किमिच्छन्ती सरमा प्रेदमानड्दूरे ह्यध्वा जगुरिः पराचैः ।
कास्मेहितिः का परितक्म्यासीत्कथं रसाया अतरः पयांसि॥
verses.tr: kimicchantī saramā predamānaḍdūre hyadhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ kāsmehitiḥ kā paritakmyāsītkathaṃ rasāyā ataraḥ payāṃsi
verses.en: What wish of Sarama hath brought her hither? The path leads far away to distant places. What charge hast thou for us? Where turns thy journey? How hast thou made thy way o'er Rasa's waters.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य दूतीरिषिता चरामि मह इच्छन्ती पणयो निधीन्वः ।
अतिष्कदो भियसा तन्न आवत्तथा रसाया अतरं पयांसि॥
verses.tr: indrasya dūtīriṣitā carāmi maha icchantī paṇayo nidhīnvaḥ atiṣkado bhiyasā tanna āvattathā rasāyā ataraṃ payāṃsi
verses.en: I come appointed messenger of Indra, seeking your ample stores of wealth, O Panis. This hath preserved me from the fear of crossing: thus have I made my way o'er Rasa's waters.

verses.sa:
कीदृङ्ङिन्द्रः सरमे का दृशीका यस्येदं दूतीरसरः पराकात् ।
आ च गच्छान्मित्रमेना दधामाऽथा गवां गोपतिर्नो भवाति॥
verses.tr: kīdṛṅṅindraḥ sarame kā dṛśīkā yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraḥ parākāt ā ca gacchānmitramenā dadhāmā'thā gavāṃ gopatirno bhavāti
verses.en: What is that Indra like, what is his aspect whose envoy, Sarama, from afar thou comest? Let him approach, and we will show him friendship: he shall be made the herdsman of our cattle.

verses.sa:
नाहं तं वेद दभ्यं दभत्स यस्येदं दूतीरसरं पराकात् ।
न तं गूहन्ति स्रवतो गभीरा हता इन्द्रेण पणयः शयध्वे॥
verses.tr: nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhatsa yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraṃ parākāt na taṃ gūhanti sravato gabhīrā hatā indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve
verses.en: I know him safe from harm: but he can punish who sent me hither from afar as envoy. Him rivers flowing with deep waters bide not. Low will ye be, O Panis, slain by Indra.

verses.sa:
इमा गावः सरमे या ऐच्छः परि दिवो अन्तान्त्सुभगे पतन्ती ।
कस्त एना अव सृजादयुध्व्युतास्माकमायुधा सन्ति तिग्मा॥
verses.tr: imā gāvaḥ sarame yā aicchaḥ pari divo antāntsubhage patantī kasta enā ava sṛjādayudhvyutāsmākamāyudhā santi tigmā
verses.en: These are the kine which, Sarama, thou seekest, flying, O Blest One, to the ends of heaven. Who will loose these for thee without a battle? Yea, and sharp-pointed are our warlike weapons.

verses.sa:
असेन्या वः पणयो वचांस्यनिषव्यास्तन्वः सन्तु पापीः ।
अधृष्टो व एतवा अस्तु पन्था बृहस्पतिर्व उभया न मृळात्॥
verses.tr: asenyā vaḥ paṇayo vacāṃsyaniṣavyāstanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ adhṛṣṭo va etavā astu panthā bṛhaspatirva ubhayā na mṛḻāt
verses.en: Even if your wicked bodies, O ye Panis, were arrow-proof, your words are weak for wounding; And were the path to you as yet unmastered, Brhaspati in neither case will spare you.

verses.sa:
अयं निधिः सरमे अद्रिबुध्नो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्न्यृष्टः ।
रक्षन्ति तं पणयो ये सुगोपा रेकु पदमलकमा जगन्थ॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ nidhiḥ sarame adribudhno gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirnyṛṣṭaḥ rakṣanti taṃ paṇayo ye sugopā reku padamalakamā jagantha
verses.en: Paved with the rock is this our treasure-chamber; filled full of precious things, of kine, and horses. These Panis who are watchful keepers guard it. In vain hast thou approached this lonely station.

verses.sa:
एह गमन्नृषयः सोमशिता अयास्यो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वाः ।
त एतमूर्वं वि भजन्त गोनामथैतद्वचः पणयो वमन्नित्॥
verses.tr: eha gamannṛṣayaḥ somaśitā ayāsyo aṅgiraso navagvāḥ ta etamūrvaṃ vi bhajanta gonāmathaitadvacaḥ paṇayo vamannit
verses.en: Rsis will come inspirited with Soma, Angirases unwearied, and Navagvas. This stall of cattle will they part among them: then will the Panis wish these words unspoken.

verses.sa:
एवा च त्वं सरम आजगन्थ प्रबाधिता सहसा दैव्येन ।
स्वसारं त्वा कृणवै मा पुनर्गा अप ते गवां सुभगे भजाम॥
verses.tr: evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇavai mā punargā apa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma
verses.en: Even thus, O Sarama, hast thou come hither, forced by celestial might to make the journey. Turn thee not back, for thou shalt be our sister: O Blest One, we will give thee of the cattle.

verses.sa:
नाहं वेद भ्रातृत्वं नो स्वसृत्वमिन्द्रो विदुरङ्गिरसश्च घोराः ।
गोकामा मे अच्छदयन्यदायमपात इत पणयो वरीयः॥
verses.tr: nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvamindro viduraṅgirasaśca ghorāḥ gokāmā me acchadayanyadāyamapāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ
verses.en: Brotherhood, sisterhood, I know not either: the dread Angirases and Indra know them. They seemed to long for kine when I departed. Hence, into distance, be ye gone, O Panis.

verses.sa:
दूरमित पणयो वरीय उद्गावो यन्तु मिनतीॠतेन ।
बृहस्पतिर्या अविन्दन्निगूळ्हाः सोमो ग्रावाण ऋषयश्च विप्राः॥
verses.tr: dūramita paṇayo varīya udgāvo yantu minatīṝtena bṛhaspatiryā avindannigūḻhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaśca viprāḥ
verses.en: Hence, far away, ye Panis! Let the cattle lowing come forth as holy Law commandeth, Kine which Brhaspati, and Soma, Rsis, sages, and pressing-stones have found when hidden.

verses.sa:
तेऽवदन्प्रथमा ब्रह्मकिल्बिषेऽकूपारः सलिलो मातरिश्वा ।
वीळुहरास्तप उग्रो मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतेन॥
verses.tr: te'vadanprathamā brahmakilbiṣe'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā vīḻuharāstapa ugro mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtena
verses.en: These first, the boundless Sea, and Matarisvan, fierce-glowing Fire, the Strong, the Bliss-bestower, And heavenly Floods, first-born by holy Order, exclaimed against the outrage on a Brahman.

verses.sa:
सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः ।
अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय॥
verses.tr: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya
verses.en: King Soma first of all, without reluctance, made restitution of the Brahman's consort. Mitra and Varuna were the inviters: Agni as Hota; took her hand and led her.

verses.sa:
हस्तेनैव ग्राह्य आधिरस्या ब्रह्मजायेयमिति चेदवोचन् ।
न दूताय प्रह्ये तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य॥
verses.tr: hastenaiva grāhya ādhirasyā brahmajāyeyamiti cedavocan na dūtāya prahye tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya
verses.en: The man, her pledge, must by her hand be taken when they have cried, She is a Brahman's consort. She stayed not for a herald to conduct her: thus is the kingdom of a ruler guarded.

verses.sa:
देवा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसे ये निषेदुः ।
भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्योपनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमे व्योमन्॥
verses.tr: devā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapase ye niṣeduḥ bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyopanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman
verses.en: Thus spake of her those Gods of old, Seven Rsis who sate them down to their austere devotion: Dire is a Brahman's wife led home by others: in the supremest heaven she plants confusion.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद्विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम् ।
तेन जायामन्वविन्दद्बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं१ न देवाः॥
verses.tr: brahmacārī carati veviṣadviṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam tena jāyāmanvavindadbṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ1 na devāḥ
verses.en: The Brahmacari goes engaged in duty: he is a member of the Gods' own body. Through him Brhaspati obtained his consort, as the Gods gained the ladle brought by Soma.

verses.sa: पुनर्वै देवा अददुः पुनर्मनुष्या उत । राजानः सत्यं कृण्वाना ब्रह्मजायां पुनर्ददुः॥
verses.tr: punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā uta rājānaḥ satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ
verses.en: So then the Gods restored her, so men gave the woman back again. The Kings who kept their promises restored the Brahman's wedded wife,

verses.sa: पुनर्दाय ब्रह्मजायां कृत्वी देवैर्निकिल्बिषम् । ऊर्जं पृथिव्या भक्त्वायोरुगायमुपासते॥
verses.tr: punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvī devairnikilbiṣam ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvāyorugāyamupāsate
verses.en: Having restored the Brahman's wife, and freed them, with Gods' aid, from sin, They shared the fulness of the earth, and won themselves extended sway.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान्यजसि जातवेदः ।
आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान्त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devānyajasi jātavedaḥ ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ
verses.en: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods as God, O Jatavedas. Observant, bright as Mitra, bring them hither: thou art a sapient and foreknowing envoy.

verses.sa:
तनूनपात्पथ ऋतस्य यानान्मध्वा समञ्जन्त्स्वदया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन्देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः॥
verses.tr: tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhandevatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ
verses.en: Tanunapat, fair-tongued, with sweet meath balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sa:
आजुह्वान ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चा ऽऽयाह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ।
त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान्यक्षीषितो यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā ''yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān
verses.en: Invoked, deserving prayer and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O Youthful Lord, the Gods' Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sa:
प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यतर अग्रे अह्नाम् ।
व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम्॥
verses.tr: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyatara agre ahnām vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam
verses.en: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe this earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far-extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sa:
व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः ।
देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः॥
verses.tr: vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ
verses.en: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy entrance.

verses.sa:
आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने॥
verses.tr: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne
verses.en: Pouring sweet dews let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, he seated at their station, Lofty, celestial Dames with gold to deck them. assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै ।
प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā
verses.en: Come the two first celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction.

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विळा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती ।
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वती स्वपसः सदन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḻā manuṣvadiha cetayantī tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu
verses.en: Let Bharati come quickly to our worship, and Ila showing like a human being. So let Sarasvati and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sa:
य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान्देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā tamadya hotariṣito yajīyāndevaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān
verses.en: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed to-day God Tvastar, thou who knowest. Even him who formed these two, the Earth and Heaven the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sa:
उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन्देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि ।
वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन॥
verses.tr: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjandevānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena
verses.en: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspati the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with meath and butter.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः ।
अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavatpurogāḥ asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ
verses.en: Agni, as soon as he was born, made ready the sacrifice, and was the Gods' preceder. May the Gods cat our offering consecrated according to this true Priest's voice and guidance.

verses.sa:
मनीषिणः प्र भरध्वं मनीषां यथायथा मतयः सन्ति नृणाम् ।
इन्द्रं सत्यैरेरयामा कृतेभिः स हि वीरो गिर्वणस्युर्विदानः॥
verses.tr: manīṣiṇaḥ pra bharadhvaṃ manīṣāṃ yathāyathā matayaḥ santi nṛṇām indraṃ satyairerayāmā kṛtebhiḥ sa hi vīro girvaṇasyurvidānaḥ
verses.en: Bring forth your sacred song ye prudent singers, even as are the thoughts of human beings. Let us draw Indra with true deeds anear us: he loves our songs, the Hero, and is potent.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि सदसो धीतिरद्यौत्सं गार्ष्टेयो वृषभो गोभिरानट् ।
उदतिष्ठत्तविषेणा रवेण महान्ति चित्सं विव्याचा रजांसि॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya hi sadaso dhītiradyautsaṃ gārṣṭeyo vṛṣabho gobhirānaṭ udatiṣṭhattaviṣeṇā raveṇa mahānti citsaṃ vivyācā rajāṃsi
verses.en: The hymn shone brightly from the seat of worship: to the kine came the Bull, the Heifer's Offspring With mighty bellowing hath he arisen, and hath pervaded even the spacious regions.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः किल श्रुत्या अस्य वेद स हि जिष्णुः पथिकृत्सूर्याय ।
आन्मेनां कृण्वन्नच्युतो भुवद्गोः पतिर्दिवः सनजा अप्रतीतः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ kila śrutyā asya veda sa hi jiṣṇuḥ pathikṛtsūryāya ānmenāṃ kṛṇvannacyuto bhuvadgoḥ patirdivaḥ sanajā apratītaḥ
verses.en: Indra knows, verily, how to hear our singing, for he, victorious, made a path for Surya. He made the Cow, and be became the Sovran of Heaven, primeval, matchless, and unshaken.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य व्रतामिनादङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः ।
पुरूणि चिन्नि तताना रजांसि दाधार यो धरुणं सत्यताता॥
verses.tr: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vratāminādaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ purūṇi cinni tatānā rajāṃsi dādhāra yo dharuṇaṃ satyatātā
verses.en: Praised by Angirases, Indra demolished with might the works of the great watery monster Full many regions, too, hath he pervaded, and by his truth supported earth's foundation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या विश्वा वेद सवना हन्ति शुष्णम् ।
महीं चिद्द्यामातनोत्सूर्येण चास्कम्भ चित्कम्भनेन स्कभीयान्॥
verses.tr: indro divaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā viśvā veda savanā hanti śuṣṇam mahīṃ ciddyāmātanotsūryeṇa cāskambha citkambhanena skabhīyān
verses.en: The counterpart of heaven and earth is Indra: he knoweth all libations, slayeth Susna. The vast sky with the Sun hath he extended, and, best otpillars, stayed it with a pillar.

verses.sa:
वज्रेण हि वृत्रहा वृत्रमस्तरदेवस्य शूशुवानस्य मायाः ।
वि धृष्णो अत्र धृषता जघन्थाऽथाभवो मघवन्बाह्वोजाः॥
verses.tr: vajreṇa hi vṛtrahā vṛtramastaradevasya śūśuvānasya māyāḥ vi dhṛṣṇo atra dhṛṣatā jaghanthā'thābhavo maghavanbāhvojāḥ
verses.en: The Vrtra-slaver with his bolt felled Vrtra: the magic of the godless, waxen mighty, Here hast thou, Bold Assailant, boldly conquered. Yea, then thine arms, O Maghavan, were potent.

verses.sa:
सचन्त यदुषसः सूर्येण चित्रामस्य केतवो रामविन्दन् ।
आ यन्नक्षत्रं ददृशे दिवो न पुनर्यतो नकिरद्धा नु वेद॥
verses.tr: sacanta yaduṣasaḥ sūryeṇa citrāmasya ketavo rāmavindan ā yannakṣatraṃ dadṛśe divo na punaryato nakiraddhā nu veda
verses.en: When the Dawns come attendant upon Surya their rays discover wealth of divers colours. The Star of heaven is seen as 'twere approaching: none knoweth aught of it as it departeth.

verses.sa:
दूरं किल प्रथमा जग्मुरासामिन्द्रस्य याः प्रसवे सस्रुरापः ।
क्व स्विदग्रं क्व बुध्न आसामापो मध्यं क्व वो नूनमन्तः॥
verses.tr: dūraṃ kila prathamā jagmurāsāmindrasya yāḥ prasave sasrurāpaḥ kva svidagraṃ kva budhna āsāmāpo madhyaṃ kva vo nūnamantaḥ
verses.en: Far have they gone, the first of all these waters, the waters that flowed forth when Indra sent them. Where is their spring, and where is their foundation? Where now, ye Waters, is your inmost centre?

verses.sa:
सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानाँ आदिदेताः प्र विविज्रे जवेन ।
मुमुक्षमाणा उत या मुमुच्रेऽधेदेता न रमन्ते नितिक्ताः॥
verses.tr: sṛjaḥ sindhūṃrahinā jagrasānāṃ ādidetāḥ pra vivijre javena mumukṣamāṇā uta yā mumucre'dhedetā na ramante nitiktāḥ
verses.en: Thou didst free rivers swallowed by the Dragon; and rapidly they set themselves in motion, Those that were loosed and those that longed for freedom. Excited now to speed they run unresting.

verses.sa:
सध्रीचीः सिन्धुमुशतीरिवायन्त्सनाज्जार आरितः पूर्भिदासाम् ।
अस्तमा ते पार्थिवा वसून्यस्मे जग्मुः सूनृता इन्द्र पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: sadhrīcīḥ sindhumuśatīrivāyantsanājjāra āritaḥ pūrbhidāsām astamā te pārthivā vasūnyasme jagmuḥ sūnṛtā indra pūrvīḥ
verses.en: Yearning together they have sped to Sindhu: the Fort-destroyer, praised, of old, hath loved them. Indra, may thy terrestrial treasures reach us, and our full songs of joy approach thy dwelling.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र पिब प्रतिकामं सुतस्य प्रातःसावस्तव हि पूर्वपीतिः ।
हर्षस्व हन्तवे शूर शत्रूनुक्थेभिष्टे वीर्या३ प्र ब्रवाम॥
verses.tr: indra piba pratikāmaṃ sutasya prātaḥsāvastava hi pūrvapītiḥ harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūnukthebhiṣṭe vīryā3 pra bravāma
verses.en: Drink of the juice, O Indra, at thy plea. sure, for thy first draught is early morn's libation. Rejoice, that thou mayst slay our foes, O Hero, and we with lauds will tell thy mighty exploits.

verses.sa:
यस्ते रथो मनसो जवीयानेन्द्र तेन सोमपेयाय याहि ।
तूयमा ते हरयः प्र द्रवन्तु येभिर्यासि वृषभिर्मन्दमानः॥
verses.tr: yaste ratho manaso javīyānendra tena somapeyāya yāhi tūyamā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhiryāsi vṛṣabhirmandamānaḥ
verses.en: Thou hast a car more swift than thought, O Indra; thereon come hither, come to drink the Soma. Let thy Bay Steeds, thy Stallions, hasten hither, with whom thou comest nigh and art delighted.

verses.sa:
हरित्वता वर्चसा सूर्यस्य श्रेष्ठै रूपैस्तन्वं स्पर्शयस्व ।
अस्माभिरिन्द्र सखिभिर्हुवानः सध्रीचीनो मादयस्वा निषद्य॥
verses.tr: haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhai rūpaistanvaṃ sparśayasva asmābhirindra sakhibhirhuvānaḥ sadhrīcīno mādayasvā niṣadya
verses.en: Deck out thy body with the fairest colours, with golden splendour of the Sun adorn it. O Indra, turn thee hitherward invited by us thy friends; be seated and be joyful.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्यत्ते महिमानं मदेष्विमे मही रोदसी नाविविक्ताम् ।
तदोक आ हरिभिरिन्द्र युक्तैः प्रियेभिर्याहि प्रियमन्नमच्छ॥
verses.tr: yasya tyatte mahimānaṃ madeṣvime mahī rodasī nāviviktām tadoka ā haribhirindra yuktaiḥ priyebhiryāhi priyamannamaccha
verses.en: O thou whose grandeur in thy festive transports not even these two great worlds have comprehended. Come, Indra, with thy dear Bay Horses harnessed, come to our dwelling and the food thou lovest.

verses.sa:
यस्य शश्वत्पपिवाँ इन्द्र शत्रूननानुकृत्या रण्या चकर्थ ।
स ते पुरंधिं तविषीमियर्ति स ते मदाय सुत इन्द्र सोमः॥
verses.tr: yasya śaśvatpapivāṃ indra śatrūnanānukṛtyā raṇyā cakartha sa te puraṃdhiṃ taviṣīmiyarti sa te madāya suta indra somaḥ
verses.en: Pressed for thy joyous banquet is the Soma, Soma whereof thou, Indra, ever drinking, Hast waged unequalled battles with thy foemen, which prompts the mighty flow of thine abundance.

verses.sa:
इदं ते पात्रं सनवित्तमिन्द्र पिबा सोममेना शतक्रतो ।
पूर्ण आहावो मदिरस्य मध्वो यं विश्व इदभिहर्यन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittamindra pibā somamenā śatakrato pūrṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva idabhiharyanti devāḥ
verses.en: Found from of old is this thy cup, O Indra: Satakratu, drink therefrom the Soma. Filled is the beaker with the meath that gladdens, the beaker which all Deities delight in.

verses.sa:
वि हि त्वामिन्द्र पुरुधा जनासो हितप्रयसो वृषभ ह्वयन्ते ।
अस्माकं ते मधुमत्तमानीमा भुवन्त्सवना तेषु हर्य॥
verses.tr: vi hi tvāmindra purudhā janāso hitaprayaso vṛṣabha hvayante asmākaṃ te madhumattamānīmā bhuvantsavanā teṣu harya
verses.en: From many a side with proffered entertainment the folk are calling thee, O Mighty Indra. These our libations shall for thee be richest in sweet meath: drink thereof and find them pleasant.

verses.sa:
प्र त इन्द्र पूर्व्याणि प्र नूनं वीर्या वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि ।
सतीनमन्युरश्रथायो अद्रिं सुवेदनामकृणोर्ब्रह्मणे गाम्॥
verses.tr: pra ta indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni satīnamanyuraśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanāmakṛṇorbrahmaṇe gām
verses.en: I will declare thy deeds of old, O Indra, the mighty acts which thou hast first accomplished. In genuine wrath thou loosenedst the mountain so that the Brahman easily found the cattle.

verses.sa:
नि षु सीद गणपते गणेषु त्वामाहुर्विप्रतमं कवीनाम् ।
न ऋते त्वत्क्रियते किं चनारे महामर्कं मघवञ्चित्रमर्च॥
verses.tr: ni ṣu sīda gaṇapate gaṇeṣu tvāmāhurvipratamaṃ kavīnām na ṛte tvatkriyate kiṃ canāre mahāmarkaṃ maghavañcitramarca
verses.en: Lord of the hosts, amid our bands be seated: they call thee greatest Sage among the sages. Nothing is done, even far away, without thee: great, wondrous, Maghavan, is the hymn I sing thee.

verses.sa:
अभिख्या नो मघवन्नाधमानान्त्सखे बोधि वसुपते सखीनाम् ।
रणं कृधि रणकृत्सत्यशुष्माऽभक्ते चिदा भजा राये अस्मान्॥
verses.tr: abhikhyā no maghavannādhamānāntsakhe bodhi vasupate sakhīnām raṇaṃ kṛdhi raṇakṛtsatyaśuṣmā'bhakte cidā bhajā rāye asmān
verses.en: Aim of our eyes be thou, for we implore thee, O Maghavan, Friend of friends and Lord of treasures. Fight, Warrior strong in truth, fight thou the battle: give us our share of undivided riches.

verses.sa:
तमस्य द्यावापृथिवी सचेतसा विश्वेभिर्देवैरनु शुष्ममावताम् ।
यदैत्कृण्वानो महिमानमिन्द्रियं पीत्वी सोमस्य क्रतुमाँ अवर्धत॥
verses.tr: tamasya dyāvāpṛthivī sacetasā viśvebhirdevairanu śuṣmamāvatām yadaitkṛṇvāno mahimānamindriyaṃ pītvī somasya kratumāṃ avardhata
verses.en: The Heavens and the Earth accordant with all Gods encouraged graciously that vigorous might of his. When he came showing forth his majesty and power, he drank of Soma juice and waxed exceeding strong.

verses.sa:
तमस्य विष्णुर्महिमानमोजसांऽशुं दधन्वान्मधुनो वि रप्शते ।
देवेभिरिन्द्रो मघवा सयावभिर्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अभवद्वरेण्यः॥
verses.tr: tamasya viṣṇurmahimānamojasāṃ'śuṃ dadhanvānmadhuno vi rapśate devebhirindro maghavā sayāvabhirvṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ abhavadvareṇyaḥ
verses.en: This majesty of his Visnu extols and lauds, making the state that gives the meath flow forth with might. When Indra Maghavan with those who followed him had smitten Vrtra he deserved the choice of Gods.

verses.sa:
वृत्रेण यदहिना बिभ्रदायुधा समस्थिथा युधये शंसमाविदे ।
विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सह त्मनाऽवर्धन्नुग्र महिमानमिन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: vṛtreṇa yadahinā bibhradāyudhā samasthithā yudhaye śaṃsamāvide viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanā'vardhannugra mahimānamindriyam
verses.en: When, bearing warlike weapons, fain to win thee praise, thou meetest Vrtra, yea, the Dragon, for the fight, Then all the Maruts who were gathered with dice there extolled, O Mighty One, thy powerful majesty.

verses.sa:
जज्ञान एव व्यबाधत स्पृधः प्रापश्यद्वीरो अभि पौंस्यं रणम् ।
अवृश्चदद्रिमव सस्यदः सृजदस्तभ्नान्नाकं स्वपस्यया पृथुम्॥
verses.tr: jajñāna eva vyabādhata spṛdhaḥ prāpaśyadvīro abhi pauṃsyaṃ raṇam avṛścadadrimava sasyadaḥ sṛjadastabhnānnākaṃ svapasyayā pṛthum
verses.en: Soon as he sprang to life he forced asunder hosts: forward the Hero looked to manly deed and war. He cleft the rock, he let concurrent streams flow forth, and with his skillful art stablished the heavens' wide vault.

verses.sa:
आदिन्द्रः सत्रा तविषीरपत्यत वरीयो द्यावापृथिवी अबाधत ।
अवाभरद्धृषितो वज्रमायसं शेवं मित्राय वरुणाय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: ādindraḥ satrā taviṣīrapatyata varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata avābharaddhṛṣito vajramāyasaṃ śevaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: Indra hath evermore possessed surpassing power: he forced, far from each other, heaven and earth apart. He hurled impetuous down his iron thunderbolt, a joy to Varuna's and Mitra's worshipper.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यात्र तविषीभ्यो विरप्शिन ऋघायतो अरंहयन्त मन्यवे ।
वृत्रं यदुग्रो व्यवृश्चदोजसाऽपो बिभ्रतं तमसा परीवृतम्॥
verses.tr: indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛghāyato araṃhayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadugro vyavṛścadojasā'po bibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam
verses.en: Then to the mighty powers of Indra, to his wrath, his the fierce Stormer, loud of voice, they came with speed; What time the Potent One rent Vrtra with his strength, who held the waters back, whom darkness compassed round.

verses.sa:
या वीर्याणि प्रथमानि कर्त्वा महित्वेभिर्यतमानौ समीयतुः ।
ध्वान्तं तमोऽव दध्वसे हत इन्द्रो मह्ना पूर्वहूतावपत्यत॥
verses.tr: yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahitvebhiryatamānau samīyatuḥ dhvāntaṃ tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahnā pūrvahūtāvapatyata
verses.en: Even in the first of those heroic acts which they who strove together came with might to execute, Deep darkness fell upon the slain, and Indra won by victory the right of being first invoked.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवासो अध वृष्ण्यानि तेऽवर्धयन्त्सोमवत्या वचस्यया ।
रद्धं वृत्रमहिमिन्द्रस्य हन्मनाऽग्निर्न जम्भैस्तृष्वन्नमावयत्॥
verses.tr: viśve devāso adha vṛṣṇyāni te'vardhayantsomavatyā vacasyayā raddhaṃ vṛtramahimindrasya hanmanā'gnirna jambhaistṛṣvannamāvayat
verses.en: Then all the Gods extolled, with eloquence inspired by draughts of Soma juice, thy deeds of manly might. As Agni eats the dry food with his tongue, he ate Vrtra, the Dragon, maimed by Indra's deadly dart.

verses.sa:
भूरि दक्षेभिर्वचनेभिॠक्वभिः सख्येभिः सख्यानि प्र वोचत ।
इन्द्रो धुनिं च चुमुरिं च दम्भयञ्छ्रद्धामनस्या शृणुते दभीतये॥
verses.tr: bhūri dakṣebhirvacanebhiṝkvabhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata indro dhuniṃ ca cumuriṃ ca dambhayañchraddhāmanasyā śṛṇute dabhītaye
verses.en: Proclaim his many friendships, met with friendship, made with singers, with the skillful and the eloquent. Indra, when he subdues Dhuni and Cumuri, lists to Dabhiti for his faithful spirit's sake.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुरूण्या भरा स्वश्व्या येभिर्मंसै निवचनानि शंसन् ।
सुगेभिर्विश्वा दुरिता तरेम विदो षु ण उर्विया गाधमद्य॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ purūṇyā bharā svaśvyā yebhirmaṃsai nivacanāni śaṃsan sugebhirviśvā duritā tarema vido ṣu ṇa urviyā gādhamadya
verses.en: Give riches manifold with noble horses, to be remembered while my songs address thee. May we by easy paths pass all our troubles: find us this day a ford wide and extensive.

verses.sa:
घर्मा समन्ता त्रिवृतं व्यापतुस्तयोर्जुष्टिं मातरिश्वा जगाम ।
दिवस्पयो दिधिषाणा अवेषन्विदुर्देवाः सहसामानमर्कम्॥
verses.tr: gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vyāpatustayorjuṣṭiṃ mātariśvā jagāma divaspayo didhiṣāṇā aveṣanvidurdevāḥ sahasāmānamarkam
verses.en: Two perfect springs of heat pervade the Threefold, and come for their delight is Matarisvan. Craving the milk of heaven the Gods are present: well do they know the praisesong and the Saman.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देष्ट्राय निॠतीरुपासते दीर्घश्रुतो वि हि जानन्ति वह्नयः ।
तासां नि चिक्युः कवयो निदानं परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु॥
verses.tr: tisro deṣṭrāya niṝtīrupāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānaṃ pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu
verses.en: The priests beard far away, as they are ordered, serve the three Nirrtis, for well they know them. Sages have traced the cause that first produced them, dwelling in distant and mysterious chambers.

verses.sa:
चतुष्कपर्दा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते ।
तस्यां सुपर्णा वृषणा नि षेदतुर्यत्र देवा दधिरे भागधेयम्॥
verses.tr: catuṣkapardā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste tasyāṃ suparṇā vṛṣaṇā ni ṣedaturyatra devā dadhire bhāgadheyam
