verses.en: The Youthful One, well-shaped, with four locks braided, brightened with oil, puts on the ordinances. Two Birds of mighty power are seated near her, there where the Deities receive their portion.

verses.sa:
एकः सुपर्णः स समुद्रमा विवेश स इदं विश्वं भुवनं वि चष्टे ।
तं पाकेन मनसापश्यमन्तितस्तं माता रेळ्हि स उ रेळ्हि मातरम्॥
verses.tr: ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe taṃ pākena manasāpaśyamantitastaṃ mātā reḻhi sa u reḻhi mātaram
verses.en: One of these Birds hath passed into the sea of air: thence he looks round and views this universal world. With simple heart I have beheld him from anear: his Mother kisses him and he returns her kiss.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णं विप्राः कवयो वचोभिरेकं सन्तं बहुधा कल्पयन्ति ।
छन्दांसि च दधतो अध्वरेषु ग्रहान्त्सोमस्य मिमते द्वादश॥
verses.tr: suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahāntsomasya mimate dvādaśa
verses.en: Him with fair wings though only One in nature, wise singers shape, with songs, in many figures. While they at sacrifices fix the metres, they measure out twelve chalices of Soma.

verses.sa:
षट्त्रिंशाँश्च चतुरः कल्पयन्तश्छन्दांसि च दधत आद्वादशम् ।
यज्ञं विमाय कवयो मनीष ऋक्सामाभ्यां प्र रथं वर्तयन्ति॥
verses.tr: ṣaṭtriṃśāṃśca caturaḥ kalpayantaśchandāṃsi ca dadhata ādvādaśam yajñaṃ vimāya kavayo manīṣa ṛksāmābhyāṃ pra rathaṃ vartayanti
verses.en: While they arrange the four and six-and-thirty, and duly order, up to twelve, the measures, Having disposed the sacrifice thoughtful sages send the Car forward with the Rc and Saman.

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशान्ये महिमानो अस्य तं धीरा वाचा प्र णयन्ति सप्त ।
आप्नानं तीर्थं क इह प्र वोचद्येन पथा प्रपिबन्ते सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: caturdaśānye mahimāno asya taṃ dhīrā vācā pra ṇayanti sapta āpnānaṃ tīrthaṃ ka iha pra vocadyena pathā prapibante sutasya
verses.en: The Chariot's majesties are fourteen others: seven sages lead it onward with their Voices. Who will declare to us the ford Apnana, the path whereby they drink first draughts of Soma?

verses.sa:
सहस्रधा पञ्चदशान्युक्था यावद्द्यावापृथिवी तावदित्तत् ।
सहस्रधा महिमानः सहस्रं यावद्ब्रह्म विष्ठितं तावती वाक्॥
verses.tr: sahasradhā pañcadaśānyukthā yāvaddyāvāpṛthivī tāvadittat sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasraṃ yāvadbrahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāk
verses.en: The fifteen lauds are in a thousand places that is as vast as heaven and earth in measure. A thousand spots contain the mighty thousand. Vak spreadeth forth as far as Prayer extendeth.

verses.sa:
कश्छन्दसां योगमा वेद धीरः को धिष्ण्यां प्रति वाचं पपाद ।
कमृत्विजामष्टमं शूरमाहुर्हरी इन्द्रस्य नि चिकाय कः स्वित्॥
verses.tr: kaśchandasāṃ yogamā veda dhīraḥ ko dhiṣṇyāṃ prati vācaṃ papāda kamṛtvijāmaṣṭamaṃ śūramāhurharī indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit
verses.en: What sage hath learned the metres' application? Who hath gained Vak, the spirit's aim and object? Which ministering priest is called eighth Hero? Who then hath tracked the two Bay Steeds of Indra?

verses.sa:
भूम्या अन्तं पर्येके चरन्ति रथस्य धूर्षु युक्तासो अस्थुः ।
श्रमस्य दायं वि भजन्त्येभ्यो यदा यमो भवति हर्म्ये हितः॥
verses.tr: bhūmyā antaṃ paryeke caranti rathasya dhūrṣu yuktāso asthuḥ śramasya dāyaṃ vi bhajantyebhyo yadā yamo bhavati harmye hitaḥ
verses.en: Yoked to his chariot-pole there stood the Coursers: they only travel round earth's farthest limits. These, when their driver in his home is settled, receive the allotted meed of their exertion.

verses.sa:
चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावप्येति धातवे ।
अनूधा यदि जीजनदधा च नु ववक्ष सद्यो महि दूत्यं१ चरन्॥
verses.tr: citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvapyeti dhātave anūdhā yadi jījanadadhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyo mahi dūtyaṃ1 caran
verses.en: Verily wondrous is the tender Youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his Mothers' milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his great errand, suddenly grew strong.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ह नाम धायि दन्नपस्तमः सं यो वना युवते भस्मना दता ।
अभिप्रमुरा जुह्वा स्वध्वर इनो न प्रोथमानो यवसे वृषा॥
verses.tr: agnirha nāma dhāyi dannapastamaḥ saṃ yo vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā abhipramurā juhvā svadhvara ino na prothamāno yavase vṛṣā
verses.en: Then Agni was his name, most active to bestow, gathering up the trees with his consuming tooth; Skilled in fair sacrifice, armed with destroying tongue, impetuous as a bull that snorteth in the mead.

verses.sa:
तं वो विं न द्रुषदं देवमन्धस इन्दुं प्रोथन्तं प्रवपन्तमर्णवम् ।
आसा वह्निं न शोचिषा विरप्शिनं महिव्रतं न सरजन्तमध्वनः॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo viṃ na druṣadaṃ devamandhasa induṃ prothantaṃ pravapantamarṇavam āsā vahniṃ na śociṣā virapśinaṃ mahivrataṃ na sarajantamadhvanaḥ
verses.en: Praise him, your God who, bird-like, rests upon a tree, scattering drops of juice and pouring forth his flood, Speaking aloud with flame as with his lips a priest, and broadening his paths like one of high command.

verses.sa:
वि यस्य ते ज्रयसानस्याजर धक्षोर्न वाताः परि सन्त्यच्युताः ।
आ रण्वासो युयुधयो न सत्वनं त्रितं नशन्त प्र शिषन्त इष्टये॥
verses.tr: vi yasya te jrayasānasyājara dhakṣorna vātāḥ pari santyacyutāḥ ā raṇvāso yuyudhayo na satvanaṃ tritaṃ naśanta pra śiṣanta iṣṭaye
verses.en: Thou Everlasting, whom, far-striding fain to burn, the winds, uninterrupted, never overcome, They have approached, as warriors eager for the fight, heroic Trita, guiding him to gain his wish.

verses.sa:
स इदग्निः कण्वतमः कण्वसखाऽर्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः ।
अग्निः पातु गृणतो अग्निः सूरीनग्निर्ददातु तेषामवो नः॥
verses.tr: sa idagniḥ kaṇvatamaḥ kaṇvasakhā'ryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ agniḥ pātu gṛṇato agniḥ sūrīnagnirdadātu teṣāmavo naḥ
verses.en: This Agni is the best of Kanvas, Kanvas' Friend, Conqueror of the foe whether afar or near. May Agni guard the singers, guard the princes well: may Agni grant to us our princes' gracious help.

verses.sa:
वाजिन्तमाय सह्यसे सुपित्र्य तृषु च्यवानो अनु जातवेदसे ।
अनुद्रे चिद्यो धृषता वरं सते महिन्तमाय धन्वनेदविष्यते॥
verses.tr: vājintamāya sahyase supitrya tṛṣu cyavāno anu jātavedase anudre cidyo dhṛṣatā varaṃ sate mahintamāya dhanvanedaviṣyate
verses.en: Do thou, Supitrya, swiftly following, make thyself the lord of Jatavedas, mightiest of all, Who surely gives a boon even in thirsty land most powerful, prepared to aid us in the wilds.

verses.sa:
एवाग्निर्मर्तैः सह सूरिभिर्वसुः ष्टवे सहसः सूनरो नृभिः ।
मित्रासो न ये सुधिता ऋतायवो द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्ति मानुषान्॥
verses.tr: evāgnirmartaiḥ saha sūribhirvasuḥ ṣṭave sahasaḥ sūnaro nṛbhiḥ mitrāso na ye sudhitā ṛtāyavo dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santi mānuṣān
verses.en: Thus noble Agni with princes and mortal men is lauded, excellent for conquering strength with chiefs, Men who are well-disposed as friends and true to Law, even as the heavens in majesty surpass mankind.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपात्सहसावन्निति त्वोपस्तुतस्य वन्दते वृषा वाक् ।
त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napātsahasāvanniti tvopastutasya vandate vṛṣā vāk tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: O Son of Strength, Victorious, with this title Upastuta's most potent voice reveres thee. Blest with brave sons by thee we will extol thee, and lengthen out the days of our existence.

verses.sa:
इति त्वाग्ने वृष्टिहव्यस्य पुत्रा उपस्तुतास ऋषयोऽवोचन् ।
ताँश्च पाहि गृणतश्च सूरीन्वषड्वषळित्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्नमो नम इत्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्॥
verses.tr: iti tvāgne vṛṣṭihavyasya putrā upastutāsa ṛṣayo'vocan tāṃśca pāhi gṛṇataśca sūrīnvaṣaḍvaṣaḻityūrdhvāso anakṣannamo nama ityūrdhvāso anakṣan
verses.en: Thus, Agni, have the sons of Vrstihavya, the Rsis, the Upastutas invoked thee. Protect them, guard the singers and the princes. With Vasat! have they come, with hands uplifted, with their uplifted hands and cries of Glory!

verses.sa:
पिबा सोमं महत इन्द्रियाय पिबा वृत्राय हन्तवे शविष्ठ ।
पिब राये शवसे हूयमानः पिब मध्वस्तृपदिन्द्रा वृषस्व॥
verses.tr: pibā somaṃ mahata indriyāya pibā vṛtrāya hantave śaviṣṭha piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvastṛpadindrā vṛṣasva
verses.en: Drink Soma juice for mighty power and vigour, drink, Strongest One, that thou mayst smite down Vrtra. Drink thou, invoked, for strength, and riches: drink thou thy fill of meath and pour it down, O Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्य पिब क्षुमतः प्रस्थितस्येन्द्र सोमस्य वरमा सुतस्य ।
स्वस्तिदा मनसा मादयस्वाऽर्वाचीनो रेवते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varamā sutasya svastidā manasā mādayasvā'rvācīno revate saubhagāya
verses.en: Drink of the foodful juice stirred into motion, drink what thou choosest of the flowing Soma. Giver of weal, be joyful in thy spirit, and turn thee hitherward to bless and prosper.

verses.sa:
ममत्तु त्वा दिव्यः सोम इन्द्र ममत्तु यः सूयते पार्थिवेषु ।
ममत्तु येन वरिवश्चकर्थ ममत्तु येन निरिणासि शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu mamattu yena varivaścakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn
verses.en: Let heavenly Soma gladden thee, O Indra, let that effused among mankind delight thee. Rejoice in that whereby thou gavest freedom, and that whereby thou conquerest thy foemen.

verses.sa:
आ द्विबर्हा अमिनो यात्विन्द्रो वृषा हरिभ्यां परिषिक्तमन्धः ।
गव्या सुतस्य प्रभृतस्य मध्वः सत्रा खेदामरुशहा वृषस्व॥
verses.tr: ā dvibarhā amino yātvindro vṛṣā haribhyāṃ pariṣiktamandhaḥ gavyā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhvaḥ satrā khedāmaruśahā vṛṣasva
verses.en: Let Indra come, impetuous, doubly mighty, to the poured juice, the Bull, with two Bay Coursers. With juices pressed in milk, with meath presented, glut evermore thy bolt, O Foe-destroyer.

verses.sa:
नि तिग्मानि भ्राशयन्भ्राश्यान्यव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनाम् ।
उग्राय ते सहो बलं ददामि प्रतीत्या शत्रून्विगदेषु वृश्च॥
verses.tr: ni tigmāni bhrāśayanbhrāśyānyava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām ugrāya te saho balaṃ dadāmi pratītyā śatrūnvigadeṣu vṛśca
verses.en: Dash down, outflaming their sharp flaming weapons, the strong-holds of the men urged on by demons. I give thee, Mighty One, great strength and conquest: go, meet thy foes and rend them in the battle.

verses.sa:
व्य१र्य इन्द्र तनुहि श्रवांस्योजः स्थिरेव धन्वनोऽभिमातीः ।
अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधानः सहोभिरनिभृष्टस्तन्वं वावृधस्व॥
verses.tr: vya1rya indra tanuhi śravāṃsyojaḥ sthireva dhanvano'bhimātīḥ asmadryagvāvṛdhānaḥ sahobhiranibhṛṣṭastanvaṃ vāvṛdhasva
verses.en: Extend afar the votary's fame and glory, as the firm archer's strength drives off the foeman. Ranged on our side, grown strong in might that conquers, never defeated, still increase thy body.

verses.sa:
इदं हविर्मघवन्तुभ्यं रातं प्रति सम्राळहृणानो गृभाय ।
तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन्तुभ्यं पक्वो३ऽद्धीन्द्र पिब च प्रस्थितस्य॥
verses.tr: idaṃ havirmaghavantubhyaṃ rātaṃ prati samrāḻahṛṇāno gṛbhāya tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyaṃ pakvo3'ddhīndra piba ca prasthitasya
verses.en: To thee have we presented this oblation: accept it, Sovran Ruler, free from anger. Juice, Maghavan, for thee is pressed and ripened: eat, Indra, drink of that which stirs to meet thee.

verses.sa:
अद्धीदिन्द्र प्रस्थितेमा हवींषि चनो दधिष्व पचतोत सोमम् ।
प्रयस्वन्तः प्रति हर्यामसि त्वा सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः॥
verses.tr: addhīdindra prasthitemā havīṃṣi cano dadhiṣva pacatota somam prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ
verses.en: Eat, Indra, these oblations which approach thee: be pleased with food made ready and with Soma. With entertainment we receive thee friendly: effectual be the sacrificer's wishes.

verses.sa:
प्रेन्द्राग्निभ्यां सुवचस्यामियर्मि सिन्धाविव प्रेरयं नावमर्कैः ।
अया इव परि चरन्ति देवा ये अस्मभ्यं धनदा उद्भिदश्च॥
verses.tr: prendrāgnibhyāṃ suvacasyāmiyarmi sindhāviva prerayaṃ nāvamarkaiḥ ayā iva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udbhidaśca
verses.en: I send sweet speech to Indra and to Agni: with hymns I speed it like a boat through waters. Even thus, the Gods seem moving round about me, the fountains and bestowers of our riches.

verses.sa:
न वा उ देवाः क्षुधमिद्वधं ददुरुताशितमुप गच्छन्ति मृत्यवः ।
उतो रयिः पृणतो नोप दस्यत्युतापृणन्मर्डितारं न विन्दते॥
verses.tr: na vā u devāḥ kṣudhamidvadhaṃ dadurutāśitamupa gacchanti mṛtyavaḥ uto rayiḥ pṛṇato nopa dasyatyutāpṛṇanmarḍitāraṃ na vindate
verses.en: The Gods have not ordained hunger to be our death: even to the well-fed man comes death in varied shape. The riches of the liberal never waste away, while he who will not give finds none to comfort him.

verses.sa:
य आध्राय चकमानाय पित्वोऽन्नवान्त्सन्रफितायोपजग्मुषे ।
स्थिरं मनः कृणुते सेवते पुरोतो चित्स मर्डितारं न विन्दते॥
verses.tr: ya ādhrāya cakamānāya pitvo'nnavāntsanraphitāyopajagmuṣe sthiraṃ manaḥ kṛṇute sevate puroto citsa marḍitāraṃ na vindate
verses.en: The man with food in store who, when the needy comes in miserable case begging for bread to eat, Hardens his heart against him-even when of old he did him service-finds not one to comfort him.

verses.sa:
स इद्भोजो यो गृहवे ददात्यन्नकामाय चरते कृशाय ।
अरमस्मै भवति यामहूता उतापरीषु कृणुते सखायम्॥
verses.tr: sa idbhojo yo gṛhave dadātyannakāmāya carate kṛśāya aramasmai bhavati yāmahūtā utāparīṣu kṛṇute sakhāyam
verses.en: Bounteous is he who gives unto the beggar who comes to him in want of food and feeble. Success attends him in the shout of battle. He makes a friend of him in future troubles.

verses.sa:
न स सखा यो न ददाति सख्ये सचाभुवे सचमानाय पित्वः ।
अपास्मात्प्रेयान्न तदोको अस्ति पृणन्तमन्यमरणं चिदिच्छेत्॥
verses.tr: na sa sakhā yo na dadāti sakhye sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ apāsmātpreyānna tadoko asti pṛṇantamanyamaraṇaṃ cidicchet
verses.en: No friend is he who to his friend and comrade who comes imploring food, will offer nothing. Let him depart-no home is that to rest in-, and rather seek a stranger to support him.

verses.sa:
पृणीयादिन्नाधमानाय तव्यान्द्राघीयांसमनु पश्येत पन्थाम् ।
ओ हि वर्तन्ते रथ्येव चक्राऽन्यमन्यमुप तिष्ठन्त रायः॥
verses.tr: pṛṇīyādinnādhamānāya tavyāndrāghīyāṃsamanu paśyeta panthām o hi vartante rathyeva cakrā'nyamanyamupa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ
verses.en: Let the rich satisfy the poor implorer, and bend his eye upon a longer pathway. Riches come now to one, now to another, and like the wheels of cars are ever rolling.

verses.sa:
मोघमन्नं विन्दते अप्रचेताः सत्यं ब्रवीमि वध इत्स तस्य ।
नार्यमणं पुष्यति नो सखायं केवलाघो भवति केवलादी॥
verses.tr: moghamannaṃ vindate apracetāḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vadha itsa tasya nāryamaṇaṃ puṣyati no sakhāyaṃ kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī
verses.en: The foolish man wins food with fruitless labour: that food -I speak the truth- shall be his ruin. He feeds no trusty friend, no man to love him. All guilt is he who eats with no partaker.

verses.sa:
कृषन्नित्फाल आशितं कृणोति यन्नध्वानमप वृङ्क्ते चरित्रैः ।
वदन्ब्रह्मावदतो वनीयान्पृणन्नापिरपृणन्तमभि ष्यात्॥
verses.tr: kṛṣannitphāla āśitaṃ kṛṇoti yannadhvānamapa vṛṅkte caritraiḥ vadanbrahmāvadato vanīyānpṛṇannāpirapṛṇantamabhi ṣyāt
verses.en: The ploughshare ploughing makes the food that feeds us, and with its feet cuts through the path it follows. Better the speaking than the silent Brahman: the liberal friend out values him who gives not.

verses.sa:
एकपाद्भूयो द्विपदो वि चक्रमे द्विपात्त्रिपादमभ्येति पश्चात् ।
चतुष्पादेति द्विपदामभिस्वरे सम्पश्यन्पङ्क्तीरुपतिष्ठमानः॥
verses.tr: ekapādbhūyo dvipado vi cakrame dvipāttripādamabhyeti paścāt catuṣpādeti dvipadāmabhisvare sampaśyanpaṅktīrupatiṣṭhamānaḥ
verses.en: He with one foot hath far outrun the biped, and the two-footed catches the three-footed. Four-footed creatures come when bipeds call them, and stand and look where five are met together.

verses.sa:
समौ चिद्धस्तौ न समं विविष्टः सम्मातरा चिन्न समं दुहाते ।
यमयोश्चिन्न समा वीर्याणि ज्ञाती चित्सन्तौ न समं पृणीतः॥
verses.tr: samau ciddhastau na samaṃ viviṣṭaḥ sammātarā cinna samaṃ duhāte yamayościnna samā vīryāṇi jñātī citsantau na samaṃ pṛṇītaḥ
verses.en: The hands are both alike: their labour differs. The yield of sister milch-kine is unequal. Twins even differ in their strength and vigour: two, even kinsmen, differ in their bounty.

verses.sa: अग्ने हंसि न्य१त्रिणं दीद्यन्मर्त्येष्वा । स्वे क्षये शुचिव्रत॥
verses.tr: agne haṃsi nya1triṇaṃ dīdyanmartyeṣvā sve kṣaye śucivrata
verses.en: Agni, refulgent among men thou slayest the devouring fiend, Bright Ruler in thine own abode.

verses.sa: उत्तिष्ठसि स्वाहुतो घृतानि प्रति मोदसे । यत्त्वा स्रुचः समस्थिरन्॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭhasi svāhuto ghṛtāni prati modase yattvā srucaḥ samasthiran
verses.en: Thou springest up when worshipped well the drops of butter are thy joy When ladies are brought near to thee.

verses.sa: स आहुतो वि रोचतेऽग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा । स्रुचा प्रतीकमज्यते॥
verses.tr: sa āhuto vi rocate'gnirīḻenyo girā srucā pratīkamajyate
verses.en: Honoured with gifts he shines afar, Agni adorable with song: The dripping ladle balms his face.

verses.sa: घृतेनाग्निः समज्यते मधुप्रतीक आहुतः । रोचमानो विभावसुः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtenāgniḥ samajyate madhupratīka āhutaḥ rocamāno vibhāvasuḥ
verses.en: Agni with honey in his mouth, honoured with gifts, is balmed with oil, Refulgent in his wealth of light.

verses.sa: जरमाणः समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन । तं त्वा हवन्त मर्त्याः॥
verses.tr: jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana taṃ tvā havanta martyāḥ
verses.en: Praised by our hymns thou kindlest thee, Oblation-bearer, for the Gods As such do mortals call on thee.

verses.sa: तं मर्ता अमर्त्यं घृतेनाग्निं सपर्यत । अदाभ्यं गृहपतिम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ martā amartyaṃ ghṛtenāgniṃ saparyata adābhyaṃ gṛhapatim
verses.en: To that Immortal Agni pay worship with oil, ye mortal men,- Lord of the house, whom none deceives.

verses.sa: अदाभ्येन शोचिषाऽग्ने रक्षस्त्वं दह । गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: adābhyena śociṣā'gne rakṣastvaṃ daha gopā ṛtasya dīdihi
verses.en: O Agni, burn the Raksasas with thine unconquerable flame Shine guardian of Eternal Law.

verses.sa: स त्वमग्ने प्रतीकेन प्रत्योष यातुधान्यः । उरुक्षयेषु दीद्यत्॥
verses.tr: sa tvamagne pratīkena pratyoṣa yātudhānyaḥ urukṣayeṣu dīdyat
verses.en: So, Agni, with thy glowing face burn fierce against the female fiends, Shining among Uruksayas.

verses.sa: तं त्वा गीर्भिरुरुक्षया हव्यवाहं समीधिरे । यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā gīrbhirurukṣayā havyavāhaṃ samīdhire yajiṣṭhaṃ mānuṣe jane
verses.en: Uruksayas have kindled thee, Oblation-bearer, thee, with hymns. Best Worshipper among mankind.

verses.sa: इति वा इति मे मनो गामश्वं सनुयामिति । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: iti vā iti me mano gāmaśvaṃ sanuyāmiti kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: This, even this was my resolve, to win a cow, to win a steed: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: प्र वाता इव दोधत उन्मा पीता अयंसत । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: pra vātā iva dodhata unmā pītā ayaṃsata kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: Like violent gusts of wind the draughts that I have drunk have lifted me Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: उन्मा पीता अयंसत रथमश्वा इवाशवः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: unmā pītā ayaṃsata rathamaśvā ivāśavaḥ kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: The draughts I drank have borne me up, as fleet-foot horses draw a car: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: उप मा मतिरस्थित वाश्रा पुत्रमिव प्रियम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: upa mā matirasthita vāśrā putramiva priyam kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: The hymn hath reached me, like a cow who lows to meet her darling calf: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: अहं तष्टेव वन्धुरं पर्यचामि हृदा मतिम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ taṣṭeva vandhuraṃ paryacāmi hṛdā matim kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: As a wright bends a chariot-seat so round my heart I bend the hymn: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: नहि मे अक्षिपच्चनाऽच्छान्त्सुः पञ्च कृष्टयः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: nahi me akṣipaccanā'cchāntsuḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: Not as a mote within the eye count the Five Tribes of men with me: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: नहि मे रोदसी उभे अन्यं पक्षं चन प्रति । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: nahi me rodasī ubhe anyaṃ pakṣaṃ cana prati kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: The heavens and earth themselves have not grown equal to one half of me Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: अभि द्यां महिना भुवमभी३मां पृथिवीं महीम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: abhi dyāṃ mahinā bhuvamabhī3māṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīm kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: I in my grandeur have surpassed the heavens and all this spacious earth Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: हन्ताहं पृथिवीमिमां नि दधानीह वेह वा । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: hantāhaṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ ni dadhānīha veha vā kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: Aha! this spacious earth will I deposit either here or there Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: ओषमित्पृथिवीमहं जङ्घनानीह वेह वा । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: oṣamitpṛthivīmahaṃ jaṅghanānīha veha vā kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: In one short moment will I smite the earth in fury here or there: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: दिवि मे अन्यः पक्षो३ऽधो अन्यमचीकृषम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: divi me anyaḥ pakṣo3'dho anyamacīkṛṣam kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: One of my flanks is in the sky; I let the other trail below: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: अहमस्मि महामहोऽभिनभ्यमुदीषितः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: ahamasmi mahāmaho'bhinabhyamudīṣitaḥ kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: 1, greatest of the Mighty Ones, am lifted to the firmament: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa: गृहो याम्यरंकृतो देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहनः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति॥
verses.tr: gṛho yāmyaraṃkṛto devebhyo havyavāhanaḥ kuvitsomasyāpāmiti
verses.en: I seek the worshipper's abode; oblation-bearer to the Gods: Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः॥
verses.tr: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ
verses.en: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the Mighty Gods, of splendid valour. As soon as born he overcomes his foemen, be in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.

verses.sa:
वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu
verses.en: Grown mighty in his strength, with ample vigour, he as a foe strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः॥
verses.tr: tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
verses.en: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, twice or thrice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win. quickly with our meath that meath in battle.

verses.sa:
इति चिद्धि त्वा धना जयन्तं मदेमदे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः ।
ओजीयो धृष्णो स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना दुरेवाः॥
verses.tr: iti ciddhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ mademade anumadanti viprāḥ ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā durevāḥ
verses.en: Therefore in thee too, thou who winnest riches, at every banquet are the sages joyful. With mightier power, Bold God, extend thy firmness: let not malignant Yatudhanas harm thee.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि ।
चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi
verses.en: Proudly we put our trust in thee in battles, when we behold great wealth the prize of combat. I with my words impel thy weapons onward, and sharpen with my prayer thy vital vigour.

verses.sa:
स्तुषेय्यं पुरुवर्पसमृभ्वमिनतममाप्त्यमाप्त्यानाम् ।
आ दर्षते शवसा सप्त दानून्प्र साक्षते प्रतिमानानि भूरि॥
verses.tr: stuṣeyyaṃ puruvarpasamṛbhvaminatamamāptyamāptyānām ā darṣate śavasā sapta dānūnpra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri
verses.en: Worthy of praises, many-shaped, most skillful, most energetic, Aptya of the Aptyas: He with his might destroys the seven Danus, subduing many who were deemed his equals.

verses.sa:
नि तद्दधिषेऽवरं परं च यस्मिन्नाविथावसा दुरोणे ।
आ मातरा स्थापयसे जिगत्नू अत इनोषि कर्वरा पुरूणि॥
verses.tr: ni taddadhiṣe'varaṃ paraṃ ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi
verses.en: Thou in that house which thy protection guardeth bestowest wealth, the higher and the lower. Thou establishest the two much-wandering Mothers, and bringest many deeds to their completion.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवो विवक्तीन्द्राय शूषमग्रियः स्वर्षाः ।
महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजो दुरश्च विश्वा अवृणोदप स्वाः॥
verses.tr: imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivaktīndrāya śūṣamagriyaḥ svarṣāḥ maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraśca viśvā avṛṇodapa svāḥ
verses.en: Brhaddiva, the foremost of light-winners, repeats these holy prayers, this strength of Indra. He rules the great self-luminous fold of cattle, and all the doors of light hath he thrown open.

verses.sa:
एवा महान्बृहद्दिवो अथर्वाऽवोचत्स्वां तन्व१मिन्द्रमेव ।
स्वसारो मातरिभ्वरीररिप्रा हिन्वन्ति च शवसा वर्धयन्ति च॥
verses.tr: evā mahānbṛhaddivo atharvā'vocatsvāṃ tanva1mindrameva svasāro mātaribhvarīrariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca
verses.en: Thus hath Brhaddiva, the great Atharvan, spoken to Indra as himself in person. The spotless Sisters, they who are his Mothers, with power exalt him and impel him onward.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् ।
स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created beings. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandments all the Gods acknowledge -. The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव ।
य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Who by his grandeur hath become Sole Ruler of all the moving world that breathes and slumbers; He who is Lord of men and Lord of cattle. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः ।
यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: His, through his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasa his possession: His arms are these, his are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृळ्हा येन स्व स्तभितं येन नाकः ।
यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḻhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: By him the heavens are strong and earth is steadfast, by him light's realm and sky-vault are supported: By him the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने ।
यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: To him, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, When over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन्गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम् ।
ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyangarbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: What time the mighty waters came, containing the universal germ, producing Agni, Thence sprang the Gods' one spirit into being. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम् ।
यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He in his might surveyed the floods containing productive force and generating Worship. He is the God of gods, and none beside him. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
मा नो हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा जजान ।
यश्चापश्चन्द्रा बृहतीर्जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: mā no hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Neer may he harm us who is earth's Begetter, nor he whose laws are sure, the heavens' Creator, He who brought forth the great and lucid waters. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव ।
यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Prajapati! thou only comprehendest all these created things, and none beside thee. Grant us our hearts' desire when we invoke thee: may we have store of riches in possession.

verses.sa:
वसुं न चित्रमहसं गृणीषे वामं शेवमतिथिमद्विषेण्यम् ।
स रासते शुरुधो विश्वधायसोऽग्निर्होता गृहपतिः सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithimadviṣeṇyam sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam
verses.en: I PRAISE the God of wondrous might like Indra, the lovely pleasant Guest whom all must welcome. May Agni, Priest and Master of the household, give hero strength and all-sustaining riches.

verses.sa:
जुषाणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य मे वचो विश्वानि विद्वान्वयुनानि सुक्रतो ।
घृतनिर्णिग्ब्रह्मणे गातुमेरय तव देवा अजनयन्ननु व्रतम्॥
verses.tr: juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvānvayunāni sukrato ghṛtanirṇigbrahmaṇe gātumeraya tava devā ajanayannanu vratam
verses.en: O Agni, graciously accept this song of mine, thou passing-wise who knowest every ordinance. Enwrapped in holy oil further the course of prayer: the Gods bestow according to thy holy law.

verses.sa:
सप्त धामानि परियन्नमर्त्यो दाशद्दाशुषे सुकृते मामहस्व ।
सुवीरेण रयिणाग्ने स्वाभुवा यस्त आनट् समिधा तं जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: sapta dhāmāni pariyannamartyo dāśaddāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yasta ānaṭ samidhā taṃ juṣasva
verses.en: Immortal, wandering round the seven stations, give, a liberal Giver, to the pious worshipper, Wealth, Agni, with brave sons and ready for his use: welcome the man who comes with fuel unto thee.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितं हविष्मन्त ईळते सप्त वाजिनम् ।
शृण्वन्तमग्निं घृतपृष्ठमुक्षणं पृणन्तं देवं पृणते सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḻate sapta vājinam śṛṇvantamagniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamukṣaṇaṃ pṛṇantaṃ devaṃ pṛṇate suvīryam
verses.en: The seven who bring oblations worship thee, the Strong, the first, the Great Chief Priest, Ensign of sacrifice, The oil-anointed Bull, Agni who hears, who sends as God full hero strength to him who freely gives.

verses.sa:
त्वं दूतः प्रथमो वरेण्यः स हूयमानो अमृताय मत्स्व ।
त्वां मर्जयन्मरुतो दाशुषो गृहे त्वां स्तोमेभिर्भृगवो वि रुरुचुः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa hūyamāno amṛtāya matsva tvāṃ marjayanmaruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhirbhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ
verses.en: First messenger art thou, meet for election: drink thou thy fill invited to the Anirta, The Maruts in the votary's house adorned thee; with lauds the Bhrgus gave thee light and glory.

verses.sa:
इषं दुहन्त्सुदुघां विश्वधायसं यज्ञप्रिये यजमानाय सुक्रतो ।
अग्ने घृतस्नुस्त्रिॠतानि दीद्यद्वर्तिर्यज्ञं परियन्त्सुक्रतूयसे॥
verses.tr: iṣaṃ duhantsudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato agne ghṛtasnustriṝtāni dīdyadvartiryajñaṃ pariyantsukratūyase
verses.en: Milking the teeming Cow for all-sustaining food. O Wise One, for the worship-loving worshipper, Thou, Agni, dropping oil, thrice lighting works of Law, showest thy wisdom circling home and sacrifice.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदस्या उषसो व्युष्टिषु दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त मानुषाः ।
त्वां देवा महयाय्याय वावृधुराज्यमग्ने निमृजन्तो अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: tvāmidasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhurājyamagne nimṛjanto adhvare
verses.en: They who at flushing of this dawn appointed thee their messenger, these men have paid thee reverence. Gods strengthened thee for work that must be glorified, Agni, while they made butter pure for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा वसिष्ठा अह्वन्त वाजिनं गृणन्तो अग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धारय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Arrangers in our synods, Agni, while they sang Vasisistha s sons have called thee down, the Potent One. Maintain the growth of wealth with men who sacrifice. Ye Gods, preserve us with your blessings evermore.

verses.sa:
अयं वेनश्चोदयत्पृश्निगर्भा ज्योतिर्जरायू रजसो विमाने ।
इममपां संगमे सूर्यस्य शिशुं न विप्रा मतिभी रिहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti
verses.en: See, Vena, born in light, hath driven hither, on chariot of the air, the Calves of Prsni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle.

verses.sa:
समुद्रादूर्मिमुदियर्ति वेनो नभोजाः पृष्ठं हर्यतस्य दर्शि ।
ऋतस्य सानावधि विष्टपि भ्राट् समानं योनिमभ्यनूषत व्राः॥
verses.tr: samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi ṛtasya sānāvadhi viṣṭapi bhrāṭ samānaṃ yonimabhyanūṣata vrāḥ
verses.en: Vena draws up his wave from out the ocean. mist-born, the fair one's back is made apparent, Brightly he shone aloft on Order's summit: the hosts sang glory to their common birthplace.

verses.sa:
समानं पूर्वीरभि वावशानास्तिष्ठन्वत्सस्य मातरः सनीळाः ।
ऋतस्य सानावधि चक्रमाणा रिहन्ति मध्वो अमृतस्य वाणीः॥
verses.tr: samānaṃ pūrvīrabhi vāvaśānāstiṣṭhanvatsasya mātaraḥ sanīḻāḥ ṛtasya sānāvadhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ
verses.en: Full many, lowing to their joint-possession, dwelling together stood the Darling's Mothers. Ascending to the lofty height of Order, the bands of singers 'sip the sweets of Amrta.

verses.sa:
जानन्तो रूपमकृपन्त विप्रा मृगस्य घोषं महिषस्य हि ग्मन् ।
ऋतेन यन्तो अधि सिन्धुमस्थुर्विदद्गन्धर्वो अमृतानि नाम॥
verses.tr: jānanto rūpamakṛpanta viprā mṛgasya ghoṣaṃ mahiṣasya hi gman ṛtena yanto adhi sindhumasthurvidadgandharvo amṛtāni nāma
verses.en: Knowing his form, the sages yearned to meet him: they have come nigh to hear the wild Bull's bellow. Performing sacrifice they reached the river: for the Gandharva found the immortal waters.

verses.sa:
अप्सरा जारमुपसिष्मियाणा योषा बिभर्ति परमे व्योमन् ।
चरत्प्रियस्य योनिषु प्रियः सन्त्सीदत्पक्षे हिरण्यये स वेनः॥
verses.tr: apsarā jāramupasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman caratpriyasya yoniṣu priyaḥ santsīdatpakṣe hiraṇyaye sa venaḥ
verses.en: The Apsaras, the Lady, sweetly smiling, supports her Lover in sublimest heaven. In his Friend's dwelling as a Friend he wanders: he, Vena, rests him on his golden pinion.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम्॥
verses.tr: nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum
verses.en: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि ।
वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्व१र्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthātpratyaṅcitrā bibhradasyāyudhāni vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ sva1rṇa nāma janata priyāṇi
verses.en: Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons; Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us.

verses.sa:
द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् ।
भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि॥
verses.tr: drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajjigāti paśyangṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānastṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi
verses.en: When as a spark he cometh near the ocean, still looking with a vulture's eye to heaven, His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the lowest region.

verses.sa:
इमं नो अग्न उप यज्ञमेहि पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम् ।
असो हव्यवाळुत नः पुरोगा ज्योगेव दीर्घं तम आशयिष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ no agna upa yajñamehi pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum aso havyavāḻuta naḥ purogā jyogeva dīrghaṃ tama āśayiṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: Come to this sacrifice of ours, O Agni, threefold, with seven threads and five divisions. Be our oblation-bearer and preceder: thou hast lain long enough in during darkness.

verses.sa:
अदेवाद्देवः प्रचता गुहा यन्प्रपश्यमानो अमृतत्वमेमि ।
शिवं यत्सन्तमशिवो जहामि स्वात्सख्यादरणीं नाभिमेमि॥
verses.tr: adevāddevaḥ pracatā guhā yanprapaśyamāno amṛtatvamemi śivaṃ yatsantamaśivo jahāmi svātsakhyādaraṇīṃ nābhimemi
verses.en: I come a God foreseeing from the godless to immortality by secret pathways, While I, ungracious one, desert the gracious, leave mine own friends and seek the kin of strangers.

verses.sa:
पश्यन्नन्यस्या अतिथिं वयाया ऋतस्य धाम वि मिमे पुरूणि ।
शंसामि पित्रे असुराय शेवमयज्ञियाद्यज्ञियं भागमेमि॥
verses.tr: paśyannanyasyā atithiṃ vayāyā ṛtasya dhāma vi mime purūṇi śaṃsāmi pitre asurāya śevamayajñiyādyajñiyaṃ bhāgamemi
verses.en: I, looking to the guest of other lineage, have founded many a rule of Law and Order. I bid farewell to the Great God, the Father, and, for neglect, obtain my share of worship.

verses.sa:
बह्वीः समा अकरमन्तरस्मिन्निन्द्रं वृणानः पितरं जहामि ।
अग्निः सोमो वरुणस्ते च्यवन्ते पर्यावर्द्राष्ट्रं तदवाम्यायन्॥
verses.tr: bahvīḥ samā akaramantarasminnindraṃ vṛṇānaḥ pitaraṃ jahāmi agniḥ somo varuṇaste cyavante paryāvardrāṣṭraṃ tadavāmyāyan
verses.en: I tarried many a year within this altar: I leave the Father, for my choice is Indra. Away pass Agni, Varuna and Soma. Rule ever changes: this I come to favour.

verses.sa:
निर्माया उ त्ये असुरा अभूवन्त्वं च मा वरुण कामयासे ।
ऋतेन राजन्ननृतं विविञ्चन्मम राष्ट्रस्याधिपत्यमेहि॥
verses.tr: nirmāyā u tye asurā abhūvantvaṃ ca mā varuṇa kāmayāse ṛtena rājannanṛtaṃ viviñcanmama rāṣṭrasyādhipatyamehi
verses.en: These Asuras have lost their powers of magic. But thou, O Varuna, if thou dost love me, O King, discerning truth and right from falsehood, come and be Lord and Ruler of my kingdom.

verses.sa:
इदं स्वरिदमिदास वाममयं प्रकाश उर्व१न्तरिक्षम् ।
हनाव वृत्रं निरेहि सोम हविष्ट्वा सन्तं हविषा यजाम॥
verses.tr: idaṃ svaridamidāsa vāmamayaṃ prakāśa urva1ntarikṣam hanāva vṛtraṃ nirehi soma haviṣṭvā santaṃ haviṣā yajāma
verses.en: Here is the light of heaven, here all is lovely; here there is radiance, here is air's wide region. Let us two slaughter Vrtra. Forth, O Soma! Thou art oblation: we therewith will serve thee.

verses.sa:
कविः कवित्वा दिवि रूपमासजदप्रभूती वरुणो निरपः सृजत् ।
क्षेमं कृण्वाना जनयो न सिन्धवस्ता अस्य वर्णं शुचयो भरिभ्रति॥
verses.tr: kaviḥ kavitvā divi rūpamāsajadaprabhūtī varuṇo nirapaḥ sṛjat kṣemaṃ kṛṇvānā janayo na sindhavastā asya varṇaṃ śucayo bharibhrati
verses.en: The Sage hath fixed his form by wisdom in the heavens: Varuna with no violence let the waters flow. Like women-folk, the floods that bring prosperity have you lit his hue and colour as they gleamed and shone.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य ज्येष्ठमिन्द्रियं सचन्ते ता ईमा क्षेति स्वधया मदन्तीः ।
ता ईं विशो न राजानं वृणाना बीभत्सुवो अप वृत्रादतिष्ठन्॥
verses.tr: tā asya jyeṣṭhamindriyaṃ sacante tā īmā kṣeti svadhayā madantīḥ tā īṃ viśo na rājānaṃ vṛṇānā bībhatsuvo apa vṛtrādatiṣṭhan
verses.en: These wait upon his loftiest power and vigour: he dwells in these who triumph in their Godhead; And they, like people who elect their ruler, have in abhorrence turned away from Vrtra.

verses.sa:
बीभत्सूनां सयुजं हंसमाहुरपां दिव्यानां सख्ये चरन्तम् ।
अनुष्टुभमनु चर्चूर्यमाणमिन्द्रं नि चिक्युः कवयो मनीषा॥
verses.tr: bībhatsūnāṃ sayujaṃ haṃsamāhurapāṃ divyānāṃ sakhye carantam anuṣṭubhamanu carcūryamāṇamindraṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo manīṣā
verses.en: They call him Swan, the abhorrent floods' Companion, moving in friendship with celestial Waters. The poets in their thought have looked on Indra swiftly approaching when Anustup calls him.

sections.label: Vak, the voice of the divine
sections.name: Hymn 125

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः ।
अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā
verses.en: I TRAVEL with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Adityas and All-Gods I wander. I hold aloft both Varuna and Mitra, Indra and Agni, and the Pair of Asvins.

verses.sa:
अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् ।
अहं दधामि द्रविणं हविष्मते सुप्राव्ये३ यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye3 yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: I cherish and sustain high-swelling Soma, and Tvastar I support, Pusan, and Bhaga. I load with wealth the zealous sacrificer who pours the juice and offers his oblation

verses.sa:
अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् ।
तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तीम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm
verses.en: I am the Queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship. Thus Gods have stablished me in many places with many homes to enter and abide in.

verses.sa:
मया सो अन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणिति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् ।
अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रद्धिवं ते वदामि॥
verses.tr: mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi
verses.en: Through me alone all eat the food that feeds them,-each man who sees, breathes, hears the word outspoken They know it not, but yet they dwell beside me. Hear, one and all, the truth as I declare it.

verses.sa:
अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवेभिरुत मानुषेभिः ।
यं कामये तंतमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम्॥
verses.tr: ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām
verses.en: I, verily, myself announce and utter the word that Gods and men alike shall welcome. I make the man I love exceeding mighty, make him a sage, a Rsi, and a Brahman.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa
verses.en: I bend the bow for Rudra that his arrow may strike and slay the hater of devotion. I rouse and order battle for the people, and I have penetrated Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन्मम योनिरप्स्व१न्तः समुद्रे ।
ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानु विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonirapsva1ntaḥ samudre tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi
verses.en: On the world's summit I bring forth the Father: my home is in the waters, in the ocean. Thence I extend o'er all existing creatures, and touch even yonder heaven with my forehead.

verses.sa:
अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिना सं बभूव॥
verses.tr: ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ babhūva
verses.en: I breathe a strong breath like the wind and tempest, the while I hold together all existence. Beyond this wide earth and beyond the heavens I have become so mighty in my grandeur.

verses.sa: न तमंहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् । सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयन्ति वरुणो अति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man, Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varima, of one accord, beyond his foes.

verses.sa: तद्धि वयं वृणीमहे वरुण मित्रार्यमन् । येना निरंहसो यूयं पाथ नेथा च मर्त्यमति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: taddhi vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe varuṇa mitrāryaman yenā niraṃhaso yūyaṃ pātha nethā ca martyamati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: This very thing do we desire, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Whereby ye guard the mortal man from sore distress, and lead him safe beyond his foes.

verses.sa: ते नूनं नोऽयमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । नयिष्ठा उ नो नेषणि पर्षिष्ठा उ नः पर्षण्यति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: te nūnaṃ no'yamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇyati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: These are, each one, our present helps, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman. Best leaders, best deliverers to lead us on and bear as safe beyond our foes.

verses.sa: यूयं विश्वं परि पाथ वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । युष्माकं शर्मणि प्रिये स्याम सुप्रणीतयोऽति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo'ti dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Ye compass round and guard each man, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman: In your dear keeping may we be, ye who are excellent as guides beyond our foes.

verses.sa: आदित्यासो अति स्रिधो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । उग्रं मरुद्भी रुद्रं हुवेमेन्द्रमग्निं स्वस्तयेऽति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā ugraṃ marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendramagniṃ svastaye'ti dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Adityas are beyond all foes,-Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman: Strong Rudra with the Marut host, Indra, Agni let us call for weal beyond our foes.

verses.sa: नेतार ऊ षु णस्तिरो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । अति विश्वानि दुरिता राजानश्चर्षणीनामति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: netāra ū ṣu ṇastiro varuṇo mitro aryamā ati viśvāni duritā rājānaścarṣaṇīnāmati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: These lead us safely over all, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, These who are Kings of living men, over all troubles far away beyond our foes.

verses.sa: शुनमस्मभ्यमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथ आदित्यासो यदीमहे अति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: śunamasmabhyamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā śarma yacchantu sapratha ādityāso yadīmahe ati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: May they give bliss to aid us well, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman: May the Adityas, when we pray, grant us wide shelter and defense beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः ।
एवो ष्व१स्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः॥
verses.tr: yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ evo ṣva1smanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ
verses.en: As in this place, O Holy Ones, ye Vasus freed even the Gaud when her feet were fettered. So free us now from trouble and affliction: and let our life be lengthened still, O Api.

sections.label: The Ratri Sukta: hymn to Night
sections.name: Hymn 127

verses.sa: रात्री व्यख्यदायती पुरुत्रा देव्य१क्षभिः । विश्वा अधि श्रियोऽधित॥
verses.tr: rātrī vyakhyadāyatī purutrā devya1kṣabhiḥ viśvā adhi śriyo'dhita
verses.en: With all her eyes the Goddess Night looks forth approaching many a spot: She hath put all her glories on.

verses.sa: ओर्वप्रा अमर्त्या निवतो देव्यु१द्वतः । ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः॥
verses.tr: orvaprā amartyā nivato devyu1dvataḥ jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ
verses.en: Immortal. she hath filled the waste, the Goddess hath filled height and depth: She conquers darkness with her light.

verses.sa: निरु स्वसारमस्कृतोषसं देव्यायती । अपेदु हासते तमः॥
verses.tr: niru svasāramaskṛtoṣasaṃ devyāyatī apedu hāsate tamaḥ
verses.en: The Goddess as she comes hath set the Dawn her Sister in her place: And then the darkness vanishes.

verses.sa: सा नो अद्य यस्या वयं नि ते यामन्नविक्ष्महि । वृक्षे न वसतिं वयः॥
verses.tr: sā no adya yasyā vayaṃ ni te yāmannavikṣmahi vṛkṣe na vasatiṃ vayaḥ
verses.en: So favour us this night, O thou whose pathways we have visited As birds their nest upon the tree.

verses.sa: नि ग्रामासो अविक्षत नि पद्वन्तो नि पक्षिणः । नि श्येनासश्चिदर्थिनः॥
verses.tr: ni grāmāso avikṣata ni padvanto ni pakṣiṇaḥ ni śyenāsaścidarthinaḥ
verses.en: The villagers have sought their homes, and all that walks and all that flies, Even the falcons fain for prey.

verses.sa: यावया वृक्यं१ वृकं यवय स्तेनमूर्म्ये । अथा नः सुतरा भव॥
verses.tr: yāvayā vṛkyaṃ1 vṛkaṃ yavaya stenamūrmye athā naḥ sutarā bhava
verses.en: Keep off the she-wolf and the wolf, O Urmya, keep the thief away; Easy be thou for us to pass.

verses.sa: उप मा पेपिशत्तमः कृष्णं व्यक्तमस्थित । उष ऋणेव यातय॥
verses.tr: upa mā pepiśattamaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyaktamasthita uṣa ṛṇeva yātaya
verses.en: Clearly hath she come nigh to me who decks the dark with richest hues: O Morning, cancel it like debts.

verses.sa: उप ते गा इवाकरं वृणीष्व दुहितर्दिवः । रात्रि स्तोमं न जिग्युषे॥
verses.tr: upa te gā ivākaraṃ vṛṇīṣva duhitardivaḥ rātri stomaṃ na jigyuṣe
verses.en: These have I brought to thee like kine. O Night, thou Child of Heaven, accept This laud as for a conqueror.

verses.sa:
ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम ।
मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वयाध्यक्षेण पृतना जयेम॥
verses.tr: mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ puṣema mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasrastvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema
verses.en: Let me win glory, Agni, in our battles: enkindling thee, may we support our bodies. May the four regions bend and bow before me: with thee for guardian may we win in combat.

verses.sa:
मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः ।
ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin
verses.en: May all the Gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts led by Indra, Visnu, Agni. Mine be the middle air's extended region, and may the wind blow favouring these my wishes.

verses.sa:
मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मय्याशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः ।
दैव्या होतारो वनुषन्त पूर्वेऽरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वा सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ daivyā hotāro vanuṣanta pūrve'riṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May the Gods grant me riches; may the blessing and invocation of the Gods assist me. Foremost in fight be the divine Invokers: may we, unwounded, have brave heroes round us.

verses.sa:
मह्यं यजन्तु मम यानि हव्याऽऽकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु ।
एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवासो अधि वोचता नः॥
verses.tr: mahyaṃ yajantu mama yāni havyā''kūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devāso adhi vocatā naḥ
verses.en: For me let them present all mine oblations, and let my mind's intention be accomplished. May I he guiltless of the least transgression: and, all ye Go-is, do ye combine to bless us.

verses.sa:
देवीः षळुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह वीरयध्वम् ।
मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन्॥
verses.tr: devīḥ ṣaḻurvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan
verses.en: Ye six divine Expanses, grant us freedom: here, all ye Gods, acquit yourselves like heroes. Let us not lose our children or our bodies: let us not benefit the foe, King Soma!

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन्परेषामदब्धो गोपाः परि पाहि नस्त्वम् ।
प्रत्यञ्चो यन्तु निगुतः पुनस्ते३ऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत्॥
verses.tr: agne manyuṃ pratinudanpareṣāmadabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nastvam pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punaste3'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat
verses.en: Baffling the wrath of our opponents, Agni, guard us as our infallible Protector. Let these thy foes turn back and seek their houses, and let their thought who watch at home be ruined.

verses.sa:
धाता धातॄणां भुवनस्य यस्पतिर्देवं त्रातारमभिमातिषाहम् ।
इमं यज्ञमश्विनोभा बृहस्पतिर्देवाः पान्तु यजमानं न्यर्थात्॥
verses.tr: dhātā dhātṝṇāṃ bhuvanasya yaspatirdevaṃ trātāramabhimātiṣāham imaṃ yajñamaśvinobhā bṛhaspatirdevāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nyarthāt
verses.en: Lord of the world, Creator of creators the saviour God who overcomes the foeman. May Gods, Brhaspati, both Asvins shelter from ill this sacrifice and sacrificer.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यंसदस्मिन्हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षुः ।
स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृळयेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः॥
verses.tr: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṃsadasminhave puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḻayendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ
verses.en: Foodful, and much-invoked, at this our calling may the great Bull vouchsafe us wide protection. Lord of Bay Coursers, Indra, blew our children: harm us not, give us riot as prey to others.

verses.sa:
ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान् ।
वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या उपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन्॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran
verses.en: Let those who are our foemen stay. afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off. Vasus, Adityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me far-reaching, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.

verses.sa:
नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् ।
किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम्॥
verses.tr: nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram
verses.en: Then was not non-existent nor existent: there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it. What covered in, and where? and what gave shelter? Was water there, unfathomed depth of water?

verses.sa:
न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः ।
आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किं चनास॥
verses.tr: na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiṃ canāsa
verses.en: Death was not then, nor was there aught immortal: no sign was there, the day's and night's divider. That One Thing, breathless, breathed by its own nature: apart from it was nothing whatsoever.

verses.sa:
तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् ।
तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम्॥
verses.tr: tama āsīttamasā gūḻhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam tucchyenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīttapasastanmahinājāyataikam
verses.en: Darkness there was: at first concealed in darkness this All was indiscriminate chaos. All that existed then was void and formless: by the great power of Warmth was born that Unit.

verses.sa:
कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत् ।
सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन्हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा॥
verses.tr: kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt sato bandhumasati niravindanhṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā
verses.en: Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire, the primal seed and germ of Spirit. Sages who searched with their heart's thought discovered the existent's kinship in the non-existent.

verses.sa:
तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त् ।
रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात्॥
verses.tr: tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3dupari svidāsī3t retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt
verses.en: Transversely was their severing line extended: what was above it then, and what below it? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder

verses.sa:
को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः ।
अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाऽथा को वेद यत आबभूव॥
verses.tr: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ arvāgdevā asya visarjanenā'thā ko veda yata ābabhūva
verses.en: Who verily knows and who can here declare it, whence it was born and whence comes this creation? The Gods are later than this world's production. Who knows then whence it first came into being?

verses.sa:
इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न ।
यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomantso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda
verses.en: He, the first origin of this creation, whether he formed it all or did not form it, Whose eye controls this world in highest heaven, he verily knows it, or perhaps he knows not.

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञो विश्वतस्तन्तुभिस्तत एकशतं देवकर्मेभिरायतः ।
इमे वयन्ति पितरो य आययुः प्र वयाप वयेत्यासते तते॥
verses.tr: yo yajño viśvatastantubhistata ekaśataṃ devakarmebhirāyataḥ ime vayanti pitaro ya āyayuḥ pra vayāpa vayetyāsate tate
verses.en: The sacrifice drawn out with threads on every side, stretched by a hundred sacred ministers and one,- This do these Fathers weave who hitherward are come: they sit beside the warp and cry, Weave forth, weave back.

verses.sa:
पुमाँ एनं तनुत उत्कृणत्ति पुमान्वि तत्ने अधि नाके अस्मिन् ।
इमे मयूखा उप सेदुरू सदः सामानि चक्रुस्तसराण्योतवे॥
verses.tr: pumāṃ enaṃ tanuta utkṛṇatti pumānvi tatne adhi nāke asmin ime mayūkhā upa sedurū sadaḥ sāmāni cakrustasarāṇyotave
verses.en: The Man extends it and the Man unbinds it: even to this vault of heaven hath he outspun, it. These pegs are fastened to the seat of worship: they made the Sama-hymns their weaving shuttles.

verses.sa:
कासीत्प्रमा प्रतिमा किं निदानमाज्यं किमासीत्परिधिः क आसीत् ।
छन्दः किमासीत्प्रउगं किमुक्थं यद्देवा देवमयजन्त विश्वे॥
verses.tr: kāsītpramā pratimā kiṃ nidānamājyaṃ kimāsītparidhiḥ ka āsīt chandaḥ kimāsītpraugaṃ kimukthaṃ yaddevā devamayajanta viśve
verses.en: What were the rule, the order and the model? What were the wooden fender and the butter? What were the hymn, the chant, the recitation, when to the God all Deities paid worship?

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्गायत्र्यभवत्सयुग्वोष्णिहया सविता सं बभूव ।
अनुष्टुभा सोम उक्थैर्महस्वान्बृहस्पतेर्बृहती वाचमावत्॥
verses.tr: agnergāyatryabhavatsayugvoṣṇihayā savitā saṃ babhūva anuṣṭubhā soma ukthairmahasvānbṛhaspaterbṛhatī vācamāvat
verses.en: Closely was Gayatri conjoined with Agni, and closely Savitar combined with Usnih. Brilliant with Ukthas, Soma joined Anustup: Brhaspati's voice by Brhati was aided.

verses.sa:
विराण्मित्रावरुणयोरभिश्रीरिन्द्रस्य त्रिष्टुबिह भागो अह्नः ।
विश्वान्देवाञ्जगत्या विवेश तेन चाकॢप्र ऋषयो मनुष्याः॥
verses.tr: virāṇmitrāvaruṇayorabhiśrīrindrasya triṣṭubiha bhāgo ahnaḥ viśvāndevāñjagatyā viveśa tena cākḷpra ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ
verses.en: Viraj adhered to Varuna and Mitra: here Tristup day by day was Indra's portion. Jagati entered all the Gods together: so by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis.

verses.sa:
चाकॢप्रे तेन ऋषयो मनुष्या यज्ञे जाते पितरो नः पुराणे ।
पश्यन्मन्ये मनसा चक्षसा तान्य इमं यज्ञमयजन्त पूर्वे॥
verses.tr: cākḷpre tena ṛṣayo manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaro naḥ purāṇe paśyanmanye manasā cakṣasā tānya imaṃ yajñamayajanta pūrve
verses.en: So by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis, when ancient sacrifice sprang up, our Fathers. With the mind's eye I think that I behold them who first performed this sacrificial worship.

verses.sa:
सहस्तोमाः सहछन्दस आवृतः सहप्रमा ऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः ।
पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीरा अन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो३ न रश्मीन्॥
verses.tr: sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo3 na raśmīn
verses.en: They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven Godlike Rsis. Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot-drivers.

verses.sa:
अप प्राच इन्द्र विश्वाँ अमित्रानपापाचो अभिभूते नुदस्व ।
अपोदीचो अप शूराधराच उरौ यथा तव शर्मन्मदेम॥
verses.tr: apa prāca indra viśvāṃ amitrānapāpāco abhibhūte nudasva apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarmanmadema
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, O Indra, the western, mighty Conqueror, and the eastern. Hero, drive off our northern foes and southern, that we in thy wide shelter may be joyful.

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय ।
इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमोवृक्तिं न जग्मुः॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ
verses.en: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn removing it in order, So bring the food of those men, bring it hither, who went not to prepare the grass for worship.

verses.sa:
नहि स्थूर्यृतुथा यातमस्ति नोत श्रवो विविदे संगमेषु ।
गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः॥
verses.tr: nahi sthūryṛtuthā yātamasti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ
verses.en: Men come not with one horse at sacred seasons; thus they obtain no honour in assemblies. Sages desiring herds of kine and horses strengthen the mighty Indra for his friendship.

verses.sa: युवं सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा । विपिपाना शुभस्पती इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam
verses.en: Ye, Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his work with Namuci of Asura birth.

verses.sa:
पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दंसनाभिः ।
यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्॥
verses.tr: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak
verses.en: As parents aid a son, both Asvins, Indra, aided thee with their wondrous Powers and wisdom. When thou, with might. hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvati, O Maghavan, refreshed thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: Indra is strong to save, rich in assistance may he, possessing all, be kind and gracious. May he disperse our foes and give us safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sa:
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्याऽपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ।
स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु॥
verses.tr: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyā'pi bhadre saumanase syāma sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu
verses.en: May we enjoy his favour, his the Holy may we enjoy his blessed loving kindness. May this rich Indra, as our good Protector, drive off and keep afar all those who hate us.

verses.sa:
ईजानमिद्द्यौर्गूर्तावसुरीजानं भूमिरभि प्रभूषणि ।
ईजानं देवावश्विनावभि सुम्नैरवर्धताम्॥
verses.tr: ījānamiddyaurgūrtāvasurījānaṃ bhūmirabhi prabhūṣaṇi ījānaṃ devāvaśvināvabhi sumnairavardhatām
verses.en: May Dyaus the Lord of lauded wealth, and Earth stand by the man who offers sacrifice, And may the Asvins, both the Gods, strengthen the worshipper with bliss.

verses.sa:
ता वां मित्रावरुणा धारयत्क्षिती सुषुम्नेषितत्वता यजामसि ।
युवोः क्राणाय सख्यैरभि ष्याम रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī suṣumneṣitatvatā yajāmasi yuvoḥ krāṇāya sakhyairabhi ṣyāma rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: As such we honour you, Mitra and Varuna, with hasty zeal, most blest, you who sustain the folk. So may we, through your friendship for the worshipper, subdue the fiends.

verses.sa:
अधा चिन्नु यद्दिधिषामहे वामभि प्रियं रेक्णः पत्यमानाः ।
दद्वाँ वा यत्पुष्यति रेक्णः सम्वारन्नकिरस्य मघानि॥
verses.tr: adhā cinnu yaddidhiṣāmahe vāmabhi priyaṃ rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ dadvāṃ vā yatpuṣyati rekṇaḥ samvārannakirasya maghāni
verses.en: And when we seek to win your love and friendship, we who have precious wealth in our possession, Or when the worshipper augments his riches let not his treasures be shut up

verses.sa:
असावन्यो असुर सूयत द्यौस्त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा ।
मूर्धा रथस्य चाकन्नैतावतैनसान्तकध्रुक्॥
verses.tr: asāvanyo asura sūyata dyaustvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā mūrdhā rathasya cākannaitāvatainasāntakadhruk
verses.en: That other, Asura! too was born of Heaven. thou art, O Varuna, the King of all men. The chariot's Lord was well content, forbearing to anger Death by sin so great.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्त्स्वे३तच्छकपूत एनो हिते मित्रे निगतान्हन्ति वीरान् ।
अवोर्वा यद्धात्तनूष्ववः प्रियासु यज्ञियास्वर्वा॥
verses.tr: asmintsve3tacchakapūta eno hite mitre nigatānhanti vīrān avorvā yaddhāttanūṣvavaḥ priyāsu yajñiyāsvarvā
verses.en: This sin hath Sakaputa here committed. Heroes who fled to their dear friend he slayeth, When the Steed bringeth down your grace and favour in bodies dear and worshipful.

verses.sa:
युवोर्हि मातादितिर्विचेतसा द्यौर्न भूमिः पयसा पुपूतनि ।
अव प्रिया दिदिष्टन सूरो निनिक्त रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: yuvorhi mātāditirvicetasā dyaurna bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani ava priyā didiṣṭana sūro ninikta raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: Your Mother Aditi, ye wise, was purified with water even as earth is purified from heaven. Show love and kindness here below: wash her in rays of heavenly light.

verses.sa:
युवं ह्यप्नराजावसीदतं तिष्ठद्रथं न धूर्षदं वनर्षदम् ।
ता नः कणूकयन्तीर्नृमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः सुमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ hyapnarājāvasīdataṃ tiṣṭhadrathaṃ na dhūrṣadaṃ vanarṣadam tā naḥ kaṇūkayantīrnṛmedhastatre aṃhasaḥ sumedhastatre aṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Ye Twain have seated you as Lords of Wealth, as one who mounts a car to him who sits upon the pole, upon the wood. These our disheartened tribes Nrmedhas saved from woe, Sumedhas saved from Woe.

verses.sa:
प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत ।
अभीके चिदु लोककृत्संगे समत्सु वृत्रहाऽस्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: pro ṣvasmai purorathamindrāya śūṣamarcata abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṃge samatsu vṛtrahā'smākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Sing strength to Indra that shall set his chariot in the foremost place. Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encourager. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.

verses.sa:
त्वं सिन्धूँरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम् ।
अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sindhūṃravāsṛjo'dharāco ahannahim aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to earth. Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.

verses.sa:
वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः ।
अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātirdadirvasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Destroyed be all malignities and all our enemy's designs. Thy bolt thou castest, at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्द्राभितो जनो वृकायुरादिदेशति ।
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि विबाधो असि सासहिर्नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: yo na indrābhito jano vṛkāyurādideśati adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahirnabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: The robber people round about, Indra, who watch and aim at us,- Trample them down beneath thy foot; a conquering scatterer art thou.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्द्राभिदासति सनाभिर्यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अव तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौरध त्मना नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: yo na indrābhidāsati sanābhiryaśca niṣṭyaḥ ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyauradha tmanā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Whoso assails us, Indra, be the man a stranger or akin, Bring down, thyself, his strength although it be as vast as are the heavens.

verses.sa:
वयमिन्द्र त्वायवः सखित्वमा रभामहे ।
ऋतस्य नः पथा नयाऽति विश्वानि दुरिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: vayamindra tvāyavaḥ sakhitvamā rabhāmahe ṛtasya naḥ pathā nayā'ti viśvāni duritā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu
verses.en: Close to thy friendship do we cling, O Indra, and depend, or, thee. Lead us beyond all pain and grief along the path of holy Law.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं सु त्वमिन्द्र तां शिक्ष या दोहते प्रति वरं जरित्रे ।
अच्छिद्रोध्नी पीपयद्यथा नः सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ su tvamindra tāṃ śikṣa yā dohate prati varaṃ jaritre acchidrodhnī pīpayadyathā naḥ sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
verses.en: Do thou bestow upon us her, O Indra, who yields according to the singer's longing, That the great Cow may, with exhaustless udder, pouring a thousand streams, give milk to feed us.

verses.sa:
उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव ।
महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: ubhe yadindra rodasī āpaprāthoṣā iva mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: As, like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven. So as the Mighty One, great King of all the mighty world of men, the Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
अव स्म दुर्हणायतो मर्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् ।
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: ava sma durhaṇāyato martasya tanuhi sthiram adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi yo asmāṃ ādideśati devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: Relax that mortal's stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness. Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
अव त्या बृहतीरिषो विश्वश्चन्द्रा अमित्रहन् ।
शचीभिः शक्र धूनुहीन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: ava tyā bṛhatīriṣo viśvaścandrā amitrahan śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhīndra viśvābhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: Shake down, O Slayer of the foe, those great all splendid enemies. With all thy powers, O Sakra, all thine helps, O Indra, shake them down:

verses.sa:
अव यत्त्वं शतक्रतविन्द्र विश्वानि धूनुषे ।
रयिं न सुन्वते सचा सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: ava yattvaṃ śatakratavindra viśvāni dhūnuṣe rayiṃ na sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: As thou, O Satakratu, thou, O Indrv, shakest all things down As wealth for him who sheds the juice, with thine assistance thousandfold.

verses.sa:
अव स्वेदा इवाभितो विष्वक्पतन्तु दिद्यवः ।
दूर्वाया इव तन्तवो व्य१स्मदेतु दुर्मतिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: ava svedā ivābhito viṣvakpatantu didyavaḥ dūrvāyā iva tantavo vya1smadetu durmatirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: Around, on every side like drops of sweat let lightning-flashes fall. Let all malevolence pass away from us like threads of Darva grass.

verses.sa:
दीर्घं ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः ।
पूर्वेण मघवन्पदाऽजो वयां यथा यमो देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: dīrghaṃ hyaṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktiṃ bibharṣi mantumaḥ pūrveṇa maghavanpadā'jo vayāṃ yathā yamo devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
verses.en: Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great Counsellor! As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
नकिर्देवा मिनीमसि नकिरा योपयामसि मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि ।
पक्षेभिरपिकक्षेभिरत्राभि सं रभामहे॥
verses.tr: nakirdevā minīmasi nakirā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi pakṣebhirapikakṣebhiratrābhi saṃ rabhāmahe
verses.en: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate: we walk as holy texts command. Closely we clasp and cling to you, cling to your sides, beneath your arms.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्वृक्षे सुपलाशे देवैः सम्पिबते यमः । अत्रा नो विश्पतिः पिता पुराणाँ अनु वेनति॥
verses.tr: yasminvṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ sampibate yamaḥ atrā no viśpatiḥ pitā purāṇāṃ anu venati
verses.en: In the Tree clothed with goodly leaves where Yama drinketh with the Gods, The Father, Master of the house, tendeth with love our ancient Sires.

verses.sa: पुराणाँ अनुवेनन्तं चरन्तं पापयामुया । असूयन्नभ्यचाकशं तस्मा अस्पृहयं पुनः॥
verses.tr: purāṇāṃ anuvenantaṃ carantaṃ pāpayāmuyā asūyannabhyacākaśaṃ tasmā aspṛhayaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: I looked reluctantly on him who cherishes those men of old, On him who treads that evil path, and then I yearned for this again.

verses.sa: यं कुमार नवं रथमचक्रं मनसाकृणोः । एकेषं विश्वतः प्राञ्चमपश्यन्नधि तिष्ठसि॥
verses.tr: yaṃ kumāra navaṃ rathamacakraṃ manasākṛṇoḥ ekeṣaṃ viśvataḥ prāñcamapaśyannadhi tiṣṭhasi
verses.en: Thou mountest, though thou dost not see, O Child, the new and wheel-less car Which thou hast fashioned mentally, one poled but turning every way.

verses.sa: यं कुमार प्रावर्तयो रथं विप्रेभ्यस्परि । तं सामानु प्रावर्तत समितो नाव्याहितम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ kumāra prāvartayo rathaṃ viprebhyaspari taṃ sāmānu prāvartata samito nāvyāhitam
verses.en: The car which thou hast made to roll hitherward from the Sages, Child! This hath the Saman followed close, hence, laid together on a ship.

verses.sa: कः कुमारमजनयद्रथं को निरवर्तयत् । कः स्वित्तदद्य नो ब्रूयादनुदेयी यथाभवत्॥
verses.tr: kaḥ kumāramajanayadrathaṃ ko niravartayat kaḥ svittadadya no brūyādanudeyī yathābhavat
verses.en: Who was the father of the child? Who made the chariot roll away? Who will this day declare to us how the funeral gift was made?

verses.sa: यथाभवदनुदेयी ततो अग्रमजायत । पुरस्ताद्बुध्न आततः पश्चान्निरयणं कृतम्॥
verses.tr: yathābhavadanudeyī tato agramajāyata purastādbudhna ātataḥ paścānnirayaṇaṃ kṛtam
verses.en: When the funeral gift was placed, straightway the point of flame appeared. A depth extended in the front: a passage out was made behind.

verses.sa: इदं यमस्य सादनं देवमानं यदुच्यते । इयमस्य धम्यते नाळीरयं गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ yamasya sādanaṃ devamānaṃ yaducyate iyamasya dhamyate nāḻīrayaṃ gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ
verses.en: Here is the seat where Yama dwells, that which is called the Home of Gods: Here minstrels blow the flute for him here he is glorified with songs.

verses.sa: केश्य१ग्निं केशी विषं केशी बिभर्ति रोदसी । केशी विश्वं स्वर्दृशे केशीदं ज्योतिरुच्यते॥
verses.tr: keśya1gniṃ keśī viṣaṃ keśī bibharti rodasī keśī viśvaṃ svardṛśe keśīdaṃ jyotirucyate
verses.en: He with the long loose locks supports Agni, and moisture, heaven, and earth: He is all sky to look upon: he with long hair is called this light.

verses.sa: मुनयो वातरशनाः पिशङ्गा वसते मला । वातस्यानु ध्राजिं यन्ति यद्देवासो अविक्षत॥
verses.tr: munayo vātaraśanāḥ piśaṅgā vasate malā vātasyānu dhrājiṃ yanti yaddevāso avikṣata
verses.en: The Munis, girdled with the wind, wear garments soiled of yellow hue. They, following the wind's swift course go where the Gods have gone before.

verses.sa: उन्मदिता मौनेयेन वाताँ आ तस्थिमा वयम् । शरीरेदस्माकं यूयं मर्तासो अभि पश्यथ॥
verses.tr: unmaditā mauneyena vātāṃ ā tasthimā vayam śarīredasmākaṃ yūyaṃ martāso abhi paśyatha
verses.en: Transported with our Munihood we have pressed on into the winds: You therefore, mortal men. behold our natural bodies and no more.

verses.sa: अन्तरिक्षेण पतति विश्वा रूपावचाकशत् । मुनिर्देवस्यदेवस्य सौकृत्याय सखा हितः॥
verses.tr: antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpāvacākaśat munirdevasyadevasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ
verses.en: The Muni, made associate in the holy work of every God, Looking upon all varied forms flies through the region of the air.

verses.sa: वातस्याश्वो वायोः सखाथो देवेषितो मुनिः । उभौ समुद्रावा क्षेति यश्च पूर्व उतापरः॥
verses.tr: vātasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhātho deveṣito muniḥ ubhau samudrāvā kṣeti yaśca pūrva utāparaḥ
verses.en: The Steed of Vata, Vayu's friend, the Muni, by the Gods impelled, In both the oceans hath his home, in eastern and in western sea.

verses.sa: अप्सरसां गन्धर्वाणां मृगाणां चरणे चरन् । केशी केतस्य विद्वान्त्सखा स्वादुर्मदिन्तमः॥
verses.tr: apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran keśī ketasya vidvāntsakhā svādurmadintamaḥ
verses.en: Treading the path of sylvan beasts, Gandharvas, and Apsarases, He with long locks, who knows the wish, is a sweet most delightful friend

verses.sa: वायुरस्मा उपामन्थत्पिनष्टि स्मा कुनन्नमा । केशी विषस्य पात्रेण यद्रुद्रेणापिबत्सह॥
verses.tr: vāyurasmā upāmanthatpinaṣṭi smā kunannamā keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yadrudreṇāpibatsaha
verses.en: Vayu hath churned for him: for him he poundeth things most hard to bend, When he with long loose locks hath drunk, with Rudra, water from the cup.

verses.sa: उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः । उतागश्चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः॥
verses.tr: uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā punaḥ utāgaścakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ
verses.en: Ye Gods, raise up once more the man whom ye have humbled and brought low. O Gods, restore to life again the man who hath committed sin.

verses.sa: द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आ सिन्धोरा परावतः । दक्षं ते अन्य आ वातु परान्यो वातु यद्रपः॥
verses.tr: dvāvimau vātau vāta ā sindhorā parāvataḥ dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yadrapaḥ
verses.en: Two several winds are blowing here, from Sindhu, from a distant land. May one breathe energy to thee, the other blow disease away.

verses.sa: आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः । त्वं हि विश्वभेषजो देवानां दूत ईयसे॥
verses.tr: ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase
verses.en: Hither, O Wind, blow healing balm, blow all disease away, thou Wind; For thou who hast all medicine comest as envoy of the Gods.

verses.sa: आ त्वागमं शंतातिभिरथो अरिष्टतातिभिः । दक्षं ते भद्रमाभार्षं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते॥
verses.tr: ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhiratho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ dakṣaṃ te bhadramābhārṣaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te
verses.en: I am come nigh to thee with balms to give thee rest and keep thee safe. I bring thee blessed strength, I drive thy weakening malady away.

verses.sa: त्रायन्तामिह देवास्त्रायतां मरुतां गणः । त्रायन्तां विश्वा भूतानि यथायमरपा असत्॥
verses.tr: trāyantāmiha devāstrāyatāṃ marutāṃ gaṇaḥ trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyamarapā asat
verses.en: Here let the Gods deliver him, the Maruts' band deliver him: All things that be deliver him that he be freed from his disease.

verses.sa: आप इद्वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः । आपः सर्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्ते कृण्वन्तु भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: āpa idvā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ āpaḥ sarvasya bheṣajīstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam
verses.en: The Waters have their healing power, the Waters drive disease away. The Waters have a balm for all: let them make medicine for thee.

verses.sa: हस्ताभ्यां दशशाखाभ्यां जिह्वा वाचः पुरोगवी । अनामयित्नुभ्यां त्वा ताभ्यां त्वोप स्पृशामसि॥
verses.tr: hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī anāmayitnubhyāṃ tvā tābhyāṃ tvopa spṛśāmasi
verses.en: The tongue that leads the voice precedes. Then with our ten-fold branching hands, With these two chasers of disease we stroke thee with a gentle touch.

verses.sa:
तव त्य इन्द्र सख्येषु वह्नय ऋतं मन्वाना व्यदर्दिरुर्वलम् ।
यत्रा दशस्यन्नुषसो रिणन्नपः कुत्साय मन्मन्नह्यश्च दंसयः॥
verses.tr: tava tya indra sakhyeṣu vahnaya ṛtaṃ manvānā vyadardirurvalam yatrā daśasyannuṣaso riṇannapaḥ kutsāya manmannahyaśca daṃsayaḥ
verses.en: Allied with thee in friendship, Indra, these, thy priests, remembering Holy Law, rent Vrtra limb from limb, When they bestowed the Dawns and let the waters flow, and when thou didst chastise dragons at Kutsa's call.

verses.sa:
अवासृजः प्रस्वः श्वञ्चयो गिरीनुदाज उस्रा अपिबो मधु प्रियम् ।
अवर्धयो वनिनो अस्य दंससा शुशोच सूर्य ऋतजातया गिरा॥
verses.tr: avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvañcayo girīnudāja usrā apibo madhu priyam avardhayo vanino asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā
verses.en: Thou sentest forth productive powers, clavest the hills, thou dravest forth the kine, thou drankest pleasant meath. Thou gavest increase through this Tree's surpassing might. The Sun shone by the hymn that sprang from Holy Law.

verses.sa:
