वि सूर्यो मध्ये अमुचद्रथं दिवो विदद्दासाय प्रतिमानमार्यः ।
दृळ्हानि पिप्रोरसुरस्य मायिन इन्द्रो व्यास्यच्चकृवाँ ऋजिश्वना॥
verses.tr: vi sūryo madhye amucadrathaṃ divo vidaddāsāya pratimānamāryaḥ dṛḻhāni piprorasurasya māyina indro vyāsyaccakṛvāṃ ṛjiśvanā
verses.en: In the mid-way of heaven the Sun unyoked his car: the Arya found a match to meet his Dam foe. Associate with Rjisvan Indra overthrew the solid forts of Pipru, conjuring Asura.

verses.sa:
अनाधृष्टानि धृषितो व्यास्यन्निधीँरदेवाँ अमृणदयास्यः ।
मासेव सूर्यो वसु पुर्यमा ददे गृणानः शत्रूँरशृणाद्विरुक्मता॥
verses.tr: anādhṛṣṭāni dhṛṣito vyāsyannidhīṃradevāṃ amṛṇadayāsyaḥ māseva sūryo vasu puryamā dade gṛṇānaḥ śatrūṃraśṛṇādvirukmatā
verses.en: He boldly cast down forts which none had e'er assailed: unwearied he destroyed the godless treasure-stores. Like Sun and Moon he took the stronghold's wealth away, and, praised in song, demolished foes with flashing dart.

verses.sa:
अयुद्धसेनो विभ्वा विभिन्दता दाशद्वृत्रहा तुज्यानि तेजते ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रादबिभेदभिश्नथः प्राक्रामच्छुन्ध्यूरजहादुषा अनः॥
verses.tr: ayuddhaseno vibhvā vibhindatā dāśadvṛtrahā tujyāni tejate indrasya vajrādabibhedabhiśnathaḥ prākrāmacchundhyūrajahāduṣā anaḥ
verses.en: Armed with resistless weapons, with vast power to cleave, the Vrtra-slayer whets his darts and deals fordi wounds. Bright Usas was afraid of Indra's slaughtering bolt: she went upon her way and left her chariot there.

verses.sa:
एता त्या ते श्रुत्यानि केवला यदेक एकमकृणोरयज्ञम् ।
मासां विधानमदधा अधि द्यवि त्वया विभिन्नं भरति प्रधिं पिता॥
verses.tr: etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yadeka ekamakṛṇorayajñam māsāṃ vidhānamadadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnaṃ bharati pradhiṃ pitā
verses.en: These are thy famous exploits, only thine, when thou alone hast left the other bereft of sacrifice. Thou in the heavens hast set the ordering of the Moons: the Father bears the felly portioned out by thee.

verses.sa:
सूर्यरश्मिर्हरिकेशः पुरस्तात्सविता ज्योतिरुदयाँ अजस्रम् ।
तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्त्सम्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः॥
verses.tr: sūryaraśmirharikeśaḥ purastātsavitā jyotirudayāṃ ajasram tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvāntsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ
verses.en: Savitar, golden-haired, hath lifted eastward, bright With the sunbeams, his eternal lustre; He in whose energy wise Pusan marches, surveying all existence like a herdsman.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षा एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
स विश्वाचीरभि चष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम्॥
verses.tr: nṛcakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum
verses.en: Beholding men he sits amid the heaven filling the two world-halves and air's wide region. He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.

verses.sa:
रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभि चष्टे शचीभिः ।
देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhanānām
verses.en: He, root of wealth, the gatherer-up of treasures, looks with his might on every form and figure. Savitar, like a God whose Law is constant, stands in the battle for the spoil like Indra.

verses.sa:
विश्वावसुं सोम गन्धर्वमापो ददृशुषीस्तदृतेना व्यायन् ।
तदन्ववैदिन्द्रो रारहाण आसां परि सूर्यस्य परिधीँरपश्यत्॥
verses.tr: viśvāvasuṃ soma gandharvamāpo dadṛśuṣīstadṛtenā vyāyan tadanvavaidindro rārahāṇa āsāṃ pari sūryasya paridhīṃrapaśyat
verses.en: Waters from sacrifice came to the Gandharva Visvavasu, O Soma, when they saw him. Indra, approaching quickly, marked their going, and looked around upon the Sun's enclosures.

verses.sa:
विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणातु दिव्यो गन्धर्वो रजसो विमानः ।
यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्याः॥
verses.tr: viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyāḥ
verses.en: This song Visvavasu shall sing us, meter of air's mid-realm celestial Gandharva, That we may know aright both truth and falsehood: may he inspire our thoughts and help our praises.

verses.sa:
सस्निमविन्दच्चरणे नदीनामपावृणोद्दुरो अश्मव्रजानाम् ।
प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचदिन्द्रो दक्षं परि जानादहीनाम्॥
verses.tr: sasnimavindaccaraṇe nadīnāmapāvṛṇodduro aśmavrajānām prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadindro dakṣaṃ pari jānādahīnām
verses.en: In the floods' track he found the booty seeker: the rocky cow-pen's doors he threw wide open. These, the Gandharva told him, Rowed with Amrta. Indra knew well the puissance of the dragons.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो ।
बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं१ दधासि दाशुषे कवे॥
verses.tr: agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ1 dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave
verses.en: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.

verses.sa:
पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना ।
पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे॥
verses.tr: pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe
verses.en: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ।
त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ
verses.en: O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

verses.sa:
इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य ।
स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum
verses.en: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

verses.sa:
इष्कर्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसो महः ।
रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिम्॥
verses.tr: iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim
verses.en: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches un der his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः ।
श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā
verses.en: The men have set before them them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.

verses.sa: अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ्नः सुमना भव । प्र नो यच्छ विशस्पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम्॥
verses.tr: agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅnaḥ sumanā bhava pra no yaccha viśaspate dhanadā asi nastvam
verses.en: Turn hither, Agni, speak to us: come to us with a gracious mind. Enrich us, Master of the house: thou art the Giver of our wealth.

verses.sa: प्र नो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः । प्र देवाः प्रोत सूनृता रायो देवी ददातु नः॥
verses.tr: pra no yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ
verses.en: Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Bhaga, and Brhaspati. Let the Gods give their gifts, and let Sunrta, Goddess, grant us wealth.

verses.sa: सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे । आदित्यान्विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: somaṃ rājānamavase'gniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
verses.en: We call King Soma to our aid, and Agni with our songs and hymns, Adityas, Visnu, Surya, and the Brahman Priest Brhaspati.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं सुहवेह हवामहे । यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असत्॥
verses.tr: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ suhaveha havāmahe yathā naḥ sarva ijjanaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asat
verses.en: Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Gods swift to listen, we invoke, That in the synod all the folk may be benevolent to us.

verses.sa: अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय । वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam
verses.en: Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Brhaspati, Vata, Visnu, Sarasvati and the Strong Courser Savitar.

verses.sa: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय । त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifice: Urge givers to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
अयमग्ने जरिता त्वे अभूदपि सहसः सूनो नह्य१न्यदस्त्याप्यम् ।
भद्रं हि शर्म त्रिवरूथमस्ति त आरे हिंसानामप दिद्युमा कृधि॥
verses.tr: ayamagne jaritā tve abhūdapi sahasaḥ sūno nahya1nyadastyāpyam bhadraṃ hi śarma trivarūthamasti ta āre hiṃsānāmapa didyumā kṛdhi
verses.en: With thee, O Agni, was this singer of the laud: he hath no other kinship, O thou Son of Strength. Thou givest blessed shelter with a triple guard. Keep the destructive lightning far away from us.

verses.sa:
प्रवत्ते अग्ने जनिमा पितूयतः साचीव विश्वा भुवना न्यृञ्जसे ।
प्र सप्तयः प्र सनिषन्त नो धियः पुरश्चरन्ति पशुपा इव त्मना॥
verses.tr: pravatte agne janimā pitūyataḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā nyṛñjase pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ puraścaranti paśupā iva tmanā
verses.en: Thy birth who seekest food is in the falling flood, Agni: as Comrade thou winnest all living things. Our coursers and our songs shall be victorious: they of themselves advance like one who guards the herd.

verses.sa:
उत वा उ परि वृणक्षि बप्सद्बहोरग्न उलपस्य स्वधावः ।
उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति मा ते हेतिं तविषीं चुक्रुधाम॥
verses.tr: uta vā u pari vṛṇakṣi bapsadbahoragna ulapasya svadhāvaḥ uta khilyā urvarāṇāṃ bhavanti mā te hetiṃ taviṣīṃ cukrudhāma
verses.en: And thou, O Agni, thou of Godlike nature, sparest the stones, while caring up the brushwood. Then are thy tracks like deserts in the corn-lands. Let us not stir to wrath thy mighty arrow.

verses.sa:
यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि बप्सत्पृथगेषि प्रगर्धिनीव सेना ।
यदा ते वातो अनुवाति शोचिर्वप्तेव श्मश्रु वपसि प्र भूम॥
verses.tr: yadudvato nivato yāsi bapsatpṛthageṣi pragardhinīva senā yadā te vāto anuvāti śocirvapteva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma
verses.en: O'er hills through vales devouring as thou goest, thou partest like an army fain for booty As when a barber shaves a beard, thou shavest earth when the wind blows on thy flame and fans it.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यस्य श्रेणयो ददृश्र एकं नियानं बहवो रथासः ।
बाहू यदग्ने अनुमर्मृजानो न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेषि भूमिम्॥
verses.tr: pratyasya śreṇayo dadṛśra ekaṃ niyānaṃ bahavo rathāsaḥ bāhū yadagne anumarmṛjāno nyaṅṅuttānāmanveṣi bhūmim
verses.en: Apparent are his lines as he approaches the course is single, but the cars are many, When, Agni, thou, making thine arms resplendent, advancest o'er the land spread out beneath thee.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मा जिहतामुत्ते अर्चिरुत्ते अग्ने शशमानस्य वाजाः ।
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व नि नम वर्धमान आ त्वाद्य विश्वे वसवः सदन्तु॥
verses.tr: utte śuṣmā jihatāmutte arcirutte agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ ucchvañcasva ni nama vardhamāna ā tvādya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu
verses.en: Now let thy strength, thy burning flames fly upward, thine energies, O Agni, as thou toilest. Gape widely, bend thee, waxing in thy vigour: let all the Vasus sit this day beside thee.

verses.sa: अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम् । अन्यं कृणुष्वेतः पन्थां तेन याहि वशाँ अनु॥
verses.tr: apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam anyaṃ kṛṇuṣvetaḥ panthāṃ tena yāhi vaśāṃ anu
verses.en: This is the waters' reservoir, the great abode of gathered streams. Take thou another path than this, and as thou listest walk thereon.

verses.sa: आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणीः । ह्रदाश्च पुण्डरीकाणि समुद्रस्य गृहा इमे॥
verses.tr: āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ hradāśca puṇḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gṛhā ime
verses.en: On thy way hitherward and hence let flowery Durva grass spring up Let there be lakes with lotus blooms. These are the mansions of the flood.

verses.sa: त्यं चिदत्रिमृतजुरमर्थमश्वं न यातवे । कक्षीवन्तं यदी पुना रथं न कृणुथो नवम्॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cidatrimṛtajuramarthamaśvaṃ na yātave kakṣīvantaṃ yadī punā rathaṃ na kṛṇutho navam
verses.en: Ye made that Atri, worn with eld, free as a horse to win the goal. When ye restored to youth and strength Kaksivan like a car renewed,

verses.sa: त्यं चिदश्वं न वाजिनमरेणवो यमत्नत । दृळ्हं ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्यतमत्रिं यविष्ठमा रजः॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cidaśvaṃ na vājinamareṇavo yamatnata dṛḻhaṃ granthiṃ na vi ṣyatamatriṃ yaviṣṭhamā rajaḥ
verses.en: Ye freed that Atri like a horse, and brought him newly-born to earth. Ye loosed him like a firm-tied knot which Gods unsoiled by dust had bound.

verses.sa: नरा दंसिष्ठावत्रये शुभ्रा सिषासतं धियः । अथा हि वां दिवो नरा पुन स्तोमो न विशसे॥
verses.tr: narā daṃsiṣṭhāvatraye śubhrā siṣāsataṃ dhiyaḥ athā hi vāṃ divo narā puna stomo na viśase
verses.en: Heroes who showed most wondrous power to Atri, strive to win fair songs; For then, O Heroes of the sky, your hymn of praise shall cease no more.

verses.sa: चिते तद्वां सुराधसा रातिः सुमतिरश्विना । आ यन्नः सदने पृथौ समने पर्षथो नरा॥
verses.tr: cite tadvāṃ surādhasā rātiḥ sumatiraśvinā ā yannaḥ sadane pṛthau samane parṣatho narā
verses.en: This claims your notice, Bounteous Gods! - oblation, Asvins! and our love, That ye, O Heroes, in the fight may bring us safe to ample room.

verses.sa: युवं भुज्युं समुद्र आ रजसः पार ईङ्खितम् । यातमच्छा पतत्रिभिर्नासत्या सातये कृतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ samudra ā rajasaḥ pāra īṅkhitam yātamacchā patatribhirnāsatyā sātaye kṛtam
verses.en: Ye Twain to Bhujyu tossed about in ocean at the region's end, Nasatyas, with your winged steeds came nigh, and gave him strength to win.

verses.sa: आ वां सुम्नैः शंयू इव मंहिष्ठा विश्ववेदसा । समस्मे भूषतं नरोत्सं न पिप्युषीरिषः॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ sumnaiḥ śaṃyū iva maṃhiṣṭhā viśvavedasā samasme bhūṣataṃ narotsaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Come with your joys, most liberal Gods, Lords of all treasures, bringing weal. Like fresh full waters to a well, so, Heroes come and be with us.

verses.sa: अयं हि ते अमर्त्य इन्दुरत्यो न पत्यते । दक्षो विश्वायुर्वेधसे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ hi te amartya induratyo na patyate dakṣo viśvāyurvedhase
verses.en: This deathless Indu, like a steed, strong and of full vitality, Belongs to thee, the Orderer.

verses.sa: अयमस्मासु काव्य ऋभुर्वज्रो दास्वते । अयं बिभर्त्यूर्ध्वकृशनं मदमृभुर्न कृत्व्यं मदम्॥
verses.tr: ayamasmāsu kāvya ṛbhurvajro dāsvate ayaṃ bibhartyūrdhvakṛśanaṃ madamṛbhurna kṛtvyaṃ madam
verses.en: Here, by us, for the worshipper, is the wise bolt that works with skill. It brings the bubbling beverage as a dexterous man brings the effectual strong drink.

verses.sa: घृषुः श्येनाय कृत्वन आसु स्वासु वंसगः । अव दीधेदहीशुवः॥
verses.tr: ghṛṣuḥ śyenāya kṛtvana āsu svāsu vaṃsagaḥ ava dīdhedahīśuvaḥ
verses.en: Impetuous Ahisuva, a bull among cows of his, looked down upon the restless Hawk.

verses.sa: यं सुपर्णः परावतः श्येनस्य पुत्र आभरत् । शतचक्रं यो३ऽह्यो वर्तनिः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ suparṇaḥ parāvataḥ śyenasya putra ābharat śatacakraṃ yo3'hyo vartaniḥ
verses.en: That the strong-pinioned Bird hath brought, Child of the Falcon, from afar, What moves upon a hundred wheels along the female Dragon's path.

verses.sa:
यं ते श्येनश्चारुमवृकं पदाभरदरुणं मानमन्धसः ।
एना वयो वि तार्यायुर्जीवस एना जागार बन्धुता॥
verses.tr: yaṃ te śyenaścārumavṛkaṃ padābharadaruṇaṃ mānamandhasaḥ enā vayo vi tāryāyurjīvasa enā jāgāra bandhutā
verses.en: Which, fair, unrobbed, the Falcon brought thee in his foot, the red-hued dwelling of the juice; Through this came vital power which lengthens out our days, and kinship through its help awoke.

verses.sa:
एवा तदिन्द्र इन्दुना देवेषु चिद्धारयाते महि त्यजः ।
क्रत्वा वयो वि तार्यायुः सुक्रतो क्रत्वायमस्मदा सुतः॥
verses.tr: evā tadindra indunā deveṣu ciddhārayāte mahi tyajaḥ kratvā vayo vi tāryāyuḥ sukrato kratvāyamasmadā sutaḥ
verses.en: So Indra is by lndu's power; e'en among Gods will it repel great treachery. Wisdom, Most Sapient One, brings force that lengthens life. May wisdom bring the juice to us.

verses.sa: इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधं बलवत्तमाम् । यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ khanāmyoṣadhiṃ vīrudhaṃ balavattamām yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim
verses.en: From out the earth I dig this plant, a herb of most effectual power, Wherewith one quells the rival wife and gains the husband for oneself.

verses.sa: उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति । सपत्नीं मे परा धम पतिं मे केवलं कुरु॥
verses.tr: uttānaparṇe subhage devajūte sahasvati sapatnīṃ me parā dhama patiṃ me kevalaṃ kuru
verses.en: Auspicious, with expanded leaves, sent by the Gods, victorious plant, Blow thou the rival wife away, and make my husband only mine.

verses.sa: उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः । अथा सपत्नी या ममाऽधरा साधराभ्यः॥
verses.tr: uttarāhamuttara uttareduttarābhyaḥ athā sapatnī yā mamā'dharā sādharābhyaḥ
verses.en: Stronger am 1, O Stronger One, yea, mightier than the mightier; And she who is my rival wife is lower than the lowest dames.

verses.sa: नह्यस्या नाम गृभ्णामि नो अस्मिन्रमते जने । परामेव परावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि॥
verses.tr: nahyasyā nāma gṛbhṇāmi no asminramate jane parāmeva parāvataṃ sapatnīṃ gamayāmasi
verses.en: Her very name I utter not: she takes no pleasure in this man. Far into distance most remote drive we the rival wife away.

verses.sa: अहमस्मि सहमानाऽथ त्वमसि सासहिः । उभे सहस्वती भूत्वी सपत्नीं मे सहावहै॥
verses.tr: ahamasmi sahamānā'tha tvamasi sāsahiḥ ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvī sapatnīṃ me sahāvahai
verses.en: I am the conqueror, and thou, thou also act victorious: As victory attends us both we will subdue my fellow-wife.

verses.sa:
उप तेऽधां सहमानामभि त्वाधां सहीयसा ।
मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु॥
verses.tr: upa te'dhāṃ sahamānāmabhi tvādhāṃ sahīyasā māmanu pra te mano vatsaṃ gauriva dhāvatu pathā vāriva dhāvatu
verses.en: I have gained thee for vanquisher, have grasped thee with a stronger spell. As a cow hastens to her calf, so let thy spirit speed to me, hasten like water on its way.

verses.sa: अरण्यान्यरण्यान्यसौ या प्रेव नश्यसि । कथा ग्रामं न पृच्छसि न त्वा भीरिव विन्दती३॥
verses.tr: araṇyānyaraṇyānyasau yā preva naśyasi kathā grāmaṃ na pṛcchasi na tvā bhīriva vindatī3
verses.en: Goddess of wild and forest who seemest to vanish from the sight. How is it that thou seekest not the village? Art thou not afraid?

verses.sa: वृषारवाय वदते यदुपावति चिच्चिकः । आघाटिभिरिव धावयन्नरण्यानिर्महीयते॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāravāya vadate yadupāvati ciccikaḥ āghāṭibhiriva dhāvayannaraṇyānirmahīyate
verses.en: What time the grasshopper replies and swells the shrill cicada's voice, Seeming to sound with tinkling bells, the Lady of the Wood exults.

verses.sa: उत गाव इवादन्त्युत वेश्मेव दृश्यते । उतो अरण्यानिः सायं शकटीरिव सर्जति॥
verses.tr: uta gāva ivādantyuta veśmeva dṛśyate uto araṇyāniḥ sāyaṃ śakaṭīriva sarjati
verses.en: And, yonder, cattle seem to graze, what seems a dwelling-place appears: Or else at eve the Lady of the Forest seems to free the wains.

verses.sa: गामङ्गैष आ ह्वयति दार्वङ्गैषो अपावधीत् । वसन्नरण्यान्यां सायमक्रुक्षदिति मन्यते॥
verses.tr: gāmaṅgaiṣa ā hvayati dārvaṅgaiṣo apāvadhīt vasannaraṇyānyāṃ sāyamakrukṣaditi manyate
verses.en: Here one is calling to his cow, another there hath felled a tree: At eve the dweller in the wood fancies that somebody hath screamed.

verses.sa: न वा अरण्यानिर्हन्त्यन्यश्चेन्नाभिगच्छति । स्वादोः फलस्य जग्ध्वाय यथाकामं नि पद्यते॥
verses.tr: na vā araṇyānirhantyanyaścennābhigacchati svādoḥ phalasya jagdhvāya yathākāmaṃ ni padyate
verses.en: The Goddess never slays, unless some murderous enemy approach. Man eats of savoury fruit and then takes, even as he wills, his rest.

verses.sa: आञ्जनगन्धिं सुरभिं बह्वन्नामकृषीवलाम् । प्राहं मृगाणां मातरमरण्यानिमशंसिषम्॥
verses.tr: āñjanagandhiṃ surabhiṃ bahvannāmakṛṣīvalām prāhaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ mātaramaraṇyānimaśaṃsiṣam
verses.en: Now have I praised the Forest Queen, sweet-scented, redolent of balm, The Mother of all sylvan things, who tills not but hath stores of food.

verses.sa:
श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्वृत्रं नर्यं विवेरपः ।
उभे यत्त्वा भवतो रोदसी अनु रेजते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: śratte dadhāmi prathamāya manyave'hanyadvṛtraṃ naryaṃ viverapaḥ ubhe yattvā bhavato rodasī anu rejate śuṣmātpṛthivī cidadrivaḥ
verses.en: I TRUST in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vrtra and didst work to profit man; What time the two world-halves fell short of thee in might, and the earth trembled at thy force, O Thunder-anned.

verses.sa:
त्वं मायाभिरनवद्य मायिनं श्रवस्यता मनसा वृत्रमर्दयः ।
त्वामिन्नरो वृणते गविष्टिषु त्वां विश्वासु हव्यास्विष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ māyābhiranavadya māyinaṃ śravasyatā manasā vṛtramardayaḥ tvāminnaro vṛṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvāṃ viśvāsu havyāsviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Thou with thy magic powers didst rend the conjurer Vrtra, O Blameless One, with heart that longed for fame. Heroes elect thee when they battle for the prey, thee in all sacrifices worthy of renown.

verses.sa:
ऐषु चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सूरिषु वृधासो ये मघवन्नानशुर्मघम् ।
अर्चन्ति तोके तनये परिष्टिषु मेधसाता वाजिनमह्रये धने॥
verses.tr: aiṣu cākandhi puruhūta sūriṣu vṛdhāso ye maghavannānaśurmagham arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medhasātā vājinamahraye dhane
verses.en: God Much-invoked, take pleasure in these princes here, who, thine exalters, Maghavan, have come to wealth. In synods, when the rite succeeds, they hymn the Strong for sons and progeny and riches undisturbed.

verses.sa:
स इन्नु रायः सुभृतस्य चाकनन्मदं यो अस्य रंह्यं चिकेतति ।
त्वावृधो मघवन्दाश्वध्वरो मक्षू स वाजं भरते धना नृभिः॥
verses.tr: sa innu rāyaḥ subhṛtasya cākananmadaṃ yo asya raṃhyaṃ ciketati tvāvṛdho maghavandāśvadhvaro makṣū sa vājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ
verses.en: That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught. Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.

verses.sa:
त्वं शर्धाय महिना गृणान उरु कृधि मघवञ्छग्धि रायः ।
त्वं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्म दयसे विभक्ता॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi rāyaḥ tvaṃ no mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā
verses.en: Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches. Magician thou, our Varuna and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.

verses.sa:
सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा ससवांसश्च तुविनृम्ण वाजम् ।
आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकन्त्मना तना सनुयाम त्वोताः॥
verses.tr: suṣvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasavāṃsaśca tuvinṛmṇa vājam ā no bhara suvitaṃ yasya cākantmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ
verses.en: When we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty. Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.

verses.sa:
ऋष्वस्त्वमिन्द्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ।
गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु बिभृमसि प्रस्रवणे न सोमम्॥
verses.tr: ṛṣvastvamindra śūra jāto dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻhamapsu bibhṛmasi prasravaṇe na somam
verses.en: Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Surya overcome the Dasa races. As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.

verses.sa:
अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वानृषीणां विप्रः सुमतिं चकानः ।
ते स्याम ये रणयन्त सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यं रथोळ्ह भक्षैः॥
verses.tr: aryo vā giro abhyarca vidvānṛṣīṇāṃ vipraḥ sumatiṃ cakānaḥ te syāma ye raṇayanta somairenota tubhyaṃ rathoḻha bhakṣaiḥ
verses.en: Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Rsis' prayer, thyself a Singer May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्मेन्द्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नृभ्यो नृणां शूर शवः ।
तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत त्रायस्व गृणत उत स्तीन्॥
verses.tr: imā brahmendra tubhyaṃ śaṃsi dā nṛbhyo nṛṇāṃ śūra śavaḥ tebhirbhava sakraturyeṣu cākannuta trāyasva gṛṇata uta stīn
verses.en: These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero. Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवमिन्द्र शूर पृथ्या उत स्तवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः ।
आ यस्ते योनिं घृतवन्तमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयन्त वक्वाः॥
verses.tr: śrudhī havamindra śūra pṛthyā uta stavase venyasyārkaiḥ ā yaste yoniṃ ghṛtavantamasvārūrmirna nimnairdravayanta vakvāḥ
verses.en: Listen to Prthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya, Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.

verses.sa:
सविता यन्त्रैः पृथिवीमरम्णादस्कम्भने सविता द्यामदृंहत् ।
अश्वमिवाधुक्षद्धुनिमन्तरिक्षमतूर्ते बद्धं सविता समुद्रम्॥
verses.tr: savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīmaramṇādaskambhane savitā dyāmadṛṃhat aśvamivādhukṣaddhunimantarikṣamatūrte baddhaṃ savitā samudram
verses.en: Savitar fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven steadfast where no prop supported. Savitar milked, as 'twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.

verses.sa:
यत्रा समुद्रः स्कभितो व्यौनदपां नपात्सविता तस्य वेद ।
अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजोऽतो द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम्॥
verses.tr: yatrā samudraḥ skabhito vyaunadapāṃ napātsavitā tasya veda ato bhūrata ā utthitaṃ rajo'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām
verses.en: Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o'erflowed its limit. Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.

verses.sa:
पश्चेदमन्यदभवद्यजत्रममर्त्यस्य भुवनस्य भूना ।
सुपर्णो अङ्ग सवितुर्गरुत्मान्पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानु धर्म॥
verses.tr: paścedamanyadabhavadyajatramamartyasya bhuvanasya bhūnā suparṇo aṅga saviturgarutmānpūrvo jātaḥ sa u asyānu dharma
verses.en: Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy. First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.

verses.sa:
गाव इव ग्रामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान्वाश्रेव वत्सं सुमना दुहाना ।
पतिरिव जायामभि नो न्येतु धर्ता दिवः सविता विश्ववारः॥
verses.tr: gāva iva grāmaṃ yūyudhirivāśvānvāśreva vatsaṃ sumanā duhānā patiriva jāyāmabhi no nyetu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ
verses.en: As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling, As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा त्वाऽऽङ्गिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन् ।
एवा त्वार्चन्नवसे वन्दमानः सोमस्येवांशुं प्रति जागराहम्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitaryathā tvā''ṅgiraso juhve vāje asmin evā tvārcannavase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ prati jāgarāham
verses.en: Like the Angirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement: So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.

verses.sa: समिद्धश्चित्समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन । आदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मृळीकाय न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: samiddhaścitsamidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana ādityai rudrairvasubhirna ā gahi mṛḻīkāya na ā gahi
verses.en: Thou, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods. With the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.

verses.sa: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि । मर्तासस्त्वा समिधान हवामहे मृळीकाय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi martāsastvā samidhāna havāmahe mṛḻīkāya havāmahe
verses.en: Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours. O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.

verses.sa: त्वामु जातवेदसं विश्ववारं गृणे धिया । अग्ने देवाँ आ वह नः प्रियव्रतान्मृळीकाय प्रियव्रतान्॥
verses.tr: tvāmu jātavedasaṃ viśvavāraṃ gṛṇe dhiyā agne devāṃ ā vaha naḥ priyavratānmṛḻīkāya priyavratān
verses.en: I laud thee Jatavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song. Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवो देवानामभवत्पुरोहितोऽग्निं मनुष्या३ ऋषयः समीधिरे ।
अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मृळीकं धनसातये॥
verses.tr: agnirdevo devānāmabhavatpurohito'gniṃ manuṣyā3 ṛṣayaḥ samīdhire agniṃ maho dhanasātāvahaṃ huve mṛḻīkaṃ dhanasātaye
verses.en: Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Rsis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould. Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं प्रावन्नः कण्वं त्रसदस्युमाहवे ।
अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितो मृळीकाय पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: agniratriṃ bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiraṃ prāvannaḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyumāhave agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḻīkāya purohitaḥ
verses.en: Atri and Bharadvaja and Gavisthira, Kanva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped. On Agni calls Vasistha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.

sections.label: The Shraddha Sukta: hymn to Faith
sections.name: Hymn 151

verses.sa:
५ श्रद्धा कामायनी।श्रधा । अनुष्टुप्।
श्रद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते श्रद्धया हूयते हविः । श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयामसि॥
verses.tr: 5 śraddhā kāmāyanīśradhā anuṣṭup śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi
verses.en: By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up. We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness.

verses.sa: प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः । प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कृधि॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ priyaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvidaṃ ma uditaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give. Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said.

verses.sa: यथा देवा असुरेषु श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे । एवं भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कृधि॥
verses.tr: yathā devā asureṣu śraddhāmugreṣu cakrire evaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvasmākamuditaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras, So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers.

verses.sa: श्रद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते । श्रद्धां हृदय्य१याकूत्या श्रद्धया विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: śraddhāṃ devā yajamānā vāyugopā upāsate śraddhāṃ hṛdayya1yākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu
verses.en: Guarded by Vayu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith. Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith.

verses.sa: श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि । श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह नः॥
verses.tr: śraddhāṃ prātarhavāmahe śraddhāṃ madhyaṃdinaṃ pari śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci śraddhe śraddhāpayeha naḥ
verses.en: Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate, Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.

verses.sa: शास इत्था महाँ अस्यमित्रखादो अद्भुतः । न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन॥
verses.tr: śāsa itthā mahāṃ asyamitrakhādo adbhutaḥ na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana
verses.en: A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe, Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.

verses.sa: स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी । वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः॥
verses.tr: svastidā viśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.en: Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend, May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.

verses.sa: वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज । वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः॥
verses.tr: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja vi manyumindra vṛtrahannamitrasyābhidāsataḥ
verses.en: Drive Raksasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vrtra's jaws: O Vrtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.

verses.sa: वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः । यो अस्माँ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः॥
verses.tr: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ yo asmāṃ abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.

verses.sa: अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधम् । वि मन्योः शर्म यच्छ वरीयो यवया वधम्॥
verses.tr: apendra dviṣato mano'pa jijyāsato vadham vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyo yavayā vadham
verses.en: Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us. Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.

verses.sa: ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते । भेजानासः सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: īṅkhayantīrapasyuva indraṃ jātamupāsate bhejānāsaḥ suvīryam
verses.en: Swaying about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, And shared his great heroic might.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः । त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि॥
verses.tr: tvamindra balādadhi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ tvaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi
verses.en: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth: Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्रासि वृत्रहा व्य१न्तरिक्षमतिरः । उद्द्यामस्तभ्ना ओजसा॥
verses.tr: tvamindrāsi vṛtrahā vya1ntarikṣamatiraḥ uddyāmastabhnā ojasā
verses.en: Thou art the Vrtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament: Thou hast with might upheld the heavens.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्र सजोषसमर्कं बिभर्षि बाह्वोः । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: tvamindra sajoṣasamarkaṃ bibharṣi bāhvoḥ vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā
verses.en: Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee, Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि विश्वा जातान्योजसा । स विश्वा भुव आभवः॥
verses.tr: tvamindrābhibhūrasi viśvā jātānyojasā sa viśvā bhuva ābhavaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might: Thou hast pervaded every place.

verses.sa: सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते । येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: For some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil: To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa: तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वर्ययुः । तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye svaryayuḥ tapo ye cakrire mahastāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven, Who showed great Fervour in their lives, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa: ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः । ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanūtyajaḥ ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away, Or who give guerdon thousandfold, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa: ये चित्पूर्व ऋतसाप ऋतावान ऋतावृधः । पितॄन्तपस्वतो यम ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: ye citpūrva ṛtasāpa ṛtāvāna ṛtāvṛdhaḥ pitṝntapasvato yama tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners, The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa: सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम् । ऋषीन्तपस्वतो यम तपोजाँ अपि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: sahasraṇīthāḥ kavayo ye gopāyanti sūryam ṛṣīntapasvato yama tapojāṃ api gacchatāt
verses.en: Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun, The Rsis, Yama! Fervour-moved, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa: अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गच्छ सदान्वे । शिरिम्बिठस्य सत्वभिस्तेभिष्ट्वा चातयामसि॥
verses.tr: arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve śirimbiṭhasya satvabhistebhiṣṭvā cātayāmasi
verses.en: Arayi, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill. We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.

verses.sa: चत्तो इतश्चत्तामुतः सर्वा भ्रूणान्यारुषी । अराय्यं ब्रह्मणस्पते तीक्ष्णशृण्गोदृषन्निहि॥
verses.tr: catto itaścattāmutaḥ sarvā bhrūṇānyāruṣī arāyyaṃ brahmaṇaspate tīkṣṇaśṛṇgodṛṣannihi
verses.en: Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn. Go, sharp-horned Brahmanaspti and drive Arayi far away.

verses.sa: अदो यद्दारु प्लवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम् । तदा रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गच्छ परस्तरम्॥
verses.tr: ado yaddāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam tadā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram
verses.en: Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,- Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.

verses.sa: यद्ध प्राचीरजगन्तोरो मण्डूरधाणिकीः । हता इन्द्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः॥
verses.tr: yaddha prācīrajagantoro maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ hatā indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbudayāśavaḥ
verses.en: When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast, All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.

verses.sa: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत । देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति॥
verses.tr: parīme gāmaneṣata paryagnimahṛṣata deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imāṃ ā dadharṣati
verses.en: These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round, And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

verses.sa: अग्निं हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु । तेन जेष्म धनंधनम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hinvantu no dhiyaḥ saptimāśumivājiṣu tena jeṣma dhanaṃdhanam
verses.en: Let songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him.

verses.sa: यया गा आकरामहे सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या । तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये॥
verses.tr: yayā gā ākarāmahe senayāgne tavotyā tāṃ no hinva maghattaye
verses.en: Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,- That send us for the gain of wealth.

verses.sa: आग्ने स्थूरं रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अङ्धि खं वर्तया पणिम्॥
verses.tr: āgne sthūraṃ rayiṃ bhara pṛthuṃ gomantamaśvinam aṅdhi khaṃ vartayā paṇim
verses.en: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel.

verses.sa: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: agne nakṣatramajaramā sūryaṃ rohayo divi dadhajjyotirjanebhyaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky, Bestowing light on living men.

verses.sa: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् । बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत्॥
verses.tr: agne keturviśāmasi preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭha upasthasat bodhā stotre vayo dadhat
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine: Watch for the singer, give him life.

verses.sa: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः॥
verses.tr: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ
verses.en: We will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.

verses.sa: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चाऽऽदित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीकॢपाति ॥१॥
verses.tr: yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cā''dityairindraḥ saha cīkḷpāti 1
verses.en: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra form together with Adityas.

verses.sa: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām
verses.en: With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.

verses.sa: हत्वाय देवा असुरान्यदायन्देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः ॥२॥
verses.tr: hatvāya devā asurānyadāyandevā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ 2
verses.en: As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,

verses.sa: प्रत्यञ्चमर्कमनयञ्छचीभिरादित्स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् ॥३॥
verses.tr: pratyañcamarkamanayañchacībhirāditsvadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan 3
verses.en: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.

verses.sa: सूर्यो नो दिवस्पातु वातो अन्तरिक्षात् । अग्निर्नः पार्थिवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sūryo no divaspātu vāto antarikṣāt agnirnaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ
verses.en: May Surya guard us out of heaven, and Vata from the firmament, And Agni from terrestrial spots.

verses.sa: जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवाँ अर्हति । पाहि नो दिद्युतः पतन्त्याः॥
verses.tr: joṣā savitaryasya te haraḥ śataṃ savāṃ arhati pāhi no didyutaḥ patantyāḥ
verses.en: Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased: From failing lightning keep us safe.

verses.sa: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः । चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः॥
verses.tr: cakṣurno devaḥ savitā cakṣurna uta parvataḥ cakṣurdhātā dadhātu naḥ
verses.en: May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight; May the Creator give us sight.

verses.sa: चक्षुर्नो धेहि चक्षुषे चक्षुर्विख्यै तनूभ्यः । सं चेदं वि च पश्येम॥
verses.tr: cakṣurno dhehi cakṣuṣe cakṣurvikhyai tanūbhyaḥ saṃ cedaṃ vi ca paśyema
verses.en: Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see: May we survey, discern this world.

verses.sa: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं प्रति पश्येम सूर्य । वि पश्येम नृचक्षसः॥
verses.tr: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ prati paśyema sūrya vi paśyema nṛcakṣasaḥ
verses.en: Thus, Surya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold, See clearly with the eyes of men.

verses.sa: उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदयं मामको भगः । अहं तद्विद्वला पतिमभ्यसाक्षि विषासहिः॥
verses.tr: udasau sūryo agādudayaṃ māmako bhagaḥ ahaṃ tadvidvalā patimabhyasākṣi viṣāsahiḥ
verses.en: Yon Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high. I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own.

verses.sa: अहं केतुरहं मूर्धाऽहमुग्रा विवाचनी । ममेदनु क्रतुं पतिः सेहानाया उपाचरेत्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ keturahaṃ mūrdhā'hamugrā vivācanī mamedanu kratuṃ patiḥ sehānāyā upācaret
verses.en: I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I: I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will.

verses.sa: मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणोऽथो मे दुहिता विराट् । उताहमस्मि संजया पत्यौ मे श्लोक उत्तमः॥
verses.tr: mama putrāḥ śatruhaṇo'tho me duhitā virāṭ utāhamasmi saṃjayā patyau me śloka uttamaḥ
verses.en: My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen: I am victorious: o'er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme.

verses.sa: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः । इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्ना किलाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnā kilābhuvam
verses.en: Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,- This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife.

verses.sa: असपत्ना सपत्नघ्नी जयन्त्यभिभूवरी । आवृक्षमन्यासां वर्चो राधो अस्थेयसामिव॥
verses.tr: asapatnā sapatnaghnī jayantyabhibhūvarī āvṛkṣamanyāsāṃ varco rādho astheyasāmiva
verses.en: Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror, The others' glory have I seized as 'twere the wealth of weaker Dames.

verses.sa: समजैषमिमा अहं सपत्नीरभिभूवरी । यथाहमस्य वीरस्य विराजानि जनस्य च॥
verses.tr: samajaiṣamimā ahaṃ sapatnīrabhibhūvarī yathāhamasya vīrasya virājāni janasya ca
verses.en: I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives, That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.

verses.sa:
तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुञ्च ।
इन्द्र मा त्वा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमन्तुभ्यमिमे सुतासः॥
verses.tr: tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi sarvarathā vi harī iha muñca indra mā tvā yajamānāso anye ni rīramantubhyamime sutāsaḥ
verses.en: Taste this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers. Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः श्वात्र्या आ ह्वयन्ति ।
इन्द्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्य विद्वाँ इह पाहि सोमम्॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ sutāstubhyamu sotvāsastvāṃ giraḥ śvātryā ā hvayanti indredamadya savanaṃ juṣāṇo viśvasya vidvāṃ iha pāhi somam
verses.en: Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee. O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.

verses.sa:
य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वहृदा देवकामः सुनोति ।
न गा इन्द्रस्तस्य परा ददाति प्रशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मै कृणोति॥
verses.tr: ya uśatā manasā somamasmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti na gā indrastasya parā dadāti praśastamiccārumasmai kṛṇoti
verses.en: Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,- Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.

verses.sa:
अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान्न सुनोति सोमम् ।
निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति ब्रह्मद्विषो हन्त्यनानुदिष्टः॥
verses.tr: anuspaṣṭo bhavatyeṣo asya yo asmai revānna sunoti somam niraratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hantyanānudiṣṭaḥ
verses.en: He looks with loving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma. Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.

verses.sa:
अश्वायन्तो गव्यन्तो वाजयन्तो हवामहे त्वोपगन्तवा उ ।
आभूषन्तस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिन्द्र त्वा शुनं हुवेम॥
verses.tr: aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u ābhūṣantaste sumatau navāyāṃ vayamindra tvā śunaṃ huvema
verses.en: We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses. For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात् ।
ग्राहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम्॥
verses.tr: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kamajñātayakṣmāduta rājayakṣmāt grāhirjagrāha yadi vaitadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam
verses.en: For life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption; Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.

verses.sa:
यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकं नीत एव ।
तमा हरामि निॠतेरुपस्थादस्पार्षमेनं शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva tamā harāmi niṝterupasthādaspārṣamenaṃ śataśāradāya
verses.en: Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already, Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षेण शतशारदेन शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम् ।
शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातीन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम्॥
verses.tr: sahasrākṣeṇa śataśāradena śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram
verses.en: With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him, That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.

verses.sa:
शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ्छतमु वसन्तान् ।
शतमिन्द्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषेमं पुनर्दुः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñchatamu vasantān śatamindrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣemaṃ punarduḥ
verses.en: Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters. Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Brhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!

verses.sa: आहार्षं त्वाविदं त्वा पुनरागाः पुनर्नव । सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च तेऽविदम्॥
verses.tr: āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punarāgāḥ punarnava sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvamāyuśca te'vidam
verses.en: So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed. Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधतामितः । अमीवा यस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā bādhatāmitaḥ amīvā yaste garbhaṃ durṇāmā yonimāśaye
verses.en: May Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Raksas-slayer, drive away The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.

verses.sa: यस्ते गर्भममीवा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये । अग्निष्टं ब्रह्मणा सह निष्क्रव्यादमनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: yaste garbhamamīvā durṇāmā yonimāśaye agniṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā saha niṣkravyādamanīnaśat
verses.en: Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh, The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.

verses.sa: यस्ते हन्ति पतयन्तं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीसृपम् । जातं यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yaste hanti patayantaṃ niṣatsnuṃ yaḥ sarīsṛpam jātaṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo, That which will kill the babe at birth, even this will we drive far away.

verses.sa: यस्त ऊरू विहरत्यन्तरा दम्पती शये । योनिं यो अन्तरारेळ्हि तमितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yasta ūrū viharatyantarā dampatī śaye yoniṃ yo antarāreḻhi tamito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair, That penetrates and licks thy side, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa: यस्त्वा भ्राता पतिर्भूत्वा जारो भूत्वा निपद्यते । प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yastvā bhrātā patirbhūtvā jāro bhūtvā nipadyate prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord, And would destroy thy Progeny, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa: यस्त्वा स्वप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते । प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yastvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi
verses.en: That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee, And will destroy thy progeny, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa: अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि । यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukādadhi yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin, Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात् । यक्ष्मं दोषण्य१मंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: grīvābhyasta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyāt yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇya1maṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine, From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोर्हृदयादधि । यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः प्लाशिभ्यो वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: āntrebhyaste gudābhyo vaniṣṭhorhṛdayādadhi yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ yaknaḥ plāśibhyo vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart, From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्याम् । यक्ष्मं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदाद्भंससो वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadādbhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet, From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: मेहनाद्वनंकरणाल्लोमभ्यस्ते नखेभ्यः । यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: mehanādvanaṃkaraṇāllomabhyaste nakhebhyaḥ yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails, From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: अङ्गादङ्गाल्लोम्नोलोम्नो जातं पर्वणिपर्वणि । यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: aṅgādaṅgāllomnolomno jātaṃ parvaṇiparvaṇi yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint, From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa: अपेहि मनसस्पतेऽप क्राम परश्चर । परो निॠत्या आ चक्ष्व बहुधा जीवतो मनः॥
verses.tr: apehi manasaspate'pa krāma paraścara paro niṝtyā ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvato manaḥ
verses.en: Avaunt, thou Master of the mind Depart, and vanish far away. Look on Destruction far from hence. The live man's mind is manifold.

verses.sa: भद्रं वै वरं वृणते भद्रं युञ्जन्ति दक्षिणम् । भद्रं वैवस्वते चक्षुर्बहुत्रा जीवतो मनः॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam bhadraṃ vaivasvate cakṣurbahutrā jīvato manaḥ
verses.en: A happy boon do men elect, a mighty blessing they obtain. Bliss with Vaivasvata they see. The live man's mind seeks many a place.

verses.sa:
यदाशसा निःशसाभिशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत्स्वपन्तः ।
अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्कृतान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद्दधातु॥
verses.tr: yadāśasā niḥśasābhiśasopārima jāgrato yatsvapantaḥ agnirviśvānyapa duṣkṛtānyajuṣṭānyāre asmaddadhātu
verses.en: If by address, by blame, by imprecation we have committed sin, awake or sleeping, All hateful acts of ours, all evil doings may Agni bear away to distant places.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभिद्रोहं चरामसि । प्रचेता न आङ्गिरसो द्विषतां पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadindra brahmaṇaspate'bhidrohaṃ carāmasi pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatāṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: When, Indra, Brahmanaspati, our deeds are wrongful and unjust, May provident Angirasa prevent our foes from troubling, us.

verses.sa:
अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् ।
जाग्रत्स्वप्नः संकल्पः पापो यं द्विष्मस्तं स ऋच्छतु यो नो द्वेष्टि तमृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam jāgratsvapnaḥ saṃkalpaḥ pāpo yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ sa ṛcchatu yo no dveṣṭi tamṛcchatu
verses.en: We have prevailed this day and won: we are made free from sin and guilt. Ill thoughts, that visit us awake or sleeping, seize the man we hate, yea, seize the man who hateth us.

verses.sa:
देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन्दूतो निॠत्या इदमाजगाम ।
तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchandūto niṝtyā idamājagāma tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Gods, whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction, For that let us sing hymns and make atonement. Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहेषु ।
अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu
verses.en: Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, ye Gods, within our dwelling. May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the Missile borne on wings avoid us.

verses.sa:
हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्र्यां पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने ।
शं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मा नो हिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः॥
verses.tr: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭryāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne śaṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu mā no hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ
verses.en: Let not the Arrow that hath wings distract us: beside the fire-place, on the hearth it settles. May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.

verses.sa:
यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतद्यत्कपोतः पदमग्नौ कृणोति ।
यस्य दूतः प्रहित एष एतत्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: yadulūko vadati moghametadyatkapotaḥ padamagnau kṛṇoti yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave
verses.en: The screeching of the owl is ineffective and when beside the fire the Dove hath settled, To him who sent it hither as an envoy, to him be reverence paid, to Death, to Yama.

verses.sa:
ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयध्वम् ।
संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पतात्पतिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra patātpatiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing, bring ye hither food and cattle, Barring the way against all grief and trouble. Let the swift bird fly forth and leave us vigour.

verses.sa: ऋषभं मा समानानां सपत्नानां विषासहिम् । हन्तारं शत्रूणां कृधि विराजं गोपतिं गवाम्॥
verses.tr: ṛṣabhaṃ mā samānānāṃ sapatnānāṃ viṣāsahim hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛdhi virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām
verses.en: Make me a bull among my peers, make me my rivals, conqueror: Make me the slayer of my foes, a sovran ruler, lord of kine

verses.sa: अहमस्मि सपत्नहेन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षतः । अधः सपत्ना मे पदोरिमे सर्वे अभिष्ठिताः॥
verses.tr: ahamasmi sapatnahendra ivāriṣṭo akṣataḥ adhaḥ sapatnā me padorime sarve abhiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.en: I am my rivals' slayer, like Indra unwounded and unhurt, And all these enemies of mine are vanquished and beneath my feet.

verses.sa: अत्रैव वोऽपि नह्याम्युभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया । वाचस्पते नि षेधेमान्यथा मदधरं वदान्॥
verses.tr: atraiva vo'pi nahyāmyubhe ārtnī iva jyayā vācaspate ni ṣedhemānyathā madadharaṃ vadān
verses.en: Here, verily, I bind you fast, as the two bow-ends with the string. Press down these men, O Lord of Speech, that they may humbly speak to me.

verses.sa: अभिभूरहमागमं विश्वकर्मेण धाम्ना । आ वश्चित्तमा वो व्रतमा वोऽहं समितिं ददे॥
verses.tr: abhibhūrahamāgamaṃ viśvakarmeṇa dhāmnā ā vaścittamā vo vratamā vo'haṃ samitiṃ dade
verses.en: Hither I came as conqueror with mighty all-effecting power, And I have mastered all your thought, your synod, and your holy work.

verses.sa:
योगक्षेमं व आदायाऽहं भूयासमुत्तम आ वो मूर्धानमक्रमीम् ।
अधस्पदान्म उद्वदत मण्डूका इवोदकान्मण्डूका उदकादिव॥
verses.tr: yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyā'haṃ bhūyāsamuttama ā vo mūrdhānamakramīm adhaspadānma udvadata maṇḍūkā ivodakānmaṇḍūkā udakādiva
verses.en: May I be highest, having gained your strength in war, your skill in peace my feet have trodden on your heads. Speak to me from beneath my feet, as frogs from out the water croak, as frogs from out the water croak.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदमिन्द्र परि षिच्यते मधु त्वं सुतस्य कलशस्य राजसि ।
त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरामु नस्कृधि त्वं तपः परितप्याजयः स्वः॥
verses.tr: tubhyedamindra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīrāmu naskṛdhi tvaṃ tapaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: This pleasant meath, O Indra, is effused for thee: thou art the ruling Lord of beaker and of juice. Bestow upon us wealth with many hero sons: thou, having glowed with Fervour, worthest heavenly light.

verses.sa:
स्वर्जितं महि मन्दानमन्धसो हवामहे परि शक्रं सुताँ उप ।
इमं नो यज्ञमिह बोध्या गहि स्पृधो जयन्तं मघवानमीमहे॥
verses.tr: svarjitaṃ mahi mandānamandhaso havāmahe pari śakraṃ sutāṃ upa imaṃ no yajñamiha bodhyā gahi spṛdho jayantaṃ maghavānamīmahe
verses.en: Let us call Sakra to libations here effused, winner of light who joyeth in the potent juice. Mark well this sacrifice of ours and come to us: we pray to Maghavan the Vanquisher of hosts.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य धर्मणि बृहस्पतेरनुमत्या उ शर्मणि ।
तवाहमद्य मघवन्नुपस्तुतौ धातर्विधातः कलशाँ अभक्षयम्॥
verses.tr: somasya rājño varuṇasya dharmaṇi bṛhaspateranumatyā u śarmaṇi tavāhamadya maghavannupastutau dhātarvidhātaḥ kalaśāṃ abhakṣayam
verses.en: By royal Soma's and by Varuna's decree, under Brhaspati's and Anumati's guard, This day by thine authority, O Maghavan, Maker, Disposer thou! have I enjoyed the jars.

verses.sa:
प्रसूतो भक्षमकरं चरावपि स्तोमं चेमं प्रथमः सूरिरुन्मृजे ।
सुते सातेन यद्यागमं वां प्रति विश्वामित्रजमदग्नी दमे॥
verses.tr: prasūto bhakṣamakaraṃ carāvapi stomaṃ cemaṃ prathamaḥ sūrirunmṛje sute sātena yadyāgamaṃ vāṃ prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī dame
verses.en: 1, too, urged on, have had my portion, in the bowl, and as first Prince I drew forth this my hymn of praise, When with the prize I came unto the flowing juice, O Visvamitra, Jamadagni, to your home.

verses.sa:
वातस्य नु महिमानं रथस्य रुजन्नेति स्तनयन्नस्य घोषः ।
दिविस्पृग्यात्यरुणानि कृण्वन्नुतो एति पृथिव्या रेणुमस्यन्॥
verses.tr: vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujanneti stanayannasya ghoṣaḥ divispṛgyātyaruṇāni kṛṇvannuto eti pṛthivyā reṇumasyan
verses.en: O THE Wind's chariot, O its power and glory! Crashing it goes and hath a voice of thunder. It makes the regions red and touches heaven, and as it moves the dust of earth is scattered.

verses.sa:
सं प्रेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गच्छन्ति समनं न योषाः ।
ताभिः सयुक्सरथं देव ईयतेऽस्य विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा॥
verses.tr: saṃ prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣāḥ tābhiḥ sayuksarathaṃ deva īyate'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā
verses.en: Along the traces of the Wind they hurry, they come to him as dames to an assembly. Borne on his car with these for his attendants, the God speeds forth, the universe's Monarch.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिरीयमानो न नि विशते कतमच्चनाहः ।
अपां सखा प्रथमजा ऋतावा क्व स्विज्जातः कुत आ बभूव॥
verses.tr: antarikṣe pathibhirīyamāno na ni viśate katamaccanāhaḥ apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā kva svijjātaḥ kuta ā babhūva
verses.en: Travelling on the paths of air's mid region, no single day doth he take rest or slumber. Holy and earliest-born, Friend of the waters, where did he spring and from what region came he?

verses.sa:
आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गर्भो यथावशं चरति देव एषः ।
घोषा इदस्य शृण्विरे न रूपं तस्मै वाताय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ ghoṣā idasya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Germ of the world, the Deities' vital spirit, this God moves ever as his will inclines him. His voice is heard, his shape is ever viewless. Let us adore this Wind with our oblation.

verses.sa:
मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा ऊर्जस्वतीरोषधीरा रिशन्ताम् ।
पीवस्वतीर्जीवधन्याः पिबन्त्ववसाय पद्वते रुद्र मृळ॥
verses.tr: mayobhūrvāto abhi vātūsrā ūrjasvatīroṣadhīrā riśantām pīvasvatīrjīvadhanyāḥ pibantvavasāya padvate rudra mṛḻa
verses.en: May the wind blow upon our Cows with healing: may they eat herbage full of vigorous juices. May they drink waters rich in life and fatness: to food that moves on feet be gracious, Rudra.

verses.sa:
याः सरूपा विरूपा एकरूपा यासामग्निरिष्ट्या नामानि वेद ।
या अङ्गिरसस्तपसेह चक्रुस्ताभ्यः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ॥
verses.tr: yāḥ sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsāmagniriṣṭyā nāmāni veda yā aṅgirasastapaseha cakrustābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha
verses.en: Like-coloured, various-hued, or single-coloured, whose names through sacrifice are known to Agni, Whom the Angirases produced by Fervour, vouchsafe to these, Parjanya, great protection.

verses.sa:
या देवेषु तन्व१मैरयन्त यासां सोमो विश्वा रूपाणि वेद ।
ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः प्रजावतीरिन्द्र गोष्ठे रिरीहि॥
verses.tr: yā deveṣu tanva1mairayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīrindra goṣṭhe rirīhi
verses.en: Those who have offered to the Gods their bodies, whose varied forms are all well known to Soma,- Those grant us in our cattle-pen, O Indra, with their full streams of milk and plenteous offspring.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिर्मह्यमेता रराणो विश्वैर्देवैः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
शिवाः सतीरुप नो गोष्ठमाकस्तासां वयं प्रजया सं सदेम॥
verses.tr: prajāpatirmahyametā rarāṇo viśvairdevaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ śivāḥ satīrupa no goṣṭhamākastāsāṃ vayaṃ prajayā saṃ sadema
verses.en: Prajapati, bestowing these upon me, one-minded with all Gods and with the Fathers, Hath to our cow-pen brought auspicious cattle: so may we own the offspring they will bear us.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् ।
वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पुपोष पुरुधा वि राजति॥
verses.tr: vibhrāḍbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati
verses.en: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shines o'er many a land.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मन्दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् ।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा॥
verses.tr: vibhrāḍbṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmandivo dharuṇe satyamarpitam amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā
verses.en: Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens, He rose, a light, that kills Vrtras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् ।
विश्वभ्राड्भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat viśvabhrāḍbhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam
verses.en: This light, the best of lights, supreme, all-conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud. All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unfailing victory and strength.

verses.sa:
विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्व१रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः ।
येनेमा विश्वा भुवनान्याभृता विश्वकर्मणा विश्वदेव्यावता॥
verses.tr: vibhrājañjyotiṣā sva1ragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ yenemā viśvā bhuvanānyābhṛtā viśvakarmaṇā viśvadevyāvatā
verses.en: Beaming forth splendour with thy light, thou hast attained heaven's lustrous realm. By thee were brought together all existing things, possessor of all Godhead, All-effecting God.

verses.sa: त्वं त्यमिटतो रथमिन्द्र प्रावः सुतावतः । अशृणोः सोमिनो हवम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyamiṭato rathamindra prāvaḥ sutāvataḥ aśṛṇoḥ somino havam
verses.en: For Ita's sake who pressed the juice, thou, Indra, didst protect his car, And hear the Soma-giver's call.

verses.sa: त्वं मखस्य दोधतः शिरोऽव त्वचो भरः । अगच्छः सोमिनो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ makhasya dodhataḥ śiro'va tvaco bharaḥ agacchaḥ somino gṛham
verses.en: Thou from his skin hast borne the head of the swift-moving combatant, And sought the Soma-pourer's home.

verses.sa: त्वं त्यमिन्द्र मर्त्यमास्त्रबुध्नाय वेन्यम् । मुहुः श्रथ्ना मनस्यवे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyamindra martyamāstrabudhnāya venyam muhuḥ śrathnā manasyave
verses.en: Venya, that mortal man, hast thou, for Astrabudhna the devout, O Indra, many a time set free.

verses.sa: त्वं त्यमिन्द्र सूर्यं पश्चा सन्तं पुरस्कृधि । देवानां चित्तिरो वशम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyamindra sūryaṃ paścā santaṃ puraskṛdhi devānāṃ cittiro vaśam
verses.en: Bring, Indra, to the east again that Sun who now is in the west, Even against the will of Gods.

verses.sa: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ
verses.en: With all thy beauty come: the kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.

verses.sa: आ याहि वस्व्या धिया मंहिष्ठो जारयन्मखः सुदानुभिः ॥१॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ 1
verses.en: Come with kind thoughts, most liberal, rousing the warrior's hymn of praise, with bounteous ones,

verses.sa: पितुभृतो न तन्तुमित्सुदानवः प्रति दध्मो यजामसि॥
verses.tr: pitubhṛto na tantumitsudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi
verses.en: As nourishers we tie the thread, and, liberal with our bounty, offer sacrifice.

verses.sa: उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ॥२॥
verses.tr: uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā 2
verses.en: Dawn drives away her Sister's gloom, and, through her excellence, makes her retrace her path.

verses.sa: आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरेधि ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः । विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत्॥
verses.tr: ā tvāhārṣamantaredhi dhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhi bhraśat
verses.en: Be with us; I have chosen thee: stand steadfast and immovable. Let all the people wish for thee let not thy kingship fall away.

verses.sa: इहैवैधि माप च्योष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः । इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय॥
verses.tr: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ indra iveha dhruvastiṣṭheha rāṣṭramu dhāraya
verses.en: Be even here; fall not away be like a mountain unremoved. Stand steadfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

verses.sa: इममिन्द्रो अदीधरद्ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा । तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवत्तस्मा उ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: imamindro adīdharaddhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā tasmai somo adhi bravattasmā u brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by strong oblation's power. May Soma speak a benison, and Brahmanaspati, on him.

verses.sa: ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे । ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगद्ध्रुवो राजा विशामयम्॥
verses.tr: dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagaddhruvo rājā viśāmayam
verses.en: Firm is the sky and firm the earth, and steadfast also are these hills. Steadfast is all this living world, and steadfast is this King of men.

verses.sa: ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः । ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम्॥
verses.tr: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ dhruvaṃ ta indraścāgniśca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam
verses.en: Steadfast, may Varuna the King, steadfast, the God Brhaspati, Steadfast, may Indra, steadfast too, may Agni keep thy steadfast reign.

verses.sa: ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषाऽभि सोमं मृशामसि । अथो त इन्द्रः केवलीर्विशो बलिहृतस्करत्॥
verses.tr: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā'bhi somaṃ mṛśāmasi atho ta indraḥ kevalīrviśo balihṛtaskarat
verses.en: On constant Soma let us think with constant sacrificial gift And then may Indra make the clans bring tribute unto thee alone.

verses.sa: अभीवर्तेन हविषा येनेन्द्रो अभिवावृते । तेनास्मान्ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभि राष्ट्राय वर्तय॥
verses.tr: abhīvartena haviṣā yenendro abhivāvṛte tenāsmānbrahmaṇaspate'bhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya
verses.en: With offering for success in fight whence Indra was victorious. With this, O Brahmanaspati, let us attain to royal sway.

verses.sa: अभिवृत्य सपत्नानभि या नो अरातयः । अभि पृतन्यन्तं तिष्ठाऽभि यो न इरस्यति॥
verses.tr: abhivṛtya sapatnānabhi yā no arātayaḥ abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭhā'bhi yo na irasyati
verses.en: Subduing those who rival us, subduing all malignities, Withstand the man who menaces, withstand the man who angers us.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा देवः सविताऽभि सोमो अवीवृतत् । अभि त्वा विश्वा भूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā devaḥ savitā'bhi somo avīvṛtat abhi tvā viśvā bhūtānyabhīvarto yathāsasi
verses.en: Soma and Savitar the God have made thee a victorious King All elements have aided thee, to make thee general conqueror.

verses.sa: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः । इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्नः किलाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnaḥ kilābhuvam
verses.en: Oblation, that which Indra. gave and thus grew glorious and most high,- This have I offered, Gods! and hence now, verily, am rivalless.

verses.sa: असपत्नः सपत्नहाऽभिराष्ट्रो विषासहिः । यथाहमेषां भूतानां विराजानि जनस्य च॥
verses.tr: asapatnaḥ sapatnahā'bhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ yathāhameṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ virājāni janasya ca
verses.en: Slayer of rivals, rivalless, victorious, with royal sway, Over these beings may I rule, may I be Sovran of the folk.

verses.sa: प्र वो ग्रावाणः सविता देवः सुवतु धर्मणा । धूर्षु युज्यध्वं सुनुत॥
verses.tr: pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā dhūrṣu yujyadhvaṃ sunuta
verses.en: May Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you according to the Law: Be harnessed to the shafts, and press.

verses.sa: ग्रावाणो अप दुच्छुनामप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । उस्राः कर्तन भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇo apa ducchunāmapa sedhata durmatim usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam
verses.en: Stones, drive calamity away, drive ye away malevolence: Make ye the Cows our medicine.

verses.sa: ग्रावाण उपरेष्वा महीयन्ते सजोषसः । वृष्णे दधतो वृष्ण्यम्॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇa upareṣvā mahīyante sajoṣasaḥ vṛṣṇe dadhato vṛṣṇyam
verses.en: Of one accord the upper Stones, giving the Bull his bull-like strength, Look down with pride on those below.

verses.sa: ग्रावाणः सविता नु वो देवः सुवतु धर्मणा । यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: May Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you as Law commands for him Who sacrifices, pouring juice.

verses.sa: प्र सूनव ऋभूणां बृहन्नवन्त वृजना । क्षामा ये विश्वधायसोऽश्नन्धेनुं न मातरम्॥
verses.tr: pra sūnava ṛbhūṇāṃ bṛhannavanta vṛjanā kṣāmā ye viśvadhāyaso'śnandhenuṃ na mātaram
verses.en: With hymns of praise their sons have told aloud the Rbhus' mighty deeds. Who, all-supporting, have enjoyed the earth as, twere a mother cow.

verses.sa: प्र देवं देव्या धिया भरता जातवेदसम् । हव्या नो वक्षदानुषक्॥
verses.tr: pra devaṃ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam havyā no vakṣadānuṣak
verses.en: Bring forth the God with song divine, being Jatavedas hitherward, To bear our gifts at once to heaven.

verses.sa: अयमु ष्य प्र देवयुर्होता यज्ञाय नीयते । रथो न योरभीवृतो घृणीवाञ्चेतति त्मना॥
verses.tr: ayamu ṣya pra devayurhotā yajñāya nīyate ratho na yorabhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāñcetati tmanā
verses.en: He here, a God-devoted Priest, led forward comes to sacrifice. Like a car covered for the road, he, glowing, knows, himself, the way.

verses.sa: अयमग्निरुरुष्यत्यमृतादिव जन्मनः । सहसश्चित्सहीयान्देवो जीवातवे कृतः॥
verses.tr: ayamagniruruṣyatyamṛtādiva janmanaḥ sahasaścitsahīyāndevo jīvātave kṛtaḥ
verses.en: This Agni rescues from distress, as 'twere from the Immortal Race, A God yet mightier than strength, a God who hath been made for life.

verses.sa:
पतंगमक्तमसुरस्य मायया हृदा पश्यन्ति मनसा विपश्चितः ।
समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो वि चक्षते मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः॥
verses.tr: pataṃgamaktamasurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ
verses.en: The sapient with their spirit and their mind behold the Bird adorned with all an Asura's magic might. Sages observe him in the ocean's inmost depth: the wise disposers seek the station of his rays.

verses.sa:
पतंगो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः ।
तां द्योतमानां स्वर्यं मनीषामृतस्य पदे कवयो नि पान्ति॥
verses.tr: pataṃgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryaṃ manīṣāmṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti
verses.en: The flying Bird bears Speech within his spirit: erst the Gandharva in the womb pronounced it: And at the seat of sacrifice the sages cherish this radiant, heavenly-bright invention.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् ।
स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ
verses.en: I saw the Herdsman, him who never resteth, approaching and departing on his pathways. He, clothed in gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa:
त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहावानं तरुतारं रथानाम् ।
अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुं स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम॥
verses.tr: tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahāvānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājamāśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyamihā huvema
verses.en: This very mighty one whom Gods commission, the Conqueror of cars, ever triumphant, Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarksya for our weal will we call hither.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्येव रातिमाजोहुवानाः स्वस्तये नावमिवा रुहेम ।
उर्वी न पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे मा वामेतौ मा परेतौ रिषाम॥
verses.tr: indrasyeva rātimājohuvānāḥ svastaye nāvamivā ruhema urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vāmetau mā paretau riṣāma
verses.en: As though we offered up our gifts to Indra, may we ascend. him as a ship. for safety. Like the two wide worlds, broad, deep far-extended, may we be safe both when he comes and leaves you.

verses.sa:
सद्यश्चिद्यः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा अस्य रंहिर्न स्मा वरन्ते युवतिं न शर्याम्॥
verses.tr: sadyaścidyaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṃhirna smā varante yuvatiṃ na śaryām
verses.en: He who with might the Five Lands hath pervaded, like Surya with his lustre, and the waters- His strength wins hundreds, thousands none avert it, as the young maid repelleth not her lover.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठताव पश्यतेन्द्रस्य भागमृत्वियम् ।
यदि श्रातो जुहोतन यद्यश्रातो ममत्तन॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgamṛtviyam yadi śrāto juhotana yadyaśrāto mamattana
verses.en: Now lift ye up yourselves and look on Indra's seasonable share. If it be ready, offer it; unready, ye have been remise.

verses.sa:
श्रातं हविरो ष्विन्द्र प्र याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनो विमध्यम् ।
परि त्वासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा न व्राजपतिं चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam
verses.en: Oblation is prepared: come to us, Indra; the Sun hath travelled over half his journey. Friends with their stores are sitting round thee waiting like lords of clans for the tribe's wandering chieftain.

verses.sa:
श्रातं मन्य ऊधनि श्रातमग्नौ सुश्रातं मन्ये तदृतं नवीयः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य दध्नः पिबेन्द्र वज्रिन्पुरुकृज्जुषाणः॥
verses.tr: śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśrātaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrinpurukṛjjuṣāṇaḥ
verses.en: Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well-dressed, I fancy, is this recent present. Drink, Indra, of the curd of noon's libation with favour, Thunderer, thou whose deeds are mighty.

verses.sa:
प्र ससाहिषे पुरुहूत शत्रूञ्ज्येष्ठस्ते शुष्म इह रातिरस्तु ।
इन्द्रा भर दक्षिणेना वसूनि पतिः सिन्धूनामसि रेवतीनाम्॥
verses.tr: pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūñjyeṣṭhaste śuṣma iha rātirastu indrā bhara dakṣiṇenā vasūni patiḥ sindhūnāmasi revatīnām
verses.en: O MUCH-INVOKED, thou hast subdued thy foemen: thy might is loftiest; here display thy bounty. In thy right hand, O Indra, bring us treasures: thou art the Lord of rivers filled with riches.

verses.sa:
मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः ।
सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून्ताळ्हि वि मृधो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūntāḻhi vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.en: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bold and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्षत्रमभि वाममोजोऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् ।
अपानुदो जनममित्रयन्तमुरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोरु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: indra kṣatramabhi vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām apānudo janamamitrayantamuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam
verses.en: Thou, mighty Indra, sprangest into being as strength for lovely lordship o'er the people. Thou drovest off the folk who were unfriendly, and to the Gods thou gavest room and freedom.

verses.sa:
प्रथश्च यस्य सप्रथश्च नामाऽऽनुष्टुभस्य हविषो हविर्यत् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णो रथंतरमा जभारा वसिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: prathaśca yasya saprathaśca nāmā''nuṣṭubhasya haviṣo haviryat dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇo rathaṃtaramā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Vasistha mastered the Rathantara, took it from radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Visnu, Oblation, portion of fourfold oblation, known by the names of Saprathas and Prathas.

verses.sa:
अविन्दन्ते अतिहितं यदासीद्यज्ञस्य धाम परमं गुहा यत् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोर्भरद्वाजो बृहदा चक्रे अग्नेः॥
verses.tr: avindante atihitaṃ yadāsīdyajñasya dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorbharadvājo bṛhadā cakre agneḥ
verses.en: These sages found what lay remote and hidden, the sacrifice's loftiest secret essence. From radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Visnu, from Agni, Bharadvaja brought the Brhat.

verses.sa:
तेऽविन्दन्मनसा दीध्याना यजुः ष्कन्नं प्रथमं देवयानम् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोरा सूर्यादभरन्घर्ममेते॥
verses.tr: te'vindanmanasā dīdhyānā yajuḥ ṣkannaṃ prathamaṃ devayānam dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorā sūryādabharangharmamete
verses.en: They found with mental eyes the earliest Yajus, a pathway to the Gods, that had descended. From radiant Dhitar, Savitar, and Visnu, from Surya did these sages bring the Gharma.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नयतु दुर्गहा तिरः पुनर्नेषदघशंसाय मन्म ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnayatu durgahā tiraḥ punarneṣadaghaśaṃsāya manma kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: Brhaspati lead us safely over troubless and turn his evil thought against the sinner; Repel the curse, and drive away ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort!

verses.sa:
नराशंसो नोऽवतु प्रयाजे शं नो अस्त्वनुयाजो हवेषु ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃso no'vatu prayāje śaṃ no astvanuyājo haveṣu kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: May Naratarhsa aid us at Prayaja: blest be our Anuyaja at invokings. May he repel the curse, and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
तपुर्मूर्धा तपतु रक्षसो ये ब्रह्मद्विषः शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः॥
