verses.tr: tapurmūrdhā tapatu rakṣaso ye brahmadviṣaḥ śarave hantavā u kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: May he whose head is flaming burn the demons, haters of prayer, so that the arrow slay them. May he repel the curse and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो विभूतम् ।
इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma
verses.en: I SAW thee meditating in thy spirit what sprang from Fervour and hath thence developed. Bestowing offspring here, bestowing riches, spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनू ऋत्व्ये नाधमानाम् ।
उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nādhamānām upa māmuccā yuvatirbabhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme
verses.en: I saw thee pondering in thine heart, and praying that in due time thy body might be fruitful. Come as a youthful woman, rise to meet me: spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

verses.sa:
अहं गर्भमदधामोषधीष्वहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः ।
अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषु पुत्रान्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ garbhamadadhāmoṣadhīṣvahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān
verses.en: In plants and herbs, in all existent beings I have deposited the germ of increase. All progeny on earth have I engendered, and sons in women who will be hereafter.

verses.sa: विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु । आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते॥
verses.tr: viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te
verses.en: May Visnu form and mould the womb, may Tvastar duly shape the forms, Prajapati infuse the stream, and Dhatar lay the germ for thee.

verses.sa: गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति । गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा॥
verses.tr: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā
verses.en: O Sinivali, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvati: May the Twain Gods bestow the germ, the Asvins crowned with lotuses.

verses.sa: हिरण्ययी अरणी यं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना । तं तत गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayī araṇī yaṃ nirmanthato aśvinā taṃ tata garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave
verses.en: That which the Asvins Twain rub forth with the attrition-sticks of gold,- That germ of thine we invocate, that in the tenth month thou mayst bear.

verses.sa: महि त्रीणामवोऽस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य॥
verses.tr: mahi trīṇāmavo'stu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya
verses.en: Great, unassailable must he the heavenly favour of' Three Gods, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa: नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु । ईशे रिपुरघशंसः॥
verses.tr: nahi teṣāmamā cana nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu īśe ripuraghaśaṃsaḥ
verses.en: O'er these, neither at home nor yet abroad or pathways that are Strange, The evil-minded foe hath power

verses.sa: यस्मै पुत्रासो अदितेः प्र जीवसे मर्त्याय । ज्योतिर्यच्छन्त्यजस्रम्॥
verses.tr: yasmai putrāso aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya jyotiryacchantyajasram
verses.en: Nor over him, the man on whom the Sons of Aditi bestow Eternal light that he may live.

verses.sa: वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: Filling our hearts with health and joy, may Vata breathe his balm on us May he prolong our days of life.

verses.sa: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा । स नो जीवातवे कृधि॥
verses.tr: uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā sa no jīvātave kṛdhi
verses.en: Thou art our Father, Vata, yea, thou art a Brother and a friend, So give us strength that we may live.

verses.sa: यददो वात ते गृहे३ऽमृतस्य निधिर्हितः । ततो नो देहि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yadado vāta te gṛhe3'mṛtasya nidhirhitaḥ tato no dehi jīvase
verses.en: The store of Amrta laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home,- Give us thereof that we may live.

verses.sa: प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: prāgnaye vācamīraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: To Agni send I forth my song, to him the Bull of all the folk: So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa: यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatastiro dhanvātirocate sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Who from the distance far away shines brilliantly across the wastes: So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa: यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वृषा शुक्रेण शोचिषा । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: The Bull with brightly-gleaming flame who utterly consumes the fiends So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Who looks on all existing things and comprehends them with his view: So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa: यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnirajāyata sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Resplendent Agni, who was born in farthest region of the air: So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa: प्र नूनं जातवेदसमश्वं हिनोत वाजिनम् । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: pra nūnaṃ jātavedasamaśvaṃ hinota vājinam idaṃ no barhirāsade
verses.en: Now send ye Jatavedas forth, send hitherward the vigorous Steed To seat him on our sacred grass.

verses.sa: अस्य प्र जातवेदसो विप्रवीरस्य मीळ्हुषः । महीमियर्मि सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḻhuṣaḥ mahīmiyarmi suṣṭutim
verses.en: I raise the lofty eulogy of Jatavedas, raining boons, With sages for his hero band.

verses.sa: या रुचो जातवेदसो देवत्रा हव्यवाहनीः । ताभिर्नो यज्ञमिन्वतु॥
verses.tr: yā ruco jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanīḥ tābhirno yajñaminvatu
verses.en: With flames of Jatavedas which carry oblation to the Gods, May he promote our sacrifice.

verses.sa: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः॥
verses.tr: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
verses.en: This spotted Bull hath come, and sat before the Mother in the east, Advancing to his Father heaven.

verses.sa: अन्तश्चरति रोचनाऽस्य प्राणादपानती । व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम्॥
verses.tr: antaścarati rocanā'sya prāṇādapānatī vyakhyanmahiṣo divam
verses.en: Expiring when he draws his breath, she moves along the lucid spheres: The Bull shines out through all the sky.

verses.sa: त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतंगाय धीयते । प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः॥
verses.tr: triṃśaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṃgāya dhīyate prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ
verses.en: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it rules supreme through thirty realms Throughout the days at break of morn.

sections.label: Order and truth born of fervour
sections.name: Hymn 190

verses.sa: ऋतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात्तपसोऽध्यजायत । ततो रात्र्यजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata tato rātryajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ
verses.en: From Fervour kindled to its height Eternal Law and Truth were born: Thence was the Night produced, and thence the billowy flood of sea arose.

verses.sa: समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवत्सरो अजायत । अहोरात्राणि विदधद्विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी॥
verses.tr: samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī
verses.en: From that same billowy flood of sea the Year was afterwards produced, Ordainer of the days nights, Lord over all who close the eye.

verses.sa: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् । दिवं च पृथिवीं चाऽन्तरिक्षमथो स्वः॥
verses.tr: sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cā'ntarikṣamatho svaḥ
verses.en: Dhatar, the great Creator, then formed in due order Sun and Moon. He formed in order Heaven and Earth, the regions of the air, and light.

verses.sa: संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ । इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर॥
verses.tr: saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā iḻaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara
verses.en: Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend. Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled in libation's place

verses.sa: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।  देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते॥
verses.tr: saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate
verses.en: Assemble, speak together: let your minds be all of one accord, As ancient Gods unanimous sit down to their appointed share.

verses.sa:
समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् ।
समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ saha cittameṣām samānaṃ mantramabhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: The place is common, common the assembly, common the mind, so be their thought united. A common purpose do I lay before you, and worship with your general oblation.

verses.sa: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति॥
verses.tr: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati
verses.en: One and the same be your resolve, and be your minds of one accord. United be the thoughts of all that all may happily agree.
